title: Effects of New Technology Adoption in Korea: Implications for Growth, Employment, and Inequality
affiliations: Yonsei University and Bank of Korea

detail.title: Effects of New Technology Adoption in Korea: Implications for Growth, Employment, and Inequality

publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Korea Economic Research Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper studies how new technologies interact with labor-market frictions to shape aggregate and distributional outcomes in a Korean context. We build a quantitative heterogeneous-agent general equilibrium model with incomplete markets in which households choose between working fixed hours and investing time in learning, subject to convex human-capital adjustment costs. Firms combine capital and effective labor and face quadratic costs of adjusting employment. In the benchmark polarized scenario, long-run output, consumption, and investment all increase, but aggregate employment falls as workers reallocate time from market work toward human-capital accumulation. This reallocation generates endogenous job polarization across skill groups and raises income and consumption inequality. Labor-market frictions are crucial for the magnitude and persistence of these effects: slow, costly skill adjustment amplifies transitional employment losses and distributional gaps. Finally, we show that the sectoral direction of technological change—which skill group the technology favors—plays a central role in shaping both macroeconomic performance and inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含不完全市场的异质性主体一般均衡模型，研究新技术如何与劳动力市场摩擦相互作用，塑造韩国背景下的总量与分配结果。研究发现，在基准极化情景下，长期产出、消费和投资均增加，但总就业下降，工人将时间从市场工作重新配置到人力资本积累，这一过程内生地产生了跨技能群体的就业极化，并加剧了收入与消费不平等。
AI.research_question: 新技术如何与劳动力市场摩擦相互作用，影响总量经济结果和分配结果？
AI.motivation: 理解新技术（如自动化、人工智能）对经济的影响需要超越总量层面，考虑其与劳动力市场摩擦的交互作用，以及在韩国这一具体情境下的分布性后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性主体一般均衡模型（Heterogeneous-Agent General Equilibrium）、不完全市场理论、人力资本积累理论、劳动力市场摩擦理论
AI.method: 构建定量异质性主体一般均衡模型，包含不完全市场、凸人力资本调整成本、企业二次就业调整成本，进行数值模拟分析。
AI.findings: （1）在基准极化情景下，长期产出、消费和投资均增加，但总就业下降；（2）工人将时间从市场工作重新配置到人力资本积累，内生产生跨技能群体的就业极化；（3）收入与消费不平等加剧；（4）劳动力市场摩擦对效应的幅度和持续性至关重要，缓慢且昂贵的技能调整会放大转型期就业损失和分配差距；（5）技术变革的行业方向（技术偏向哪个技能群体）对宏观经济表现和不平等具有核心塑造作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将劳动力市场摩擦引入新技术冲击的研究框架，揭示了摩擦如何放大和延长技术冲击的转型期就业损失与分配差距，并强调了技术变革方向性（技能偏向）作为独立机制的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国等经济体的政策制定者提供关于技术创新与劳动力市场调整的洞见，提示政策需关注技能再培训成本、转型期就业损失以及技术偏向方向对不平等的影响。

title: Good Housing Booms, Bad Housing Booms: Classifying Local Housing-Market Episodes and The Macroeconomic Consequences
affiliations: Yonsei University and Bank of Korea

detail.title: Good Housing Booms, Bad Housing Booms: Classifying Local Housing-Market Episodes and The Macroeconomic Consequences
detail.abstract: How can we distinguish good housing booms from bad ones? We develop a high-frequency classification of local housing-market episodes that separates demand-dominant movements from flow-supply-dominant movements and then distinguishes, within demand-dominant episodes, between housing-service-dominant and valuation-dominant booms. We implement the framework using Korea’s Jeonse system—a lump-sum lease arrangement that provides a market-based, capitalized benchmark for current housing-service value—together with monthly district-level data. Housing-service-dominant booms are followed by higher consumption, employment, and output, whereas valuation-dominant booms are followed by weaker economic activity. Using borrower-level panel data covering 710,000 borrowers per quarter, we show that valuation-dominant episodes are associated with greater household borrowing and lower expenditure. The expenditure decline is larger among borrowers with faster prior debt growth, a pattern consistent with a household balance-sheet channel.

AI.tldr: 本文利用韩国全租房（Jeonse）制度作为住房服务价值的市场化基准，开发了一套高频分类框架，将当地住房市场周期区分为需求主导与供给主导，并在需求主导中进一步区分住房服务主导与估值主导的繁荣。研究发现，住房服务主导的繁荣伴随更高的消费、就业和产出，而估值主导的繁荣则伴随更弱的经济活动；基于71万借款人/季度的面板数据表明，估值主导阶段与更高的家庭借贷和更低的支出相关，且支出下降在债务增长更快的借款人中更为明显，符合家庭资产负债表渠道。
AI.research_question: 如何区分"好"的住房繁荣与"坏"的住房繁荣？不同性质的住房市场繁荣对宏观经济活动和家庭借贷、消费行为有何不同影响？
AI.motivation: 住房繁荣并不总是同质的——有些繁荣伴随着强劲的经济增长，而另一些则与随后的经济衰退相关。现有文献缺乏一个能够区分住房繁荣内在驱动因素（住房服务需求 vs. 资产估值）的高频分类框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 住房市场周期分类理论；住房服务需求与投资/估值需求区分框架；家庭资产负债表渠道
AI.method: 利用韩国全租房（Jeonse）制度所提供的市场化的住房服务价值基准，结合月度区级数据，构建高频住房市场周期分类框架。采用借款人层面的面板数据（每季度约71万借款人）进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）住房服务主导的繁荣之后伴随更高的消费、就业和产出；（2）估值主导的繁荣之后伴随更弱的经济活动；（3）估值主导阶段与更高的家庭借贷和更低的支出相关；（4）支出下降在前期债务增长较快的借款人中更为明显，与家庭资产负债表渠道一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个全新的高频住房市场周期分类框架，能够将住房繁荣细分为住房服务主导与估值主导两种类型，为理解住房市场与宏观经济之间的异质性关系提供了理论基础。同时为家庭资产负债表渠道提供了直接的微观证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了识别"好"与"坏"住房繁荣的工具，有助于在住房市场过热时更精准地采取宏观审慎政策（如信贷管控），避免对健康的住房服务需求增长造成误伤。

title: Ageless Management: A Theory of Cognitive Complementarity, the Audit Value of Experience, and the Lifelong Extension of Brain Capital in the Age of AI

detail.title: Ageless Management: A Theory of Cognitive Complementarity, the Audit Value of Experience, and the Lifelong Extension of Brain Capital in the Age of AI
detail.abstract: This paper presents a theory of Ageless Management: a management regime that removes the variable of chronological age from decisions about role allocation, evaluation, participation, and exit, and instead allocates roles dynamically on the basis of measured cognitive characteristics, accumulated domain experience, health status, and the individual's own volition. Whereas conventional senior-employment and diversity initiatives have rested on a paradigm of accommodation and compensation, this paper envisions a management model that, through bidirectional complementarity between heterogeneous cognitive abilities mediated by AI, converts multigenerational and diverse talent into co-creating agents of a managerial resource: brain capital. The paper's principal axis is the axis of age and experience linking super-seniors (aged 60 to their 90s) and youth; the extension to socially marginalized groups is positioned as a secondary context of generalization, applicable only insofar as the logic of the cognitive bottleneck and AI complementation applies. The theory's point of departure is the following asymmetry. Generative AI lowers the marginal cost of fluid intelligence (Gf)-type tasks and raises the relative marginal value of crystallized intelligence (Gc)-type tasks (contextual interpretation and interpersonal judgment, and above all evaluative and audit-type tasks)—although this rise is conditional on verification actually detecting errors. Under this shift, the "cognitive bottleneck"—whereby difficulty in performing the Gf-type components of a job bundle has forced exit from the job as a whole—can be removed. At the same time, the supervision of AI output retains a residual that cannot be delegated to AI (Human on the Loop: HOTL), and the supply side of supervision as a scarce resource comes into question. This paper conceptualizes this scarce input operationally as "experiential audit capacity"—the capacity to detect contextual errors, practical risks, and ethical risks in AI output—measured by detection performance on verification tasks. The claim that this capacity is formed not by chronological age but by the interaction of domainspecific knowledge and operational schemata (the products of long-term domain experience) with generalized crystallized intelligence and metacognition is placed not in the definition but as a refutable proposition, and constitutes the core of the theory. This formation has boundary conditions: when AI output conforms to the auditor's own received views, the synergy of confirmation bias and automation bias means experience can instead impede detection, and in domains where technological change is rapid and the half-life of domain knowledge is short, the audit effectiveness of experience can decline. Further, the paper formalizes "generational decorrelation"—the tendency of supervisor pools that have lived through different era environments and technological generations to be less likely to share blind spots in judgment—as an organizational supply source of oversight value. Its realization is explicitly conditioned on three requirements: a channel condition, that auditors have unmediated access to raw output; an organizational condition, that power gradients are flattened so that objections reach decision-making; and a model condition, that the AI output under audit is not monopolized by a single foundation model and cross-verification by models from different developers is used in parallel. The claims are consistently conditional. The three social problems of population aging, constrained youth participation, and the exclusion of socially marginalized groups convert into untapped supply sources of brain capital (stock K × utilization rate u) only when the conditions of AI-mediated complementarity and Brain Safety are met; the conversion is not automatic. Moreover, the outcomes of multigenerational staffing are evaluated not solely by the quality of ideas but as net benefit—including the avoidance of excessive risk and the reduction of rework, and net of the cost of decision time required for verification. The paper presents eight definitions; twelve propositions, each with a refutation condition—including the superiority of dynamic role allocation over fixed, chronological-agebased role allocation (Proposition 12)—and three testable hypotheses (brain health, multigenerational team outcomes, and the non-compressibility of experience). Most of the propositions are untested: this paper is not a report of established facts but a proposal of theory equipped with a map of verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"无龄化管理"（Ageless Management）理论：一种将生理年龄从角色分配、评价、参与和退出决策中移除，转而基于认知特征、领域经验、健康状况和个人意愿动态分配角色的管理模式。在生成式AI降低流体智力（Gf）任务边际成本、提升晶体智力（Gc）任务相对价值的背景下，通过AI中介的异质认知能力双向互补，将多代际和多样化人才转化为"脑资本"的共同创造者。该理论以超高龄者（60-90多岁）与青年的年龄-经验轴为主线，提出"经验性审计能力"（experiential audit capacity）作为稀缺监督资源的核心概念，并系统阐述了其形成条件、边界条件及"代际去相关"的组织供应机制。
AI.research_question: 在生成式AI改变认知任务价值结构的条件下，如何构建一种超越生理年龄限制的管理制度，使不同代际（特别是60-90多岁的超高龄者与青年）的异质认知能力通过AI中介实现互补，从而将人口老龄化等社会问题转化为"脑资本"的未被开发的供应来源？
AI.motivation: 人口老龄化、青年参与受限和社会边缘群体排斥是三大社会问题。传统的老年就业和多样性倡议基于"适应与补偿"范式，未从根本上解决认知瓶颈导致的被迫退出问题。生成式AI的出现改变了流体智力与晶体智力任务的边际价值结构，创造了重新设计管理制度的契机——需要一种超越"补偿"逻辑、将多代际人才转化为共同创造者的新管理理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 流体智力（Gf）与晶体智力（Gc）的双因素认知理论；2) 认知瓶颈理论（cognitive bottleneck）；3) Human on the Loop（HOTL）AI监督理论；4) 经验性审计能力理论（领域知识与操作图式×晶体智力×元认知）；5) 代际去相关理论（generational decorrelation）；6) 脑资本理论（stock K × utilization rate u）；7) 确认偏误与自动化偏误的整合视角；8) 净收益评估框架（包含风险评估与返工减少）。
AI.method: 理论构建性论文。提出8个定义、12个命题（每个均附带反驳条件）和3个可检验假设（脑健康、多代际团队结果、经验不可压缩性）。核心主张（经验性审计能力由领域知识与操作图式×晶体智力×元认知形成而非生理年龄）被定位为可反驳命题而非定义。多数命题未经实证检验，论文提供的是带有验证图谱的理论提案。
AI.findings: 该论文是理论提案而非实证报告。核心主张包括：1) 生成式AI降低Gf任务边际成本并提高Gc任务相对价值（前提是验证确实能检测出错误）；2) 认知瓶颈可被移除，但AI输出的监督留存不可委派给AI的残余（HOTL）；3) 经验性审计能力的形成依赖领域知识与操作图式×晶体智力×元认知的交互，而非生理年龄；4) 该能力有边界条件——当AI输出符合审计者固有观点时，确认偏误与自动化偏误的协同可能使经验反而阻碍检测；在技术快速变迁、领域知识半衰期短的领域，经验的审计有效性会下降；5) 代际去相关作为监督价值的组织供应来源，其实现需满足渠道条件、组织条件和模型条件三个要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"无龄化管理"新概念，将年龄从管理决策变量中移除，挑战了传统老年就业的"适应与补偿"范式；2) 形式化"经验性审计能力"概念，将稀缺监督输入操作化为可测量的验证任务检测表现；3) 提出"代际去相关"作为组织供应监督价值的机制，并明确其三个实现条件；4) 构建脑资本框架下的供应来源转化逻辑（K×u），将社会问题重新概念化为未开发的资源；5) 所有命题均附带反驳条件，体现了可证伪性的理论自觉。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为组织提供了超越年龄标签的动态角色分配机制设计蓝图；2) 为超高龄者（60-90多岁）重新参与高价值工作（特别是AI审计与评估类任务）提供理论依据；3) 提出"脑安全"（Brain Safety）与AI中介互补的实现条件，指导实践中的多模型并行交叉验证策略；4) 为多代际团队结果提供净收益评估框架（包含风险规避、返工减少、验证时间成本）；5) 通过代际去相关的三个条件（渠道、组织权力扁平化、多模型验证），为组织在AI治理中设计审计机制提供可操作准则。

title: Competitor Differentiation Through Product Augmentation: A Street Food Case Study of Salad Variety Strategy in Durban

detail.title: Competitor Differentiation Through Product Augmentation: A Street Food Case Study of Salad Variety Strategy in Durban
detail.abstract: This case study examines how small-scale street food operators in Durban achieve differentiation in saturated markets. Drawing from autoethnographic reflection on selling scones in the morning and takeaway meals during the day, the study documents a product augmentation strategy centered on salad variety. While competitors offered a standardized single salad of beetroot or tomato and onion, market observation revealed a gap in diversified salad offerings. I introduced extra takeaway options including coleslaw salad, cabbage and carrot with mayonnaise, and cucumber mixed salad, priced at five rand per portion. Rather than disparaging competitors who held established client relationships, I positioned differentiation respectfully, offering additional choice. The case demonstrates that surveying competitors before market entry and augmenting core products with small, paid extras can drive customer trial and loyalty without price wars or client hijacking. The paper contributes a practical model of respectful differentiation for informal food enterprises.

AI.tldr: 本案例研究通过自我民族志方法，探讨了德班小规模街头食品经营者如何在饱和市场中通过产品增扩策略实现差异化。研究发现，在竞争对手仅提供标准化单一沙拉（甜菜根或番茄洋葱沙拉）的情况下，经营者通过引入多样化沙拉选项（凉拌卷心菜、卷心菜胡萝卜蛋黄酱沙拉、黄瓜混合沙拉，每份5兰特）作为额外付费配菜，实现了有尊严的差异化竞争，而非贬低竞争对手或发动价格战。
AI.research_question: 小规模街头食品经营者如何在饱和市场中实现差异化？具体而言，产品增扩策略（沙拉多样化）如何在不损害竞争对手关系的前提下驱动客户尝试和忠诚度？
AI.motivation: 饱和市场中的小规模街头食品经营者面临激烈竞争，但现有研究缺乏对非正式食品企业差异化策略的实践性洞察。作者通过自身经营实践经验（早晨卖司康饼、白天卖外卖餐）探索可行的差异化路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产品增扩理论（product augmentation）；差异化竞争理论；自我民族志（autoethnography）方法框架。
AI.method: 案例研究法，基于自我民族志反思（autoethnographic reflection），结合市场观察与竞争分析，记录作者在德班经营街头食品摊位的实际经验。
AI.findings: 1) 市场调查发现竞争对手仅提供标准化单一沙拉，存在多样化沙拉供应的市场空白；2) 引入三种额外沙拉选项（各5兰特/份）作为核心产品的付费增扩；3) 通过尊重式差异化（不贬低竞争对手、不抢夺客户），提供额外选择而非价格竞争，成功驱动客户试购与忠诚度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"尊重式差异化"（respectful differentiation）的实践模型，为非正式食品企业的差异化竞争提供了理论框架，补充了产品增扩理论在非正式经济情境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为小规模街头食品经营者提供了可操作的差异化策略：入市前进行竞争对手调研、以小额付费附加品增扩核心产品、在不发起价格战和不抢夺客户的前提下实现市场差异化。

title: Quantifying the Personalization-Compliance Trade-off

detail.title: Quantifying the Personalization-Compliance Trade-off
detail.abstract: The digital economy is fundamentally driven by two competing imperatives: the commercial value derived from hyper-personalized user experiences and the legal and ethical necessity of strict data privacy compliance. Organizations today face a pervasive "personalizationcompliance paradox," where the very data practices that fuel algorithmic relevance and customer engagement are increasingly constrained by a complex web of regulations such as the GDPR and CCPA. Despite extensive discourse on privacy and personalization in isolation, the literature lacks a unified, quantifiable framework that enables organizations to systematically measure, model, and optimize the inherent tension between these two objectives. This research addresses that critical gap by proposing a novel, multi-dimensional metric to operationalize the personalization-compliance trade-off. Drawing upon information economics, privacy engineering, and regulatory theory, we decompose the trade-off into measurable axes: data utility (representing personalization performance), privacy risk exposure, and regulatory adherence cost. Through a mixed-methods approach combining largescale user behavioral experiments, computational modeling of privacy-enhancing technologies (e.g., differential privacy, federated learning), and a comparative legal analysis of compliance overhead, we empirically validate our framework across diverse industry sectors, including ecommerce, digital health, and content streaming. Our findings reveal that the trade-off is nonlinear and highly context-dependent, varying significantly with data type sensitivity, user consent granularity, and jurisdictional regulatory stringency. Critically, we identify threshold effects where marginal gains in personalization incur disproportionately high compliance penalties, and vice versa. The results yield a pragmatic decision-support tool that allows stakeholders to select optimal data processing strategies that balance business value with regulatory safety. By shifting the debate from a binary choice between personalization and privacy to a quantifiable spectrum of strategic trade-offs, this research provides actionable insights for policymakers designing risk-based regulations, engineers building compliant AI systems, and business leaders navigating the ethical data economy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的多维度量化框架，用于衡量和优化"个性化-合规悖论"——即企业在追求超个性化用户体验与遵守数据隐私法规（如GDPR、CCPA）之间的根本张力。通过混合方法（行为实验、隐私增强技术计算建模、法律比较分析），作者将这一权衡分解为数据效用、隐私风险暴露和监管合规成本三个可测维度，并发现该权衡是非线性的、高度依赖情境的，存在阈值效应。最终提供决策支持工具，帮助企业选择兼顾商业价值与监管安全的数据处理策略。
AI.research_question: 如何在系统层面测量、建模并优化个性化服务与数据合规之间的内在张力？即如何将"个性化-合规悖论"转化为可量化的决策框架？
AI.motivation: 企业在数字经济发展中面临双重压力：一方面需要利用用户数据进行超个性化以获取商业价值，另一方面必须严格遵守GDPR、CCPA等隐私法规。尽管已有大量关于隐私和个人化的独立研究，但缺乏一个统一的、可量化的框架来系统性地测量和优化这两者之间的张力，这是现有文献中的关键空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息经济学、隐私工程学、监管理论（三者交叉构建分析框架）
AI.method: 混合方法：1）大规模用户行为实验；2）隐私增强技术（差分隐私、联邦学习）的计算建模；3）合规成本的比较法律分析。跨行业验证涵盖电子商务、数字健康和内容流媒体等领域。
AI.findings: 1）个性化-合规权衡是非线性的且高度依赖情境；2）权衡随数据类型敏感性、用户同意粒度、司法管辖区监管严格程度而显著变化；3）存在阈值效应：个性化收益的边际增长会带来不成比例的高合规惩罚，反之亦然。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"个性化vs隐私"从二元对立叙事转向可量化的权衡谱系，为隐私经济学和监管理论提供了统一的、可操作化的测量框架，填补了文献中缺乏系统性量化模型的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者设计基于风险的监管提供依据；2）为工程师构建合规AI系统提供指导；3）为商业领袖在道德数据经济中导航提供决策支持工具。

title: The Claw Machine Effect: Variable Reinforcement, Near Misses, and Work Intensification in Agentic AI
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Claw Machine Effect: Variable Reinforcement, Near Misses, and Work Intensification in Agentic AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract:
Agentic artificial intelligence can produce substantial gains in speed, output, and problem-solving capacity. Yet the interaction process also creates a distinctive pattern of intermittent outcomes: complete successes, partial progress, plausible near misses, regressions, and failures arrive in an uncertain sequence. This paper introduces the Claw Machine Effect as a theoretical mechanism through which those outcomes may reinforce continued human engagement independently of verified value. The metaphor is intentionally narrower than a claim of addiction. A claw machine combines uncertainty with perceived skill, visible proximity to success, repairable partial progress, and the recurring intuition that one more attempt may complete the task. These features map closely onto human supervision of contemporary AI agents.

The paper integrates research on partial reinforcement, reward prediction error, near misses, social-media reward learning, automation bias, human-AI productivity, software-engineering work, and work intensification. It then develops a formal model distinguishing objective progress, perceived progress, verification debt, and the decision to continue. Seven propositions specify when salient near misses, variable outcomes, rising verification complexity, and concurrent agents should extend sessions or widen the gap between perceived and verified value. An illustrative Monte Carlo analysis runs 100,000 simulated sessions in each of four scenarios. Relative to a calibrated variable-outcome baseline, adding a salient near-miss premium raises simulated completion from 13.0% to 19.0% and sessions exceeding 20 attempts from 3.4% to 6.4%, while mean objective value falls from 0.120 to 0.117 model units and a large verification gap emerges. Periodic verified checkpoints reduce sessions exceeding 20 attempts to 2.4% and restore objective value to 0.120, though simulated completion returns to 13.4%. These values are demonstrations of the model's implications, not estimates of human behavior.

The analysis predicts a productivity-burden paradox: AI can genuinely accelerate work while also increasing verification, concurrency, after-hours extension, and organizational expectations. Because many business models benefit from repeated attempts, token consumption, retention, or apparent throughput, the resulting incentive wedge does not require intentional addictive design. The paper concludes with testable hypotheses, experimental and field-study designs, and implications for product metrics, organizational governance, and terminology. In particular, it recommends agentic over-engagement and verification fatigue for workplace phenomena, reserving clinical terms such as psychosis and addiction for evidence that meets diagnostic and causal standards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"夹娃娃机效应"（Claw Machine Effect）作为理论机制，解释智能体AI（Agentic AI）的间歇性结果（成功、部分进展、近失、回退、失败）如何强化人类的持续投入——即使这种投入超出已验证的价值。通过整合部分强化、奖励预测误差、近失效应等理论，构建形式化模型区分客观进展、感知进展、验证债务与继续决策，并提出七项命题。蒙特卡洛模拟（四场景各10万次）演示了模型含义：近失溢价提升完成率但降低客观价值并产生验证缺口；定期验证检查点可缓解过度投入。论文预测"生产力-负担悖论"，并建议使用"代理式过度参与"和"验证疲劳"等术语，而非临床术语。
AI.research_question: 智能体AI如何通过间歇性结果（成功、近失、部分进展、回退、失败的不确定序列）强化人类持续投入，且这种强化可能独立于已验证的实际价值？
AI.motivation: 智能体AI在提升速度、产出和问题解决能力的同时，其交互过程产生独特的间歇性结果模式。现有研究缺乏一个统一的理论框架来解释这种间歇性结果如何驱动人类持续参与，以及这种参与如何可能在缺乏已验证价值的情况下被强化。作者希望超越简单的"成瘾"论断，提供更精确的机制性理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了以下理论：部分强化（partial reinforcement）、奖励预测误差（reward prediction error）、近失效应（near misses）、社交媒体奖励学习、自动化偏见（automation bias）、人机AI生产力、软件工程工作、工作强化（work intensification）。核心隐喻为"夹娃娃机效应"：不确定性结合感知技能、可见的接近成功、可修复的部分进展、以及"再来一次"的直觉。
AI.method: 1) 理论整合与形式化建模：区分客观进展、感知进展、验证债务和继续决策；2) 提出七项可检验命题；3) 蒙特卡洛模拟分析：在四个场景中各运行100,000次模拟会话，比较基线、近失溢价、验证检查点等场景的完成率、长会话比例和客观价值。
AI.findings: 1) 近失溢价场景下：模拟完成率从13.0%升至19.0%，超过20次尝试的会话从3.4%升至6.4%，但平均客观价值从0.120降至0.117，并出现较大验证缺口；2) 定期验证检查点场景下：超过20次尝试的会话降至2.4%，客观价值恢复至0.120，但完成率回落至13.4%；3) 预测"生产力-负担悖论"：AI可真正加速工作，同时增加验证负担、并发性、下班后延伸和组织期望。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"夹娃娃机效应"作为新的理论机制，解释AI代理交互中的持续投入强化，比"成瘾"论断更精确；2) 构建形式化模型区分客观进展、感知进展和验证债务，为理解人机AI交互中的价值感知偏差提供分析框架；3) 整合多学科理论（学习、决策、自动化、软件工程、组织行为）建立跨领域理论桥梁；4) 揭示"生产力-负担悖论"作为结构性现象，而非个别偏差。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供可测试的假设及实验和现场研究设计，供从业者验证；2) 对产品指标提出建议，警示仅关注token消耗、留存率等表面指标可能掩盖验证债务；3) 提出组织治理建议，包括引入定期验证检查点以缓解过度投入；4) 提出术语建议：使用"代理式过度参与"（agentic over-engagement）和"验证疲劳"（verification fatigue）描述工作场所现象，避免滥用临床术语（如精神病、成瘾），除非有符合诊断和因果标准的证据。

title: Co-Location Competition and Customer Diversion: A Multi-Site Qualitative Study of Fashion Designers, Salons and Wedding Bakers in Durban

detail.title: Co-Location Competition and Customer Diversion: A Multi-Site Qualitative Study of Fashion Designers, Salons and Wedding Bakers in Durban
detail.abstract: This study explores customer diversion tactics within co-located micro-enterprises in Durban. Based on semi-structured interviews with ten small business operators across three commercial buildings, the study examines how intra-sector competition influences client acquisition strategies. The sample includes four fashion designers (Building A), two wedding cake bakers (Building B), and four salon operators (Building C). Data was gathered through direct fieldwork in July-August 2026 involving in-depth interviews about pricing, client acquisition, and service differentiation. Findings indicate that economic survival anxiety drives three distinct forms of diversion: price-based undercutting, quality failures from non-specialist interception, and bundled service promises. While providing shortterm liquidity, these practices were reported to erode collective market trust and cause reputational damage to non-involved providers. The paper contributes empirical evidence on co-location competition and offers recommendations for formalizing conduct in shared commercial spaces.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于对德班三个商业建筑中十家微型企业运营者的半结构化访谈，探讨了共址微型企业中的客户分流策略。研究发现经济生存焦虑驱动三种分流形式：基于价格的削价、非专业拦截造成的质量失败以及捆绑服务承诺。这些做法虽然提供短期流动性，但侵蚀了集体市场信任并对未参与的服务提供者造成声誉损害。
AI.research_question: 共址微型企业如何通过客户分流策略在产业内竞争中获取客户？这些策略对市场信任和声誉有何影响？
AI.motivation: 微型企业共址经营是普遍现象，但关于产业内竞争如何影响客户获取策略的实证研究不足，尤其是客户分流行为及其后果尚未得到充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业内竞争理论、共址聚集理论、经济生存焦虑视角
AI.method: 定性研究方法：对十家微型企业运营者进行半结构化访谈（包括四名时装设计师、两名婚礼蛋糕烘焙师、四名沙龙经营者），在2026年7-8月通过直接实地调研收集有关定价、客户获取和服务差异化的深入访谈数据。
AI.findings: 经济生存焦虑驱动三种客户分流形式：价格削价、非专业拦截导致的质量失败、以及捆绑服务承诺。这些做法在提供短期流动性的同时，侵蚀了集体市场信任，并对无关服务提供者造成声誉损害。
AI.theory_contributions: 为共址竞争提供了实证证据，丰富了微型企业竞争策略与市场信任关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为共享商业空间中正式化行为规范提供了建议，有助于改善共址微型企业的市场竞争环境。

title: Pricing with Customer (Internal vs External) Purchase Records
affiliations: School of Management, University of Science and Technology of China, University of Science and Technology of China - School of Management, School of Management, University of Science and Technology of China, University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) and The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen - School of Management and Economics

detail.title: Pricing with Customer (Internal vs External) Purchase Records
detail.abstract:
Problem Definition: Firms increasingly use customer purchase-record information to implement price discrimination. Some firms adopt a moderate acquisition strategy, relying only on their internal purchase records to distinguish first-time from repurchasing customers, while others pursue a more aggressive strategy by further tracking customers' external purchase records with rivals and offering tailored discounts to competitors' customers. These observations raise a fundamental question: in competitive markets, what drives firms to adopt different purchase record acquisition strategies?
Methodology/Results: We develop a stylized two-period model in which two firms compete, products are horizontally differentiated, and customers make purchases in both periods. Firms determine their strategies for acquiring customer purchase records: no acquisition, internal acquisition, or external acquisition; each acquisition strategy corresponds to a different pricing approach. We show that purchase-record acquisition has a non-monotonic effect on firms' competitive dynamics. In particular, while the transition from no acquisition to internal acquisition softens price competition, the transition from internal acquisition to external acquisition intensifies price competition. In equilibrium, we identify customer farsightedness as a key driver of firms' acquisition strategies. Both firms choose to acquire only internal records when customers are mildly farsighted, whereas they acquire external records from each other when customers are highly farsighted. When customer farsightedness falls within an intermediate range, the two firms adopt asymmetric acquisition strategies---one acquires internal records while the other acquires external records---despite being ex ante symmetric. This differentiation leads the two firms to reward different customer types and derive their profits primarily from different periods.
Managerial Implications: Aggressively acquiring customers' purchase records from rivals does not necessarily generate higher profits, and acquiring only internal records can be rewarding. When facing a rival's internal or external acquisition strategy, a firm can respond with an alternative strategy, which mitigates competition and enables both firms to extract customer surplus at different stages of the customer lifecycle.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个两期双寡头竞争模型，研究企业在竞争市场中采取不同购 买记录获取策略（不获取、仅获取内部记录、同时获取外部记录）的驱动因素与竞争效应。研究发现，购买记录获取对竞争具有非单调影响：从无获取到内部获取会缓和价格竞争，而从内部获取到外部获取则加剧价格竞争。客户远见性是决定企业获取策略的关键因素：低远见性时双方仅获取内部记录，高远见性时双方互取外部记录，中间区间时两家事前对称的企业会采取不对称的获取策略，并在不同时期获取利润。
AI.research_question: 在竞争市场中，什么因素驱动企业选择不同的购买记录获取策略（不获取、仅获取内部记录、或获取外部记录）？
AI.motivation: 现实中企业越来越多地利用客户购买记录实施价格歧视，但不同企业采取了不同的获取策略——有的仅依赖内部记录区分新老客户，有的进一步追踪客户在其他竞争企业的购买记录并针对竞争对手客户提供定向折扣。这一现象缺乏系统的理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两期双寡头竞争模型，产品水平差异化，客户两期均有购买行为。企业可选择三种购买记录获取策略：不获取、内部获取、外部获取，每种策略对应不同的定价方式。
AI.method: 构建一个风格化的两期双寡头竞争模型，通过博弈论分析求解均衡，并考察客户远见性（farsightedness）对企业获取策略选择的影响。
AI.findings: （1）购买记录获取对竞争动态具有非单调影响：从无获取到内部获取缓和价格竞争，从内部获取到外部获取加剧价格竞争。（2）客户远见性是获取策略的关键驱动因素：客户轻度远见时，双方仅获取内部记录；客户高度远见时，双方互相获取外部记录。（3）当客户远见性处于中间区间时，事前对称的两家企业采取不对称获取策略（一家内部获取、一家外部获取），导致它们回报不同类型的客户，利润来源集中于不同时期。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了购买记录获取策略对竞争影响的非单调性，将客户远见性纳入价格歧视与企业信息获取策略的分析框架，并解释了事前对称企业为何会在均衡中出现信息获取策略的不对称分化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供战略启示：激进地从竞争对手处获取客户购买记录并不必然带来更高利润，仅获取内部记录也可能是有利可图的策略；面对竞争对手的获取策略，企业可以选择替代性策略作为回应，从而缓和竞争并在客户生命周期的不同阶段提取客户剩余。

title: Human Capital Accounting and Market Valuation of Football Players: Assessing the Role of Performance Metrics and Intangible Assets on Financial Reporting and Club Value
affiliations: and

detail.title: Human Capital Accounting and Market Valuation of Football Players: Assessing the Role of Performance Metrics and Intangible Assets on Financial Reporting and Club Value

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses publicly available club financial statements and player performance data and involves no human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This research applies the principles of human resource accounting (HRA) and intangible asset valuation frameworks under IAS 38/IFRS to examine the relationship between the quality of player performance metrics, human capital metrics, and the quality of their financial reporting on the market valuation of football players and the financial performance of the leading football clubs in Europe. Based on a dual-level database, composed by 20 leading European clubs (club-level) and by 120 players (player-level) in the season 2023/24, the study constructs a performance-adjusted valuation model for estimating the interconnection between on-field statistics (goals, assists, expected goals, defensive actions, and performance indices imposed on a composite measure) and accounting or financial number (transfer fees, amortization charges, intangible asset values, book values) and financial results (ROA, club market valuation). The Outcome of multiple OLS Regression Models using Robust Standard Errors shows that Performance Index is the most important predictor of player market value (max 0.497, p < 0.01) whereas club revenue is the most important predictor of club market valuation (max 0.009, p < 0.01, R2 = 0.879). The market to book ratio analysis shows systematic difference between economic value and accounting book value based on player age, duration of contract signed, and performance indicators (Adj. R² = 0.363). The Moderated regression shows existence of positive moderating relationship between IFRS compliance and Big4 audit quality with on-field performance and financial outcomes. The findings add to the intersection of sports finance, accounting and human capital theory, stressing the inadequacy of current IAS 38 provisions in capturing the true economic value of football players as human capital assets.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于20家欧洲顶级足球俱乐部和120名球员的双层面数据库（2023/24赛季），运用人力资源会计（HRA）和IAS 38/IFRS无形资产估值框架，构建了绩效调整估值模型，探讨球员场上表现指标、人力资本指标与财务报告质量对球员市场价值及俱乐部财务绩效的影响。研究发现绩效指数是球员市场价值最重要的预测因子（β=0.497），俱乐部收入是俱乐部市场价值最重要的预测因子（R²=0.879），市场与账面价值比率分析显示出经济价值与会计账面价值的系统性差异，且IFRS合规与四大审计质量对场上表现与财务结果存在正向调节作用。
AI.research_question: 球员表现质量指标、人力资本指标与财务报告质量如何影响足球球员的市场估值和欧洲顶级俱乐部的财务绩效？
AI.motivation: 现行IAS 38/IFRS框架未能充分反映足球球员作为人力资本资产的真实经济价值，作者旨在通过结合场上绩效统计与会计财务数据，探索两者之间的互联关系，弥补体育金融、会计与人力资本理论交叉领域的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资源会计（HRA）理论、无形资产估值框架（IAS 38/IFRS）、人力资本理论、市场与账面价值比率分析、调节效应分析
AI.method: 基于20家欧洲顶级俱乐部（俱乐部层面）和120名球员（球员层面）的双层面数据库，构建绩效调整估值模型，采用多元OLS回归模型（使用稳健标准误）以及调节回归分析。
AI.findings: （1）绩效指数是球员市场价值最重要的预测因子（最大β=0.497，p<0.01）；（2）俱乐部收入是俱乐部市场价值最重要的预测因子（最大β=0.009，p<0.01，R²=0.879）；（3）市场与账面价值比率分析显示经济价值与会计账面价值存在基于球员年龄、合同期限和绩效指标的系统性差异（Adj. R²=0.363）；（4）IFRS合规与四大审计质量对场上表现与财务结果存在正向调节关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究将人力资源会计概念扩展到体育产业，揭示了现行IAS 38条款在捕捉足球球员真实经济价值方面的不足，为人力资本理论与体育金融会计的交叉研究提供了实证证据，并提出了绩效调整的估值模型框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为足球俱乐部管理层、投资者和监管机构提供了更全面的球员估值与财务报告改进建议，强调了超越传统会计指标、纳入场上绩效数据的重要性，对俱乐部投资决策、球员转会估值及会计准则改进具有实践指导意义。

title: Mapping the Interaction of Social Media and Sustainable Product Consumption: Trends, Themes, and Future Directions
affiliations: Alliance University, The Icfai University, Alexandria University and M S Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences

detail.title: Mapping the Interaction of Social Media and Sustainable Product Consumption: Trends, Themes, and Future Directions
detail.abstract: Sustainable product consumption has gained prominence worldwide as consumers perceive it as environmentally f riendly and are becoming increasingly aware of environmental degradation. Social media plays a crucial role in increasing public awareness. Owing t o high digital penetration, social media has transf ormed into the most important communication channel in the current context. This study aims to map the interactions among existing literature, theories, and outcomes and to propose f uture directions related to social media and sustainable product consumption through the bibliometric method. 421 articles in Scopus and Web of Science (WOS) f rom 2002 to 2024 have been examined by using the R Bibliometrix and VOSviewer. The trends show that extensive research has been undertaken on the subject f rom 2018 onwards by authors during and af ter the pandemic. The thematic analysis of research papers indicated f ive main research themes: a) social media strategies, b) corporate innovation and social responsibility, c) sustainable development of society, d) changes in consumer behaviour, and e) sustainable supply chain management f or social media and sustainable product consumption research. The drivers and barriers of sustainable product consumption have been discussed. The f indings, along with their theoretical implications, will guide f uture research by consolidating a unif ied body of literature. The Social-Sustainable Resonance Framework of this study will help managers implement innovative social media marketing strategies to enhance sustainable product consumption.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献计量方法，系统梳理了2002至2024年间社交媒体与可持续产品消费领域的421篇文献，识别出五大研究主题，并提出未来研究方向及"社会-可持续共振框架"以指导管理实践。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体与可持续产品消费领域的现有文献、理论与结果之间存在怎样的互动关系？未来研究方向是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着消费者环保意识提升，可持续产品消费受到全球关注，社交媒体已成为重要的传播渠道，但该领域缺乏系统性文献梳理，需要整合现有研究成果并指明未来方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量分析视角，结合主题分析提炼出五大研究主题；提出"社会-可持续共振框架"（Social-Sustainable Resonance Framework）。
AI.method: 文献计量方法（Bibliometric method），使用R Bibliometrix和VOSviewer工具，分析Scopus和Web of Science数据库中2002至2024年的421篇文章。
AI.findings: （1）2018年（含疫情期间及之后）起相关研究大幅增长；（2）识别出五大研究主题：社交媒体策略、企业创新与社会责任、社会可持续发展、消费者行为变化、可持续供应链管理；（3）讨论了可持续产品消费的驱动因素和障碍因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了分散的文献，形成统一的文献体系；提炼五大主题明确了领域结构；提出"社会-可持续共振框架"作为理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: "社会-可持续共振框架"可帮助管理者制定创新的社交媒体营销策略，以促进可持续产品消费。

title: BEFORE THE DASHBOARD: How Frontline Pharmaceutical Work Turned Local Signals into Action Before Modern CRM

detail.title: BEFORE THE DASHBOARD: How Frontline Pharmaceutical Work Turned Local Signals into Action Before Modern CRM

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: his retrospective practitioner case did not involve patients, human research participants, or identifiable personal data. It is based on the author’s professional experience, practitioner recollection, and private employment records. No ethics committee approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper asks a practical question: before modern customer relationship management (CRM) systems, mobile dashboards, and AI-supported field tools, how did pharmaceutical field employees turn scattered local information into useful action? The question is examined through a retrospective practitioner case from India. Surviving Bombay Tablet Mfg. Co. records document the author's entry into pharmaceutical field work as a Trainee Medical Representative in 1998 and his Chandigarh work base. Mandar Pharma records from 2003 document a later Area Sales Manager role based in Chandigarh. A separate contemporaneous Mandar Pharma work letter from August 2003 records participation in a training programme, guidance to Sales Officers, and positive feedback on the author's quality of work. The paper deliberately separates documentary facts from practitioner recollection. The recalled field routine included listening to chemists, meeting doctors, watching local market conditions, checking availability, following up, and later helping field staff improve their work. Existing scholarship already explains adaptive selling, pharmaceutical promotion, market-information collection, and sales technology. The paper therefore makes no claim to have invented those activities. Its narrower contribution is to reconstruct the sequence through which a frontline signal could be noticed, checked, interpreted, acted on, shared, and turned into learning when much of the process depended on people rather than shared digital systems. The case is summarized as a six-step Frontline Learning Cycle: SEE-> CHECK-> UNDERSTAND-> ACT-> SHARE-> LEARN. The cycle is offered as a simple analytical device, not as a validated scale or universal theory. The paper then uses modern CRM and AI-enabled pharmaceutical field tools as a contrast and asks what technology can capture, what it can accelerate, and what still requires human judgment. Possible relevance to medical devices, insurance, FMCG distribution, agricultural extension, and B2B field sales is identified as an agenda for future testing.

AI.tldr: 本文通过印度制药行业的回顾性从业者案例，重构了现代CRM和AI工具出现之前前线医药代表如何将零散的地方信息转化为有效行动的过程，提炼出"前线学习循环"（SEE→CHECK→UNDERSTAND→ACT→SHARE→LEARN）六步分析框架，并与现代技术工具进行对比讨论。
AI.research_question: 在缺乏现代CRM系统、移动仪表盘和AI辅助工具的时代，制药行业前线员工如何将零散的地方信息转化为有用的行动？
AI.motivation: 现有研究已涵盖适应性销售、药品推广、市场信息收集和销售技术等领域，但缺乏对信息从"发现到学习"完整转化过程的序列重建，特别是在高度依赖人际判断而非数字化系统的条件下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 前线学习循环（Frontline Learning Cycle）：SEE→CHECK→UNDERSTAND→ACT→SHARE→LEARN六步分析框架；结合适应性销售、药品促销、市场信息收集和销售技术等既有学术领域。
AI.method: 回顾性从业者案例研究，基于印度Bombay Tablet Mfg. Co.（1998年）和Mandar Pharma（2003年）的文件档案记录，并结合从业者个人回忆，严格区分文件事实与回忆内容。
AI.findings: 识别并重建了前线信号从注意、检查、解释、行动、分享到学习的六步循环过程；论证了在人为主导而非共享数字系统的条件下，一线人员如何完成信息到行动的转化；分析了现代CRM和AI工具能捕捉什么、加速什么以及仍需人类判断的部分。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"前线学习循环"这一简单分析工具，填补了从分散信息到组织学习过程中间环节的序列描述空白；将技术工具的局限性置于与传统人际流程的对比框架中分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗设备、保险、快消品分销、农业推广和B2B现场销售等领域提供了可测试的分析框架；帮助理解现代技术应捕捉与加速哪些环节、哪些环节仍需保留人类判断。

title: Digital Marketing Transformation and Consumer Purchase Behaviour in Post-Pandemic Markets

detail.title: Digital Marketing Transformation and Consumer Purchase Behaviour in Post-Pandemic Markets
detail.abstract: The rapid acceleration of digital marketing channels-including social media advertising, influencer partnerships, and personalised e-commerce experiences-has fundamentally reshaped consumer purchase behaviour in the post-pandemic era. This study examines how digital marketing strategies influence consumer trust, brand loyalty, and purchase intent across different demographic segments, with particular attention to the role of data-driven personalisation and targeted advertising. Drawing on survey data from 428 consumers and engagement analytics from 15 brands operating across multiple digital platforms, the paper investigates which marketing approaches most effectively convert online engagement into sustained purchasing behaviour. The findings reveal that personalisation strategies yield diminishing returns once consumers perceive excessive targeting, highlighting a critical balance point for marketers. The paper offers practical implications for marketing practitioners and contributes to consumer behaviour literature on trust and engagement in digitally-mediated markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于428名消费者的调查数据和15个品牌的多平台参与度分析，探讨后疫情时代数字营销策略如何影响消费者信任、品牌忠诚度和购买意愿，发现个性化策略在消费者感知到过度定向后会呈现边际收益递减，揭示了营销者需要把握的关键平衡点。
AI.research_question: 数字营销策略如何在不同人口统计群体中影响消费者信任、品牌忠诚度和购买意愿？哪些营销方法能最有效地将在线参与转化为持续的购买行为？
AI.motivation: 后疫情时代数字营销渠道（社交媒体广告、网红合作、个性化电商体验）的快速扩张已根本性重塑消费者购买行为，但现有文献对个性化营销的边界效应和对不同人口统计群体的差异化影响缺乏充分理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者信任理论、品牌忠诚度理论、数字媒介市场中的消费者参与理论
AI.method: 混合方法：对428名消费者进行问卷调查，并对15个跨数字平台运营的品牌进行参与度分析（engagement analytics）
AI.findings: 个性化策略在消费者感知到过度定向后会呈现收益递减效应，营销者需要识别这一关键平衡点；不同人口统计群体对数字营销策略的反应存在差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了数字媒介市场中消费者信任与参与行为的文献，为个性化营销的边际效应提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销从业者提供了关于个性化策略与定向广告平衡点的实践指导，帮助优化数字营销资源配置。

title: The Discovery Rate Question are Ideas Getting Harder to Find, or About to Become Easier? Artificial Intelligence, Causal Diagnostics, and Longevity Escape Velocity as a Critical Test Case
affiliations: Anglia Ruskin University

detail.title: The Discovery Rate Question are Ideas Getting Harder to Find, or About to Become Easier? Artificial Intelligence, Causal Diagnostics, and Longevity Escape Velocity as a Critical Test Case

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Whether ideas are getting harder to find is a central unresolved question in the economics of growth, and it has become newly urgent because artificial intelligence plausibly changes the technology through which existing knowledge generates subsequent discovery. This paper states the question formally, argues that longevity escape velocity (LEV) provides an example of a critical empirical test case, and sets out a research programme organised around both. Discovery is modelled as a self-exciting point process whose branching ratio provides a candidate event-time measure of the cumulativeness of a scientific field. Within a benchmark model, LEV becomes a criticality condition: an escape index combining baseline discovery input, translation efficiency, mean intervention effect, and field-level cumulativeness must exceed unity. The programme’s principal theoretical contribution is the mapping from discovery dynamics to an explicit LEV criticality condition and the resulting ordering over research-system instruments. Within this benchmark mapping, the escape index has unit elasticities with respect to baseline discovery input, translation efficiency, and mean intervention effect, whereas its elasticity with respect to the branching ratio diverges as the critical boundary is approached. Under a local cost normalisation, this divergence implies that, for any fixed finite relative cost of raising cumulativeness, there exists a sufficiently near-critical subcritical region in which marginal intervention on cumulativeness dominates marginal intervention on baseline discovery input. Interventions that raise cumulativeness can therefore dominate interventions that raise research scale at the margin, making meta science, measurement infrastructure, reusable knowledge, and causal architecture potentially first-order determinants of discovery rather than supporting activities around it. The paper also positions this programme within the developing literature on causal emergence, predictive coarse-graining, and multiscale effective description. Its contribution is not to propose another general measure of emergence, but to identify a welfare-relevant candidate macro-property of a scientific system and pose the microfoundational question of how lower-level processes of search, recombination, measurement, communication, and validation generate it. The paper specifies four LEV-focused work packages, states conditions under which the programme would be refuted, and locates subsequent theoretical and empirical work within this architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文正式提出了"创意是否越来越难发现"这一增长经济学核心问题，并以"长寿逃逸速度"（LEV）作为关键实证检验案例，构建了一个以发现动力学为基础的研究纲领。论文将科学发现建模为自激点过程，通过分支比衡量科学领域的累积性，推导出LEV临界条件（逃逸指数须大于1），并证明在临界边界附近，提升累积性的干预在边际上优于提升研究规模的干预，从而使元科学、测量基础设施、可复用知识和因果架构可能成为发现的一阶决定因素。
AI.research_question: 创意是否变得越来越难发现？在人工智能可能改变既有知识生成新发现的机制背景下，如何形式化这一问题，并通过长寿逃逸速度（LEV）作为关键实证检验案例来组织研究纲领？
AI.motivation: "创意是否越来越难找到"是增长经济学中尚未解决的核心问题。人工智能的出现可能从根本上改变知识生成新发现的路径，使得这一问题变得更加紧迫。然而，现有文献缺乏一个将发现动态、领域累积性和政策干预统一起来的正式框架，也缺乏一个可检验的临界条件来评估研究体系的"逃逸能力"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文的理论框架包括：(1) 将科学发现建模为自激点过程（self-exciting point process），用分支比（branching ratio）衡量科学领域的累积性；(2) 长寿逃逸速度（LEV）作为临界条件，构建逃逸指数（escape index）综合基线发现投入、转化效率、平均干预效应和领域累积性；(3) 弹性分析揭示各参数对逃逸指数的边际贡献；(4) 与因果涌现、预测粗粒化和多尺度有效描述等文献建立联系。
AI.method: 本文采用理论建模方法，构建了一个基准模型将发现动态映射为显式的LEV临界条件。具体包括：(1) 以自激点过程刻画科学发现的自我激发机制；(2) 定义逃逸指数及其对各参数的弹性；(3) 在局部成本归一化下，比较提升累积性干预与提升研究规模干预的边际效果；(4) 提出四个LEV导向的工作包并设定可证伪条件。
AI.findings: (1) 逃逸指数对基线发现投入、转化效率和平均干预效应具有单位弹性；(2) 逃逸指数对分支比的弹性在接近临界边界时发散；(3) 在局部成本归一化下，任何固定有限相对成本下，存在足够接近临界的亚临界区域，其中对累积性的边际干预优于对基线发现投入的边际干预；(4) 提升累积性的干预可在边际上支配提升研究规模的干预，从而使元科学、测量基础设施等成为发现的一阶决定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将发现动态显式映射为LEV临界条件，为增长经济学提供了可检验的理论基准；(2) 对研究体系内各类工具进行排序（ordering over research-system instruments）；(3) 识别出一个具有福利相关性的"科学系统的宏观特性"，并提出了其微观基础问题；(4) 将增长理论与因果涌现、粗粒化文献连接起来，但不提出新的涌现度量。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为研究政策提供明确指导：在接近临界时，提升累积性（如元科学、测量基础设施、可复用知识、因果架构）比扩大研究规模更有效；(2) 提出四个LEV导向的工作包作为后续实证研究的组织框架；(3) 设定了研究纲领可被否证的条件，为政策制定和科学资助提供可操作的分析框架。

title: Data Analytics Applications in Banking Customer Service and Financial Operations Management
affiliations: Texas State University

detail.title: Data Analytics Applications in Banking Customer Service and Financial Operations Management
detail.abstract: Financial institutions generate large volumes of operational and transactional data related to customer accounts, service interactions, and financial activities. Effective analysis of these datasets supports operational management and helps financial organizations identify service trends and operational challenges. This research examines the application of data analytics techniques in banking customer service and financial operations management. The study introduces a framework that combines transaction data analysis, service request monitoring, and performance reporting to evaluate customer service operations within banking environments. The framework includes structured data processing methods and reporting dashboards that assist banking institutions in monitoring operational performance indicators and customer service outcomes. The results demonstrate that structured data analytics practices provide valuable insights into service operations and customer behavior patterns. The study highlights how data analysis can support decision-making processes and operational improvements within financial institutions. A synthetic dataset is used to demonstrate the framework because proprietary banking operational data were not available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个结合交易数据分析、服务请求监控和绩效报告的框架，用于评估银行客户服务运营，并使用合成数据集验证其有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何应用数据分析技术来评估和改进银行客户服务运营及金融运营管理？
AI.motivation: 金融机构产生大量运营和交易数据，但缺乏系统的分析框架来利用这些数据支持客户服务运营管理和决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据驱动决策理论、运营管理分析框架、客户服务绩效评估理论
AI.method: 构建一个包含交易数据分析、服务请求监控和绩效报告的集成框架，采用结构化数据处理方法和报告仪表盘，并使用合成数据集进行演示。
AI.findings: 结构化数据分析实践能够为银行服务运营和客户行为模式提供有价值的洞察，支持金融机构的决策制定和运营改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合交易数据、服务监控与绩效报告的银行客户服务分析框架，丰富了金融运营管理中数据分析应用的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行等金融机构提供了可操作的数据分析框架和报告仪表盘设计，帮助其监控运营绩效指标和客户服务结果，支撑日常决策与运营改进。由于缺乏专有银行运营数据，使用合成数据集进行演示。

title: The Commercial Coordination Hypothesis: A Layered Model for Value Migration in Cross-Border Payments Infrastructure

detail.title: The Commercial Coordination Hypothesis: A Layered Model for Value Migration in Cross-Border Payments Infrastructure
detail.abstract: Most current thinking on cross-border payments infrastructure is organised around a connectivity question: how quickly and cheaply can domestic instant payment systems be linked. This paper argues that connectivity framing, while directionally correct, understates where durable economic value is likely to accumulate once linkage becomes widespread. The paper draws on the historical evolution of three other network industries (telecommunications, the internet, and civil aviation) to propose a five-layer model of payments infrastructure: rail, signalling and semantics, interconnection, commercial coordination, and orchestration. It argues that the least developed of these, commercial coordination (identity, liability allocation, FX and liquidity provisioning, cross-jurisdiction compliance, and dispute resolution), is structurally analogous to the settlement and governance layer that made civil aviation's interline system commercially viable, and is likely to be the layer that captures the next wave of value in payments. The paper reviews two live initiatives, Project Nexus and Project Agorá, as partial, early evidence consistent with this hypothesis, and identifies three open questions (retail/wholesale divergence, unresolved legal finality for tokenised cross-border settlement, and unresolved governance of the coordination layer itself) that the hypothesis does not yet answer.

AI.tldr: 本文认为跨境支付基础设施的核心价值不在连接层面（如快慢与成本），而在于商业协调层（身份、责任分配、外汇与流动性供给、跨境合规和争议解决），该层在结构上类似民航联运体系的结算与治理层，将是下一波支付价值的主要聚集地。
AI.research_question: 跨境支付基础设施中，一旦各国内快速支付系统实现广泛互联，持久的经济价值将积累在何处？
AI.motivation: 当前关于跨境支付基础设施的主流思考集中于"连接性"问题（如何快速且廉价地连接国内即时支付系统），但这一框架虽方向正确，却低估了互联普及后持久经济价值的真正聚集点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴电信、互联网和民航三个网络行业的历史演进，提出支付基础设施的五层模型：轨道（rail）、信令与语义（signalling and semantics）、互联（interconnection）、商业协调（commercial coordination）和编排（orchestration）。核心类比为民航联运系统（interline system）的结算与治理层。
AI.method: 基于历史比较分析，借鉴三个网络行业的演进经验构建五层模型；并结合两个在运行的倡议（Project Nexus和Project Agorá）作为部分早期证据进行案例检验。
AI.findings: 五层模型中发展最不充分的是商业协调层，该层在结构上类比于使民航联运系统具有商业可行性的结算与治理层，很可能成为支付领域下一波价值的捕获层。现有两个倡议提供了部分一致的早期证据，但仍有三个悬而未决的问题：零售/批发分化、代币化跨境结算的法律终局性未决、以及协调层自身的治理问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个超越传统"连接性"框架的跨境支付五层模型，将商业协调层识别为结构性价值聚集点，并引入民航联运系统作为类比，为理解跨境支付基础设施的价值分布提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、支付基础设施运营商和行业参与者指出了应重点投资和布局的领域（商业协调层），并识别出三个尚待解决的关键开放问题，为跨境支付基础设施的未来发展方向提供了参考。

title: Reproducibility and external threshold-transfer audit of transfer-learning CNNs for pediatric chest X-ray pneumonia detection
affiliations: Ramkhamhaeng University

detail.title: Reproducibility and external threshold-transfer audit of transfer-learning CNNs for pediatric chest X-ray pneumonia detection
detail.abstract: Background and ObjectiveTransfer-learning convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for pediatric chest X-ray pneumonia detection often report strong in-domain performance, but such reports may depend on a single seed, a small validation split, and a fixed 0.5 decision threshold. This study audits whether in-domain model ranking, fixed-threshold behaviour, and probability calibration transfer to an external dataset.MethodsResNet50, DenseNet121, and VGG16 were trained on the Kermany pediatric chest X-ray dataset under two validation protocols and five random seeds. Robust-protocol checkpoints were evaluated externally on the RSNA Pneumonia Detection Challenge dataset under Normal-negative and Combined-negative scenarios. We assessed external discrimination, specificity at the fixed 0.5 threshold, specificity after threshold selection at 95% sensitivity, post-hoc recalibration with temperature scaling, Platt scaling, and isotonic regression, and train-test data integrity.ResultsIn-domain AUC was high for DenseNet121 and VGG16, but external AUC fell to 0.843/0.734 for DenseNet121, 0.781/0.693 for ResNet50, and 0.805/0.690 for VGG16 in the Normal-negative/Combined-negative scenarios. Specificity at the fixed 0.5 threshold was low and architecture-dependent. Re-thresholding to 95% sensitivity changed specificity by +20.2/+14.8 percentage points for VGG16, +5.5/+2.6 for ResNet50, and −6.7/−5.3 for DenseNet121. Raw ECE values of 0.31–0.67 were reduced to approximately 0.02 by Platt scaling or isotonic regression, but Platt scaling did not change specificity at the matched 95%-sensitivity operating point in any of the six architecture-by-scenario cells. Exact train-test duplication was zero.ConclusionsStrong in-domain performance did not reliably predict external operating behaviour. Discrimination, operating-point selection, calibration, and data integrity should be reported separately in transfer-learning pneumonia classifiers. The findings support a reporting standard rather than a clinical-use recommendation or a single best architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文系统审计了迁移学习CNN在儿科胸部X光肺炎检测中的域内性能是否可迁移到外部数据集。研究发现，尽管域内AUC很高，但外部AUC显著下降，固定0.5阈值下的特异度低且依赖架构，重阈值化和校准的效果因模型而异，且数据完整性良好。
AI.research_question: 迁移学习CNN在儿科胸部X光肺炎检测中的域内模型排名、固定0.5阈值行为和概率校准是否能够迁移到外部数据集？
AI.motivation: 现有研究常报告迁移学习CNN在肺炎检测中的强域内性能，但这种报告可能依赖于单一随机种子、小验证集划分和固定0.5决策阈值，缺乏对外部数据集泛化能力和操作行为的系统审计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 迁移学习、卷积神经网络（CNN）、概率校准理论（温度缩放、Platt缩放、等渗回归）
AI.method: 在Kermany儿科胸部X光数据集上训练ResNet50、DenseNet121和VGG16，使用两种验证协议和五个随机种子；在RSNA肺炎检测挑战数据集上进行外部评估，涵盖正常阴性/合并阴性两种场景；评估外部判别力、固定0.5阈值特异度、95%敏感度下阈值选择后的特异度，以及三种校准方法的效果和数据完整性检查。
AI.findings: 外部AUC显著低于域内表现（DenseNet121为0.843/0.734，ResNet50为0.781/0.693，VGG16为0.805/0.690）；固定0.5阈值下特异度低且架构依赖；重阈值化对VGG16（+20.2/+14.8个百分点）和ResNet50（+5.5/+2.6）有利但损害DenseNet121（−6.7/−5.3）；校准可将ECE从0.31-0.67降至约0.02，但Platt缩放不改变匹配95%敏感度工作点的特异度；未发现训练测试重复数据。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了强域内性能并不能可靠预测外部操作行为，提出应将判别力、操作点选择、校准和数据完整性分开报告的迁移学习报告标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为迁移学习肺炎分类器的评估和报告提供了系统的审计框架，警示临床研究者和实践者不要仅依赖域内指标，需分别报告外部判别力、操作点选择和校准表现。

title: Coping with M&A Uncertainty: Cultural Beliefs and TMT Selection in China
affiliations: Southwest Jiaotong University, Southwest Jiaotong University, Southwest Jiaotong University and Southwest Jiaotong University

detail.title: Coping with M&A Uncertainty: Cultural Beliefs and TMT Selection in China
detail.abstract: We examine the effect of traditional beliefs on top management team (TMT) composition in China, focusing on the role of the zodiac-conflict beliefs. Using a panel of 15,399 firm-year observations for Chinese A-share listed firms from 2007 to 2023, we show that the share of TMT members whose zodiac signs conflict with the chairperson's is systematically below the birth-cohort-adjusted natural benchmark. We further identify strategic uncertainty as a key driver of this behavior. We find that this aversion sharpens before large mergers and acquisitions (M&As): transaction value has a positive and significant effect on the pre-deal change in zodiac aversion across a range of specifications. The effect is more pronounced in non-state-owned enterprises (non-SOEs) and smaller firms, where chairpersons have greater discretion over appointments. This study underscores the critical role of irrational cultural beliefs in shaping managerial decision-making and TMT composition.

AI.tldr: 本文研究中国传统生肖相冲信念对中国上市公司高管团队（TMT）构成的影响。基于2007-2023年15,399个公司-年度观测值，发现与董事长生肖相冲的TMT成员占比系统性低于基于出生队列调整的自然基准水平。战略不确定性（如大型并购）会加剧这种回避行为，且该效应在非国有企业和规模较小的公司中更为显著，表明董事长在人事任命中拥有更大自由裁量权时会更多依赖非理性文化信念。
AI.research_question: 传统生肖相冲信念如何影响中国上市公司高管团队（TMT）的构成？
AI.motivation: 现有文献鲜少关注非理性文化信念对高管团队构成的影响，本文旨在填补这一空白，探讨传统信念（生肖相冲）如何在高层管理决策中发挥作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化信念与决策理论；战略不确定性理论；高层梯队理论（Upper Echelons Theory）
AI.method: 基于2007-2023年中国A股上市公司15,399个公司-年度观测值的面板数据分析，将TMT中生肖相冲成员占比与出生队列调整的自然基准进行比较；采用多种回归规格检验并购交易规模对并购前生肖回避程度变化的影响。
AI.findings: （1）生肖与董事长相冲的TMT成员占比系统性低于自然基准；（2）战略不确定性（大型并购前）会显著加剧生肖回避行为；（3）交易规模对并购前生肖回避变化有正向显著影响；（4）该效应在非国有企业和小型企业中更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 将非理性文化信念纳入高管团队构成的研究框架，丰富了高层梯队理论，揭示了文化信念在管理决策中的重要作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解中国企业高管人事任命的非正式影响因素提供了新视角，对人才管理实践和公司治理结构优化具有启示意义。

title: Multiple Large Shareholders and Corporate Investment: The Role of Relative Shareholdings
affiliations: Nanjing Audit University, Durham University Business School, Coventry University, Tsinghua University and Nanjing University - Research Center for Banking

detail.title: Multiple Large Shareholders and Corporate Investment: The Role of Relative Shareholdings
detail.abstract: This paper examines the effect of multiple large shareholders (MLS) on corporate investment from the perspective of the relative shareholdings (RS) between controlling shareholders (CS) and non-controlling large shareholders (NCLS). Using a sample of Chinese listed firms and exploiting exogenous variation in ownership generated by the 2005 Split-Share Structure Reform, we find that investment initially declines as the relative holdings increase but subsequently rises, consistent with monitoring dominating at lower levels of RS and collusion dominating at higher levels. This pattern is mirrored in investment efficiency and firm value and is more clearly observed when shareholder identities align, external governance is weak, and firms face greater financial constraints. Our findings bridge the corporate governance and corporate investment literatures by showing that the conditional governance role of MLS translates into conditional investment outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2005年中国股权分置改革作为外生冲击，考察多个大股东（MLS）的相对持股比例（RS）对企业投资的影响，发现投资与相对持股比例呈U型关系——低RS时监督效应主导抑制投资，高RS时合谋效应主导促进投资，且这一模式在投资效率和公司价值中得到印证。
AI.research_question: 多个大股东（MLS）的相对持股比例如何影响企业投资？监督与合谋效应在不同持股水平下如何发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 已有文献多聚焦于多个大股东的存在与否对企业治理的影响，但缺乏从控股股东与非控股大股东相对持股比例这一连续维度来考察其对企业投资后果的研究。本文旨在弥合公司治理与企业投资两大文献领域的鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于监督效应与合谋效应的双重视角，构建相对持股比例（RS）与企业投资之间的非线性（U型）关系理论框架。
AI.method: 以2005年股权分置改革作为所有权结构的外生变动来源，使用中国上市公司样本进行实证分析（准自然实验/工具变量方法）。
AI.findings: 投资随相对持股比例增加先下降后上升，呈U型模式；低RS水平下监督效应占主导，高RS水平下合谋效应占主导。该模式在投资效率和公司价值中同样存在，且在股东身份一致、外部治理薄弱及融资约束更大的企业中更为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了多个大股东的治理作用是条件性的（监督与合谋随持股比例变化而转换），并将这种条件性治理角色延伸至条件性投资结果，桥接了公司治理与企业投资两大文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者和投资者理解股权结构与企业投资行为的关系提供参考，提示在评估多个大股东治理效应时需考虑相对持股比例的阈值效应。

title: International R&D Spillovers, Innovation by Learning from Abroad and Medium-Run Fluctuations
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: International R&D Spillovers, Innovation by Learning from Abroad and Medium-Run Fluctuations
detail.abstract: Developed economies experienced large and correlated fluctuations in the medium run during the postwar period. Many industrialized countries experienced high productivity growth in the 1960s, low growth between the early 1970s and the early 1980s, and high growth in the 1990s. This paper develops a model of medium-run fluctuations incorporating research and development (R&D)-based endogenous growth and international R&D spillovers from a technologically leading country to a technologically lagging country. An important feature of the model is that a key role of the lagging country’s R&D is innovation by learning (IBL) from abroad. After calibration using U.S. and Japanese data, the model shows that changes in U.S. R&D expenditure alone can substantially explain Japan’s medium-run fluctuations. The results show that the diffusion of U.S. innovations (generated by U.S. R&D) to Japan and Japan’s IBL from the U.S. play important roles in determining Japan’s medium-run fluctuations.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含基于研发的内生增长和国际研发溢出效应的中期波动模型，其中技术落后国家的研发核心作用是通过向国外学习进行创新（IBL）。使用美国和日本数据进行校准后，模型显示美国研发支出的变化可以实质性解释日本的中期波动，美国创新向日本扩散以及日本从美国的IBL在决定日本中期波动中发挥重要作用。
AI.research_question: 技术落后国家的中期经济波动在多大程度上可以由领先国家的研发支出变化和研发溢出效应来解释？
AI.motivation: 战后时期发达经济体在中期内经历了大规模且相关的波动，如1960年代高生产率增长、1970年代初至1980年代初的低增长、1990年代的高增长。现有文献缺乏能够解释这种跨国同步性中期波动的理论模型，特别是技术落后国家如何受领先国家研发活动的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于研发（R&D）的内生增长理论；国际研发溢出效应理论；创新与模仿（innovation by imitation）框架，特别是"通过向国外学习进行创新"（innovation by learning, IBL）机制。
AI.method: 构建包含R&D内生增长和国际研发溢出的中期波动理论模型；利用美国和日本数据进行校准和数值模拟，分析美国研发支出变化对日本中期波动的解释力。
AI.findings: 美国研发支出的变化能够显著解释日本的中期波动；美国创新的国际扩散以及日本通过向国外学习进行创新的机制，是决定日本中期波动的重要因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 将国际研发溢出和"通过向国外学习进行创新"（IBL）机制引入中期波动模型，为解释发达经济体中期波动的跨国相关性提供了新的理论框架；揭示了领先国家研发活动对落后国家中期波动的传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解国际技术扩散对经济波动的影响提供依据；有助于落后国家认识到研发投入和从国外学习对稳定经济增长的重要性；对国际科技政策协调具有启示意义。

title: Research landscape across central banks: rising importance and shrinking distances
affiliations: John von Neumann University, Central Bank of Hungary and Magyar Nemzeti Bank

detail.title: Research landscape across central banks: rising importance and shrinking distances
detail.abstract: Amid increasing economic and political fragmentation — and given the growing influence of central bank research on policy and academic discourse — this study examines collaboration patterns among central banks and the distances that shape their potential for alignment. Using web scraping and database integration, we build two new datasets covering 20,000 and 28,000 research papers published between 2000-2024, focusing on 15 major central banks across advanced and emerging economies. We find that although collaboration among EU central banks has grown, overall cross-central-bank collaboration has declined from its post-2008–09 peak, even as research focus and strategy show some increase in alignment. Converging topic trends follow broader macroeconomic developments, although some differences in focus persist. Cross-citation patterns are stable, especially among Western institutions, where FED research continues to play a central role. A shared shift toward data-intensive work and three identifiable publication strategies also point to untapped opportunities for deeper collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过网页抓取和数据库整合，构建了两个覆盖2000-2024年、分别包含20,000和28,000篇研究论文的新数据集，聚焦15家主要发达与新兴经济体央行，考察央行间合作模式及其对政策协调的影响距离。研究发现欧盟央行合作增长，但整体跨央行合作自2008-09年峰值后下降；研究重点和策略呈现一定趋同，交叉引用模式稳定（美联储仍居核心），数据密集型工作的共同转向和三种可识别出版策略指向未开发的深层合作机会。
AI.research_question: 在经济和政治碎片化加剧的背景下，央行之间的研究合作模式如何演变？影响其潜在协调能力的"距离"（如地理、制度、主题距离）如何塑造合作格局？
AI.motivation: 央行研究对政策制定和学术话语的影响力日益增长，但现有研究缺乏对央行间科研合作模式的系统考察。在经济与政治碎片化加剧、央行互动日益关键的背景下，理解央行间的合作网络与协调潜力具有重要的政策意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于协作网络分析、科学计量学以及制度距离/地理距离视角，考察央行研究机构间的合作模式、主题收敛性和交叉引用网络。
AI.method: 采用网页抓取（web scraping）和数据库整合方法，构建两个大规模数据集（20,000篇和28,000篇论文），覆盖2000-2024年期间15家主要央行（包括发达和新兴经济体），运用网络分析和主题建模等方法研究合作模式、引用关系和出版策略。
AI.findings: (1) 欧盟央行间合作增长，但整体跨央行合作自2008-09年峰值后有所下降；(2) 研究焦点和策略出现一定程度的趋同，且主题趋势跟随更广泛的宏观经济发展，但仍存在一些焦点差异；(3) 交叉引用模式稳定，西方机构尤其如此，美联储研究仍居核心地位；(4) 存在向数据密集型工作的共同转型和三种可识别的出版策略，指向未开发的深层合作机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统构建了央行研究合作的实证数据库，为理解央行间知识生产与传播网络提供了新的经验证据；揭示了合作与协同（alignment）之间的非线性关系，表明合作下降并不必然伴随研究策略的分化；为央行间政策协调的"远端基础"（研究层面的趋同）提供了量化分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和央行管理层提供了央行间研究合作格局的全景图，识别了深层合作机会和未开发的协同潜力，有助于促进央行间知识共享、研究协作和政策协调，尤其在碎片化时代为加强国际合作提供实证依据。

title: Liquidity Shocks, Valuation Wedges, and Investment Dynamics in Subsidized Guarantee Markets
affiliations: , , Shanghai University of Finance and Economics and Southern University of Science and Technology - Department of Finance

detail.title: Liquidity Shocks, Valuation Wedges, and Investment Dynamics in Subsidized Guarantee Markets
detail.abstract: Credit guarantee markets can fail when fee regulation curbs default-inducing fees but weakens compensation for guarantor participation. We develop a continuous-time real options model showing how guarantor-side liquidity shocks reshape guarantee contracts, undermine market viability, and distort investment timing. A Poisson liquidity shock raises the guarantor's effective discount rate, creating a provider-side valuation wedge that increases required compensation. When financing constraints and regulatory fee caps preclude price-based clearing, two-stage contracts substitute backend equity for upfront cash. This backend claim triggers the guarantor's equity-induced urgency to realize future payoffs early, driving premature investment and eroding waiting value. Fiscal transfers restore participation through fee substitution, yet policy efficacy is inverted U-shaped. Moderate subsidies weaken urgency but may induce delay, whereas excessive support shifts compensation toward backend equity, partly reverses this delay, and erodes waiting value. Scale flexibility generates quality-induced delay, providing a budget-neutral market complement that realigns incentives when scalability is high.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个连续时间实物期权模型，研究信用担保市场中担保方流动性冲击如何重塑担保合约、削弱市场可行性并扭曲投资时机。流动性冲击提高担保方有效贴现率，造成估值偏差；在融资约束和监管费率上限下，两阶段合约以后端股权替代前端现金，引发担保方提前实现收益的紧迫感，导致过早投资。财政转移通过费用替代恢复参与，但政策效力呈倒U型；规模灵活性则通过质量诱导延迟提供预算中性的市场互补机制。
AI.research_question: 当费用监管遏制了违约诱导性费用但削弱了担保方参与补偿时，信用担保市场如何发生失灵？担保方流动性冲击如何影响合约设计、市场可行性与投资时机？
AI.motivation: 信用担保市场在费率监管下可能失灵——监管虽遏制了违约诱导性费用，却削弱了对担保方参与的补偿。现有研究对担保方供给侧流动性冲击如何影响市场合约结构与投资决策缺乏系统理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间实物期权理论、流动性冲击（泊松过程）下的有效贴现率调整、估值偏差分析、两阶段合约设计理论、政策干预（财政转移）与市场互补机制分析。
AI.method: 构建连续时间实物期权模型，引入泊松流动性冲击设定担保方有效贴现率，分析估值偏差、合约结构（前端现金替代后端股权）、投资时机扭曲、财政补贴（倒U型效应）及规模灵活性等机制。
AI.findings: 1）泊松流动性冲击提高担保方有效贴现率，产生供给侧估值偏差，提高所需补偿；2）融资约束与费率上限排除了价格出清时，两阶段合约以后端股权替代前端现金；3）后端股权引发担保方提前实现收益的紧迫感，导致过早投资并侵蚀等待价值；4）财政转移恢复参与但政策效力呈倒U型——适度补贴削弱紧迫感但可能诱发延迟，过度支持则部分逆转延迟并侵蚀等待价值；5）规模灵活性产生质量诱导延迟，在高可扩展性下提供预算中性的市场互补机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将担保方供给侧流动性冲击引入担保合约设计的理论分析，揭示了估值偏差对合约结构的影响机制；2）识别了后端股权索赔引发投资时机扭曲的新渠道；3）刻画了财政补贴政策效力倒U型的理论机制；4）提出规模灵活性作为预算中性政策替代方案的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者在费率上限与担保市场可行性之间提供权衡依据；为设计财政补贴政策（补贴力度选择）提供理论指导；为通过规模灵活性设计预算中性的市场激励机制提供政策参考。

title: Active Innovation Networks, Entry Failures and the Implementability of Explosive Growth
affiliations: Université de Poitiers

detail.title: Active Innovation Networks, Entry Failures and the Implementability of Explosive Growth
detail.abstract: This paper shows that explosive growth can fail to emerge not because the technology is insufficient, but because decentralized markets do not activate all the research sectors the innovation network requires. The mechanism is an extensive-margin market failure distinct from standard R\&D underinvestment: with fixed operating costs, a research sector that is marginally unprofitable for private firms --- due to incomplete appropriability of cross-sector spillovers --- may be excluded from the innovation network entirely. If that sector completes the feedback cycle whose spectral radius determines the growth regime, its exclusion keeps the market economy below the explosive-growth threshold even when the social planner would cross it. The paper formalizes this through an active-set ordering theorem: under incomplete appropriability, the set of sectors activated by the competitive equilibrium is weakly contained in the planner's set, so the operative feedback matrix of the market economy is elementwise weakly below the planner's and its spectral radius is weakly lower. The main theorem establishes that this ordering is regime-splitting for an open set of primitives --- markets deliver balanced growth while the planner implements an explosive feedback regime. The first-best instrument is a sector-specific entry grant equal to the gap between the fixed operating cost and the privately appropriable surplus; required support rises in downstream spillover centrality and output elasticity. Explosive growth is an implementability outcome, not a technological inevitability.

AI.tldr: 本文证明爆炸性增长可能无法实现，不是因为技术不足，而是因为分散化市场未能激活创新网络所需的所有研究部门。这是一种与标准研发投资不足不同的广延边际市场失灵：在固定运营成本下，因跨部门溢出效应不完全可占有而边际无利可图的研究部门可能被完全排除在创新网络之外。如果该部门恰好完成了决定增长机制的反馈回路（其谱半径决定增长状态），那么即使社会计划者能够跨越爆炸性增长的阈值，市场经济的排除效应也会使其低于该阈值。论文通过活动集排序定理形式化该机制，并证明存在一组开参数集使得该排序是"机制分裂"的——市场实现平衡增长而计划者实现爆炸性增长。最优政策工具是部门特定的进入补贴，等于固定运营成本与私人可占有剩余之间的缺口。
AI.research_question: 为什么爆炸性增长未能出现？其根源是否可能是市场组织而非技术不足？
AI.motivation: 标准R&D理论将增长失灵归因于研发投资不足（集约边际），但现实中爆炸性增长可能因某些研究部门被完全排除在创新网络之外（广延边际）而无法实现，这需要新的理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生增长理论；创新网络与跨部门溢出；反馈回路与谱半径决定增长机制；不完全可占有性理论；竞争均衡与社会计划者的活动集比较
AI.method: 理论建模与数学证明：构建包含固定运营成本和跨部门溢出的创新网络模型；通过活动集排序定理（active-set ordering theorem）证明竞争均衡激活的部门集合弱包含于计划者的集合；利用谱半径比较证明"机制分裂"定理
AI.findings: （1）不完全可占有性下，市场激活的部门集合弱包含于计划者集合，市场反馈矩阵逐元素弱低于计划者，谱半径也弱更低；（2）存在一组开参数集使得市场实现平衡增长而计划者实现爆炸性增长（机制分裂）；（3）最优政策为部门特定进入补贴，其规模随下游溢出中心性和产出弹性递增
AI.theory_contributions: 首次区分了广延边际市场失灵（部门排除）与标准集约边际R&D投资不足；提出活动集排序定理和"机制分裂"定理；将爆炸性增长重新概念化为"可实施性结果"而非技术必然性，连接了市场组织理论与增长理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供部门特定进入补贴的设计原则：补贴应等于固定运营成本与私人可占有剩余之差；补贴需求随下游溢出中心性和产出弹性上升，为创新政策的精准施策提供了理论依据

title: Pricing social impact: social bonds, SDGs alignment, and yield differentials in global debt markets
affiliations: Catholic University of the Sacred Heart of Milan - Department of Economics and Business Administration and Catholic University of the Sacred Heart of Milan - Department of Economics and Business Administration

detail.title: Pricing social impact: social bonds, SDGs alignment, and yield differentials in global debt markets
detail.abstract: The paper investigates the pricing of social impact in global debt markets using a representative sample of 401 social bonds over the period 2020-2024. While social bonds generally trade at a “socialium" (i.e., a yield discount) of approximately 40 basis points, we find that this premium is highly sensitive to the specific Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) alignment. Bonds linked to infrastructure-related SDGs exhibit a robust premium, whereas those targeting purely social objectives often face a yield penalty. This suggests that markets do not price “social impact” uniformly; instead, they distinguish between asset-backed social projects with tangible impacts (e.g., infrastructure) and those with harder-to-measure outcomes (i.e., purely social). Moreover, our results highlight that the Eurobond status affects the presence of a premium. The baseline results are robust to propensity score matching, sensitivity and instrumental variable analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2020-2024年401只社会债券的代表性样本，研究全球债务市场中社会影响的定价问题。研究发现社会债券整体存在约40个基点的收益率折价（"socialium"），但这一溢价高度依赖于具体的可持续发展目标（SDG）对齐情况：与基础设施相关SDG的债券表现出稳健溢价，而纯社会目标的债券往往面临收益率惩罚。市场并非统一对社会影响定价，而是区分有实物资产支撑、可衡量影响的社会项目（如基础设施）与难以衡量的纯社会项目。
AI.research_question: 全球债务市场中，社会债券的社会影响如何被定价？其溢价是否因可持续发展目标（SDG）的对齐类型而异？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注绿色债券的定价（greenium），而对社会债券的定价机制研究不足。社会债券的"社会影响"是否被市场统一定价，还是因项目类型不同而存在差异，这一问题尚不清楚。理解社会债券定价有助于发行人优化融资策略并促进社会债券市场发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产定价理论与社会影响可衡量性理论，核心观点是市场对"可触实的资产支撑型社会项目"（如基础设施）与"难以衡量的纯社会目标"存在不同的定价逻辑，体现了投资者对可验证性的偏好。
AI.method: 采用2020-2024年401只社会债券的代表性样本，运用回归分析估计社会债券收益率折价；使用倾向得分匹配（PSM）、敏感性分析和工具变量分析（IV）进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）社会债券整体存在约40个基点的收益率折价（socialium）；（2）与基础设施相关SDG（如SDG 9）挂钩的债券具有稳健溢价；（3）纯社会目标（如SDG 1、SDG 3等难以量化目标的）债券面临收益率惩罚；（4）欧元债券（Eurobond）状态影响溢价的存在；（5）基准结果在PSM、敏感性和IV分析下保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次系统揭示社会债券定价的非均质性，证明市场并非对社会影响统一定价；（2）提出"资产支撑型社会项目"与"纯社会项目"的定价差异机制，拓展了可持续金融定价理论；（3）将SDG对齐纳入债券定价研究框架，丰富了社会影响可衡量性与金融定价关系的理论认知。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为社会债券发行人提供融资策略参考：基础设施类社会项目可获得更低融资成本，而纯社会项目可能面临更高的发行成本；（2）有助于投资者理解社会债券的风险收益特征，优化投资决策；（3）为政策制定者和标准制定机构提供关于SDG分类与社会债券市场发展的政策启示。

title: The Faustmann model does not require a positive discount rate: optimal rotation under divergent present values
affiliations: Technische Universität München (TUM), German Centre for Integrative Biodiversity Research (iDiv) Halle-Jena-Leipzig, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Georgia, Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences, Warsaw University of Life Sciences, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Technische Universität München (TUM), University of Pisa, Technische Universität München (TUM), affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Technische Universität München (TUM)

detail.title: The Faustmann model does not require a positive discount rate: optimal rotation under divergent present values
detail.abstract: Effective discount rates for long-horizon environmental problems have been revised steadily downward, and standard frameworks can yield negative rates under sufficiently uncertain growth, expected contraction, or—for carbon benefits—when real price growth outpaces discounting. Yet classical asset-replacement models exclude such rates: under negative discounting, any fixed receipt becomes arbitrarily valuable through delay, apparently implying that a renewable resource should never be harvested. We revisit one of the oldest asset-replacement problems in economics—optimal forest rotation—without the sign restriction on the discount rate, showing that stationary Faustmann programs remain rankable even when every present value diverges. The cumulative discounted benefit factors into a horizon term, which carries the divergence, and a finite rotation statistic that solely determines the ranking at common renewal dates. Its annuity gives a welfare-consistent ranking at all horizons and reproduces each program’s cumulative present value at every harvest, for any nonzero rate. The land expectation value, soil rent, and previous negative-rate objectives are affine transformations of this index and share the classical first-order condition. Consistent with observed stand dynamics, eventually declining asset value is sufficient for a finite global optimum. As the discount rate falls through zero, that optimum surpasses the rotation maximizing average net revenue and extends toward the age of maximum value. Negative discounting thus implicates late-stage growth poorly described by timber-oriented models, shifting the analytical burden to ecology, but the prototypical asset-replacement model remains intact.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视经济学中最古老的资产替换问题——最优森林轮伐问题，在没有折现率符号限制的情况下，证明了即使所有现值发散，平稳的Faustmann方案仍可排序。累积折现收益可分解为承载发散性的期限项和唯一决定排序的有限轮伐统计量。
AI.research_question: 当折现率为负时（这在长期环境问题的标准框架中是可能的），经典的资产替换模型（最优森林轮伐）是否仍然有效？如何在没有折现率符号限制的情况下对Faustmann方案进行排序？
AI.motivation: 长期环境问题的有效折现率持续下调，标准框架在增长不确定、预期收缩或碳收益实际价格增长超过折现时可能产生负利率。但经典资产替换模型排除负利率：在负折现下，任何固定收益通过延迟都变得任意有价值，似乎意味着可再生资源永远不应被采伐。这产生了理论与现实之间的矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优森林轮伐问题（Faustmann模型），折现率为负的资产替换理论，土地期望值、土壤租金等经典概念
AI.method: 理论分析：将累积折现收益分解为期限项（承载发散性）和有限轮伐统计量（决定排序）；利用年金给出福利一致的排序；证明各目标函数（土地期望值、土壤租金等）是该指数的仿射变换，并共享经典一阶条件。
AI.findings: 1. 即使所有现值发散，平稳Faustmann方案仍可排序；2. 土地期望值、土壤租金等是该指数的仿射变换，共享经典一阶条件；3. 资产价值最终下降足以保证有限全局最优；4. 当折现率降至零以下时，最优轮伐超过最大化平均净收入的轮伐，并延伸至最大价值年龄；5. 负折现指向木材导向模型难以描述的后期生长，将分析负担转向生态学。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了经典资产替换模型以涵盖负折现率；证明了负利率下目标函数的仿射等价性；建立了负折现率下轮伐最优性的充分条件；为长期环境问题折现提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为负折现率下的环境资源管理提供理论基础；表明在负折现下需要更多关注生态学上的后期生长动态；为碳收益等长期环境效益的估值提供方法参考。

title: Friction Rents, Rationing Relief, and the Price-Income Decoupling: Cross-Border Service Competition in a Self-Pay Health Care Market

detail.title: Friction Rents, Rationing Relief, and the Price-Income Decoupling: Cross-Border Service Competition in a Self-Pay Health Care Market

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: We study how cross-border service competition transmits through a self-pay health care market that combines private provision, public rationing, and a rigid public wage. Motivated by the Hong Kong-Shenzhen dental market-where a two-to-fivefold price gap coexists with stable private incomes and falling public waiting costswe build a multi-market equilibrium model in which patients choose among private, public-rationed, cross-border, and no-treatment channels. Three mechanisms organize the results. First, trust-related cross-border frictions generate friction rents: the high-price market converges to the low price plus a full-cost friction, not to the low price itself. Second, cross-border competition relieves public rationing: lower private prices pull patients out of the public queue, cutting the endogenous rationing cost by 20 to 60 percent. Third, a rigid public wage transmits through a no-arbitrage condition into an income floor for private providers-an implicit put underwritten by public vacancies-so that price deflation decouples from income deflation as quantity expands along an extensive margin. Under calibrated parameter values consistent with observed moments, the model illustrates a 21.6% price decline against a 6.3% income decline over two decades, with about 56% of welfare gains accruing to previous non-users. Extensions endogenize the friction through social learning, add two-market supply interaction, a political response function, and regime switching when public vacancies are exhausted.

AI.tldr: 本文研究跨境服务竞争如何通过一个结合私人供给、公共配给和刚性公共工资的自费医疗市场传导。以香港-深圳牙科市场为背景，构建多市场均衡模型，发现跨境摩擦产生摩擦租金、跨境竞争缓解公共配给、刚性公共工资通过无套利条件形成私人供给者的收入下限。
AI.research_question: 跨境服务竞争如何在一个同时包含私人供给、公共配给和刚性公共工资的自费医疗市场中传导并影响价格、收入和福利分配？
AI.motivation: 香港-深圳牙科市场存在2-5倍的价格差距，同时伴随稳定的私人收入和下降的公共等待成本，这一现象无法用标准竞争理论解释，需要更完整的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多市场均衡模型；摩擦租金理论；无套利条件；内生化配给成本；刚性工资传导机制
AI.method: 构建包含私人、公共配给、跨境和无治疗四种渠道的多市场均衡模型，通过校准参数与观察矩匹配，并进行多个扩展（社会学习内生化摩擦、两市场供给互动、政治反应函数、公职空缺耗尽的体制转换）。
AI.findings: 跨境竞争使高价市场收敛到低价加上全成本摩擦而非低价本身；私人价格下降使病人退出公共队列，内生化配给成本降低20-60%；刚性公共工资通过无套利条件为私人供给者提供收入下限，使价格下降与收入下降脱钩；校准结果显示20年间价格下降21.6%而收入仅下降6.3%，约56%的福利收益由原有非使用者获得。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出摩擦租金概念，将跨境竞争与公共配给和刚性工资纳入统一框架；揭示了价格下降与收入下降脱钩的机制（公共空缺隐性看跌期权）；将福利分析扩展至非用户群体。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨境医疗服务竞争的政策评估提供理论工具；对公共医疗配给、工资刚性和跨境医疗开放政策的福利影响提供量化洞见；对香港-深圳牙科市场的价格与收入演化提供解释与预测。

title: Opportunity Recognition During Financial Crises: A Behavioral Analysis of Contrarian Investor Decision-Making
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Opportunity Recognition During Financial Crises: A Behavioral Analysis of Contrarian Investor Decision-Making
detail.abstract: Most research on financial crises asks why things go wrong. This paper asks a different question: who gets it right, and how? Rather than treating crises solely as episodes of systemic failure, we argue that the same behavioral dynamics that cause the majority of investors to suffer — loss aversion, cognitive tunneling, and narrative anchoring — simultaneously generate structured mispricing opportunities for the disciplined minority who can avoid them. Drawing on Prospect Theory, the framing effect, and the tunneling hypothesis, and situated within Lo's (2004, 2017) Adaptive Markets Hypothesis, the paper examines contrarian investor decision-making across three episodes: the 1997 Asian Financial Crisis, the 2008 Global Financial Crisis, and the 2020 COVID-19 market crash. Five investors — George Soros, Mark Mobius, Michael Burry, John Paulson, and Howard Marks — are analyzed in depth. Three behavioral patterns emerge consistently across all cases: deliberate decoupling from loss-framed narratives, recalibration of reference points toward intrinsic value, and structural positioning that preserves cognitive bandwidth under stress. These patterns are formalized in the Opportunity Recognition Sequence (ORS), a novel three-stage framework that integrates behavioral finance with the entrepreneurship literature on opportunity identification. The paper contributes a process-level account of crisis opportunity recognition — one that distinguishes disciplined contrarianism from overconfident risk-taking — that is largely absent from existing behavioral finance scholarship.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨金融危机中谁能够正确识别机会以及如何做到。通过分析五位成功的逆向投资者（索罗斯、莫比乌斯、伯里、保尔森、马克斯）在三次金融危机中的决策行为，提炼出三种一致的行为模式，并将其形式化为"机会识别序列"（ORS）三阶段框架，整合了行为金融与创业机会识别文献，提供了危机机会识别的过程层面解释。
AI.research_question: 金融危机中谁能够正确识别机会，以及他们是如何做到的？
AI.motivation: 大多数金融危机研究关注系统性失败的原因，而忽略了少数纪律严明的投资者如何在危机中识别并利用机会。作者认为，导致多数投资者受损的行为动力学（损失厌恶、认知隧道、叙事锚定）同时为能够规避这些偏差的少数投资者创造了结构性错误定价机会，但现有行为金融文献缺乏对这一过程的过程层面解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 前景理论（Prospect Theory）、框架效应（Framing Effect）、隧道假说（Tunneling Hypothesis）、自适应市场假说（Adaptive Markets Hypothesis, Lo 2004, 2017）
AI.method: 多案例深度分析：选取五位著名逆向投资者（乔治·索罗斯、马克·莫比乌斯、迈克尔·伯里、约翰·保尔森、霍华德·马克斯），考察其在三次金融危机（1997年亚洲金融危机、2008年全球金融危机、2020年COVID-19市场崩盘）中的决策行为，并进行跨案例的模式提取与理论构建。
AI.findings: 所有案例中一致浮现三种行为模式：（1）刻意脱离损失框架叙事的解耦行为；（2）将参考点向内生价值重新校准；（3）在压力下保持认知带宽的结构性定位。这些模式被形式化为机会识别序列（ORS）三阶段框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了机会识别序列（ORS）这一新颖的三阶段框架，将行为金融与创业机会识别文献整合；提供了危机机会识别的过程层面解释，区别于将逆向投资仅视为过度自信风险承担的观点；区分了纪律性逆向投资与过度自信冒险行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了一套可操作的危机机会识别框架（ORS），帮助投资者理解如何在市场恐慌中保持理性、重新校准参考点并保持认知带宽，从而在危机中发现被结构性错误定价的机会。

title: Scale and Local Information in Housing Markets: A Graph-Laplacian AVM Benchmarked Against Machine Learning
affiliations: Neoval

detail.title: Scale and Local Information in Housing Markets: A Graph-Laplacian AVM Benchmarked Against Machine Learning
detail.abstract: Automated house valuation is often framed as a choice between predictive accuracy and explicit econometric structure. We examine that premise through repeated prospective evaluation of 13,100 house sales in Inner West Sydney, comparing a graph-Laplacian hedonic model with gradient boosting, random forest and conventional hedonic models. The graph model is the most accurate: it is modestly more accurate than a LightGBM gradient booster benchmark supplied with previous and nearby sales. The comparisons point to a broader source of accuracy: capturing fine local variation in persistent dwelling premia. Restricting the training region improves plain boosting, but most of that benefit disappears when previous and neighboring sales are supplied. A penalized coordinate surface substantially improves a conventional OLS hedonic regression.
