Once it is supplied with regionally interacted hedonic coefficients and time indexes, the extent of the fitting region matters little. Local model structure, engineered sales histories and local fitting therefore provide partly substitutable ways of capturing spatial detail. The graph model has the further advantage of additionally estimating local price indexes, persistent dwelling effects and their uncertainty as explicit model quantities.

AI.tldr: 本文通过悉尼内西区13,100套房屋销售的前瞻性评估，比较了图拉普拉斯特征价格模型与梯度提升、随机森林及传统特征价格模型。研究发现图模型在预测精度上表现最佳，其优势源于捕捉持续住房溢价中的精细局部变化，并兼具显式估计地方价格指数和住房持久效应的额外优势。
AI.research_question: 自动化房屋估值是否必须在预测准确性与显式计量结构之间做出取舍？哪种模型在预测精度上表现最佳，其准确性来源是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为自动化房屋估值需要在预测精度和显式计量经济学结构之间做出权衡，但这一前提缺乏系统的实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 特征价格模型（Hedonic Model）、图拉普拉斯模型、机器学习预测框架
AI.method: 对悉尼内西区13,100套房屋销售进行反复前瞻性评估，比较图拉普拉斯特征价格模型、梯度提升（LightGBM）、随机森林和传统特征价格模型；通过限制训练区域、供给邻近销售数据、引入惩罚坐标曲面等方法进行对照实验。
AI.findings: 图模型预测最准确，略优于获得先前和邻近销售数据的LightGBM；限制训练区域改善普通提升模型，但供给邻近销售数据后该优势大部分消失；惩罚坐标曲面显著改善OLS特征价格回归；局部模型结构、工程化销售历史与局部拟合适配在捕捉空间细节上具有部分替代性；图模型还能显式估计地方价格指数、持久住房效应及其不确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了预测准确性与显式计量结构之间的传统权衡假设，证明了图拉普拉斯模型可以同时兼顾二者；揭示了局部模型结构、工程化销售历史和局部拟合在捕捉空间细节上的部分可替代性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为房屋估值实践提供了精确且具有可解释性的图模型方案，该模型不仅能提高预测精度，还能显式输出地方价格指数、持久住房效应及其不确定性，有助于实务中的估值决策和风险评估。

title: Government Reputation and Fiscal Capacity
affiliations: Geneva Business School and

detail.title: Government Reputation and Fiscal Capacity
detail.abstract: How does uncertain implementation shape fiscal policy over time? We study an uninformed fiscal authority that chooses a distortionary tax-financed mandate and audit intensity while a privately informed executive decides whether to deliver or divert the proceeds. Reputation is the Bayesian state variable linking current fiscal control to future capacity. In a two-period benchmark, a mandate is also an experiment: delivery sacrifices current rents but preserves future access. We prove that the dynamic activation threshold is no greater than the square of the static reputation cutoff; the bound is exact and independent of discounting in a linear-benefit, quadratic-cost economy. A positive trial mandate may therefore be optimal when every positive tax is statically undesirable. In the infinite-horizon model, posterior reputation is a bounded martingale and its one-step conditional variance admits an exact policy-dependent formula. Zero mandates can create closed inactive classes in which fiscal activity and learning stop together. On a finite approximation, we compute stationary equilibria with noisy signals, endogenous auditing, and spending-need shocks and certify them against every action in a common adaptive cloud. The equilibria display history-dependent limiting fiscal capacity, non-monotone auditing, and nonlinear responses to spending need: shocks leave mean reputation unchanged but alter its dispersion and exposure to the inactive region.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不确定实施如何随时间塑造财政政策。一个不知情的财政当局选择扭曲性税收融资的指令和审计强度，而一个拥有私人信息的行政机构决定是否交付或挪用资金。在无限期模型中，后验声誉是有界鞅，零指令可创造封闭的非活跃类。均衡显示历史依赖的财政能力极限、非单调审计和对支出需求的非线性响应。
AI.research_question: 不确定实施（uncertain implementation）如何随时间塑造财政政策？具体而言，当财政当局对行政机构的执行能力不确定时，动态的最优税收指令和审计强度应如何设定？
AI.motivation: 现实中的财政政策面临严重的实施不确定性问题——财政当局无法确定行政机构是否会忠实执行指令还是挪用资金。理解这种不确定性如何动态影响财政政策的设计具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 声誉博弈理论（reputation game）、贝叶斯更新、鞅理论、动态规划
AI.method: 构建两期基准模型和无限期模型，运用贝叶斯声誉更新机制，结合数值模拟（有限近似下计算平稳均衡）和自适应云方法验证均衡。
AI.findings: 1) 动态激活阈值不超过静态声誉截止值的平方，该界限精确且独立于贴现率；2) 当所有正的税收在静态上不可取时，正向试验指令可能是最优的；3) 零指令可创造封闭的非活跃类，财政活动和学习同时停止；4) 均衡显示历史依赖的财政能力极限、非单调审计和对支出需求的非线性响应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将声誉机制与财政政策动态联系起来，证明了动态激活阈值与静态声誉截止值的精确平方关系，并给出后验声誉一阶条件方差的精确政策依赖公式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为财政当局提供了在实施不确定条件下设计税收指令和审计策略的理论指导，揭示了试验性指令在声誉较差时也能发挥价值的条件，以及审计强度和支出需求之间的非线性关系。

title: Not All Benchmarks Are Equal: Saturation-Aware Evaluation of Pathology Foundation Models
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Not All Benchmarks Are Equal: Saturation-Aware Evaluation of Pathology Foundation Models
detail.abstract: Background and Objective: Pathology foundation models (FMs) are increasingly used for H&E image classification, but guidance on how to choose among them is limited, and the public patch-classification datasets used to compare them are increasingly near their discriminative ceiling. We examine whether widely used public H&E datasets retain enough discriminative capacity to distinguish among pathology FMs, and propose a principled way to categorize such benchmarks.,Methods: We benchmarked seven backbones — four pathology FMs (Virchow2, UNI2-h, Phikon, and CONCH) and three ImageNet-pretrained or randomly initialized baselines — across five public H&E datasets (PCam, NCT-CRC, MHIST, LC25000, and BreakHis) under a single protocol: frozen feature extraction, a 256-unit MLP classifier head, five-fold stratified cross-validation with three random seeds, bootstrap confidence intervals, DeLong’s test, and McNemar’s test, including newly curated leakage-free LC25000-clean splits.,Results: Virchow2 achieved the best aggregate performance (mean AUC 0.9848, mean rank 1.60), but UNI2-h and Phikon were best on individual datasets, so no single model was consistently superior. PCam, MHIST, and BreakHis separated models with statistical confidence, whereas NCT-CRC and LC25000 were near-ceiling across all four FMs (AUC ≥ 0.997); this saturation persisted after leakage-aware splitting.,Conclusions: We propose a saturation-aware benchmarking framework that separates datasets useful for model differentiation from saturated datasets that are better treated as sanity checks. Reporting benchmark usefulness alongside model performance can make future FM comparisons more informative for downstream model selection.

AI.tldr: 该论文对七个骨干模型（四个病理基础模型和三个基线）在五个公开H&E数据集上进行了系统基准测试，发现部分数据集已接近判别天花板，提出了一种"饱和度感知"的基准测试框架，区分可用于模型区分的有效数据集与仅适合作为健全性检查的饱和数据集。
AI.research_question: 公开H&E病理数据集是否仍然具有足够的判别能力来区分不同的病理基础模型？如何建立一种有原则的方式来对这些基准数据集进行分类？
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型在H&E图像分类中应用日益广泛，但缺乏选择模型的指导；同时公开的patch分类数据集越来越接近判别天花板，导致模型之间的差异难以被有效识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 病理基础模型（Foundation Models）、基准测试饱和度（benchmark saturation）、判别能力评估、特征提取+线性分类头的迁移学习范式
AI.method: 统一实验协议基准测试：冻结特征提取、256单元MLP分类头、五折分层交叉验证（三个随机种子）、bootstrap置信区间、DeLong检验和McNemar检验；包含七个骨干模型（Virchow2、UNI2-h、Phikon、CONCH及三个ImageNet预训练/随机初始化基线）在五个公开数据集（PCam、NCT-CRC、MHIST、LC25000、BreakHis）上的评估，并新构建了无泄漏的LC25000-clean数据集。
AI.findings: Virchow2在所有模型中获得最佳综合表现（平均AUC 0.9848，平均排名1.60），但UNI2-h和Phikon在个别数据集上表现最佳，没有单一模型始终最优。PCam、MHIST和BreakHis能统计显著地区分模型，而NCT-CRC和LC25000对所有四个病理FM均接近天花板（AUC≥0.997），且该饱和现象在泄漏感知分割后依然存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"饱和度感知"的基准测试框架，将数据集划分为可用于模型区分的有效数据集和仅适合作为健全性检查的饱和数据集，为病理基础模型比较提供了方法论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议在报告模型性能的同时报告基准数据集的可用性，使未来的病理FM比较对下游模型选择更具信息量；提供了无泄漏的LC25000-clean分割，改进了现有基准数据质量。

title: Which Diagnoses Change How Long People Think They Will Live: Cancer against other first diagnoses in three ageing panels
affiliations: University of Hawaii at Manoa - Department of Quantitative Health Sciences

detail.title: Which Diagnoses Change How Long People Think They Will Live: Cancer against other first diagnoses in three ageing panels

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a secondary analysis of de-identified public-use and restricted-access survey data and involved no interaction with human subjects; it was therefore exempt from institutional review board approval. All respondents consented to participation in the original surveys.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: A serious diagnosis is news that one will not live as long as expected. In three panels I compare first cancer diagnoses with first diagnoses of heart disease, stroke, diabetes or lung disease. Cancer lowers the stated chance of reaching a target age four to five percentage points further than the other four combined, on the survey's scale. Against what later mortality justifies, cancer delivers the largest share in every survey, and every diagnosis warranting more than cancer delivers less: American lung disease warrants 2.3 times cancer's revision and delivers 17 percent of it, against cancer's 94. Cancer's first place is a tested result in the American panel (probability 1.00) but not in the continental European one (0.72), where the runner-up's interval is too wide to rank. What reaches the belief tracks the name of the disease more closely than the danger it carries.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三个面板数据比较首次癌症诊断与其他四种疾病（心脏病、中风、糖尿病、肺病）诊断对个体预期寿命信念的影响。研究发现癌症诊断会使个体认为达到目标年龄的概率降低4-5个百分点，远超其他四种疾病的总和。肺癌等疾病在医学上更危险，但个体对其寿命预期的修正远小于癌症。个体对寿命的信念更多受到疾病名称的心理影响，而非实际风险。
AI.research_question: 首次癌症诊断与首次其他慢性疾病诊断相比，对个体主观预期寿命信念的影响有何差异？这种影响是否与医学上的实际死亡风险相匹配？
AI.motivation: 癌症常被视为"最可怕"的疾病，但其对个体信念的影响是否超出了医学风险的实际依据尚未被系统量化。理解疾病诊断对主观寿命预期的影响，有助于理解患者行为决策和健康预期形成的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预期寿命信念更新理论；疾病风险感知理论；信念形成与信息处理理论
AI.method: 使用三个调查面板数据集，比较首次癌症诊断与首次心脏病、中风、糖尿病、肺病诊断对个体报告的目标年龄达成概率的影响，并将主观信念与基于实际死亡率的客观风险进行对照分析。
AI.findings: 癌症诊断使目标年龄达成概率降低4-5个百分点，超过其他四种疾病影响之和。癌症在所有调查中对预期寿命的修正占比最大，且在客观死亡率上，肺癌风险是癌症的2.3倍，但其对信念的影响仅为癌症的17%，而癌症自身的信念修正达到客观风险的94%。癌症在主观影响排名第一在美国面板中高度显著（概率1.00），但在欧洲大陆面板中不显著（0.72）。个体信念更新与疾病名称紧密相关，而非实际风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了疾病"标签效应"在信念更新中的主导作用，挑战了理性信念更新假设，说明个体对健康风险的信念修正并非基于客观概率，而是受到疾病的象征性意义和文化认知的强烈影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗沟通和患者心理支持提供了依据：医务工作者需意识到癌症诊断可能引发超出医学实际风险过的度悲观预期，应针对性地进行风险沟通和心理干预。

title: Detecting Depression Using EEG: A Hybrid CNN-GRU Approach with Optimized MRMR Features
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Institute for Research in Fundamental Sciences (IPM), affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Detecting Depression Using EEG: A Hybrid CNN-GRU Approach with Optimized MRMR Features
detail.abstract: Depression is a common and debilitating mental health disorder that significantly reduces quality of life. Early and accurate diagnosis is crucial for effective treatment, yet conventional methods largely depend on subjective self-reports, which often lack reliability. This study presents a novel deep learning framework for the objective detection of depressive versus non-depressive states using electroencephalography (EEG) signals. EEG captures underlying neural activity unaffected by external behavioral factors, making it ideal for revealing subtle depression-related brain changes. The proposed model integrates a hybrid architecture combining convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and gated recurrent units (GRUs) to extract both spatial and temporal features from EEG data simultaneously. To enhance classification efficiency, the minimum redundancy maximum relevance (MRMR) algorithm selects the most informative features, which are then classified using a fully connected neural network. The proposed method achieves outstanding performance with an overall accuracy of 98.74%, demonstrating its exceptional capability in identifying depressive states. By effectively fusing temporal-spatial information with optimized feature selection, this framework offers a highly reliable, objective tool for early depression detection. Furthermore, it holds strong promise for supporting improved treatment strategies and better patient outcomes in clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于EEG信号的深度学习框架，通过融合CNN和GRU提取时空特征，并利用MRMR算法进行特征选择，实现对抑郁状态的高精度客观检测，准确率达98.74%。
AI.research_question: 如何利用EEG信号和深度学习技术实现抑郁症的客观、准确检测，以克服传统自我报告方法的主观性和不可靠性？
AI.motivation: 抑郁症是常见且严重影响生活质量的疾病，早期准确诊断对治疗至关重要。然而传统诊断方法依赖主观自我报告，缺乏可靠性，亟需基于客观神经信号的自动检测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于EEG神经信号反映大脑活动的理论，结合深度学习（CNN用于空间特征提取，GRU用于时间特征提取）以及特征选择理论（MRMR算法）构建混合模型。
AI.method: 提出CNN与GRU混合架构，同时从EEG数据中提取空间和时间特征；采用最小冗余最大相关性（MRMR）算法筛选最具有判别力的特征；最终使用全连接神经网络进行分类。
AI.findings: 该框架在抑郁与非抑郁状态分类中达到98.74%的整体准确率，展现了卓越的抑郁状态识别能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了将CNN-GRU混合架构与MRMR特征选择相结合用于EEG信号分析的有效性，为脑电信号驱动的精神疾病客观检测提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床实践提供了一种高度可靠、客观的早期抑郁症检测工具，有望支持改善治疗策略和患者预后。

title: Municipally‑funded Tiered Population Screening for Upper Gastrointestinal Cancers in Changzhi, North China: A Real‑world Cross‑sectional Screening Cohort Study of Regional Disparities and Health‑Economic Benefits
affiliations: Yangzhou University - Department of Gastrointestinal Surgery, Yangzhou University - Department of Gastrointestinal Surgery, Fujian Medical University, Yangzhou University - Department of Gastrointestinal Surgery, Yangzhou University - Department of Gastrointestinal Surgery, Changzhi City People's Hospital, Yangzhou University - Department of Gastrointestinal Surgery, Charité - Universitätsmedizin Berlin, General Hospital of Jincheng and Nanjing Medical University

detail.title: Municipally‑funded Tiered Population Screening for Upper Gastrointestinal Cancers in Changzhi, North China: A Real‑world Cross‑sectional Screening Cohort Study of Regional Disparities and Health‑Economic Benefits

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors declare no relevant financial or non-financial conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: ethics approval: Changzhi People's Hospital, No. CZPH2023006. Participants provided informed consent.
declarations.funderStatement: Supported by Changzhi Special Fund for Major Disease Prevention and Control (CZJK2023001).

detail.abstract: BackgroundUpper gastrointestinal (UGI) cancers contribute substantially to global cancer mortality, with most cases detected at advanced stages. High-incidence mountainous regions lack affordable population-based screening strategies. This study aimed to evaluate a low-cost tiered UGI cancer screening programme in high-burden northern China, assessing its detection performance, regional disparities, feasibility and health-economic benefits, and to quantify its national public health value in addressing China’s UGI cancer crisis.MethodsA population-based cross-sectional screening programme covering 1.2358 million residents was conducted across urban, suburban, and mountainous areas of Changzhi from 2023 to 2025. Supported by municipal funding of CNY 2.43 million (USD 332, 910), we recruited permanent residents aged ≥50 years. We implemented a three-step dual-path screening workflow: participants with positive risk questionnaires underwent symptom-based Path A or serology-assisted Path B, followed by endoscopy, biopsy and pathological confirmation. We analysed regional diagnostic metrics, 3-year pathological follow-up data and health-economic outcomes to estimate local fiscal benefits and national scalability.FindingsWe collected 243,790 valid digital questionnaires from 1.2358 million residents, identifying 2,734 high-risk individuals (1.12% overall questionnaire positivity rate) for gastroscopy. Among 880 participants undergoing targeted biopsy, 149 were confirmed to have precancerous or malignant lesions, including 82 low-grade intraepithelial neoplasia (LGIN), 30 high-grade intraepithelial neoplasia (HGIN), and 37 invasive carcinomas. Lesion density per 10,000 residents was highest in mountainous Pingshun County (3.25), followed by urban Luzhou (1.10) and suburban Lucheng (0.62). Age (OR=1.357, 95%CI 1.181-1.563, P<0.001), endoscopic H. pylori positivity(OR=5.489,95%CI 3.717-8.234, P<0.001), and tobacco/alcohol consumption (OR=1.174 95%CI 1.221–2.481, P=0.002) were independent risk factors, while prior chronic UGI disease exerted a protective effect (OR=0.618, 95%CI 0.429–0.890, P=0.0098). Three-year follow-up documented three cancer-related deaths and frequent pathological upstaging of HGIN. Treatment expenditure differed markedly by lesion stage. The per-capita screening cost was CNY 1.966 (USD 0.269). Nationwide implementation would require CNY 2.77 billion (USD 379, 490, 000) and could identify 170, 000 early UGI lesions annually.InterpretationThis budget-friendly tiered screening enables consistent early detection of UGI lesions. Its low population-level cost supports national fiscal feasibility, providing a generalisable grassroots prevention framework for high-burden middle-income countries.FundingSupported by Changzhi Special Fund for Major Disease Prevention and Control (CZJK2023001).

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了中国北方高负担地区一项低成本分层上消化道（UGI）癌症筛查项目，覆盖125万居民，人均筛查成本仅1.966元人民币。通过三步双路径筛查流程，在2734名高风险个体中发现149例癌前或恶性病变。山区检出密度最高。该模式具有国家级推广的财政可行性和公共卫生价值。
AI.research_question: 在资源有限的高负担山区，低成本分层上消化道癌症筛查项目能否实现有效的早期检测，并具有全国推广的公共卫生价值？
AI.motivation: 上消化道癌症占全球癌症死亡的重要比例，多数病例在晚期才被发现。高发山区缺乏可负担的人群筛查策略，亟需探索低成本的筛查方案来解决中国的上消化道癌症危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险分层筛查理论，结合症状导向和血清学辅助的双路径筛查策略，以及健康经济学评估框架。
AI.method: 采用人口基数的横断面筛查研究设计，覆盖2023-2025年长治市城市、郊区和山区共123.58万居民。实施三步双路径筛查流程（风险问卷→症状导向Path A或血清学辅助Path B→内镜活检病理确诊），分析区域诊断指标、3年病理随访数据和健康经济结果。
AI.findings: 收集243,790份有效问卷，识别2,734名高风险个体，880人接受靶向活检，149人确诊癌前或恶性病变（82例LGIN、30例HGIN、37例浸润癌）。山区检出密度最高（3.25/万人）。年龄、内镜幽门螺杆菌阳性、烟酒消费为独立风险因素。人均筛查成本1.966元，全国推广预计年需27.7亿元，可识别17万例早期病变。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了低成本分层筛查框架在高负担中低收入地区的可推广性，为精准风险分层筛查策略提供了实证证据，拓展了癌症筛查健康经济学评估在资源受限环境中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可负担、可推广的基层上消化道癌症筛查模式，证实地方政府财政投入的可行性，为中国及类似高负担中低收入国家的癌症防控提供了可操作的政策参考。

title: From Bins to Behaviors: Assessing the Influence of Automatic Enrollment Strategies on Composting Attitudes and Behaviors
affiliations: , affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Ohio State University (OSU) - Department of Agricultural, Environmental & Development Economics

detail.title: From Bins to Behaviors: Assessing the Influence of Automatic Enrollment Strategies on Composting Attitudes and Behaviors
detail.abstract: Organizations increasingly use automatic enrollment to increase participation in residential composting programs. We examine how composting attitudes and behaviors differ across students automatically enrolled, voluntarily enrolled, and never enrolled in university residential composting. Bin access is associated with significantly higher composting rates and more favorable attitudes than having no bin. However, voluntary enrollees compost significantly more food and hold more favorable composting attitudes than automatic enrollees. The findings suggest that the positive effect of bin access is driven by motivated voluntary enrollees rather than bin provision itself, and that automatic enrollment alone is not a panacea for stimulating composting participation.

AI.tldr: 研究发现虽然垃圾桶使用权与更高的堆肥率和更积极的态度相关，但自愿参加堆肥项目的学生比自动登记的学生堆肥更多食物且态度更积极，表明自动登记并非刺激堆肥参与的万能药。
AI.research_question: 自动登记、自愿登记和未登记的学生在住宅堆肥态度和行为上有何差异？
AI.motivation: 组织越来越多地使用自动登记来提高住宅堆肥项目的参与率，但自动登记的实际效果尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的默认选项效应（nudge理论）与动机理论。
AI.method: 对自动登记、自愿登记和未登记的大学住宅堆肥学生群体进行对比研究，分析其堆肥行为和态度差异。
AI.findings: 拥有垃圾桶与更高的堆肥率和更积极的态度相关；但自愿登记的学生比自动登记的学生堆肥更多食物且态度更积极；堆肥桶获取的积极效应由有动机的自愿登记学生驱动，而非垃圾桶提供本身。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了自动登记作为行为干预手段的普遍有效性假设，揭示了默认选项背后的动机异质性，为nudge理论提供了重要边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计堆肥项目提供实践指导，表明仅靠自动登记不够，需考虑参与者内在动机或结合其他激励措施。

title: Evaluating Saliency Explanation Faithfulness in Diabetic Foot Thermography: A Framework Revealing Divergent Spatial and Causal Metrics
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Evaluating Saliency Explanation Faithfulness in Diabetic Foot Thermography: A Framework Revealing Divergent Spatial and Causal Metrics
detail.abstract: Background and Objectives: Saliency maps such as Grad-CAM are routinely presented alongside deep learning classifiers in medical imaging as evidence of interpretability, typically shown once and described as highlighting a plausible region, without quantitative evaluation against an independent reference. This study introduces a registration-derived reference for such evaluation in diabetic foot thermography, a modality where no manually annotated abnormality localization exists, and tests whether spatial correspondence with this reference agrees with causal, perturbation-based faithfulness.Methods: Contralateral plantar thermogram pairs from 167 subjects (INAOE Plantar Thermogram Database) were aligned using a deformable registration pipeline, producing a per-pixel asymmetry map used as an anatomically grounded, though not clinically verified, reference. Two classifiers (a compact convolutional network and a transfer-learned ResNet-18) were trained to distinguish diabetic from control thermograms, and three saliency methods (Grad-CAM, Grad-CAM++, and Integrated Gradients) were evaluated against this reference using spatial overlap (Intersection-over-Union, Dice, precision, recall) and causal perturbation testing (deletion and insertion), across five independent data splits.Results: Spatial overlap was low in absolute terms across all methods (mean IoU 0.011 to 0.121) but differed significantly by method in both architectures (P < .001), with Grad-CAM++ achieving higher spatial correspondence than Grad-CAM in every individual seed. The classifier with higher accuracy (ResNet-18, 85.9%) showed lower spatial correspondence than the less accurate classifier (76.2%) across every saliency method, an observation consistent with, though not proof of, overfitting apparent in its training dynamics. The saliency method with the highest spatial correspondence was not the most causally faithful method by deletion AUC in either architecture, and this causal ranking itself differed between architectures. A candidate explanation, that sparser attribution maps produce more causally sensitive deletion behavior, was not supported by within-method correlation analysis.Conclusions: Spatial correspondence with a clinically grounded reference and perturbation-based causal sensitivity are complementary rather than interchangeable measures of explanation quality. Relying on either alone would give an incomplete, and potentially misleading, picture of which saliency method is most trustworthy for diabetic foot thermogram classification

AI.tldr: 本文针对医学影像中显著图（如Grad-CAM）缺乏定量评估的问题，在糖尿病足热成像领域引入基于配准的解剖学参考，系统比较了三种显著图方法（Grad-CAM、Grad-CAM++、Integrated Gradients）的空间对应性与因果扰动忠诚度，发现两者是互补而非可互换的解释质量指标。
AI.research_question: 在糖尿病足热成像分类中，显著图与配准推导的解剖参考之间的空间对应性，是否与基于扰动的因果忠诚度（deletion/insertion测试）一致？
AI.motivation: 医学影像中的显著图（如Grad-CAM）常被作为可解释性证据展示，但缺乏对独立参考的定量评估。糖尿病足热成像领域不存在人工标注的异常区域，亟需建立无需标注的参考标准来评估显著图的可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于可解释性评估中两种互补范式：空间对应性（与独立参考的重叠度量，如IoU、Dice）和因果扰动测试（deletion/insertion衡量特征对预测的因果贡献）。
AI.method: 使用INAOE足底热成像数据库167名受试者的对侧足热图对，通过可变形配准生成逐像素不对称图作为参考。训练两个分类器（紧凑卷积网络和迁移学习ResNet-18），评估三种显著图方法（Grad-CAM、Grad-CAM++、Integrated Gradients），采用IoU、Dice、精确率、召回率及deletion/insertion测试，在5个独立数据划分上验证。
AI.findings: （1）所有方法的空间重叠绝对值低（平均IoU 0.011-0.121），但方法间差异显著（P<.001），Grad-CAM++在每个种子中均优于Grad-CAM；（2）更准确的分类器（ResNet-18, 85.9%）比低准确率分类器（76.2%）的空间对应性更低；（3）空间对应性最高的方法并非因果忠诚度最高的方法，且因果排序在两种架构间不一致；（4）稀疏归因图导致更敏感的deletion行为这一假设未被组内相关性分析支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在糖尿病足热成像领域建立无需人工标注的配准推导参考来评估显著图；实证表明空间对应性与因果忠诚度是互补而非可互换的解释质量维度，挑战了单指标评估的常规做法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医学影像AI的可解释性评估提供了方法论框架；警示仅依赖单一评估指标可能导致对显著图可信度的误导性结论；为糖尿病足热成像分类模型的解释验证提供参考。

title: Product market access and VC investment misallocation: Evidence from China’s suspension of game license approvals
affiliations: Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU), affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Fudan University

detail.title: Product market access and VC investment misallocation: Evidence from China’s suspension of game license approvals
detail.abstract: This paper examines how disruptions to product market access affect staged VC financing and capital allocation. We exploit China’s 2018 suspension of online game license approvals as an exogenous shock. Synthetic difference-in-differences estimates show that core VC/PE financing in the online game industry fell by about 44.8%, with larger declines in growth-stage and follow-on financing. Firm-level evidence shows a lower probability of obtaining subsequent financing, while firms with greater pre-shock reliance on game licenses experienced more persistent reductions in product approvals. At the investor level, prior game investors reduced allocations to online games and shifted investment toward adjacent digital industries. We propose a commercialization–financing stage mismatch mechanism: the suspension delayed commercialization milestones while financing cycles continued. Our findings show how regulatory frictions can disrupt staged financing and reallocate venture capital across industries.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国2018年暂停网络游戏版号审批作为外生冲击，考察产品市场准入中断如何影响分阶段风险投资融资和资本配置。研究发现游戏行业核心VC/PE融资下降约44.8%，成长期和后续融资跌幅更大，企业获得后续融资概率降低，投资者将资金从游戏行业转向相邻数字行业。
AI.research_question: 产品市场准入的中断如何影响分阶段风险投资融资和跨行业的资本配置？
AI.motivation: 已有研究多关注融资端冲击对VC融资的影响，但产品市场准入这一需求/商业化端冲击如何影响分阶段融资（staged financing）及其资本再配置，缺乏充分的因果证据。中国2018年游戏版号暂停审批提供了理想的外生冲击场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分阶段融资理论（staged financing）与商业化-融资阶段错配机制（commercialization–financing stage mismatch），即产品准入中断延迟了商业化里程碑，而融资周期仍在继续，导致阶段错配。
AI.method: 合成双重差分法（synthetic difference-in-differences），结合企业层面和投资者层面的实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）游戏行业核心VC/PE融资下降约44.8%；（2）成长期融资和后续融资跌幅更大；（3）企业获得后续融资的概率降低，事前对游戏版号依赖程度更高的企业产品审批减少更持续；（4）投资者减少对游戏行业的配置，转向相邻数字行业。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"商业化-融资阶段错配"机制，揭示产品市场准入（商业化端）冲击如何通过延迟商业化里程碑，与持续运转的融资周期产生错配，进而扰乱分阶段融资安排；拓展了分阶段融资理论中关于外部冲击如何影响资本配置的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管政策如何影响创业企业融资和风险资本配置提供了证据；提示政策制定者关注监管审批中断对创新生态系统的间接影响，以及VC行业如何通过行业间资本再配置来应对监管冲击。

title: Convergence, Big Time? The 2020s Return of Income Divergence Across Countries
affiliations: Stanford University

detail.title: Convergence, Big Time? The 2020s Return of Income Divergence Across Countries
detail.abstract: This paper documents an interruption in the post-1990 era of unconditional convergence in per capita income across countries. I show that rich countries grew significantly faster than poor countries from 2021 through 2024 in the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic, reversing three decades of convergence, before the divergence faded in 2025. This divergence is robust to controlling for cross-country capital investment rates.

AI.tldr: 本文记录了一个重要经济现象：COVID-19大流行后的2021至2024年间，人均收入的跨国无条件收敛趋势出现中断，富国增长率显著快于穷国，逆转了此前三十年（1990-2020年代）的收敛趋势。不过这一发散趋势在2025年逐渐消退。该发散结果在控制跨国资本投资率后依然稳健。
AI.research_question: COVID-19大流行之后，各国人均收入的收敛趋势是否被中断？即自1990年以来富国与穷国之间的增长率差距是否出现逆转？
AI.motivation: 1990年后全球经济经历了长达三十年的无条件收敛时期，但COVID-19大流行可能扰乱了这一趋势。研究这一中断现象对理解后疫情时代全球经济增长格局具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无条件收敛理论（absolute/unconditional convergence）——即穷国人均收入增长速度应快于富国的新古典增长理论假设。
AI.method: 跨国面板数据分析，对比1990年后收敛时期与2021-2024年期间各国人均收入增长率与初始收入水平的关系，并通过控制资本投资率进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1) 2021-2024年间富国增长率显著高于穷国，出现发散而非收敛；2) 这一发散逆转了此前三十年的收敛趋势；3) 发散在2025年逐渐消退；4) 控制资本投资率后发散结果依然稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战并修正了后1990年代无条件收敛的普遍认知，揭示了COVID-19大流行作为外生冲击对跨国经济增长收敛模式的重要干扰作用，丰富了无条件收敛理论的边界条件和适用情境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供疫情期间及疫后全球收入差距扩大的实证证据，提示国际社会关注大流行冲击可能加剧的全球不平等问题，并认识到这种发散虽暂时但影响深远。

title: Acephalous Governmentality: Coherence Without Coordination

detail.title: Acephalous Governmentality: Coherence Without Coordination

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study received ethical approval from King's College London prior to data collection. All interview participants provided informed consent to participate and to have their anonymised data used in research outputs, including in this and related publications arising from the doctoral thesis.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Political thought has long assumed that order requires a head. Sovereignty is figured as a crowned body, government as an executive function, and the analysis of power as the search for whoever holds it. This paper develops the concept of acephalous governmentality to name a class of arrangement that defeats the assumption: governance without a governor, coherence without coordination. It describes conditions under which multiple actors, each governing a domain according to locally defensible reasoning, produce a patterned and consequential outcome that none of them authored and none is positioned to answer for. The term transposes into governmental analytics the anthropological notion of acephalous political systems, societies achieving collective order without centralised bureaucracies (Fortes & Evans-Pritchard, 1940). The paper specifies three conditions for the concept, distinguishes it from conspiracy, emergence, assemblage and structural determination, and illustrates it through the Nigeria-UK healthcare worker recruitment corridor, the case from which the concept was generated. It then addresses the objection that an account without a designer dissolves responsibility, arguing that acephaly describes the distribution of authorship rather than the distribution of benefit. The practical implication concerns institutional design: before building architectural remedies for systemic problems, one should establish whether the system in question has a centre capable of answering for itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"无首治理术"（acephalous governmentality）概念，指称一种无治理者却产生秩序与后果的安排类型：多个行动者各自基于地方性合理逻辑治理各自领域，共同产生无人主导、也无人负责的规律性后果。作者通过尼日利亚-英国医疗工作者招聘通道的案例阐发这一概念，并区分其与阴谋论、涌现、组装体及结构决定论的不同。
AI.research_question: 是否存在一种治理秩序，其产生不依赖于中央权威或单一治理者？如果是，这类安排的运作条件、特征及理论意涵是什么？
AI.motivation: 政治思想长期预设"秩序必须有一个头"——主权被构想为加冕的身体，政府被理解为执行功能，权力分析被化约为寻找掌权者。作者旨在挑战这一根本假设，为无治理者却有治理后果的现象提供概念工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借用人类学中"无首政治体系"（acephalous political systems）概念（Fortes & Evans-Pritchard, 1940），将其转置到治理分析中；同时与治理术（governmentality）文献、福柯式治理分析传统对话。
AI.method: 概念建构与理论分析：提出概念，界定三个构成条件，进行概念区分（与阴谋论、涌现、组装体、结构决定论等对照），并以尼日利亚-英国医疗工作者招聘通道作为案例进行说明（系概念产生的经验来源）。
AI.findings: 无首治理术的三个条件：（1）多个行动者各自治理一个领域；（2）每个行动者依据地方性可辩护的推理行事；（3）共同产生无人创作、也无人能为之负责的模式化且具有后果性的结果。此外，作者论证"无首"描述的是作者身份的分散，而非利益的分散，因此不能以"没有设计者即无责任"为由否定该概念。
AI.theory_contributions: 将人类学"无首政治体系"概念引入治理分析，为"无治理者的治理"提供分析性概念工具；澄清其与阴谋论、涌现、组装体、结构决定论等既有概念的差异，拓展了治理理论的概念边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 对制度设计提出实践启示：在针对系统性问题构建制度性补救方案之前，应首先确认该系统是否存在一个能够自我负责的中心；若无，则传统的"制度建筑学"式修正是错位的。

title: Proactive Joint Load Balancing of Controllers, Servers, and Links in SD-IoMT Networks: A Fuzzy-LSTM Approach
affiliations: University of Isfahan and University of Isfahan

detail.title: Proactive Joint Load Balancing of Controllers, Servers, and Links in SD-IoMT Networks: A Fuzzy-LSTM Approach
detail.abstract: Internet of Multimedia Things (IoMT) extends the traditional Internet of Things (IoT) by enabling the transmission of rich multimedia flows. However, the exponential growth in connected devices, data volumes, and user demands increases traffic load, leading to server congestion and degraded Quality of Service (QoS). Legacy network architectures struggle to accommodate the scalability and dynamic nature of IoMT. Software-Defined Networking (SDN), with its centralized control and global network view, offers a promising solution for resource management and load balancing. Although prior research has addressed load balancing at the server, link, or controller level, either individually or in limited pairwise combinations, it lacks a holistic strategy that captures the interdependencies among all three. This work proposes a joint load-balancing approach across servers, links, and multi-domain SDN controllers. It employs Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks to predict future server and controller loads, achieving a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) as low as 0.3934, and integrates a fuzzy-logic system to categorize server levels and domain assignments. The results demonstrate significant improvements in intra-domain load distribution and show that balancing server and link loads directly reduces controller overhead. Furthermore, coordinated interdomain load management helps minimize costly switch migrations, thereby enhancing overall network efficiency and reducing operational costs. The proposed approach enables more intelligent and proactive management of the Software-Defined Internet of Multimedia Things (SD-IoMT), improving QoS and overall performance. Quantitatively, the integrated multi-layer balancing improves the controller Jain's Fairness Index (JFI) by up to 20.6% (from 0.792 to 0.955).

AI.tldr: 本文针对物联网多媒体（IoMT）环境中服务器、链路和多域SDN控制器三层负载均衡问题，提出了一种联合负载均衡方法。该方法利用LSTM网络预测服务器和控制器的未来负载（RMSE低至0.3934），并结合模糊逻辑系统对服务器级别和域分配进行分类，实现了跨三层（服务器、链路、多域控制器）的协同负载均衡。实验结果表明，该方法可将控制器Jain公平性指数提升20.6%（从0.792提升至0.955），显著改善域内负载分布并降低控制器开销。
AI.research_question: 如何在软件定义物联网多媒体（SD-IoMT）环境中实现服务器、链路和多域SDN控制器三个层面的联合负载均衡，以提升整体网络效率和QoS？
AI.motivation: IoMT设备、数据量和用户需求的指数级增长导致流量负载增加，引发服务器拥塞和QoS下降。传统网络架构难以适应IoMT的可扩展性和动态性。虽然已有研究分别在服务器、链路或控制器层面处理负载均衡，但缺乏一种能够捕捉三者间相互依赖关系的整体策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 软件定义网络（SDN）集中控制理论、LSTM深度学习预测模型、模糊逻辑系统分类理论、Jain公平性指数评估框架
AI.method: 提出跨服务器、链路和多域SDN控制器的联合负载均衡方法。采用LSTM网络预测未来服务器和控制器负载，集成模糊逻辑系统对服务器级别和域分配进行分类，实现三层协同的负载管理。
AI.findings: （1）LSTM预测RMSE低至0.3934；（2）平衡服务器和链路负载可直接降低控制器开销；（3）协调的域间负载管理可最小化代价高昂的交换机迁移；（4）集成多层负载均衡使控制器Jain公平性指数提升20.6%（从0.792提升至0.955）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个涵盖服务器、链路和多域控制器三个层面的联合负载均衡框架，弥补了以往仅针对单一或有限两两组合层面的研究空白，深化了对三层负载间相互依赖关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为SD-IoMT网络提供了智能化和前瞻性的负载管理方案，显著提升QoS和整体性能，降低运营成本，减少交换机迁移带来的开销。

title: Economic Policy Uncertainty in the Wake of COVID-19 Pandemic in Kenya: Evidence from Wavelet Coherence Analysis

detail.title: Economic Policy Uncertainty in the Wake of COVID-19 Pandemic in Kenya: Evidence from Wavelet Coherence Analysis
detail.abstract: This study uses wavelet coherence approach on daily data of Covid-19 pandemic and Economic Policy Uncertainty in Kenya spanning from 13 th March 2020 to 22 nd October 2021. The paper aims to firstly adopt a new methodology to measuring economic policy uncertainty based on tweets and secondly to establish whether the Covid-19 pandemic resulted in economic policy uncertainty in Kenya. The study finds evidence of in-phase coherency between covid-19 pandemic and Economic Policy Uncertainty over varying frequency and time dimensions. The study also finds that there were uncertainty jumps during major pandemic events like waves and announcement of new variants by the World Health Organization. The implication of this study to policy makers is twofold. For one, it uses a new web scrapping approach to mine EPU data. The study recommends policymakers to purse this approach along other economic policy uncertainty measures particularly when they want to capture the effect of infectious pandemic on the economy. Secondly, the study offers an initial evidence-based benchmark on policy direction to take in a feat to protect investors and businesses from such shocks in the future as well as the remaining lifetime of the pandemic. From an academic point of view, the methodology can be applied in comparative analysis with other EPU measures such as monetary policy uncertainty and stock market variability. The EPU coefficients created can be used as variables in other studies.

AI.tldr: 本文利用小波相干方法，基于肯尼亚2020年3月13日至2021年10月22日的每日数据，研究了Covid-19疫情与经济政策不确定性（EPU）之间的关系。研究采用基于推文的新方法来衡量经济政策不确定性，发现疫情与EPU在不同频率和时间维度上存在同相相干性，并且在重大疫情事件（如感染浪潮和WHO宣布新变种）期间出现不确定性跳升。
AI.research_question: Covid-19疫情是否导致了肯尼亚的经济政策不确定性？如何采用基于推文的新方法来衡量经济政策不确定性？
AI.motivation: 传统EPU衡量方法主要依赖新闻报纸，可能无法及时捕捉传染病等突发事件对经济政策不确定性的影响。本文旨在采用新的网络爬取方法（基于推文）来度量EPU，并检验疫情对肯尼亚经济政策不确定性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 小波相干分析（wavelet coherence approach），用于分析不同频率和时间维度下两个时间序列之间的相关性。
AI.method: 采用小波相干分析方法，基于肯尼亚每日疫情数据与基于推文构建的经济政策不确定性指数，数据跨度为2020年3月13日至2021年10月22日。
AI.findings: 1) 疫情与EPU在不同频率和时间维度上存在同相相干性；2) 在重大疫情事件（如感染浪潮和WHO宣布新变种）期间出现不确定性跳升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于推文数据（网络爬取方法）衡量经济政策不确定性的新方法论，可应用于与其他EPU指标（如货币政策不确定性和股票市场波动性）的比较分析，生成的EPU系数也可作为其他研究的变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了一种新的EPU衡量方法，特别是在捕捉传染病对经济影响方面具有优势；2) 为保护投资者和企业免受类似冲击提供了基于证据的政策方向基准。

title: ESG Disclosure as a Spatial Competition Device: Cost of Capital, Investment, and Regional Inequality
affiliations: Sapienza University of Rome

detail.title: ESG Disclosure as a Spatial Competition Device: Cost of Capital, Investment, and Regional Inequality
detail.abstract: Mandatory ESG disclosure affects corporate investment through bank credit markets. We model financially constrained firms facing moral hazard, so bank lending capacity is limited by pledgeable income rather than the price of risk. Firm-level environmental disclosure allows banks to replace pooling with separating loan contracts; because borrowing capacity is convex in pledgeable income, disclosure increases aggregate credit and investment. Sustainability mandates bind only against verified standardized metrics, mechanically activating exclusion and segmenting loan supply, thereby reducing credit to excluded borrowers without a corresponding social cost. Because the friction is agency-based, these effects persist under competitive, risk-neutral lending, whereas a risk premium alone would leave investment unchanged. Institutional quality complements environmental exposure in determining pledgeable income, but its investment effect reverses because leverage is convex in pledgeability. The model generates testable predictions for borrower-bank matched lending, financially constrained borrowers, mandate-bound banks, and the staggered implementation of European disclosure rules across countries.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个面临道德风险的财务受限企业模型，研究强制性ESG披露如何通过银行信贷市场影响企业投资。研究表明，企业层面的环境信息披露使银行能够用分离贷款合约替代混同合约，由于借款能力对可质押收入呈凸性，披露总体上增加了信贷和投资。但可持续性强制要求仅针对经核实的标准指标发挥作用，机械性地触发排除机制并分割贷款供给，从而减少了被排除借款人的信贷而不产生相应的社会成本。
AI.research_question: 强制性ESG披露如何通过银行信贷市场影响企业投资？其作用机制和经济后果是什么？
AI.motivation: ESG披露的强制性监管在全球范围内快速推行，但其对实体经济（尤其是企业投资）的影响机制尚未被充分理解。现有文献多关注风险定价渠道，忽视了代理摩擦（道德风险）这一更基础的信贷约束来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论的信贷模型：企业面临道德风险，银行放贷能力受限于可质押收入（pledgeable income）而非风险价格；结合信息经济学中的混同与分离合约理论。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建财务受限企业面临道德风险的正式模型，分析披露前后银行合约从混同到分离的变化，推导信贷总量与投资水平的变化，并扩展至可持续性强制要求、机构质量等情景。
AI.findings: （1）披露通过使银行从混同合约转向分离合约，因借款能力对可质押收入的凸性而增加总信贷与投资；（2）强制性可持续性指标机械激活排除机制，分割贷款供给，减少被排除借款人的信贷且无对应社会成本；（3）在竞争性、风险中性的银行环境中效果依然存在，而单纯风险溢价不会改变投资；（4）机构质量与环境暴露互补决定可质押收入，但对投资的影响方向反转，因为杠杆对可质押性呈凸性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ESG披露效应从风险定价渠道拓展至代理摩擦渠道，揭示了银行信贷中可质押收入约束的关键作用；区分了披露的信息效应与强制性标准的机械排除效应；发现了机构质量与投资之间非单调的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲各国分阶段实施披露规则的预测提供了理论依据；对监管者提出警示：强制性可持续标准可能减少被排除企业的信贷而不产生社会收益；为理解借款人与银行匹配数据、财务受限借款人行为以及受强制约束银行的贷款决策提供分析框架。

title: FRMC: Feature-Regularized Mutual Consistency and Multi-Scale Contrastive Enhancement for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: FRMC: Feature-Regularized Mutual Consistency and Multi-Scale Contrastive Enhancement for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the Chongqing Natural Science Foundation (Grant No. 2024NSCQ-MSX0321), the Science and Technology Research Program of Chongqing Municipal Education Commission (Grant No. KJZD-K202501106), and the Science and Technology Research Program of Chongqing Municipal Education Commission (Grant No. KJZD-K202312906).

detail.abstract: Semi-supervised medical image segmentation has emerged as an effective paradigm for alleviating the reliance on dense expert annotations. However, most existing methods primarily depend on output-level consistency regularization and pseudo-label supervision, while paying insufficient attention to representation discrepancies between heterogeneous networks in the intermediate feature space. Moreover, the lack of coordinated multi-scale feature modeling limits their ability to simultaneously capture fine-grained local details and global anatomical semantics, particularly in anatomically complex regions with ambiguous boundaries. To address these limitations, we propose FRMC, a semi-supervised medical image segmentation framework that integrates Feature-Regularized Mutual Consistency with Multi-scale Contrastive Enhancement in a heterogeneous dual-network architecture. Specifically, we develop a Feature-level Cross-regularization Mechanism (FCM) to explicitly mitigate latent representation discrepancies between heterogeneous branches. By applying region-constrained feature masking and projecting multi-level features into a shared normalized embedding space, this mechanism enforces feature-level semantic consistency and enhances the reliability of pseudo-label learning. Furthermore, we introduce a Multi-scale Contrastive Enhancement Strategy (MCES) to improve feature discriminability across hierarchical semantic levels. Through adaptive response-aware weighting and cross-model contrastive learning on aligned multi-scale representations, this strategy facilitates the joint modeling of local texture patterns and global anatomical structures, thereby strengthening structural semantic representation and suppressing pseudo-label noise accumulation. Extensive experiments on multiple medical image segmentation benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of FRMC. In particular, on the LAHeart dataset with only 20% labeled data, FRMC outperforms strong competing methods by approximately 2 percentage points in Dice score and achieves superior performance on boundary-sensitive metrics, including Hausdorff distance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FRMC框架，一个基于异构双网络架构的半监督医学图像分割方法，通过特征级交叉正则化机制（FCM）和多尺度对比增强策略（MCES）来缓解表示差异、增强多尺度特征建模，在LAHeart等数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.research_question: 如何解决半监督医学图像分割中异构网络间的特征表示差异问题，以及如何通过多尺度特征建模同时捕捉局部细节和全局解剖语义？
AI.motivation: 现有半监督医学图像分割方法主要依赖输出级一致性正则化和伪标签监督，忽视了异构网络在中间特征空间的表示差异；同时缺乏协调的多尺度特征建模，难以在解剖结构复杂的模糊边界区域同时捕捉精细局部细节和全局解剖语义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半监督学习、一致性正则化、对比学习、异构双网络架构、多尺度特征建模
AI.method: 提出FRMC框架，包含两个核心组件：（1）特征级交叉正则化机制（FCM），通过区域约束特征掩蔽和共享归一化嵌入空间投影，强制特征级语义一致性；（2）多尺度对比增强策略（MCES），通过自适应响应感知加权和跨模型对比学习，对对齐的多尺度表示进行联合建模。
AI.findings: 在多个医学图像分割基准上的大量实验验证了FRMC的有效性和鲁棒性。在LAHeart数据集上仅用20%标注数据时，FRMC在Dice分数上比强竞争方法高出约2个百分点，并在Hausdorff距离等边界敏感指标上表现优越。
AI.theory_contributions: 将特征级正则化引入异构双网络半监督分割，弥补了以往仅关注输出级一致性的不足；提出多尺度对比增强策略，实现局部纹理与全局解剖结构的联合建模，丰富了特征表示学习理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医学图像分割提供了一种高效利用少量标注数据的半监督方法，显著降低了对专家标注的依赖；在边界复杂区域的分割精度提升具有临床实用价值。

title: Managing Public Health Surveillance Operations with Endogenous Population Growth
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU), , Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Antai College of Economics and Management, Sun Yat-sen University and Columbia University - School of Nursing

detail.title: Managing Public Health Surveillance Operations with Endogenous Population Growth

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Public health surveillance is "the continuous, systematic collection, analysis and interpretation of health-related data" to guide public health actions (WHO 2012). In addition to traditional recruitment approaches, such as facility-based methods and community outreach, modern surveillance efforts increasingly rely on social media and online platforms. A central operational challenge in these efforts is recruiting a sufficient number of participants within a targeted time frame to ensure unbiased estimation of population health status. In this paper, we develop a Markov Decision Process model to support decision-making in participant recruitment and service for public health surveillance. The resulting formulation is analytically challenging for several reasons. First, population growth, and consequently participant arrivals, are endogenous to the manager's decisions. Second, the terminal penalty depends on cumulative recruitment outcomes from previous periods, creating strong intertemporal dependencies. Third, the model jointly accounts for multiple sources of uncertainty including time-dependent arrival rates, eligibility rates and attrition rates. To address these challenges, we devise a simple yet powerful exact reformulation of the original model. This reformulation reveals the hidden convexity and submodularity properties that are not apparent in the natural formulation. Leveraging these structural properties, we establish that the optimal population expansion decisions exhibit monotonicity and bounded sensitivity with respect to the system state. Building on these theoretical insights, we develop a highly effective, easy-to-implement, and interpretable heuristic policy to dynamically make population expansion decisions. Using data from a large-scale epidemiological study designed to assess HIV risks, we demonstrate that our approach can substantially improve recruitment efficiency and reduce associated costs by 67.44% compared with the policy currently used in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文针对公共卫生监测中的参与者招募与服务决策问题，构建了马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）模型，通过巧妙的精确重构揭示模型的隐凸性和子模性，进而提出高效且可解释的启发式策略。基于大规模HIV风险流行病学研究的实际数据验证，该方法相较现行策略可降低67.44%的成本。
AI.research_question: 如何在公共卫生监测中动态优化参与者招募和服务的决策，以在规定时间框架内招募足够数量的参与者，从而确保人群健康状况估计的无偏性？
AI.motivation: 公共卫生监测面临招募足够数量参与者的核心运营挑战。传统招募方法之外，现代监测越来越多依赖社交媒体和在线平台，但如何在目标时间窗内高效招募参与者并控制成本是亟待解决的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）理论；凸优化与子模性理论，用于揭示模型的结构性质。
AI.method: 构建MDP模型刻画参与者招募与服务的动态决策过程；设计精确重构方法将原始模型转化为具有凸性和子模性的等价形式；利用结构性质推导最优决策的单调性和有界敏感性；基于理论洞见开发简单易行且可解释的启发式策略。
AI.findings: （1）提出了具有隐藏凸性和子模性的精确重构；（2）证明了最优人口扩展决策对系统状态具有单调性和有界敏感性；（3）开发的启发式策略在大规模HIV研究中相较现行策略降低67.44%的成本，显著提升招募效率。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）揭示了公共卫生监测招募问题中MDP模型隐藏的凸性和子模性结构，为类似内生人口增长和跨期依赖问题提供了新的分析框架；（2）建立了最优决策的单调性和有界敏感性理论结果，深化了对该类动态决策问题的结构理解。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供了简单易实现、可解释的启发式策略，便于公共卫生管理人员直接部署使用；（2）基于真实流行病学数据验证，证明该策略能大幅降低招募成本（67.44%），具有显著的实践价值。

title: Self-Cannibalizing Flexibility: When Battery Cycling Destroys Future Opportunities
affiliations: University of Macau, University of Macau and New York University (NYU) - Department of Information, Operations, and Management Sciences

detail.title: Self-Cannibalizing Flexibility: When Battery Cycling Destroys Future Opportunities
detail.abstract: Problem definition: Grid-scale batteries profit by charging when electricity is cheap and discharging when it is expensive. But large batteries face a paradox: by exploiting a price spread today, they can weaken the spread opportunities available tomorrow. We call this effect self-cannibalizing flexibility. We study how this dynamic feedback should change cycle timing, project scale, and portfolio coordination. Methodology/results: We develop a tractable two-window cycle-depth model in which battery cycling affects both current prices and the profitability of the next operating opportunity. The model shows that an operator may optimally skip a profitable current cycle when exercising it destroys a more valuable future opportunity. Stronger feedback reduces total repeated cycling but makes operation more selective, concentrating activity in the better window. As capacity expands, use of a weaker window can decline even while total throughput and project value increase. Future uncertainty always raises continuation value, but it can either increase or decrease current waiting depending on whether future exercise is likely to be underused or capacity-constrained. Fragmented operators cycle earlier than an integrated portfolio because they do not fully internalize the future opportunities their actions destroy. Extensions incorporate physical inventory carryover and multiple connected operating windows, and a CAISO-grounded numerical analysis illustrates the economic magnitudes. Managerial implications: The results translate spread cannibalization into practical operating and investment rules. We derive feedback-adjusted bidding thresholds, cycle-selection rules, project-sizing corrections, and portfolio coordination mechanisms, while identifying the data needed to estimate horizon-specific feedback. The central message is simple: a battery should be valued not only for the spread it captures, but also for the future spread its operation destroys.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了电网规模电池储能面临的自噬灵活性悖论——电池通过利用当前价差获利的同时，会削弱未来价差机会。作者开发了一个两窗口循环深度模型，展示了动态反馈效应如何改变循环时机、项目规模和组合协调决策，并提出了反馈调整的出价阈值、循环选择规则和项目规模修正等实操规则。
AI.research_question: 电池储能的自噬灵活性效应（电池当前的操作会削弱未来盈利机会）如何影响其循环时机、项目规模以及组合协调决策？
AI.motivation: 大型电池储能面临一个悖论：今天利用价差获利会削弱明天的价差机会，这种动态反馈效应在现有文献中缺乏系统性研究，需要理解其对运营和投资决策的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两窗口循环深度模型（two-window cycle-depth model），考虑电池循环对当前价格和下一次运营机会盈利能力的动态影响，并结合实物期权理论分析未来不确定性的延续价值。
AI.method: 构建可解析的两窗口循环深度模型，纳入动态反馈效应、未来不确定性、容量约束、物理库存结转和多连接运营窗口等扩展，并通过CAISO（加州独立系统运营商）数据驱动的数值分析验证经济含义。
AI.findings: （1）在反馈较强的条件下，运营商可能最优地跳过当前有利可图的循环以保留更宝贵的未来机会；（2）能力扩张时，较弱窗口的使用可能下降，即使总吞吐量和项目价值增加；（3）未来不确定性总是提高延续价值，但对当前等待的影响方向取决于未来执行是否可能被低使用或受容量约束；（4）分散运营商比一体化组合更早循环，因为他们没有完全内部化其行为破坏的未来机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统建模了电池储能的"自噬灵活性"效应，将动态反馈引入储能运营优化理论，揭示了未来不确定性与容量约束对等待决策的非单调影响，以及分散决策与一体化组合在循环时机上的系统性差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了反馈调整的出价阈值、循环选择规则、项目规模修正及组合协调机制等实用运营规则，并明确了估算特定时域反馈所需的数据需求。核心信息是电池不仅应计量其捕获的价差，还应计量其操作所破坏的未来价差。

title: The Tech Synthesis: Artificial Intelligence, Indigenous Purpose, and the Future of Ghanaian Social Enterprises

detail.title: The Tech Synthesis: Artificial Intelligence, Indigenous Purpose, and the Future of Ghanaian Social Enterprises
detail.abstract:
Essays like this one often treat indigenous knowledge as a kind of cultural garnish, a
respectful nod before moving on to the real business of technology and economics. That
treatment misunderstands what indigenous knowledge is and what it does. Far from a
static archive of folklore waiting to be digitised, it is a living, adaptive way of knowing and
deciding that continues to generate real economic and social value today.
A University of Ghana study of the informal economy found that indigenous knowledge
significantly enhances food security, health, and community well-being, and promotes environmental sustainability through resource conservation and waste reduction, with recognition scores in the high seventies to mid-eighties across these areas.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了将本土知识视为"文化点缀"的常见观点，指出本土知识是活的、适应性强的认知与决策方式。基于加纳大学对非正式经济的研究，发现本土知识显著提升粮食安全、健康、社区福祉，并通过资源节约和减少浪费促进环境可持续性，各领域认知评分在70多到80多分之间。
AI.research_question: 本土知识在当代非正式经济中的实际价值与作用是什么？它如何贡献于经济、社会与环境可持续性？
AI.motivation: 许多论文将本土知识仅仅视为"文化点缀"，对其真实价值缺乏理解。作者希望纠正这一误解，展示本土知识作为活生生的、适应性强的认知体系，在当代社会中持续产生真实的经济和社会价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本土知识理论（Indigenous Knowledge Theory），非正式经济理论
AI.method: 基于加纳大学对非正式经济的研究数据进行分析，通过对粮食安全、健康、社区福祉、环境可持续性（资源节约与废物减少）等维度进行认知评分。
AI.findings: 本土知识在粮食安全、健康和社区福祉方面显著增强效用，并通过资源节约和减少浪费促进环境可持续性。各维度的认知评分在70多分到80多分之间，表明本土知识在这些领域具有较高的认可度。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了将本土知识视为静态民俗档案的主流观点，提出本土知识是动态、适应性强的认知与决策系统，为理解本土知识的经济与社会价值提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究者提供了实证依据，表明本土知识在非正式经济中对粮食安全、健康、社区福祉和环境可持续性具有实质性贡献，应被纳入发展策略而非仅作文化象征。

title: Digital Appointment Scheduling in the Registries of Criminal Courts of Appeal in Greece

detail.title: Digital Appointment Scheduling in the Registries of Criminal Courts of Appeal in Greece
detail.abstract: The day-to-day operation of the registries of Criminal Courts of Appeal in Greece is characterized by high volumes of citizens and lawyers seeking in-person services, significant fluctuations in workload, and frequent interruptions to internal administrative tasks. This article examines the potential introduction of a digital appointment scheduling system as a means of improving the organization and delivery of public-facing court services. Drawing on an analysis of current practices, international experience, and the specific characteristics of the Greek criminal justice system, the article proposes a hybrid implementation model that combines scheduled appointments for selected administrative procedures with the continued availability of flexible channels for direct access. It highlights the expected benefits for citizens, lawyers, court administrative staff, and court administration, while also identifying the main conditions required for effective implementation, including regulatory clarity, technical simplicity, and appropriate organizational change management. Finally, the article proposes the pilot implementation of such a system in Greek Criminal Courts of Appeal as a cautious and practical pathway towards a gradual transition to a more predictable and efficient model of court administration.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在希腊刑事上诉法院登记处引入数字预约调度系统，提出混合实施模式，将预约制与灵活的直接访问渠道相结合，以改善法院面向公众服务的组织与交付。
AI.research_question: 如何通过引入数字预约调度系统来改善希腊刑事上诉法院登记处的服务组织与交付效率？
AI.motivation: 希腊刑事上诉法院登记处的日常运营面临高人流量的面对面服务需求、工作量波动显著以及内部行政任务频繁中断等问题，亟需改进服务交付模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共服务数字化转型理论、混合服务交付模式理论、组织变革管理理论
AI.method: 基于对现行实践的案例分析、国际经验比较研究，以及希腊刑事司法体系的特征分析，提出混合实施模式。
AI.findings: 提出了一种混合实施模式：对选定的行政程序采用预约制，同时保留灵活的直接访问渠道；识别了有效实施的关键条件（监管清晰性、技术简洁性和适当的组织变革管理）；建议在希腊刑事上诉法院进行试点实施。
AI.theory_contributions: 为法院公共服务数字化转型提供了混合预约模式的框架性分析，丰富了司法行政管理领域的服务交付理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为希腊刑事上诉法院提供了具体的数字预约系统实施路径和试点方案，有助于提升公民、律师、法院行政人员及管理层的服务体验与工作效率。

title: Examining The Value Relevance of Accounting Information: Evidence from Nairobi Stock Exchange (Nse)
affiliations: , Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics, Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics, Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics and University of Jos, Nigeria

detail.title: Examining The Value Relevance of Accounting Information: Evidence from Nairobi Stock Exchange (Nse)
detail.abstract: Prior studies indicate that with the transition of economy from industrial to a technology-driven service-oriented economy, the usefulness of accounting numbers, especially earnings, has reduced. This is shown by the obscurity of the link between market stock prices in accounting figures, especially earnings. Based on his perspective, this study examines the extent of stock price movement explained by the change in key accounting metrics using companies listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange. The sample comprises 56 listed companies across 23 sectors from 2016 to 2023. Using a panel data fixed effects regression, we examine the impacts of key accounting metrics on market share prices. We find that both (lnEPS β = 0.137; p < 0.05) and (lnDPS β = 0.331; p < 0.01) have statistically significant positive relationships with share prices in the market (lnMSP). In contrast, lnOCF (β = 0.01, p < 0.1) and lnTA (β = 0.013, p < 0.1) have positive but insignificant impact effects. The R-squared of the model is 0.471, indicating that the four accounting variables explain 47.1 % of the movement in stock price. The findings align with the Dividend Signaling Theory and the Bird-in-Hand Theory. Additionally, the findings show the existence of a weak-form efficient market in the Nairobi Stock Exchange. Generally, the study confirms the persistence of accounting information's value relevance in equity investments in Kenya.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于价值相关性视角，利用内罗毕证券交易所2016-2023年56家上市公司的面板数据，检验关键会计指标对股票价格变动的影响。研究发现每股收益（EPS）和每股股利（DPS）与股价显著正相关，而经营现金流（OCF）和总资产（TA）的影响不显著。四个会计变量共同解释了股价变动的47.1%，支持股利信号理论和"一鸟在手"理论，并表明内罗毕证券交易所存在弱式有效市场。
AI.research_question: 在经济从工业向技术驱动的服务型经济转型的背景下，会计信息（尤其是盈余）的价值相关性是否仍然存在？具体而言，关键会计指标在多大程度上能够解释内罗毕证券交易所上市公司的股价变动？
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明，随着经济向技术驱动型服务经济转型，会计数字（尤其是盈余）的有用性已经降低，表现为市场股价与会计数据（特别是盈余）之间联系的模糊性。本研究旨在从这一视角出发，检验新兴市场（肯尼亚）中会计信息的价值相关性是否依然存在。
AI.theoretical_framework: 股利信号理论（Dividend Signaling Theory）和一鸟在手理论（Bird-in-Hand Theory）；弱式有效市场假说（Weak-form Efficient Market Hypothesis）。
AI.method: 采用面板数据固定效应回归模型，研究样本为内罗毕证券交易所2016-2023年23个行业的56家上市公司。因变量为对数化市场股价（lnMSP），自变量包括对数化每股收益（lnEPS）、对数化每股股利（lnDPS）、对数化经营现金流（lnOCF）和对数化总资产（lnTA）。
AI.findings: 1. lnEPS（β=0.137, p<0.05）和lnDPS（β=0.331, p<0.01）与股价呈统计显著的正相关关系；2. lnOCF（β=0.01, p<0.1）和lnTA（β=0.013, p<0.1）虽为正但影响不显著；3. 模型R²为0.471，表明四个会计变量解释了股价变动的47.1%；4. 研究结果支持股利信号理论和一鸟在手理论；5. 内罗毕证券交易所存在弱式有效市场。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了在新兴市场（肯尼亚）背景下会计信息价值相关性的持续性；2. 为股利信号理论和一鸟在手理论提供了新兴市场的实证证据；3. 提供了弱式有效市场假说在非洲资本市场的经验支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供依据会计指标进行投资决策的参考；2. 为内罗毕证券交易所上市公司管理层提供股利政策制定的实证依据；3. 为监管机构和准则制定者提供会计信息有用性的市场证据。

title: Personal AI Sovereignty: From Platform Data Extraction to User-Controlled Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: Personal AI Sovereignty: From Platform Data Extraction to User-Controlled Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: Contemporary digital services generally organise personal information around institutional ownership, centralised platforms and repeated data extraction. Individuals may generate enormous quantities of behavioural, social, educational, financial, health and conversational data while retaining limited practical control over how those data are combined, inferred from, transferred or monetised. The emergence of persistent personal artificial intelligence creates an opportunity to reverse this relationship. This paper proposes personal AI sovereignty: an architecture in which an individual controls a persistent AI environment and the underlying longitudinal personal record, while third parties receive only the information required for an authorised purpose. The proposed architecture combines a personal encrypted data environment, self-sovereign identity, verifiable credentials, selective disclosure, zero-knowledge proofs and an auditable permission layer. Sensitive personal content—including journals, health information, photographs, documents and other high-dimensional records—would remain off-chain in encrypted storage. Distributed ledgers would not be used as a database for intimate information; their proposed role is narrower: recording permissions, proofs, credential status, governance rules and auditable access events where appropriate. This distinction is essential because public transparency and personal privacy are not the same objective. The paper argues that data sovereignty should be understood not merely as a privacy preference but as an institutional design principle. The individual should be able to decide who may access information, for what purpose, for how long, under what conditions, and whether access can subsequently be revoked. Service providers should be able to request a verifiable claim without necessarily learning the underlying data—for example, proving that a person is over a required age without revealing a full date of birth. Contemporary standards and public infrastructure demonstrate that significant components of this architecture are already technically and institutionally plausible. W3C Verifiable Credentials 2.0 is a web standard, W3C's Decentralized Identifier work provides a framework for decentralised identity, and European digital identity work incorporates selective disclosure and zero-knowledge techniques. The paper does not claim that blockchain, self-sovereign identity or cryptography automatically solve surveillance, discrimination or commercial exploitation. Technical systems can fail, users can be coerced, metadata can leak, credentials can be abused and governance can be captured. The proposal is therefore a socio-technical architecture: technical sovereignty must be combined with legal rights, transparent governance, independent audit, interoperability, security, accessibility and meaningful user control. The AI Journal is used as a concrete case through which the architecture can be tested, beginning with privacy-preserving child safeguarding and life-course personal development. The wider proposition is that personal AI could shift the dominant digital relationship from platform-owned data extraction to individual data stewardship, creating a foundation for new forms of social coordination without requiring a central institution to possess everyone's personal history.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"个人AI主权"架构，旨在逆转当前以平台为中心的数据提取模式。该架构让个体控制一个持久的AI环境及其底层的纵向个人记录，第三方仅能获得授权目的所需的信息。架构结合个人加密数据环境、自主身份、可验证凭证、选择性披露、零知识证明和可审计的权限层，并强调数据主权应被视为制度设计原则而非单纯的隐私偏好。
AI.research_question: 如何通过"个人AI主权"架构来逆转当前数字服务中以机构所有权和集中式平台为中心的数据关系，使个体能够真正控制其个人数据的使用与流转？
AI.motivation: 当前数字服务围绕机构所有权、集中平台和重复数据提取组织个人信息，个体虽生成大量行为、社交、教育、金融、健康和对话数据，却对数据的组合、推断、转移和变现缺乏实际控制。持久个人AI的出现提供了逆转这一关系的机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据主权理论（作为制度设计原则而非隐私偏好）、自主身份（Self-Sovereign Identity）、可验证凭证（W3C Verifiable Credentials 2.0）、去中心化标识符（DID）、选择性披露与零知识证明、社会技术架构理论
AI.method: 概念性架构设计方法。提出一个多层技术架构（加密数据环境+自主身份+可验证凭证+选择性披露+零知识证明+可审计权限层），并通过"AI期刊"（AI Journal）作为具体用例进行验证，涵盖隐私保护的儿童保护和终生个人发展场景。同时结合现有标准（W3C VC 2.0、DID、欧洲数字身份框架）论证技术可行性。
AI.findings: 当代标准（W3C可验证凭证2.0、去中心化标识符、欧洲数字身份工作）已证明该架构的核心组件在技术和制度层面具有可行性。分布式账本不应作为亲密信息的数据库，其角色应局限于记录权限、证明、凭证状态、治理规则和可审计访问事件。区块链、自主身份或密码学并不能自动解决监控、歧视或商业剥削问题，技术主权必须与法律权利、透明治理、独立审计、互操作性、安全性和有意义的用户控制相结合。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数据主权重新概念化——从单纯的隐私偏好提升为制度设计原则；区分"公共透明"与"个人隐私"为不同目标，明确了分布式账本在个人数据架构中的恰当边界角色；提出"个人AI"作为从平台所有权数据提取转向个体数据管理的制度转变基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可操作的个人AI主权架构蓝图；以"AI期刊"作为具体测试用例，覆盖隐私保护的儿童保护和终生个人发展场景；利用已有W3C标准与欧洲数字身份基础设施，降低了实施门槛；为服务提供商提供验证声明而不必接触底层数据的实践路径（如证明年龄而不泄露出生日期）。

title: From Watchdog to Policy Participant: Why Retraction Watch and the Center for Scientific Integrity Fail the Test for Presumptive Independent Authority
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: From Watchdog to Policy Participant: Why Retraction Watch and the Center for Scientific Integrity Fail the Test for Presumptive Independent Authority
detail.abstract: Retraction Watch is a journalism website and the Center for Scientific Integrity (CSI) is its private nonprofit parent. Neither label establishes scientific, adjudicative or policy authority. This article tests whether the public record demonstrates the independence, methodological validation, conflict control, external mandate and contestability required for institutions to defer to their outputs. It does not. The resulting conclusion is disqualification from presumptive independent authority: their statements may be examined as claims, but journals, universities, funders, lawmakers and data users should not treat them as verified findings without independent primary-source review.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了Retraction Watch及其母机构科学诚信中心（CSI）是否具备独立权威性，结论是其不符合独立裁决机构的标准，其输出只能被视为主张而非经过验证的发现。
AI.research_question: Retraction Watch和科学诚信中心是否拥有可供机构（期刊、大学、资助方、立法者和数据用户）依赖其输出的独立权威性？
AI.motivation: Retraction Watch作为学术撤稿新闻网站被广泛引用，但其地位既非科学机构也非裁决机构，需要检验其是否具备机构依赖所需的标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机构权威的正当性标准，包括独立性、方法论验证、冲突控制、外部授权和可争辩性。
AI.method: 基于公开记录的检验评估，围绕独立性、方法论验证、冲突控制、外部授权和可争辩性五个维度进行审查。
AI.findings: 公开记录未能证明Retraction Watch具备五个关键标准，因此其不应被赋予预设的独立权威地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了评估科学新闻/监督机构是否应被机构依赖的五个标准框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为期刊、大学、资助方、立法者和数据使用者提供指导，建议不应将Retraction Watch输出视为经过验证的发现，需独立审查原始来源。
