AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了"发散算子"（快窗口与慢窗口追踪估计量之差，即广义的移动平均收敛/发散指标），证明了22项刻画其灵敏度、时序及分岔附近最优窗口化的结果，并建立持久性-符号定理与超集性质（临界减速是发散算子局限于分岔型转变的特例）。作者在七个领域用单一预注册规范进行测试，结果喜忧参半：同观测符号律在五个领域成立、无一被反驳，太阳物理是最强佐证；股市波动率面板是最弱案例，面板均值相关性仅+0.0528且未通过预注册门槛。论文还报告了一个洁净的样本外检验（太阳验证）。
AI.research_question: 如何从统一的理论框架理解并刻画"发散算子"（快慢窗口估计量之差）这一跨领域被广泛使用但缺乏共享理论的制度转变预测指标？其性质、信息含量与实证表现如何？
AI.motivation: 金融中的MACD指标、宏观经济学中的萨姆规则、生态学中的方差上升指标等都在实践中用"快估计与慢基线比较"来预测制度转变，但缺乏统一理论。本文旨在填补这一理论空白，将这种比较操作形式化为"发散算子"并系统刻画其性质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 发散算子（divergence operator）理论框架，包括：快窗口与慢窗口追踪估计量之差的形式化；持久性-符号定理（Persistence-Sign Theorem，仅凭观测值的自相关即可确定其前向预测符号）；超集性质（证明临界减速是发散算子局限于分岔型转变的特例）；分岔附近的最优窗口化理论。
AI.method: 理论证明与实证检验相结合：(1) 推导22项数学结果刻画发散算子的灵敏度、时序与最优窗口化；(2) 在七个领域（股票波动率、股票相关结构、水文学、太阳物理学、流行病学、天气、宏观经济学）进行单一预注册规范的实证测试；(3) 报告一个样本外验证（太阳验证）：锁定2009年前固定规格的操作符在2008年后数据上验证其先验负号。
AI.findings: 实证结果喜忧参半：(1) 同观测符号律在七个领域中的五个成立且无一被反驳，太阳物理是最强确认；(2) 发散算子相较临界减速的实际优势真实存在但依赖领域；(3) 股票波动率面板是最弱案例，面板均值相关性仅+0.0528且未通过预注册门槛；(4) 太阳验证（样本外）：锁定操作符的先验负号在2008年后留存数据上持续成立。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 为跨领域的发散比较操作提供了统一理论框架；(2) 持久性-符号定理建立了观测自相关与前向预测符号之间的理论联系；(3) 超集性质确立了发散算子与临界减速之间的包含关系，证明前者携带严格更多的信息；(4) 提供22项定理系统刻画该算子的灵敏度、时序与窗口化性质。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为金融、宏观、生态等领域的制度转变预测提供了可操作的统一指标框架；(2) 提供了单预注册多领域的大规模实证基准评估，帮助实践者了解各领域适用性；(3) 提供了一个洁净的样本外验证案例（太阳验证），展示了锁定规格操作符的验证方法论；(4) 明确了发散算子相对临界减速的实用优势及其领域依赖性。

title: Geographic Disparities in International News Coverage of Fatal Israeli Attacks in Lebanon, March 2026
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Geographic Disparities in International News Coverage of Fatal Israeli Attacks in Lebanon, March 2026

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: International news coverage of armed conflict shapes which fatal events and affected regions become globally visible, yet geographic inequality in conflict reporting within countries remains understudied. This study examines international media attention to fatal Israeli attacks during the March 2026 escalation of the Israel-Hezbollah conflict in Lebanon, with particular attention to South Lebanon and Nabatieh. Using an location-day-level computational media analysis, we constructed an NNA-derived reference list of 229 fatal location-days-defined as a place and calendar day with at least one confirmed death-and matched each against non-Lebanese English-language news coverage indexed by Media Cloud within three days. Among the 180 cases whose coverage status could be resolved, 90 (50.0%) received no qualifying international coverage. The resolved-case coverage rate was 44.9% in South Lebanon and Nabatieh, which together accounted for 83.4% of documented fatal location-days, compared with 72.7% elsewhere in Lebanon. In a logistic regression adjusting for death toll and calendar week, with standard errors clustered by event date, fatal location-days in South Lebanon and Nabatieh had approximately 65% lower odds of international news coverage than those elsewhere (adjusted OR 0.35, 95% CI 0.17-0.72, p=0.004). This geographic disparity remained statistically significant under alternative treatments of unresolved cases, while the association between casualty scale and coverage was positive but statistically inconclusive. The findings document substantial geographic inequality in conflict reporting and international news visibility within Lebanon. Because the study is observational and limited to NNA-documented events and Media Cloud's English-language sources, it cannot identify the mechanisms producing the disparity or provide a complete census of global media coverage.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察了2026年3月以色列-真主党冲突升级期间，国际媒体对黎巴嫩境内致命袭击事件的报道地理不平等性。基于NNA衍生的229个致命地点-日清单，匹配Media Cloud索引的非黎巴嫩英语新闻报道，发现50%的可确认事件未获任何国际报道。南黎巴嫩和纳巴提耶地区的报道率（44.9%）显著低于黎巴嫩其他地区（72.7%），经Logistic回归调整死亡人数和日历周后，该地区获得报道的几率低约65%（校正OR 0.35）。
AI.research_question: 在国家内部，国际媒体报道武装冲突致命事件时是否存在地理不平等性？具体而言，黎巴嫩南部的南黎巴嫩和纳巴提耶地区的致命袭击事件是否比黎巴嫩其他地区更少获得国际新闻报道？
AI.motivation: 国际新闻报道塑造了全球对致命事件和受影响地区的可见性，但现有研究大多关注国家间报道不平等，而忽视国家内部的报道地理差异。理解这种地理不平等有助于揭示媒体关注度的系统性偏差及其对全球认知的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于冲突报道的新闻价值理论框架，关注地理因素如何影响新闻选择过程，即新闻编辑部在有限的报道资源下如何决定报道哪些冲突事件和地区。
AI.method: 采用地点-日层面的计算媒体分析方法。构建了229个致命地点-日（某地点某日至少有一人确认死亡的组合）的参考清单，并与Media Cloud索引的非黎巴嫩英语新闻报道在三天内进行匹配。使用Logistic回归，以死亡人数和日历周为调整变量，按事件日期聚类标准误。
AI.findings: 在180个可确认报道状态的事件中，90个（50.0%）未获得任何符合条件的国际报道。南黎巴嫩和纳巴提耶的可确认事件报道率为44.9%，而黎巴嫩其他地区为72.7%。调整后，南黎巴嫩和纳巴提耶的致命地点-日获得国际报道的几率低约65%（校正OR 0.35, 95% CI 0.17-0.72, p=0.004）。该地理差异在不同处理未解决案例的替代方案下仍保持统计显著，而伤亡规模与报道之间的关联为正相关但在统计上无定论。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究将新闻价值理论扩展到国家内部的报道地理不平等分析，实证揭示了即使在同一国家内，不同地理区域的冲突事件在国际媒体报道中存在系统性可见性差异，补充了冲突新闻地理学的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究为国际媒体和新闻机构提供了关于报道偏见的具体证据，有助于推动媒体反思并改善对国家内部边缘地区的冲突报道覆盖，促进全球对冲突中人道主义危机的更公平认知。

title: Risk-based Interest Rate Expectations

detail.title: Risk-based Interest Rate Expectations
detail.abstract: I develop a method to extract interest-rate expectations from options markets by connecting interest-rate risk premia to interest-rate variance risk premia, with no assumptions on interest-rate stationarity. I document first that historical excess bond returns were driven by risk premia, not forecast errors. Second, risk-based forecasts outperform surveys and term-structure models out of sample. Third, risk-neutral variance drops sharply around FOMC announcements, suggesting a risk-premium explanation for the FOMC-announcement decline in long-term rates. Fourth, the recent positive stock-yield correlation is driven by expectations and not risk premia.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种从期权市场提取利率预期的新方法，通过将利率风险溢价与利率方差风险溢价联系起来，且不假设利率具有平稳性。作者发现：历史超额债券收益由风险溢价驱动而非预测误差；风险因子预测模型在样本外优于调查和期限结构模型；FOMC公告前后风险中性方差急剧下降，为FOMC公告导致长期利率下降提供了风险溢价解释；近期股票-收益率正相关由预期驱动而非风险溢价。
AI.research_question: 如何从期权市场中提取利率预期？利率风险溢价与利率方差风险溢价之间存在何种联系？
AI.motivation: 传统的利率预期提取方法通常依赖期限结构模型或调查数据，且往往需要对利率平稳性做出假设，这限制了其适用性。作者希望开发一种不依赖平稳性假设的方法，通过期权市场数据更准确地提取利率预期，并揭示FOMC公告效应和股债相关性等关键宏观金融现象背后的驱动机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利率风险溢价与利率方差风险溢价之间的联系框架；无套利定价理论；预期假说。
AI.method: 利用期权市场隐含信息构建利率风险溢价与方差风险溢价的联系，开发从期权中提取利率预期的新方法，配合实证分析（样本外预测比较、事件研究等）。
AI.findings: （1）历史超额债券收益由风险溢价驱动而非预测误差；（2）基于风险的预测在样本外优于调查和期限结构模型；（3）FOMC公告时风险中性方差急剧下降，表明风险溢价解释了FOMC公告导致的长期利率下降；（4）近期股票-收益率正相关由预期驱动而非风险溢价。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种不依赖利率平稳性假设的利率预期提取方法，将利率风险溢价与方差风险溢价联系起来；为FOMC公告效应和股债相关性提供了新的理论解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种更准确的利率预期提取工具，可用于资产定价、货币政策传导分析和投资决策；帮助理解FOMC公告、股债相关性等实际市场现象。

title: The Anatomy of a Squeeze: An Agent-Based Model of Attention-Driven Herding in Meme Stocks
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Anatomy of a Squeeze: An Agent-Based Model of Attention-Driven Herding in Meme Stocks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no funding for this work.

detail.abstract: The 2021 GameStop episode and subsequent "meme stock" events revealed a trading pattern that standard asset-pricing models struggle to capture: coordinated retail buying, driven by social-media attention, that triggers short-covering feedback loops and produces extreme, transient price dislocations. This paper develops an agent-based model (ABM) of meme-stock dynamics with three heterogeneous agent types-fundamentalist traders, herding retail traders whose behavior follows a Kirman (1993) ant-colony imitation process modulated by an endogenous attention signal, and margin-constrained short sellers subject to forced covering. We present a four-stage model progression, from an unrefined Base Model that reproduces strongly fat-tailed, positively-skewed returns through three successively more mechanically realistic refinements, and validate the final specification against the empirical herding methodology of Chang, Cheng, and Khorana (2000) and Chiang and Zheng (2010)-the same framework used in the empirical meme-stock literature (Aloosh, Choi, and Ouzan, 2021; Warkulat and Pelster, 2024). Simulating a cross-section of stocks sharing a common attention pool, we recover a correlation between rolling herding intensity and attention of-0.183, closely matching the-0.18 reported by Aloosh et al. for real WallStreetBets-driven meme stocks. We discuss the trade-offs revealed across the four model variants and situate the model within the heterogeneous-agentmodel (behavioral ABM) tradition rather than the market-microstructure tradition.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于主体的模型（ABM）来捕捉迷因股（meme stock）的动态特征，包括协调性散户买入、社交媒体注意力驱动的羊群行为，以及卖空者的强制回补所形成的反馈循环。模型包含三类异质主体：基本面交易者、遵循Kirman（1993）蚁群模仿过程并受内生注意力信号调节的羊群散户，以及面临保证金约束的卖空者。经过四阶段模型演进和实证验证，模型成功复现了与真实WallStreetBets驱动迷因股一致的羊群强度与注意力之间的负相关关系。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够捕捉迷因股动态特征（社交媒体注意力驱动的协调性散户买入、卖空回补反馈循环及极端价格错位）的异质主体模型？
AI.motivation: 2021年GameStop事件及其他迷因股事件揭示了一种标准资产定价模型难以捕捉的交易模式：社交媒体注意力驱动的协调性散户买入，触发卖空回补反馈循环，产生极端且短暂的价格错位。现有模型无法解释这一现象，需要新的建模框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于主体的模型（ABM）传统，结合Kirman（1993）蚁群模仿过程作为羊群行为的微观基础，并融入异质主体模型（行为ABM）理论框架。
AI.method: 构建包含三类异质主体（基本面交易者、羊群散户、受保证金约束的卖空者）的基于主体的模型。采用四阶段模型递进：从基础模型到三个逐步更机械现实的精细化版本。使用Chang, Cheng和Khorana（2000）及Chiang和Zheng（2010）的实证羊群方法进行验证，并模拟共享共同注意力池的股票横截面。
AI.findings: 模型成功复现了迷因股的核心动态。在共享共同注意力池的股票横截面模拟中，滚动羊群强度与注意力之间的相关系数为-0.183，与Aloosh等人报告的WallStreetBets驱动的真实迷因股-0.18的相关系数高度吻合。基础模型即可复现厚尾、正偏态的收益分布。
AI.theory_contributions: 将模型定位于异质主体模型（行为ABM）传统而非市场微观结构传统，为理解社交媒体驱动的新兴交易现象提供了行为金融学视角的理论框架，并系统揭示了四阶段模型变体之间的权衡取舍。
AI.practical_contributions: 为迷因股现象提供了一个可验证的模拟框架，能够复现真实的经验羊群度量结果，有助于监管者和市场参与者理解社交媒体驱动交易模式的动态机制。

title: AI as Individualised Persona: A Useful Addition to the Economist's Toolbox? The case of "Stephen Littlechild AI Agent"
affiliations: Victoria University and Victoria University

detail.title: AI as Individualised Persona: A Useful Addition to the Economist's Toolbox? The case of "Stephen Littlechild AI Agent"

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This paper examines a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) customisation of artificial intelligence platform ChatGPT, using papers written by economist Professor Stephen Littlechild from the 1960s to the present, to create "SCL AI Agent" (SCL). SCL seeks to replicate and apply the thinking of Professor Littlechild. Establishing the corpus of Professor Littlechild's papers, uploading it to ChatGPT and then instructing ChatGPT on how to understand that information and apply it, revealed the need for experimentation and learning-by-doing. Careful configuration sought to reduce hallucination and ensure well-informed responses delivered in Professor Littlechild's style. Assessment of SCL by regulatory professionals who have had long interaction with Professor Littlechild rated SCL highly, particularly in respect of "insight", "completeness" and "accuracy". These assessors were less convinced of SCL's ability to replicate Professor Littlechild's written style. However, if users provided SCL with context to their questions and information on the audience for its answers, SCL did deliver responses tailored to those audiences. SCL itself and uncustomised ChatGPT were asked to assess SCL's answers to the assessors' questions. They both agreed on SCL's superiority relative to uncustomised ChatGPT. SCL demonstrated a sophisticated, abstract understanding of Professor Littlechild's scholarship, although its ability to replicate his imagination is less clear and merits further research. Creating AI agents of other economists and setting them to critique each other's work could facilitate the more rapid dissemination of insight and understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了如何通过检索增强生成（RAG）技术定制化ChatGPT，利用经济学家Stephen Littlechild教授自1960年代至今的论文构建语料库，创建"SCL AI Agent"（SCL），以复制和应用Littlechild教授的思维方式。研究发现，通过精心配置可减少幻觉并确保以教授风格提供信息充分的回答。监管专业人士对SCL评价较高，尤其在"洞察力"、"完整性"和"准确性"方面，但对文风复刻能力存疑。SCL展现出对教授学术思想的复杂抽象理解能力，但其想象力复制能力仍有待研究。
AI.research_question: 如何利用RAG技术定制化AI平台，创建能够复制和应用特定经济学家（Stephen Littlechild教授）思维的AI智能体？
AI.motivation: 探索利用AI技术保存和传播杰出经济学家的学术思维与洞察力，并通过定制化RAG方法减少幻觉、提供更精准的学术回答。
AI.theoretical_framework: 检索增强生成（RAG）技术；人工智能大语言模型定制化理论；知识蒸馏与思维复刻
AI.method: 运用RAG技术定制ChatGPT平台，建立Littlechild教授论文语料库并上传，通过实验和边做边学方式指导ChatGPT理解与应用信息；由长期与教授互动的监管专业人士进行评估，并由SCL自身及未定制ChatGPT进行自我评估对比。
AI.findings: 监管专业人士对SCL评价较高，尤其在"洞察力"、"完整性"和"准确性"方面突出；对文风复刻能力认可度较低；当用户提供上下文和受众信息时，SCL能提供针对性回答；SCL与未定制ChatGPT均认可SCL在回答质量上优于未定制ChatGPT；SCL展现出对教授学术思想的高级抽象理解能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI智能体复制特定学者思维方式提供了实践框架和评估方法，展示了RAG定制化在学术知识传播领域的应用潜力。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了创建其他经济学家AI智能体并进行互相批评的新思路，可能促进洞察和理解的快速传播；为学术机构和个人利用AI保存和传承学者智慧提供了可行方案。

title: Pretreatment CT identification of lymph node metastasis in esophageal squamous cell cancer using deep learning: a multicenter, retrospective study in China
affiliations: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC), Peking University, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC), Fujian Medical University - Department of Radiation Oncology, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC), University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC), Sichuan Clinical Research Center for Cancer, Sichuan Clinical Research Center for Cancer, Sichuan Clinical Research Center for Cancer, Sichuan Clinical Research Center for Cancer, Fujian Medical University - Fujian Cancer Hospital, Peking University - Center for Data Science, Peking University, Xinjiang Medical University, Central South University - Hunan Cancer Hospital, Alibaba Damo Academy and University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC)

detail.title: Pretreatment CT identification of lymph node metastasis in esophageal squamous cell cancer using deep learning: a multicenter, retrospective study in China

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval for this study was granted by the institutional review board of Sichuan Cancer Hospital (KY-2026-125-02). All patient information was anonymized prior to analysis and individual informed consent was waived due to its retrospective nature.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by Damo Academy (Hupan Laboratory) through the Damo Academy (Hupan Laboratory) Innovative Research Program, Sichuan Science and Technology Program (No. 2026NSFSC1908), the National Natural Science Foundation of China (No. 82573448).

detail.abstract:
Background: Manual assessment of lymph node metastasis (LNM) in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) is inconsistent, and this study is aimed to develop a deep learning tool, DeepLNM, for LNM identification in ESCC. 

Methods: Consecutive ESCC patients with radical esophagectomy at Sichuan Cancer Hospital (2009–2018) comprised the internal cohort to develop DeepLNM, with three independent external test sets. Regional lymph nodes (LNs) with nodal stations were automatically segmented on computed tomography (CT) scans, and manually annotated according to histopathology. The DeepLNM diagnostic performance was evaluated by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) with its 95% confidence interval (CI), and compared to physicians.

Findings: The internal set comprised 815 ESCC patients (2,631 LN masks) for DeepLNM development, with 657 patients (4,314 annotations) in the external set. DeepLNM achieved an AUC of 0.92 (95% CI: 0.90, 0.94) for lesion-level LNM identification in the internal dataset with the most optimal sensitivity 0.85 and specificity 0.86, and AUCs of 0.89 (95% CI: 0.86, 0.92), 0.90 (95% CI: 0.86, 0.93), and 0.89 (95% CI: 0.86, 0.91) in the external test set 1, 2, and 3, respectively. For patient-level N-stage classification, DeepLNM demonstrated an AUC of 0.86 (95% CI: 0.84, 0.89) in the internal dataset with the most optimal sensitivity 0.73 and specificity 0.85, and AUCs of 0.84 (95% CI: 0.79, 0.88), 0.85 (95% CI: 0.77, 0.92), and 0.81 (95% CI: 0.75, 0.86) in the external test set 1, 2, and 3, respectively. DeepLNM outperformed oncologists in AUCs of LNM identification (0.91 vs 0.66–0.78, P < 0.05) and N-stage classification (0.83 vs 0.53–0.67, P < 0.05).

Interpretation: DeepLNM accurately detected LNM and classified N-stage in patients with ESCC using pretreatment CT, highlighting its clinical value in personalized risk stratification and risk-adapted treatment.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并验证了深度学习工具DeepLNM，用于基于CT影像自动分割淋巴结并识别食管鳞状细胞癌（ESCC）的淋巴结转移（LNM），在内部和外部数据集上均表现出优于肿瘤科医生的诊断性能。
AI.research_question: 如何利用深度学习技术基于CT影像自动、准确地在食管鳞状细胞癌（ESCC）患者中识别淋巴结转移并分类N分期？
AI.motivation: 食管鳞状细胞癌（ESCC）中淋巴结转移（LNM）的人工评估存在不一致性问题，缺乏客观、标准化且准确的诊断工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习（深度卷积神经网络）在医学影像分析中的应用，结合CT影像的淋巴结自动分割与分类。
AI.method: 内部队列来自四川肿瘤医院2009-2018年815例ESCC根治术后患者（2,631个淋巴结掩膜），构建DeepLNM模型；另设三个独立外部测试集共657例患者（4,314个标注）。CT扫描上自动分割区域淋巴结及淋巴结站，并根据组织病理学手动标注。通过受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）评估诊断性能，并与医生进行比较。
AI.findings: DeepLNM在内部数据集的病变水平LNM识别中AUC为0.92（敏感性0.85，特异性0.86），在三个外部测试集中AUC分别为0.89、0.90和0.89。患者水平N分期分类中，内部数据集AUC为0.86，外部测试集AUC分别为0.84、0.85和0.81。DeepLNM在LNM识别（0.91 vs 0.66-0.78）和N分期分类（0.83 vs 0.53-0.67）方面均显著优于肿瘤科医生（P < 0.05）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将深度学习应用于ESCC患者CT影像的淋巴结自动分割与转移识别，实现了病变水平和患者水平的双重诊断，为医学影像AI在肿瘤精准分期中的应用提供了理论和实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: DeepLNM可利用治疗前CT准确检测LNM并分类N分期，有助于ESCC患者的个性化风险分层和风险适应性治疗决策，可减少人工评估的主观性和不一致性，提升临床诊断效率和准确性。

title: Impact of the Diabetes Poland Grant Program in 2010–2026 on scientific performance, productivity and career development
affiliations: Medical University of Lodz, Medical University of Lodz, Medical University of Lodz, Medical University of Lodz and Medical University of Lodz

detail.title: Impact of the Diabetes Poland Grant Program in 2010–2026 on scientific performance, productivity and career development

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors declare non conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: The study was financed by Diabetes Poland, including medical writing support for J.C., B.P., and A.M. J.C. was additionally supported by the Medical University of Lodz BRaIn P1 grant, the National Science Centre PRELUDIUM BIS 4 grant (2022/47/O/NZ5/00683), and the Foundation for Polish Science START programme.

detail.abstract:
Background: The grant program of Diabetes Poland (PTD) is a key funding source for diabetes-focused researchers in Poland. To assess the impact of PTD grant program on scientific productivity and career development.

Methods: Bibliometric, career and financial data was extracted from PTD, Scopus and Polish science databases (RAD-on) for the 2010-2026 period. Network analysis was performed to evaluate collaboration patterns.

Findings: A total of 1.8 million USD was distributed through 83 grants to 71 researchers. The annual funding increased by 9.6%/year (95%CI: 4.1 to 15.3%). Median research productivity increased from 0.6 to 1.6 publications/year (+1.0; p<0.0001). A significant increase in collaboration among awardees was observed (p<0.0001). The awardees had a significantly shorter time to associate professorship than the national average (8 vs 11.8 years; p=0.0045).

Interpretation: The PTD grant program increases scientific productivity, accelerates post-doctoral advancement, and enhances integration of the Polish diabetology research community.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了波兰糖尿病协会（PTD）资助项目对科学产出和职业发展的影响，发现该项目显著提高了研究者的发表效率、加快了晋升速度，并增强了波兰糖尿病研究社区的合作网络。
AI.research_question: PTD资助项目是否以及如何影响波兰糖尿病研究者的科学产出和职业发展？
AI.motivation: PTD资助项目是波兰糖尿病研究者的关键资金来源，但此前缺乏对其影响力的系统性评估。评估资助项目的成效有助于优化资源配置并验证项目的价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量学理论（用于评估科学产出）、科学合作网络理论（用于分析合作模式）、职业发展理论（以晋升时间为衡量指标）。
AI.method: 从PTD、Scopus和波兰科学数据库（RAD-on）中提取2010-2026年间的文献计量、职业和财务数据，并采用网络分析方法评估合作模式。
AI.findings: 共通过83项资助向71名研究者分配了180万美元。年度资助额以每年9.6%的速度增长（95%CI: 4.1-15.3%）。研究者中位发表产出从0.6篇/年增加到1.6篇/年（+1.0；p<0.0001）。受资助者之间的合作显著增加（p<0.0001）。受资助者获得副教授职位的时间显著短于全国平均水平（8年vs 11.8年；p=0.0045）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了小额专项科研资助项目对学术社区影响的实证证据，拓展了对专业学会资助计划在促进学科整合和科学家职业发展方面作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为波兰糖尿病协会及其他专业学会的资助策略提供了数据支持，证明专项资助计划是提升研究生产力、加速职业晋升和加强研究者网络的有效工具，具有推广价值。

title: Common Privacy Norms for Websites: Origins, Convergence, and Institutional Redesign

detail.title: Common Privacy Norms for Websites: Origins, Convergence, and Institutional Redesign

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it is a doctrinal and comparative legal analysis based exclusively on publicly available legal materials, regulatory documents, and secondary literature, and does not involve human participants, patients, personal data collection, interviews, surveys, or experimental procedures.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
The normative framework that presently governs website privacy practices did not originate in any single international instrument or coordinated global legislative initiative. Rather, it comprises a constellation of interlocking obligations — prior consent to non-essential tracking, transparent privacy notices, identification of the controller, enforceable rights of access and erasure, breach notification duties, purpose-limited retention, safeguards for cross-border transfers, and claims to extraterritorial application — that have coalesced through a combination of technical self-regulation, national constitutional traditions, and successive waves of legislative diffusion.

Their origins are mixed: some evolved as internal practices of the internet itself (operator identification through WHOIS, privacy notices through industry self-regulation such as TRUSTe and BBBOnline, security contacts through RFC conventions, and cookie consent mechanisms through early browser implementations), while others originated as national or subnational legislation grounded in constitutional protections of individual rights and were subsequently adopted across jurisdictions through legal transplants and convergence around shared constitutional values. Over two decades, these internet-level norms — regardless of their origin — were adopted into national legislation across more than thirty jurisdictions, producing an unusual case of bottom-up international legal unification. This article traces that trajectory by surveying the EU, UK, Switzerland, US, Canada, Brazil, South Korea, and India — across three operational dimensions: consent models, enforcement and penalties, and the combined problem of territorial scope and cross-border transfers. It documents a substantial common core and identifies three bounded areas of genuine divergence. It then argues that because several of these norms have infrastructural or operational roots, and because others can be translated into implementation-layer commitments, their implementation can be shifted from the current site-by-site model — which empirical research shows to be ineffective and burdensome — to the level of internet infrastructure itself: a single contractual disclosure at the point of internet access for users, and a set of commitments verified at the point of domain registration for operators. This does not make access providers or domain registrars substantive privacy regulators; it treats them only as infrastructure points at which standardized operator commitments can be recorded and made visible. For purposes of institutional redesign, the article distinguishes seven implementation-layer norms: consent to non-essential tracking, accurate operator/contact information, privacy notice, rights-response workflow, breach-notification capacity, retention limits/deletion routines, and transfer safeguards together with extraterritorial acknowledgment. Six of these seven implementation-layer norms — accurate operator/contact information, privacy notice, rights-response workflow, breach-notification capacity, retention limits/deletion routines, and transfer safeguards together with extraterritorial acknowledgment — do not depend on an individualised act of user consent and can be relocated to the infrastructure layer without change to their content. The seventh implementation-layer norm — consent to non-essential tracking — is different in kind: empirical evidence shows that the current per-site consent mechanism often fails to generate meaningful user choice, and this article argues for replacing it, not merely relocating it, with a single honest disclosure at the point of infrastructure access.

AI.tldr: 本文追踪了网站隐私规范从互联网自发实践和各国国内立法逐渐汇聚成跨国共同规范的过程，涵盖欧盟、英国、瑞士、美国、加拿大、巴西、韩国和印度等三十多个司法辖区。文章识别出七项"实施层规范"，并主张将其中六项从网站逐站点模式迁移至互联网基础设施层（接入点和域名注册点），同时用基础设施接入点的单一诚实披露替代现行的逐站点同意机制。
AI.research_question: 网站隐私规范体系是如何形成的？这些规范能否从现行逐站点实施模式迁移到互联网基础设施层面，以解决当前机制低效和负担过重的问题？
AI.motivation: 经验研究表明，现行逐站点（site-by-site）的隐私同意和实施模式效果不佳且给用户和运营者都带来沉重负担。同时，多数隐私规范具有基础设施或操作性根源，因此存在被迁移到网络基础设施层次的制度设计空间。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律移植与规范趋同理论（legal transplants and convergence around shared constitutional values）；自下而上的国际法律统一化（bottom-up international legal unification）；多层治理/基础设施层治理框架（infrastructure-layer governance）
AI.method: 比较法研究：对欧盟、英国、瑞士、美国、加拿大、巴西、韩国和印度八个司法辖区进行立法调查，从同意模式、执行与处罚、领土范围与跨境数据传输三个操作维度进行分析，识别共同核心与分歧领域。
AI.findings: 发现存在显著的规范共同核心，同时识别出三个有限的分歧领域。将七项实施层规范分类后发现，其中六项（准确运营者/联系信息、隐私通知、权利响应流程、违约通知能力、保留限制/删除程序、传输保障和域外承认）不依赖个体化用户同意，可直接迁移至基础设施层；第七项即非必要追踪同意，应从逐站点机制替换为基础设施接入点的单一诚实披露。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"实施层规范"（implementation-layer norms）这一分析概念，区分规范内容与其可操作化的实施层面；论证互联网基础设施可作为隐私规范的制度落点，丰富了国际法自上而下统一化之外的"自下而上"法律趋同理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体的制度重构方案：在互联网接入点向用户提供单一契约性披露，在域名注册点验证并记录运营者的标准化承诺，而不将接入服务商或域名注册商实质性地转变为隐私监管者。

title: The Effect of Corporate Mergers and Acquisitions on Government Subsidies

detail.title: The Effect of Corporate Mergers and Acquisitions on Government Subsidies
detail.abstract: What is the effect of corporate mergers and acquisitions on firms’ subsidies? I examine this question using U.S. firm-level subsidy data with a stacked difference-in-differences design and find that non-PE-backed merged firms receive 40% less subsidy dollars after the merger, while private equity buyouts have no significant effect on firm subsidies. Declines are stronger in cross-border deals, in deals that lead to improved financial performance in merged firms, and when the buyer of the deal has no political connection prior to the deal, while they are weaker in firms that increase investing activity after merging and mergers between larger firms. The results suggest that improved financials, weakened political connections, and decreased capital investments drive post-deal subsidy reductions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国企业层面的补贴数据，采用堆叠双重差分（stacked DID）方法，发现非私募股权（PE）支持的并购企业并购后获得的补贴金额减少40%，而PE收购对企业补贴没有显著影响。
AI.research_question: 企业并购对企业获得的政府补贴有何影响？
AI.motivation: 此前研究较少关注并购对企业政府补贴的影响，作者希望通过并购这一企业边界变化事件，考察企业政治关系、财务状况和投资行为等如何影响其获取政府补贴的能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政府补贴分配机制的理论，涉及企业政治关联、财务状况和资本投资对补贴获取的影响渠道。
AI.method: 使用美国企业层面的补贴数据，采用堆叠双重差分（stacked difference-in-differences）设计进行因果识别。
AI.findings: 非PE支持的并购企业并购后补贴金额平均减少40%；PE收购对补贴无显著影响。补贴下降在跨境交易、并购后财务业绩改善的交易、并购方无先前政治关联的交易中更强；在并购后增加投资的企业和规模较大的企业并购中更弱。结果表明财务改善、政治关联弱化和资本投资减少是并购后补贴下降的驱动机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文提供了并购如何影响企业获取政府补贴能力的实证证据，揭示了财务绩效、政治关联和投资行为在补贴分配中的作用，丰富了并购效应与政府补贴决定因素的研究文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解并购对政府资源配置的影响提供参考，也为企业管理层评估并购的战略收益（包括补贴变化）提供依据。

title: Products or Payoffs? Financial Substitution after an Access Restriction

detail.title: Products or Payoffs? Financial Substitution after an Access Restriction
detail.abstract: What happens to portfolio demand when access to a financial product is restricted? This paper exploits a 2026 Korean regulatory intervention that sharply tightened retail access to newly introduced single-stock leveraged ETFs and ETNs to answer this question. The restriction binds hard: once a KRW 30 million cash requirement becomes effective, retail purchase share in the targeted ETFs falls by 38.4 percentage points relative to domestic institutions. Retail investors do not shift toward the closest payoff substitute-same-underlying single-stock futures. Instead, retail turnover rises by roughly 78 percent in matched pre-existing 2× semiconductor ETFs, relative to corresponding 1× products and non-retail investors. Substitution follows product category, not payoff proximity: investors move toward the nearest leveraged, exchange-traded alternative rather than the nearest reconstruction of the restricted payoff. Product-level access restrictions can therefore redirect leveraged demand across product categories rather than eliminate it.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2026年韩国监管干预（对单一股票杠杆ETF/ETN实施3000万韩元现金门槛）作为准自然实验，发现零售投资者并未转向收益等价替代品（单一股票期货），而是大幅转向已有的2倍半导体ETF，表明产品类别而非收益相近性驱动了替代行为，产品级准入限制会将杠杆需求重新引导至其他产品类别而非消除。
AI.research_question: 当金融产品准入受到限制时，投资组合需求会发生什么变化？零售投资者是否会转向收益替代品，还是转向其他产品类别？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对金融产品准入限制的研究多关注需求总量变化，较少深入考察需求在替代产品间的具体流向，尤其是投资者选择替代品的决策依据（收益相近性vs产品类别）。本文利用韩国独特政策干预提供了识别机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资组合选择理论、产品替代框架（收益相近维度与产品类别维度的区分）、行为金融中的类别思维/集团内替代效应。
AI.method: 利用2026年韩国监管政策作为准自然实验，采用双重差分或事件研究法，对比受限制ETF、同类产品（单一股票期货）、匹配的2倍半导体ETF、1倍产品及非零售投资者的相对变化。
AI.findings: （1）政策生效后，目标ETF的零售购买份额相对国内机构下降38.4个百分点；（2）零售投资者未转向收益最接近的替代品（同标的单一股票期货）；（3）匹配的既有2倍半导体ETF零售换手率相对1倍产品和非零售投资者上升约78%；（4）替代遵循产品类别而非收益相近性。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了金融产品准入限制下需求替代遵循产品类别而非收益相近逻辑，拓展了产品替代理论中关于投资者决策维度的理解，说明杠杆需求具有跨产品类别的传导性而非被消除。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供政策设计启示：产品级准入限制可能无法真正抑制杠杆需求，需求会转移至其他已存在产品类别，监管需考虑跨产品类别的溢出效应；同时为金融产品设计与投资者保护提供实证参考。

title: Household Purchases and Inflation Impacts of the 2022 Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza Outbreak
affiliations: Virginia Tech

detail.title: Household Purchases and Inflation Impacts of the 2022 Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza Outbreak
detail.abstract: The 2022-2023 U.S. highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) outbreak generated substantial food price increases. Using NielsenIQ Consumer Panel data covering approximately 42,000 households from 2021 to 2024, we quantify its effects on household purchases and inflation across six protein categories-three that HPAI affected directly (eggs, turkey, and fresh chicken) and three close substitutes (fresh red meat, frozen meat, and processed meat). Purchase responses were uniform across the income distribution, with egg quantities falling about 1.6 percent at mean exposure. Yet a four-level nested constant-elasticity-of-substitution demand system reveals sharply regressive welfare consequences operating through prices: egg exposure raised the exact price index by 1.06 percent for the lowest income tercile versus 0.04 percent for the highest, a gap exceeding two percentage points at the outbreak's peak. Behavioral adjustment did not narrow the gap-substitution offset only a quarter of the price shock, and where responses differed by income, lower-income households substituted more. The regressivity traces to cheapflation: prices of budget products, which make up a larger share of low-income than of high-income households' protein spending, rose more than non-budget products. These findings underscore the importance of accounting for the distributional inflation impacts of supply shocks like HPAI in the design of food assistance programs.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2021-2024年NielsenIQ消费者面板数据（约4.2万户家庭），量化了2022-2023年美国高致病性禽流感（HPAI）疫情对六类蛋白质产品（鸡蛋、火鸡、鲜鸡肉及其三种替代品）家庭购买和通胀的影响。研究发现购买反应在收入分布中一致，但通过一个四层嵌套的常替代弹性（CES）需求系统揭示了显著的累退性福利后果：鸡蛋暴露使最低收入三分位组的价格指数上升1.06%，而最高收入组仅上升0.04%，高峰期差距超过两个百分点。这种累退性源于"廉价通胀"（cheapflation）——预算型产品价格涨幅更大，而低收入家庭在预算型产品上的支出占比更高。
AI.research_question: 高致病性禽流感（HPAI）疫情对美国不同收入水平家庭的蛋白质购买和通胀（福利）产生了怎样不同的影响？
AI.motivation: 2022-2023年美国HPAI疫情导致食品价格大幅上涨，但现有研究缺乏对其分配性影响的系统量化。理解供应链冲击对不同收入群体的差异化福利后果，对于设计食品援助政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四层嵌套的常替代弹性（CES）需求系统模型，用于分解价格效应对不同收入群体的福利影响；"廉价通胀"（cheapflation）概念解释累退性价格冲击的机制。
AI.method: 使用2021-2024年NielsenIQ消费者面板数据（约42,000户家庭），对六类蛋白质类别进行计量分析。采用四层嵌套CES需求系统估计精确价格指数，比较不同收入三分位组的福利效应，并分析行为调整（替代效应）对价格冲击的抵消程度。
AI.findings: （1）购买反应在收入分布中高度一致，鸡蛋数量在平均暴露水平下降约1.6%；（2）福利后果具有显著的累退性：鸡蛋暴露使最低收入三分位组精确价格指数上升1.06%，最高收入组仅上升0.04%，高峰期差距超2个百分点；（3）行为调整无法缩小差距——替代只抵消了约四分之一的价格冲击，且低收入家庭替代更多；（4）累退性的根源是"廉价通胀"：预算型产品（低收入家庭蛋白质支出占比较高）的价格涨幅大于非预算型产品。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将供应链冲击（如HPAI）的分配性通胀影响纳入需求系统分析框架，揭示供给冲击可能通过"廉价通胀"渠道产生累退性福利后果，为理解价格冲击的异质性分配效应提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为食品援助项目的设计提供了实证依据，强调在应对供应链冲击时需要将不同收入群体的差异化通胀负担纳入考量，以更精准地配置援助资源。

title: The Economics of Sports BBQ

detail.title: The Economics of Sports BBQ

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: none
declarations.funderStatement: none

keywords.keywords: Sports BBQ Pro Barbacuer Comparable Case Analog Method Comparable Case Analog Professional Bull Riders World Series of Poker BBQ World Cup Distribution Economics Competitive Barbecue Cha Young-gi

detail.abstract: This paper critically revisits the additive market-sizing method used in the August 2026 working paper "The Emergence of Sports BBQ and the Pro Barbacuer," which summed heterogeneous, differently-scoped market reports as if they were a single addressable market, and redesigns it using a Comparable Case Analog Method. Because broadcast/streaming rights and national-brand sponsorship are minimum conditions for Sports BBQ to function as a spectator sport, this paper's headline forecast is explicitly conditioned on these being secured by 2034. Uncritically summing incommensurable reports does not constitute proof of market size — but the world BBQ restaurant market is not discarded either; it is explicitly retained as the cultural and economic population from which Sports BBQ draws its base (est. USD 22B in 2025 growing to USD 38B by 2034). The paper analyzes two independent historical analogs — Professional Bull Riders (PBR), which grew from amateur rodeo in 1992 into a league with USD 16M+ annual prize money and 3M+ attendance by 2024, and the World Series of Poker (WSOP), where roughly USD 480M in prize money is generated annually from a ~100M-player global hobbyist population (roughly 0.5–1% of the parent market) — and cross-checks their growth multiples and penetration rates against a bottom up Sports BBQ Industry Total built from primary competitive-BBQ data (KCBS, American Royal, Memphis in May) and the currently unfolding BBQ World Cup (April 2027, Las Vegas, USD 1M purse, 100 finalists). The result: the paper's headline Sports BBQ Industry Total (High scenario, under the broadcast-and sponsorship premise) ≈ USD 2.24–5.85B (approx. KRW 3.1–8.1 trillion). Combined with the existing grill-market forecast (KRW 13T), the revised 2034 outlook is approximately KRW 15.4–20.4 trillion; including grill, seasoning, and restaurant markets, the broadest BBQ Industry Total is approximately KRW 86.5–91.5 trillion.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性审视了2026年8月工作论文中使用的加性市场规模测算方法（该方法将异质性、不同范围的市场报告简单相加，视为单一可寻址市场），并采用可比案例类比法重新设计。核心预测明确以2034年前获得转播/流媒体版权和全国品牌赞助为前提条件。通过PBR（职业骑牛）和WSOP（世界扑克系列赛）两个历史类比，并结合自下而上的竞技烧烤行业总量测算，得出体育烧烤行业总量（高情景）约22.4–58.5亿美元，合并烤架市场后2034年展望约154–204万亿韩元，最广泛口径（含烤架、调味料、餐厅）约865–915万亿韩元。
AI.research_question: 如何通过更严谨的市场测算方法（可比案例类比法），重新评估体育烧烤（Sports BBQ）作为观众体育项目的可寻址市场规模？
AI.motivation: 原始论文简单相加不同范围、不可通约的市场报告，不构成市场规模的有效证明；需要更严谨的方法来修正体育烧烤市场规模的估算。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可比案例类比法（Comparable Case Analog Method）、渗透率分析、增长倍数交叉验证
AI.method: 选取PBR和WSOP两个独立历史类比案例，分析其增长倍数和渗透率（从爱好者人口到产生收入的转化率），并将其与基于KCBS、American Royal、Memphis in May等一手竞技烧烤数据及BBQ世界杯（2027年拉斯维加斯）构建的自下而上行业总量进行交叉验证。
AI.findings: 体育烧烤行业总量（高情景，在获得转播和赞助前提下）约22.4–58.5亿美元（约3.1–8.1万亿韩元）；合并现有烤架市场预测（13万亿韩元），修正后2034年展望约15.4–20.4万亿韩元；最广泛口径（含烤架、调味料、餐厅）约86.5–91.5万亿韩元。世界烧烤餐厅市场（2025年220亿美元，2034年380亿美元）作为体育烧烤的基础文化与经济人口被保留。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出可比案例类比法作为市场测算的替代框架，纠正加性市场规模测算的方法论缺陷，强调不可通约市场报告不应直接相加。
AI.practical_contributions: 为体育烧烤产业的投资决策、赛事组织和商业开发提供基于历史类比和一手数据的市场规模基准，并明确划定了转播与赞助作为前置条件的敏感性边界。

title: Correlation or Causation? Abortion Restriction and America's Growing Reliance on Skilled Immigration

detail.title: Correlation or Causation? Abortion Restriction and America's Growing Reliance on Skilled Immigration

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial, professional, or personal conflict of interest related to the subject matter of this paper. No funding body, employer, advocacy organization, or third party had any role in the design, analysis, interpretation, or conclusions of this work. The author has no affiliation with any organization that stands to benefit financially or politically from the paper's findings.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper relies exclusively on publicly available, de-identified, aggregate secondary data (peer-reviewed literature and government statistical reports, including data from the U.S. Department of Labour's Office of Foreign Labour Certification). No original human subjects research, survey, interview, or primary data collection involving identifiable individuals was undertaken, and no new data were gathered from human participants. As such, this work did not require review or approval by an Institutional Review Board or equivalent ethics committee.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant, funding, or financial support from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was conducted independently by the author.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: This paper does not report the results of a clinical trial and involves no clinical intervention, experimental treatment, or human trial of any kind. Accordingly, clinical trial registration is not applicable to this work.

detail.abstract: This paper asks a single, narrow question in three different ways: Is American reproductive policy connected to the country's growing reliance on H-1B skilled immigration? And if so, is that connection correlational or causal? Drawing on four independent, peer-reviewed natural-experiment studies spanning 1992 to 2022, the paper first confirms that state-level abortion restriction has a repeated, measurable effect on the births and educational trajectories of the low-income and teenage women directly subject to each law. It then tests two further, distinct claims. First, whether this sub-population effect aggregates into a national-level driver of H-1B visa policy, by placing 35 years of abortion policy and H-1B policy history on parallel timelines: it does not, H-1B's cap history tracks its own legislative cycle and the technology sector's business cycle with far more precision than it tracks any state's birth or dropout trend. Second, whether individual U.S. states with abortion bans have absorbed a disproportionate share of the growing H-1B pipeline relative to states where abortion remains legal, using U.S. Department of Labour Office of Foreign Labour Certification (OFLC) data. Here, a real, government-sourced correlation emerges: banned states with reliably reported H-1B data grew their share of the skilled immigration pipeline faster than most protected states between FY2020 and FY2025, though the pattern is not uniform. The paper concludes that this correlation is real and worth further study, but that the available evidence is insufficient to establish a causal link, and several plausible confounding explanations remain untested.

AI.tldr: 本文通过四个独立的自然实验研究（1992-2022），探讨美国堕胎政策与H-1B技术移民之间的联系。研究发现：州级堕胎限制确实对低收入和青少年女性的生育及教育轨迹产生可测量影响；但这一亚群体效应并未聚合为全国层面H-1B政策的驱动因素（H-1B配额历史更多由其立法周期和技术产业商业周期驱动）；然而在州级层面，拥有堕胎禁令的州在FY2020-FY2025期间确实在H-1B技术移民管道中占据了不成比例的份额增长（基于OFLC政府数据），这一相关性真实存在但因果关系尚无法确立。
AI.research_question: 美国生殖政策（堕胎限制）与该国日益增长的H-1B技术移民依赖之间是否存在联系？如果存在，这种联系是相关性还是因果关系？
AI.motivation: 该研究试图从一个狭窄但重要的角度，检验堕胎政策是否通过影响低教育程度人口的生育与教育轨迹，进而影响国家对技术移民的需求。这一问题的实质是：人口政策是否构成移民政策的驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人口政策与移民政策的因果关联框架；自然实验方法（natural-experiment）；亚群体效应与宏观政策聚合的理论逻辑；劳动力市场替代理论（国内低技能劳动力供给减少可能推升对外部技术劳动力的需求）
AI.method: 综合四个独立的同行评审自然实验研究（1992-2022）；将35年堕胎政策与H-1B政策历史放在平行时间线上比较；使用美国劳工部外国劳工认证办公室（OFLC）数据，比较堕胎禁令州与保护州在FY2020-FY2025年间H-1B管道份额的增长情况
AI.findings: （1）州级堕胎限制对低收入和青少年女性的生育量和教育轨迹有重复性的可测量效应；（2）但这一亚群体效应并未聚合为全国层面H-1B签证政策的驱动因素——H-1B配额历史更精确地跟踪其自身立法周期和技术产业商业周期；（3）在州级层面，堕胎禁令州（有可靠H-1B数据报告的）在FY2020-FY2025年间在技术移民管道中份额增长快于大多数保护州，但这一模式并非一致；（4）该相关性真实存在，但证据不足以确立因果关系，多个合理的混淆因素仍未得到检验。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的重要理论贡献在于区分了"亚群体效应"与"宏观政策驱动"之间的落差——即局部人口变化未必转化为全国层面的政策动因；同时为"人口政策-移民政策"关联研究提供了基于自然实验和官方数据的三层检验框架（微观效应、宏观时间线、跨州比较）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了基于政府来源数据（OFLC）的实证证据，表明堕胎禁令州在H-1B技术移民份额上出现增长趋势，提示需要进一步监测和检验这一关系的政策含义；同时也提醒避免过度解读因果关系。

title: From Individual to Social Imitation: How Communities Expand Organizational Search
affiliations: ESADE Business School and Imperial College London

detail.title: From Individual to Social Imitation: How Communities Expand Organizational Search

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced the work reported in this paper. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based exclusively on computer simulations and did not involve human participants or personal data. Therefore, ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence illustrates a broader organizational puzzle: young, resourceconstrained firms can build on knowledge produced across a wider field to address problems that exceed their internal experience. We theorize one mechanism as social imitation: a distributed and recursive process through which communities observe practices and outcomes across organizations, distill recurrent elements into portable strategies, circulate them, and revise the collective repertoire as adoption produces new evidence. This perspective endogenizes the object of imitation. Organizations do not merely copy practices; communities collectively produce what becomes available to copy. We distinguish the source of a candidate-directly observed organizations or a collective-from its mode of adoption-blind or informed-and examine four forms of imitation in an agent-based model of organizational search. Collective sourcing alone does not improve performance. Its value depends on situated evaluation: assessing whether a candidate fits the adopter's configuration. As interdependence increases, informed social imitation improves population performance and the best solution discovered. As problems grow, it becomes more likely to outperform informed imitation from one or several directly observed peers because collective distillation sustains a broader candidate repertoire. Most gains arise from evaluating a small candidate set, and population performance can improve when only a minority of organizations possesses evaluative capability. Social imitation thus reveals a division of cognitive labor: communities expand the strategies organizations can consider, while organizations create value by determining which strategies fit. It explains how firms can mobilize knowledge beyond their boundaries-and why widespread access to collective knowledge does not produce equal benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"社会模仿"（social imitation）理论，解释资源受限的年轻企业如何通过分布式、递归的社区过程，将跨组织的实践与结果进行提炼、传播和修订，从而利用超越自身经验的领域知识解决问题。通过基于主体的组织搜索模型，研究发现集体来源本身并不能提升绩效，其价值取决于情境化评估（判断候选方案是否适合采用者的配置）；随着问题相互依赖性和规模增加，知情的社会模仿优于直接观察单个或少数同行的模仿。本文揭示了认知劳动分工：社区扩展可供考虑的策略，组织通过评估创造价值。
AI.research_question: 资源受限的年轻企业如何利用超越其内部经验的领域知识来解决问题？社会模仿作为分布式、递归的集体过程，如何影响组织搜索与绩效？
AI.motivation: 生成式人工智能展现了一个更广泛的组织难题：年轻、资源受限的企业可以基于更广领域内生产的知识来解决超出其内部经验的问题。现有理论对组织模仿的解释未能充分内生化模仿的对象——组织的模仿对象本身也是集体生产的产物，需要理论化这一分布式、递归的社区过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会模仿理论（Social Imitation）：将模仿对象内生化，认为社区通过观察跨组织的实践与结果、提炼可移植的策略、传播并随采纳产生新证据而持续修订集体知识库；区分候选来源（直接观察的组织 vs. 集体）与采用模式（盲目 vs. 知情），并结合组织搜索理论与情境化评估。
AI.method: 基于主体的计算模型（Agent-Based Model）——构建组织搜索模型，模拟四种模仿形式（直接来源×盲目/知情、集体来源×盲目/知情），系统操纵问题相互依赖性和问题规模等参数以比较不同模仿形式的绩效表现。
AI.findings: （1）集体来源本身不能提升绩效，其价值取决于情境化评估；（2）随着相互依赖性增加，知情的社会模仿能提升群体绩效和最优解；（3）随着问题规模增大，知情的社会模仿比直接观察一个或少数同行的知情模仿更可能胜出，因为集体提炼维持了更广泛的候选策略库；（4）大部分收益来自评估少量候选方案；（5）即使只有少数组织具备评估能力，群体绩效也能改善。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出了"社会模仿"概念，将模仿对象内生化——组织不仅复制实践，社区集体生产可供复制的知识；（2）区分候选来源与采用模式两个维度，构建四类模仿形式的类型学；（3）揭示了认知劳动分工——社区扩展策略空间，组织通过评估创造价值；（4）解释了组织间知识利用的不对称收益，即为何广泛获取集体知识并不产生同等福利。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了关于如何有效利用外部集体知识的实践洞见：组织的价值创造不在于简单模仿或广泛获取知识，而在于评估能力（判断候选策略是否适合自身配置）；即便仅少部分组织具备评估能力，群体绩效仍可整体改善，为企业资源分配和能力建设提供指导。

title: Equity-Based Financial System as an Alternative to Debt-Based Financial System: A Mathematical Analysis and Simulation
affiliations: Shifa Tameer-e-Millat University

detail.title: Equity-Based Financial System as an Alternative to Debt-Based Financial System: A Mathematical Analysis and Simulation
detail.abstract: This paper develops a theoretical mathematical argument that an equity-based financial system is generally more stable, equitable, and efficient than a debt-based financial system. The analysis is motivated by the Qur'anic objective that wealth should not circulate only among the rich. The central claim is that equity-based financial instruments, such as mudarabah, musharakah, equity sukuk, profit-sharing investment accounts, and venture participation, are more supportive of wealth circulation because they distribute profits and losses according to real economic outcomes. Debt-based instruments, by contrast, create fixed claims in favour of creditors, impose repayment obligations on debtors independent of project performance, and often transfer value from capital-constrained users of funds to capital-rich providers of funds. The paper formalizes this difference through payoff equations, default thresholds, leverage dynamics, inequality indicators, and efficiency conditions. It shows that debt finance produces instability when fixed repayment obligations exceed stochastic income, inequity when creditors receive protected claims while debtors absorb residual risk, and inefficiency when bankruptcy costs, debt overhang, and risk-transfer distort investment. Equity finance, by contrast, makes payments state-contingent, reduces default pressure, shares risk, aligns finance with real-sector output, and distributes surplus more broadly. The paper concludes that equity-based instruments in money and capital markets may serve as a strong proxy for the circulation of wealth, provided they are genuinely risk-sharing and not merely debt-like instruments in legal form.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数学论证提出，股权型金融体系在稳定性、公平性和效率上普遍优于债务型金融体系。以《古兰经》"财富不应仅在富人之间流通"的目标为动机，论文通过支付方程、违约阈值、杠杆动态、不平等指标和效率条件等形式化工具证明：债务融资在固定偿付超过随机收入时产生不稳定，在债权人受保护而债务人承担剩余风险时产生不公平，在破产成本、债务积压和风险转移扭曲投资时产生低效率；而股权融资因支付随状态变化、减少违约压力、共享风险、与实体经济产出对齐并更广泛分配盈余，更有利于财富流通。
AI.research_question: 股权型金融体系是否在数学上比债务型金融体系更稳定、更公平、更高效，从而更好地促进财富流通？
AI.motivation: 源于《古兰经》中"财富不应仅在富人之间循环"的伦理目标，旨在从理论上论证股权型金融工具（如穆达拉巴、穆沙拉卡、股权型伊斯兰债券等）比债务型工具更能促进财富的广泛流通。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于伊斯兰金融的风险共担原则与《古兰经》财富分配伦理，结合金融经济学的支付结构理论、违约阈值分析、杠杆动力学、不平等指标和效率条件构建理论框架。
AI.method: 理论数学模型分析，通过形式化支付方程、违约阈值、杠杆动态、不平等指标和效率条件，对债务型与股权型金融工具进行对比推演。
AI.findings: 债务金融在固定偿付超过随机收入时产生不稳定；在债权人获得受保护债权而债务人承担剩余风险时产生不公平；在破产成本、债务积压和风险转移扭曲投资时产生低效率。股权金融因支付状态依存、减少违约压力、共享风险并与实体经济对齐而更优，但前提是股权工具须为真实风险共担而非负债表观的法律形式。
AI.theory_contributions: 为伊斯兰金融中股权型工具优于债务型工具的主张提供了严谨的数学形式化基础；将财富流通的宗教伦理目标转化为可检验的经济学模型框架；明确了"真实风险共担"是股权工具发挥优势的必要条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为货币与资本市场中推广股权型金融工具（如穆达拉巴、穆沙拉卡、股权型伊斯兰债券、利润分享账户）提供理论依据；警示金融实践中须确保股权工具是真正的风险共担而非债务化伪装。

detail.abstract: This study examines how sustainable business models (SBM) shape the quality of environmental, social and governance (ESG) reporting, and whether technology adoption and triple bottom line (TBL) performance sequentially mediate this relationship. Drawing on the natural resource-based view, stakeholder theory and the technology-organizationenvironment framework, survey data from 350 auditors, accountants and ESG managers across six industry sectors were analysed using partial least squares structural equation modelling to test nine hypotheses. SBM exerts strong direct effects on ESG reporting quality, technology adoption and TBL performance. The serial path running from SBM through technology adoption and TBL performance to ESG reporting quality is significant, whereas the direct effect of technology adoption on reporting quality is not, indicating that technology improves disclosure quality indirectly through realised sustainability performance rather than directly. The study provides the first empirical test of a serial mediation model linking SBM to ESG reporting quality through technology adoption and TBL performance. The findings imply that firms should embed sustainability within their business model architecture and align technology investment with sustainability performance rather than treating technology as a stand-alone reporting solution.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于自然资源基础观、利益相关者理论和TOE框架，通过对350名审计师、会计师和ESG经理的问卷调查数据（覆盖六个行业）进行PLS-SEM分析，检验了可持续商业模式（SBM）如何通过技术采纳和三维底线（TBL）绩效的序列中介作用影响ESG报告质量。研究发现SBM对ESG报告质量有显著的直接效应，且存在"SBM→技术采纳→TBL绩效→ESG报告质量"的显著序列中介路径，但技术采纳对报告质量的直接效应不显著，表明技术通过实际可持续绩效间接提升披露质量。
AI.research_question: 可持续商业模式如何塑造ESG报告质量？技术采纳和三维底线绩效是否以及如何在这一关系中起序列中介作用？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对SBM与ESG报告质量之间内在机制的实证检验，尤其是技术采纳和TBL绩效在这一关系中的传导作用尚未得到清晰阐释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自然资源基础观（NRBV）、利益相关者理论、技术-组织-环境（TOE）框架
AI.method: 采用问卷调查法收集350名审计师、会计师和ESG经理的数据，覆盖六个行业部门，运用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）检验九个假设。
AI.findings: SBM对ESG报告质量、技术采纳和TBL绩效均有显著的直接效应；序列中介路径（SBM→技术采纳→TBL绩效→ESG报告质量）显著；但技术采纳对报告质量的直接效应不显著，说明技术通过实际可持续绩效间接改善披露质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了将SBM与ESG报告质量通过技术采纳和TBL绩效联系起来的序列中介模型的实证检验，深化了对可持续商业模式影响披露质量内在机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 企业应将可持续性嵌入商业模式架构，并将技术投资与可持续绩效对齐，而非将技术视为独立的报告解决方案。

title: Deep Learning-Based Anatomical Landmark Localization for Nonradiographic Assessment of Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis from Back Images

detail.title: Deep Learning-Based Anatomical Landmark Localization for Nonradiographic Assessment of Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis from Back Images
detail.abstract: Background and objective:Adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS) is commonly assessed using standing full-spine radiography; however, repeated examinations expose adolescents to cumulative ionizing radiation. Existing nonradiographic methods mainly support preliminary screening or global angle estimation and provide limited anatomically interpretable characterization of segment-level deformity. Thus, this study developed a deep learning-based framework to realize automatic anatomical landmark localization and nonradiographic AIS assessment from back images. Methods:The proposed framework combined real-world clinical photographs, synthetic three-dimensional modeled images, and data augmentation techniques to improve robustness and generalizability. The dataset included real-world back images from more than 300 patients, 800 synthetic images, and 1,100 augmented images, yielding a total of 2,200 annotated images. Then, a DeepPose-based network was trained to predict 10 anatomically meaningful surface landmarks, from which three segment-related curvature angles and scoliosis types were derived using predefined geometric rules. Model performance was evaluated on a fixed independent test set of 30 back images using mean absolute error and surface-based geometric analysis. Results:The proposed surface-landmark configuration reliably identified the bending direction of the three Cobb-related curvature segments, with inferred directions being almost always consistent with the corresponding radiographs. The fitted ratio-angle curves exhibited clear inverse relationships between bilateral surface ratios and the corresponding segmental spinal angles. Landmark-localization performance improved progressively with richer training data, and the overall average error decreased from 1.84% in Case 1 to 1.61% in Case 2 and 1.35% in Case 3. Conclusions:The proposed framework provides an interpretable and quantitative pipeline for surface-based, segment-level AIS assessment from back images. By moving beyond binary screening and single-angle estimation, it offers a promising noncontact and nonradiographic tool for scalable scoliosis assessment; however, more extensive external validations are required before clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个基于深度学习的框架，利用背部图像实现青少年特发性脊柱侧弯（AIS）的无辐射自动解剖标志定位与节段级评估。该框架融合真实临床照片、合成3D模型图像和数据增强技术，共使用2,200张标注图像训练DeepPose网络，预测10个解剖表面标志点，进而通过几何规则推导三个节段弯曲角度和侧弯类型。在30张独立测试图像上，标志点定位平均误差从1.84%降至1.35%，弯曲方向的推断与X光片高度一致。
AI.research_question: 如何利用背部图像通过深度学习实现青少年特发性脊柱侧弯的自动解剖标志定位和无辐射的节段级评估？
AI.motivation: 传统的站立全脊柱X光片评估AIS会使青少年反复暴露于累积电离辐射；现有非放射学方法主要支持初步筛查或整体角度估计，缺乏节段级畸形的可解释性解剖特征描述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习的解剖表面标志点定位理论、DeepPose网络架构、三维合成图像建模与数据增强理论
AI.method: 结合真实临床照片（300+患者）、合成三维模型图像（800张）和数据增强技术（1,100张），共2,200张标注图像。使用DeepPose网络预测10个解剖表面标志点，通过预定义几何规则推导节段弯曲角度和侧弯类型。采用30张背部图像的独立测试集，用平均绝对误差和表面几何分析评估性能。
AI.findings: 表面标志点配置能可靠识别三个Cobb相关弯曲节段的弯曲方向，推断方向与X光片几乎一致；拟合的比率-角度曲线显示双侧表面比率与相应节段脊柱角度呈清晰的反比关系；标志点定位性能随训练数据丰富程度逐步提升，平均误差从Case 1的1.84%降至Case 2的1.61%和Case 3的1.35%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个可解释的、量化的基于表面的节段级AIS评估管线，超越了二元筛查和单角度估计的局限，为无接触、无辐射脊柱侧弯评估提供了新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种无需X光辐射的非接触式脊柱侧弯评估工具，可用于规模化筛查，但推广至临床部署前仍需更广泛的外部验证。

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is a transformative enabler of sustainable business practices, offering substantial opportunities to enhance the environmental and operational performance of micro, small, and medium enterprises. Despite growing global interest in artificial intelligence-driven sustainability, limited attention has been directed toward its application in resource-constrained and conflict-affected economies. This study aims to examine the role of artificial intelligence in facilitating sustainable practices among green micro, small, and medium enterprises and to evaluate the applicability of successful artificial intelligence adoption experiences from India to Afghanistan. A qualitative research design based on a structured literature review was employed, and relevant secondary data were systematically collected from peer-reviewed publications indexed in Scopus, Science Direct, and Google Scholar. The reviewed evidence demonstrates that artificial intelligence can significantly improve resource efficiency, energy management, waste reduction, supply chain optimization, environmental monitoring, green marketing, and eco-innovation. The Indian experience indicates that successful artificial intelligence adoption has been facilitated by supportive policy frameworks, expanding digital infrastructure, and continuous capacity development for micro, small, and medium enterprises. In contrast, artificial intelligence adoption in Afghanistan is constrained by inadequate digital infrastructure, limited technological readiness, and insufficient financial resources. Nevertheless, the findings suggest that these barriers can be progressively mitigated through context-specific implementation strategies. It is therefore concluded that artificial intelligence can serve as a practical catalyst for accelerating sustainable micro, small, and medium enterprise transformation and promoting green economic development in Afghanistan when integrated with coordinated investments in digital infrastructure, technical capacity development, supportive policy frameworks, and financial support mechanisms. By synthesizing existing knowledge and translating successful practices from India into the Afghan context, this study contributes to the growing literature on artificial intelligence-driven sustainable entrepreneurship and provides evidence-based policy recommendations for fostering environmentally sustainable and economically resilient micro, small, and medium enterprises in developing economies.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨人工智能在促进绿色中小微企业可持续实践中的作用，通过结构化文献综述评估印度成功经验在阿富汗的适用性。研究发现人工智能可显著提升资源效率、能源管理、废弃物减少等，但阿富汗受限于数字基础设施不足、技术准备度低和财务资源匮乏，需通过情境化策略逐步克服。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何在资源受限和冲突影响的经济体中促进绿色中小微企业的可持续实践？印度成功的人工智能采用经验能否适用于阿富汗情境？
AI.motivation: 尽管全球对人工智能驱动的可持续性兴趣日益增长，但对其在资源受限和冲突影响经济体中应用关注不足。阿富汗作为此类典型经济体，缺乏相关研究，亟需探索人工智能作为可持续商业实践变革推动者的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续创业理论、人工智能技术采纳理论（涉及技术准备度和数字基础设施等维度）
AI.method: 定性研究设计，基于结构化文献综述，系统收集Scopus、Science Direct和Google Scholar索引的同行评审出版物中的二手数据。
AI.findings: 人工智能可显著改善资源效率、能源管理、废弃物减少、供应链优化、环境监测、绿色营销和生态创新。印度通过政策框架支持、数字基础设施扩展和能力建设成功采用人工智能；而阿富汗受限于数字基础设施不足、技术准备度低和财务资源匮乏，但这些障碍可通过情境化实施策略逐步缓解。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了人工智能驱动可持续创业的文献，将印度经验翻译到阿富汗情境，丰富了关于在发展中经济体、资源受限及冲突影响条件下人工智能促进可持续商业的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿富汗及类似发展中经济体提供基于证据的政策建议，建议协调投资于数字基础设施、技术能力建设、支持性政策框架和金融支持机制，以促进中小微企业的绿色经济转型和可持续韧性发展。

title: A Comparative Study Of Bank Guarantee Law And Its Exceptions In India, Singapore, And The UK

detail.title: A Comparative Study Of Bank Guarantee Law And Its Exceptions In India, Singapore, And The UK
detail.abstract:
Bank guarantees operate as independent undertakings. The bank's obligation to pay against a compliant demand stands separate from the underlying contract, and English courts have long treated that autonomy as the lifeblood of international commerce. Indian law formally accepts this position, yet Indian courts have increasingly restrained invocation by invoking "special equities" — a phrase that entered Indian jurisprudence in Texmaco Ltd v State Bank of India and was for decades treated as synonymous with irretrievable injustice, but which the Supreme Court in Standard Chartered Bank v Heavy Engineering Corporation Ltd set out disjunctively, as a distinct third ground of intervention. This paper traces that shift and asks whether it can be reconciled with commercial certainty.

The paper examines the pandemic-era decisions in which disrupted performance and economic hardship were treated as sufficient to justify temporary equitable protection, and then the recent High Court decisions — CRSC Research and Navayuga–Van Oord — which have sought to re-anchor special equities to a threshold approaching irretrievable injustice. It situates the Indian position alongside Singapore's structured unconscionability doctrine and the English fraud-only rule, arguing that India occupies a middle ground that is more responsive to extraordinary disruption than the English model, but less disciplined than the Singaporean one.

The paper concludes that the doctrine's continued utility depends on an articulated threshold. Left undefined, special equities risks converting ordinary contractual disputes into grounds for injunction and eroding the trust on which guarantees rest.

AI.tldr: 本文追踪印度法院在银行保函"特殊衡平"（special equities）干预权从与"不可挽回的不公"同义到成为独立第三项干预理由的演变过程，通过与新加坡和英格兰的比较，论证该 doctrine 的持续效用取决于明确化其适用门槛，否则将侵蚀保函的商业确定性。
AI.research_question: 印度法院对银行保函"特殊衡平"干预的扩张是否能够与商业确定性相协调？
AI.motivation: 印度法院日益以"特殊衡平"为由限制银行保函的独立自主性，尤其体现在疫情期间的裁决中；最高法院在Standard Chartered Bank一案中将其设定为独立的第三项干预理由，但门槛模糊，威胁保函作为国际贸易生命线的可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行保函独立自主性原则（autonomy principle）；特殊衡平（special equities） doctrine；不可挽回的不公（irretrievable injustice）标准；新加坡的构建性不公正（structured unconscionability）理论与英格兰欺诈例外规则的比较法框架。
AI.method: 法律案例分析（doctrinal analysis）：追踪Texmaco案至Standard Chartered Bank案的判例演进，分析疫情期间的裁决及近期CRSC Research和Navayuga–Van Oord两案，并与新加坡和英格兰的比较法分析相结合。
AI.findings: 印度在保函干预标准上处于中间立场：比英格兰的纯欺诈例外规则对异常干扰更敏感，但不如新加坡的构建性不公正理论有纪律性。"特殊衡平"门槛若不加明确界定，有将普通合同纠纷转化为禁令申请的风险，侵蚀保函所依托的信任基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 厘清了印度"特殊衡平" doctrine从与"不可挽回的不公"同义到独立干预理由的判例演变脉络，并通过比较法定位揭示了印度中间立场的制度特征及其理论张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度法院明确"特殊衡平"的适用门槛提供论证依据，为银行和商业主体在印度的保函条款设计和争议防范提供指引，警示过度干预对商业信任的损害。

detail.abstract: An advisor deciding whether to run a client's equity in a tax-managed account wants to know how many dollars of harvestable loss the portfolio will throw off. The literature gives conflicting guidance on one of the inputs. Practitioner work recommends tilting a directindexing target toward higher return dispersion, which is usually implemented by selecting on volatility, while a widely read primer reports that lower correlation across holdings raises the value of harvesting. We show that under a lot-level harvesting rule with a fixed share count, the expected realized loss is invariant to the dependence structure of returns once the single-name marginals are held fixed. The reason is that each name's cost basis is a functional of that name's own price path, so the expected harvest is a sum of single-name marginal expectations into which no cross-moment enters. The result is exact, holds at every horizon rather than only at inception, and survives fat tails, jumps, negative drift, heterogeneous volatilities, and monthly rather than weekly monitoring; across eight such settings the largest paired deviation we can measure is 0.34% of the level, with a combined $z$ of $-0.80$ over independent replications. Correlation instead governs the second moment. With identical marginals the standard deviation of the harvest is bounded above by $\sqrt{N}$ times its value under independence, a bound attained at comonotonicity and matched in simulation to within 2% for $N$ from 10 to 400. This reconciles the conflicting claims in two steps. Because the deductible amount is capped by the gains available to offset it, expected usable losses are a concave function of the gross harvest and therefore fall as dependence rises, by 21% at a realistic gain budget, which recovers the reported sign from the variance channel rather than from any shortage of losers. And because the conventional harvest yield divides by a contemporaneous and path-dependent NAV, it inherits a correlation dependence that is an artifact of the normalization; the same portfolios whose dollar harvest is flat show a 95% rise in yield. A permutation test on 2,395 days of US equity returns, which destroys cross-sectional dependence while preserving each name's own path law by circular shifts, reproduces both findings without a return model: the dollar harvest is unchanged ($t = 0.69$) while the yield rises ($t = 5.37$). The theorem also removes the conditional mean from the list of objects worth predicting across portfolios, which leaves the conditional quantile. We estimate it with quantile regression, gradient boosting, and a monotone deep quantile network, and calibrate it by conformalized quantile regression. The fitted models carry the theorem's signature: dependence receives almost no weight at the median and large, opposite weight in the two tails. --

AI.tldr: 本文研究税务管理账户中可收割损失的预期值。核心理论发现：在固定股数、逐笔（lot-level）收割规则下，预期已实现损失与收益的相关性结构无关（仅取决于单只股票的边际分布），因为每只股票的成本基础是该股票自身价格路径的函数。相关性仅影响收割损失的二阶矩（标准差）。这一发现调和了实务界（建议追求高波动/高离散）与经典教材（建议低相关性）之间的冲突：美元收割额对相关性不敏感，但“收割收益率”（以NAV归一化）会随相关性变化，且可用损失受收益上限约束会随相关性上升而下降。作者通过置换检验和多种机器学习模型验证了该定理。
AI.research_question: 税务管理账户中，投资组合的预期可收割损失在多大程度上取决于收益的相关性结构？相关性究竟如何影响税务收割的价值？
AI.motivation: 实务文献建议直接指数化应追求更高的收益离散度（通常以波动率实现），而广为阅读的教科书则指出持有资产间的低相关性会提高收割价值。这两种指导存在矛盾，需要厘清相关性对税务收割的真实影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 逐笔（lot-level）税务收割规则；单名边际分布；成本基础作为价格路径的泛函；凸损失函数下的可用损失；夏普/收益率归一化效应；依赖结构理论（comonotonicity）
AI.method: 理论推导（证明预期收割损失与相关性无关的精确定理）；蒙特卡洛模拟（8种设定、独立重复）；置换检验（circular shifts破坏横截面依赖但不改变单名路径律，2395天美国股票收益数据）；对比美元收割额vs归一化收益率；机器学习方法（分位数回归、梯度提升、单调深度分位数网络、保形分位数回归校准）
AI.findings: （1）在固定股数下，预期已实现损失与相关性结构完全无关（精确结果，适用于任意时域、厚尾、跳跃、负漂移、异质波动率等）；（2）相关性只影响收割额的标准差，上界为独立情形下的√N倍，comonotonicity时达到该界；（3）可用损失（受收益上限约束）是总收割额的凹函数，随相关性上升下降21%；（4）传统收割收益率因除以同期NAV而产生相关性依赖，是归一化的伪影（美元收割额不变量下收益率可涨95%）；（5）置换检验证实美元收割额不变（t=0.69）而收益率上升（t=5.37）；（6）相关性在条件分位数预测中，中位数处权重几乎为零，两尾处权重较大且符号相反。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了精确的定理：固定股数下预期税务收割与相关结构无关；澄清了文献中冲突结论的根源（收益率的归一化伪影与可用损失的上限约束）；证明相关性只作用于二阶矩并给出上界；揭示了条件均值在跨组合预测中不可预测，应将预测目标转向条件分位数。
AI.practical_contributions: 为税务管理账户的顾问提供了明确指导：选择标的时不必追求低相关性来提高美元收割额（相关性不改变预期美元收割额）；但收益率度量会随相关性上升而产生虚高现象需注意；为跨组合预测提供新目标（条件分位数而非均值），并提供了可操作的量化方法与保形校准工具。

title:
Korea Fama-French Factors: 
An Open Monthly Library with a Verified Construction Pipeline
affiliations: Amazon Web Services Inc

detail.title:
Korea Fama-French Factors: 
An Open Monthly Library with a Verified Construction Pipeline

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. The views expressed are the author's own and do not represent those of any affiliated organization.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable — this study does not involve human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: I introduce an open, monthly-updated library of Fama-French five factors plus momentum (MKT-RF, SMB, HML, RMW, CMA, WML) for the Korean stock market, covering July 2001 to the present-the Korean analog of the Ken French Data Library, which does not offer Korea-specific series. Factors are constructed from WRDS Compustat Global security and fundamentals data and Bank of Korea risk-free rates, following Fama and French (1993) and Fama and French (2015) with documented Korean-market adaptations: KOSPI-only breakpoints mirroring the NYSE convention, the 91-day CD rate as the risk-free proxy, and a Shumway (1997) delisting-return adjustment. Critically, the construction pipeline is verified rather than merely described: applying identical code to US CRSP/Compustat data replicates the official Fama-French factors with correlations of 0.96-0.999. Over 2001-2026, Korea exhibits a significantly positive value premium (HML +0.98%/month, t = 4.07) and profitability premium (RMW +0.86%, t = 3.55), a negative size premium (SMB-0.25%, insignificant), an insignificant investment factor, and a momentum premium (+1.04%, t = 4.12) that emerged only after 2000. Each monthly release carries a version DOI for exact reproducibility in citing research.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了韩国股票市场的Fama-French五因子加动量因子（MKT-RF、SMB、HML、RMW、CMA、WML）的开放式月度更新数据库，覆盖2001年7月至今，是Ken French数据图书馆的韩国版对应物。因子基于WRDS Compustat Global数据、韩国银行无风险利率构建，并采用韩国市场特定调整（KOSPI断点、91天CD利率、Shumway退市调整）。文章通过用相同代码复现美国官方Fama-French因子（相关性0.96-0.999）来验证构建流程。实证发现韩国存在显著的价值溢价、盈利溢价和动量溢价，但规模溢价为负且不显著。
AI.research_question: 如何为韩国股票市场构建一个可靠的、可验证的、开放的Fama-French五因子加动量因子数据库，并基于该数据库检验韩国市场的因子溢价特征？
AI.motivation: Ken French数据图书馆不提供韩国特定因子序列，研究者缺乏可靠的韩国市场因子数据。现有研究要么依赖非官方数据，要么采用不同的构建方法导致结果不可比。需要一个经过验证、可复现的韩国因子数据库。
AI.theoretical_framework: Fama-French三因子模型（1993）、Fama-French五因子模型（2015）、动量因子（Carhart, 1997）、Shumway（1997）退市回报调整方法。
AI.method: 基于WRDS Compustat Global证券和基本面数据及韩国银行无风险利率构建因子，遵循Fama和French（1993, 2015）的方法并采用韩国市场特定调整：KOSPI仅断点、91天CD利率作为无风险利率代理、Shumway（1997）退市调整。通过将相同代码应用于美国CRSP/Compustat数据复现官方因子来验证构建流程。
AI.findings: 2001-2026年间，韩国市场呈现显著正的价值溢价（HML +0.98%/月，t=4.07）和盈利溢价（RMW +0.86%，t=3.55）；规模溢价为负（SMB -0.25%，不显著）；投资因子不显著；动量溢价（+1.04%，t=4.12）仅在2000年后出现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了经过严格验证的韩国市场因子构建流程，通过与美国官方因子复现对比确保方法论可靠性；补充了韩国股票市场各因子溢价的实证证据，丰富了新兴市场中多因子模型的适用性证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术界和实务界提供开放的、月度更新的韩国市场因子数据库，每个月度版本附带DOI以确保引用和复现的准确性；投资者和研究者可直接使用标准化因子数据进行分析和策略研究。

title: Complementary AI and Physical Internet Capabilities in Egyptian Healthcare Logistics: A Monte Carlo Analysis

detail.title: Complementary AI and Physical Internet Capabilities in Egyptian Healthcare Logistics: A Monte Carlo Analysis
detail.abstract: This Monte Carlo study examines whether artificial intelligence (AI) and Physical Internet (PI) capabilities create complementary improvements in healthcare logistics. Four synthetic scenariosbaseline, AI only, PI only, and integrated AI plus PI-were each replicated 300 times under stochastic demand surge and disruption intensity. The integrated scenario increased mean fill rate from 76.2% to 92.8%, reduced lead time from 5.49 to 3.70 days, lowered expiry waste from 10.13% to 6.35%, reduced the emissions index from 105.7 to 85.7, and shortened recovery from 13.62 to 7.74 days. AI-only and PIonly configurations generated partial gains, whereas integration produced the strongest result because the model explicitly includes interoperability and coordination synergy. The findings validate the scenario architecture and identify calibration requirements; they are not observations from Egyptian hospitals or estimates of healthcare-system performance. AI disclosure: Generative AI tools assisted with language editing, document formatting, and selected coding tasks. The named author independently reviewed the study design, assumptions, computational procedures, numerical outputs, references, figures, interpretations, and conclusions and accepts full responsibility for the final manuscript. Healthcare evidence boundary: This study is a computational simulation. No patient records, biological samples, laboratory records, hospital operational data, or identifiable human information were used. The reported findings are intended exclusively for methodological validation and should not be interpreted as clinical evidence or guidance for healthcare decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过蒙特卡洛模拟，考察人工智能（AI）与物理互联网（PI）能力在医疗物流中的互补效应。在四种场景（基线、仅AI、仅PI、AI+PI集成）各重复300次随机模拟后，发现集成场景显著优于单一技术场景：平均填充率从76.2%提升至92.8%，交付时间从5.49天缩短至3.70天，过期浪费从10.13%降至6.35%，排放指数从105.7降至85.7，恢复时间从13.62天降至7.74天。研究强调这是计算方法验证而非临床证据。
AI.research_question: AI能力与物理互联网（PI）能力在医疗物流中是否能产生互补性的协同改进效应？
AI.motivation: 医疗物流面临需求激增和中断等随机冲击，单一技术方案（仅AI或仅PI）可能只能产生部分改进，需要通过系统性的计算实验来验证AI与PI集成是否能产生超越各自独立效果的互补性协同收益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 互补性理论（互补技术能力的协同效应）、物理互联网（Physical Internet）理论、AI能力理论框架
AI.method: 蒙特卡洛模拟研究：构建四种合成场景（基线、仅AI、仅PI、集成AI+PI），每种场景在随机需求激增和中断强度条件下重复300次模拟，比较关键绩效指标（填充率、交付时间、过期浪费、排放指数、恢复时间）。模型明确纳入互操作性和协调协同项。
AI.findings: 集成AI+PI场景表现最优：填充率从76.2%提升至92.8%（+16.6个百分点），交付时间从5.49天缩短至3.70天，过期浪费从10.13%降至6.35%，排放指数从105.7降至85.7，恢复时间从13.62天缩短至7.74天。AI-only和PI-only均只产生部分改进，验证了互补性和协同效应假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI与PI能力的互补性理论提供了计算实证支持，验证了互操作性和协调协同机制在技术集成中的关键作用，丰富了数字技术互补性理论在医疗物流情境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗物流系统设计者提供技术集成方案的量化比较依据；识别了模拟场景架构的校准需求；明确界定了研究结论的适用范围（方法论验证而非临床决策依据），为后续实证研究奠定基础。

title: The Global Macro Bifurcation: Real GDP-Driven vs. Inflation-Dominated Nominal GDP Growth
affiliations: Laval University, Faculté des Sciences Sociales, Département d'Économique, Students

detail.title: The Global Macro Bifurcation: Real GDP-Driven vs. Inflation-Dominated Nominal GDP Growth

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract:
Through-cycle empirical estimates of the nominal GDP growth anchor highlight a pronounced macro bifurcation across sovereigns and economic aggregates. 

Two quantitatively different risk profiles emerge through log-additive nominal growth decomposition over the 2001–2025 cycle: i) a Real-GDP driven share cohort — including the United States, China, Singapore, Japan, France, and the broader G7 aggregate — where long-term nominal trends reflect a materially healthy and robust macro backdrop driven by structural output expansion and relatively moderate domestic inflation pressures, and ii) an inflation-dominated share cohort — including Mexico, Brazil, Germany, Chile, Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), the Middle East and Central Asia (MECA), and the broader Emerging Market and Developing Economies (EMDE) aggregate — charactarised by a stagflation-tilted nominal growth composition, where real GDP expansion is coupled with a relatively elevated domestic aggregate price level. 

From an active market risk deployment lens, this diagnostic reinforces that the structural premium of a sovereign macro backdrop remains heavily contingent upon the underlying economy's capacity to expand real output organically while maintaining an effective, price-stabilisation-oriented policy framework to prevent unanchored inflation from bloating headline nominal growth and diluting the structural real-output share.

AI.tldr: 本文通过2001-2025年周期的名义GDP增长分解，识别出两类截然不同的宏观风险画像：一类是由实际GDP增长驱动的国家（如美国、中国、新加坡等），其名义增长反映健康的实体扩张；另一类是由通胀主导的国家（如墨西哥、巴西、德国等），呈现滞胀倾向的增长结构。研究强调主权宏观溢价取决于经济体有机扩张实际产出并维持价格稳定的能力。
AI.research_question: 在2001-2025年周期中，各国名义GDP增长的构成分解呈现何种分化，以及这种分化对主权宏观风险画像有何含义？
AI.motivation: 需要通过名义GDP增长的对数可加分解（log-additive decomposition），识别不同主权国家和经济体的名义增长究竟是源于实际产出扩张还是通胀推动，从而为市场风险配置提供诊断依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 名义GDP增长的对数可加分解框架，将名义增长拆分为实际GDP增长与价格水平（通胀）增长的乘积/加和关系。
AI.method: 基于2001-2025年跨周期数据，对各国及经济聚合体的名义GDP增长进行对数可加分解，区分实际GDP驱动与通胀驱动的增长构成。
AI.findings: 发现两大分化的风险画像：（1）实际GDP驱动型群体（美国、中国、新加坡、日本、法国及G7整体），名义增长由结构性的产出扩张主导，通胀温和；（2）通胀主导型群体（墨西哥、巴西、德国、智利、撒哈拉以南非洲、中东中亚及EMDE整体），呈现滞胀倾向，实际增长伴随较高国内价格水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 为名义增长分解提供了跨主权、跨经济体的系统比较框架，揭示出增长构成对宏观风险画像的结构性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为主动市场风险配置提供了诊断工具，强调主权宏观溢价取决于经济体的实际产出扩张能力与价格稳定政策有效性。

title: Currency Dominance Is Not Forever: Some Insights from a Non-Linear Dynamic Model
affiliations: Rutgers University, New Brunswick - Department of Economics and University of Toulon-Var - Laboratory of Economics Applied to Development (LEAD)

detail.title: Currency Dominance Is Not Forever: Some Insights from a Non-Linear Dynamic Model
detail.abstract:
We develop stress tests based on an original International Monetary System (IMS) model with regime switchings. The model is calibrated for nine reference currencies from the beginning of the Classical Gold Standard to the present. Regime switchings in currency dominance are related to combinations of conditions on a multidimensional environment variable that includes five classes of shocks: technology; development; monetary, financial and fiscal institutions; democracy and conflicts; and the regulatory environment. We provide an original database of events for these five classes of shocks, which is used for calibration. The calibration highlights the important role of the democracy and conflicts component in regime switchings. The calibrated model is then used to perform stress tests on the current prospects of currency dominance for a broad set of scenarios. A salient result from the scenarios we tested is that the dominance of the US dollar is at most marginally affected. No other currency emerges as a major player, suggesting strong inertia in the system’s current centripetal dynamics.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了基于原始国际货币体系（IMS）模型的压力测试方法，该模型包含制度切换机制。模型针对从古典金本位时期至今的九种参考货币进行校准。制度切换与包含五类冲击（技术、发展、货币金融财政制度、民主与冲突、监管环境）的多维环境变量条件组合相关。作者提供了五类冲击事件的原创数据库用于校准，校准结果凸显了民主与冲突成分在制度切换中的重要作用。校准后的模型用于对广泛的货币主导权前景情景进行压力测试，一个显著结果是美元的主导地位至多受到轻微影响，没有其他货币成为主要参与者，表明该体系当前向心动力存在强烈惯性。
AI.research_question: 如何基于国际货币体系模型对货币主导权的制度切换进行压力测试，评估当前美元主导地位及其他货币的未来前景？
AI.motivation: 国际货币体系中的货币主导权切换是一个复杂且关键的问题，现有的国际货币体系（IMS）模型往往缺乏对制度切换机制的刻画。作者希望构建一个具有制度切换能力的模型，并利用覆盖长期历史的数据校准模型，从而对当前美元地位和未来货币格局进行系统性的压力测试评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际货币体系（IMS）模型，包含制度切换（regime switching）机制，涉及五类冲击：技术冲击、发展冲击、货币金融财政制度冲击、民主与冲突冲击、监管环境冲击。
AI.method: ①构建包含制度切换的IMS模型；②针对九种参考货币（从古典金本位时期至今）进行校准；③建立五类冲击事件的原创数据库用于校准；④利用校准后的模型进行多情景压力测试。
AI.findings: 校准结果凸显了民主与冲突成分在制度切换中的重要作用；压力测试的显著结果是美元的主导地位至多受到轻微影响；没有其他货币能作为主要参与者崛起，表明体系存在强烈的惯性（向心动力）。
AI.theory_contributions: ①提出了一个包含制度切换机制的原始IMS模型，超越了传统静态模型；②识别出五类冲击维度及其组合条件对货币主导权切换的影响，其中民主与冲突成分的作用被显著强调；③提供了可复制的五类冲击事件数据库，为后续研究提供基础。
AI.practical_contributions: ①提供了基于历史校准的压力测试框架，可用于政策制定者评估不同情景下的货币主导权前景；②表明在广泛测试的情景中，美元地位具有较强韧性，其他货币难以崛起，为国际货币格局预测提供了重要的实证参考。

title: An ε-Approximation of ξ(1/2 + s)
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: An ε-Approximation of ξ(1/2 + s)
detail.abstract: Comtet and Majumdar, in an appendix on the precise asymptotics of a random walker's maximum, evaluate a divergent Mellin integral by inserting a cutoff ε, splitting it into a Lerch transcendent and a Beta function, and cancelling the divergences before letting ε tend to zero. We carry that device to the completed zeta function. Writing z = 1/2 + s and λ =-log(1-ε), a contour argument of Barnes type shows that the Lerch minus Beta pair equals Γ(z)ζ(z) plus a convergent power series in λ with explicit coefficients and explicit remainder bounds, that the Beta term is the residue at the pole of ζ, and that it disappears for Dirichlet L functions with non-principal character. On 1/2 < s < 1 this gives an approximation of ξ(1/2+s) with error O(λ), against O(λ s-1/2) if the Beta term is dropped, a rigorous two sided enclosure of ξ between the two versions, and a binomial extrapolation from K regulators whose error is exactly-κ(s)Γ(z)ζ(z-K)λ K + O(λ K+1). The ε-Xi function has a Levy form of its own: it is the Mellin transform of the tilted defect between counting measure on the positive integers and Lebesgue measure, equivalently a difference of fractional moments of the Levy densities of two generalized gamma convolutions, with Stieltjes transform the difference of a Lerch transcendent and an exponential integral, and the defect is evaluated exactly by the formula of Abel and Plana against the Bose kernel at 2π. We then study the zeros. The ε-Xi function is meromorphic rather than entire, with simple real poles of residue O(λ), its Fourier kernel is not even and decays only like e-|v|/2 , and the reality criteria of Polya and of Cardon therefore do not apply to it at any λ > 0. What survives unconditionally is a Thorin condition on the integer side: the regularized Bose kernel is exactly the Levy density of a generalized gamma convolution T λ whose Thorin measure is m e-λm δ m , the certifying Stieltjes transform is again a Lerch transcendent, and T λ centred converges to the Gumbel law. The Thorin condition on the zero side, which is equivalent to the Riemann Hypothesis, provably fails at every λ > 0. Numerical checks at 40 digits are reported throughout.

AI.tldr: 本文延续Comtet和Majumdar处理发散Mellin积分的截断方法，并将其推广到完整的zeta函数。通过引入截断参数ε，作者将Lerch超越函数与Beta函数的差分解耦为Γ(z)ζ(z)与一个具有显式系数和余项界的收敛幂级数之和，从而在1/2 < s < 1区间内给出了ξ(1/2+s)的O(λ)阶近似以及严格的双侧包围。文章还系统研究了ε-Xi函数的解析性质，证明了其仅为亚纯函数（非整函数），并在λ>0时Pólya和Cardon的实数性判据均不适用。但文章在整数侧保留了Thorin条件（正则化Bose核恰为广义gamma卷积T_λ的Lévy密度），并证明零侧Thorin条件（等价于黎曼猜想）在任意λ>0时都失败。全部计算均经40位精度数值验证。
AI.research_question: 如何将Comtet和Majumdar用于随机游走最大值精确渐近的发散Mellin积分截断技术推广到完整的Riemann zeta函数，并利用该技术研究ε-Xi函数的解析性质、近似精度及其与黎曼猜想（零侧Thorin条件）的关系？
AI.motivation: Comtet和Majumdar在附录中提出的截断技巧（插入截断ε、将积分拆分为Lerch超越函数与Beta函数、消去发散后取极限）是一种处理发散Mellin积分的有力工具，但该方法尚未被系统推广到完成zeta函数的研究中。将这一工具推广至Γ(z)ζ(z)和ξ函数，有望为zeta函数在临界线附近提供新的近似方法、严格误差界以及实证极点结构的分析途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文的理论框架包括：Mellin变换与发散积分正则化、Lerch超越函数与Beta函数的渐近分析、Barnes型围道积分方法、广义gamma卷积（GGC）与Lévy密度理论、Thorin条件、Abel-Plana公式、Stieltjes变换、Gumbel分布极限定理，以及Pólya和Cardon关于整函数实零点的判据。
AI.method: 本文采用解析数论与概率论相结合的方法：(1) 通过引入截断参数ε（令λ=-log(1-ε)），利用Barnes型围道积分证明Lerch减去Beta等于Γ(z)ζ(z)加上一个具有显式系数的收敛幂级数；(2) 将Beta项识别为ζ在极点处的留数，并考察其在非主特征的Dirichlet L函数下的消失行为；(3) 分析了ξ函数的近似误差O(λ)与仅保留主项时的误差O(λ^{s-1/2})并构建双侧包围；(4) 建立了K个调节器的二项式外推法，给出显式误差项；(5) 证明了ε-Xi函数的Fourier核非偶且仅以e^{-|v|/2}衰减，从而在λ>0时Pólya和Cardon判据失效；(6) 通过精确计算正则化Bose核验证其整侧Thorin条件，并通过数值检验（40位精度）证明零侧Thorin条件失败。
AI.findings: (1) Lerch超越函数与Beta函数的差等于Γ(z)ζ(z)加收敛幂级数，Beta项为ζ极点处的留数，且对非主特征Dirichlet L函数该项消失。(2) 在1/2<s<1时，ξ(1/2+s)的近似误差为O(λ)，低于丢弃Beta项时的O(λ^{s-1/2})，并提供严格双侧包围。(3) 二项式外推法的误差精确为-κ(s)Γ(z)ζ(z-K)λ^K+O(λ^{K+1})。(4) ε-Xi函数是亚纯函数而非整函数，具有简单实极点（留数O(λ)），其Fourier核非偶且仅以e^{-|v|/2}衰减，故Pólya和Cardon实数性判据在任意λ>0时均不适用。(5) 整数侧Thorin条件无条件成立：正则化Bose核恰为GGC T_λ的Lévy密度，其Thorin测度为m e^{-λm}δ_m，且中心化的T_λ收敛于Gumbel分布。(6) 零侧Thorin条件（等价于RH）在任意λ>0时均可证地失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文将正则化截断方法系统引入完成zeta函数的研究，给出了ε-Xi函数作为分数阶矩差分（两个广义gamma卷积的Lévy密度的分数阶矩之差）的Lévy形式刻画，建立了ε-Xi函数与Mellin变换（倾斜缺陷的变换）、Stieltjes变换（Lerch超越函数与指数积分之差）以及Abel-Plana公式之间的精确联系，并将Thorin条件框架推广到ε-Xi函数的整数侧和零侧，澄清了正则化后实零点判据失效的根本原因。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文提供了计算ξ函数在临界线上及其附近的显式近似公式（O(λ)精度）、严格双侧包围以及二项式外推法（带精确误差估计），这些工具可应用于zeta函数的数值计算、零点探测和误差控制；同时提供了40位精度的数值验证方案，为后续的解析数论计算提供了可靠的方法论参考。

title: Where the Grass Seems Greener: Economic Misperceptions and Support for Democracy
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics, McGill University, , Boston University - Department of Economics, Stanford University and University of South Carolina

detail.title: Where the Grass Seems Greener: Economic Misperceptions and Support for Democracy
detail.abstract:
Support for populist and authoritarian regimes is rising worldwide, despite evidence that they tend to underperform economically.
