We examine the role of (mis)perceptions of regime performance as drivers of political attitudes, leveraging two survey experiments with 11,377 respondents during Argentina’s 2023 presidential elections. Optimistic beliefs about the performance of populist and non-democratic regimes were widespread, and displayed a strong correlation with support for these regimes. When exposed to randomly assigned informational treatments challenging optimistic views about these political regimes, individuals significantly adjusted their beliefs, and reduced their support for candidates they associate with populist and authoritarian leanings. Exploring the impact of different information sources, we find that academic sources and newspapers were more influential than social media. Although individuals adjusted their beliefs and attitudes in response to information on regime performance, contradicting their prior beliefs reduced their demand for additional information, consistent with an important role for motivated reasoning.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过阿根廷2023年总统大选期间的两项调查实验（11,377名受访者），研究民众对民粹主义与威权政权的表现（错误）认知如何影响政治态度。研究发现乐观认知普遍存在且与支持度高度相关；随机信息干预能显著修正信念并降低对相关候选人的支持；学术来源和报纸比社交媒体更具影响力；但信息与既有信念相矛盾时，人们会减少对额外信息的需求，体现了动机推理的作用。
AI.research_question: 民众对民粹主义和威权政权表现的（错误）认知是否以及如何驱动其对这类政权的政治支持？
AI.motivation: 全球范围内民粹主义和威权政权支持率上升，但这类政权在经济表现上往往不佳，存在认知与现实的脱节，需要理解错误认知在其中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 错误认知（misperceptions）、动机推理（motivated reasoning）、信念更新（belief updating）与政治支持之间的理论关联。
AI.method: 两项随机调查实验（survey experiments），共11,377名受访者，在阿根廷2023年总统选举期间实施；对受访者随机施加传递乐观政权表现认知挑战的信息干预，并比较不同信息来源（学术来源、报纸、社交媒体）的影响。
AI.findings: （1）对民粹主义和非民主政权表现的乐观认知广泛存在，且与对这些政权的支持高度相关；（2）信息干预显著降低了受访者对这些政权的支持；（3）学术来源和报纸比社交媒体更具影响力；（4）当信息与个体既有信念相矛盾时，个体会减少对额外信息的需求，体现了动机推理的作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了错误认知与政治态度关系的理论，揭示信念更新与支持度变化之间的因果机制，并阐明了动机推理在信息回避中的角色。
AI.practical_contributions: 为信息干预设计提供实证依据，表明学术与报纸来源在纠正政治错误认知方面比社交媒体更有效；对民主治理和反民粹政策传播具有实践启示。

title: When Cultural Beliefs Kill Creativity: Evidence from Chinese Zodiac Culture and Corporate Innovation
affiliations: Southwest Jiaotong University and Southwest Jiaotong University

detail.title: When Cultural Beliefs Kill Creativity: Evidence from Chinese Zodiac Culture and Corporate Innovation
detail.abstract: This study examines the aversion to zodiac conflict within top management teams (TMTs) and its impact on corporate innovation. Using Chinese A-share listed companies from 2007 to 2023, we confirm the existence of this belief and find that it significantly reduces both the quantity and quality of innovation output. This adverse effect operates through two mechanisms: fostering a conflict-avoidant culture that undermines competitive drive, and inducing discriminatory screening that leads to talent mismatch and declined TMT capability. Further analysis shows the effect is more pronounced in firms with weaker governance or in regions with stronger traditional culture. Our findings suggest that applying such cultural heuristics to pursue team harmony paradoxically inhibits organizational stability and innovation performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨高层管理团队（TMT）中"生肖冲克"这一传统信念对企业创新的影响。基于2007-2023年中国A股上市公司数据，研究发现生肖冲克信念显著降低了企业创新的数量和质量，其作用机制包括催生避免冲突的文化（削弱竞争动力）和诱导歧视性筛选（导致人才错配和TMT能力下降），且在公司治理较弱或传统文化较强的地区更为显著。
AI.research_question: 高层管理团队中的生肖冲克信念是否以及如何影响企业创新？
AI.motivation: 尽管文化信念对组织行为的影响已被广泛研究，但关于中国传统文化中"生肖冲克"这一具体信念如何影响高层管理团队决策和企业创新绩效，尚未有系统的实证研究。传统信念与组织治理之间的冲突值得深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化启发式（cultural heuristics）、冲突回避理论、人才筛选与人力资本理论、公司治理理论
AI.method: 基于2007-2023年中国A股上市公司面板数据进行实证分析，包括基准回归检验、机制检验（冲突回避文化与歧视性筛选两条路径）、以及异质性分析（公司治理强度、地区传统文化强度）
AI.findings: （1）生肖冲克信念在TMT中确实存在，且显著降低了创新产出的数量和质量；（2）该负面效应通过两条机制起作用：冲突回避文化削弱竞争动力、歧视性筛选导致人才错配和TMT能力下降；（3）在公司治理较弱或传统文化较强的地区，该效应更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 将文化信念（生肖冲克）引入高层管理团队与企业创新研究，拓展了文化对企业战略决策影响的理论视角；揭示了"追求团队和谐"的文化启发式反而损害组织稳定性和创新绩效的悖论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业优化TMT组建和管理提供警示，提示管理者应避免基于非理性文化信念进行人才筛选；为完善公司治理机制、弱化传统文化迷信对企业决策的负面影响提供政策启示。

title: The Effect of Childcare on Female Labor Supply and Child Development in Low and Middle Income Countries
affiliations: Yale University and Yale University

detail.title: The Effect of Childcare on Female Labor Supply and Child Development in Low and Middle Income Countries
detail.abstract:
Childcare services can offer an opportunity for women to develop their careers and increase household income. At the same time, it can affect the development of children, depending on the quality of care. We first develop a collective model of the household as a conceptual framework to show how improving the availability of childcare can affect mothers’ labor market opportunities and earnings and how it can affect child development. We then review the literature on the effects of childcare on the employment and earnings of women and on child development. Childcare can increase mothers’ employment. However, limited work opportunities or strict norms against maternal work can keep mothers out of the labor force. When other family members provide care, childcare can free these caregivers to work or attend school. When studies measure the impact on child development, the results are mixed and depend on both context and quality of provision.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个家庭集体决策模型作为概念框架，分析托儿服务对女性就业、收入及儿童发展的影响，并系统回顾了相关实证文献。研究发现托儿服务能提升母亲就业率，但其效果受限于劳动机会和性别规范；对儿童发展的影响则取决于照护质量与具体情境，结果并不一致。
AI.research_question: 改善托儿服务的可获得性如何影响母亲的劳动力市场机会和收入？如何影响儿童发展？
AI.motivation: 托儿服务既可能为女性提供职业发展和增加家庭收入的机会，又可能因照护质量差异影响儿童发展，需要从理论框架和实证文献两方面系统梳理其综合效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭集体决策模型（collective model of the household）
AI.method: 理论建模与文献综述相结合：首先构建家庭集体决策模型作为概念框架，然后系统回顾关于托儿服务对女性就业、收入及儿童发展影响的实证文献。
AI.findings: （1）托儿服务可以提高母亲就业率；（2）有限的劳动机会或严格的反对女性工作的社会规范会阻碍母亲进入劳动力市场；（3）当其他家庭成员提供照护时，托儿服务可以解放这些照护者去工作或上学；（4）托儿服务对儿童发展的影响结果混杂，取决于具体情境和照护质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 将托儿服务的经济效应置于家庭集体决策模型框架下，系统地整合了劳动经济学与发展经济学视角，为理解托儿服务对家庭内部资源配置的影响提供了统一的理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于托儿服务政策设计的实证依据，指出托儿服务的效果依赖于劳动市场条件和性别社会规范，且儿童发展结果取决于服务质量，为托儿服务的质量监管和供给政策提供指导。

title: Survival Analysis with Limited Overlap and Censoring Distribution Shift
affiliations: , , , University of Michigan at Ann Arbor - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Survival Analysis with Limited Overlap and Censoring Distribution Shift
detail.abstract:
Survival analysis methods are often used to predict the time until the onset of an event in settings when the true time-to-event (TTE) may be censored during training. Such approaches typically assume uncensored data are representative of censored data and that the probability of censoring conditioned on the covariates remains constant over time, i.e., there is no censoring distribution shift. However, both assumptions can fail in practice when censoring results from interventions targeted to individuals with particular comorbidities or genetic markers (such as prophylactic surgery when predicting time to cancer onset, or scheduled cesarean delivery and induction when predicting time to spontaneous labor) and changes in clinical policies alter which individuals are targeted for these interventions over time. To address this, we propose a new approach, cluster-weighted inference of time-to event (CWITE), that remains accurate when these assumptions do not hold. Unlike existing approaches that ignore times-to-censoring (TTC) or treat them only as a lower bound of the TTE, CWITE leverages the insight that a subset of censored individuals are likely censored close to their true TTEs, and uses a novel mechanism to learn from such individuals. On the task of predicting time to spontaneous labor using real-world data, CWITE improves TTE accuracy for individuals similar to censored training data (mean absolute error: 6.50 days, 95% CI: [5.55, 7.40] vs. 7.82 days, [6.82, 8.82]) while maintaining comparable performance for those similar to uncensored training data (6.50 days, [5.54, 7.61] vs. 6.63 days, [5.67,7.69]). Our results demonstrate that incorporating more specific supervision from censored training data can significantly improve TTE predictions in settings with limited overlap and censoring distribution shift, challenges common in real-world clinical data. Code to implement CWITE and reproduce all experiments in the paper is available at https://github.com/MLD3/CWITE.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的生存分析方法CWITE（聚类加权时间-事件推断），该方法能够在删失分布偏移（censoring distribution shift）存在的情况下仍保持准确的预测性能。与现有方法不同，CWITE利用部分删失个体可能在其真实TEE附近被删失的洞察，通过新颖的机制从这些个体中学习，在预测自发分娩时间等真实临床任务中显著提升了预测准确性。
AI.research_question: 当生存分析中传统假设（未删失数据代表删失数据、删失概率随时间恒定）失效时，如何准确预测时间到事件（TTE）？具体而言，如何在存在删失分布偏移和训练数据重叠有限的情况下提升TTE预测精度？
AI.motivation: 传统生存分析方法假设删失机制与协变量无关且随时间恒定，但现实中删失往往源于针对特定共病患者或携带遗传标记个体的干预措施（如预防性手术、计划剖宫产等），且临床政策变化会改变被干预对象，导致删失分布偏移。现有方法忽略删失时间或仅将其视为TTE的下界，未能充分利用删失数据中的信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生存分析理论、删失分布偏移理论、聚类加权推断方法
AI.method: 提出CWITE（cluster-weighted inference of time-to-event）方法。该方法利用"部分删失个体可能在其真实TTE附近被删失"的洞察，通过新颖的聚类加权机制从删失训练数据中学习更具体的监督信息，从而在删失分布偏移和重叠有限的情况下保持预测准确性。
AI.findings: 在预测自发分娩时间的真实临床数据任务中，对于与删失训练数据相似的个体，CWITE将平均绝对误差从7.82天（95% CI: [6.82, 8.82]）降至6.50天（95% CI: [5.55, 7.40]）；对于与未删失训练数据相似的个体，性能保持可比（6.50天 vs. 6.63天）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地解决了生存分析中删失分布偏移的问题，提出了利用删失个体TTC（time-to-censoring）信息的新框架，填补了传统方法将删失时间仅视为TTE下界的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 在临床预测场景（如预测自发分娩时间）中显著提高了模型在真实世界数据上的预测准确性，为临床决策支持提供了更可靠的工具；提供了开源代码便于复现和推广应用。

title: Falling Fertility: The Changing Value of Freedom, Fulfillment, and Family
affiliations: New York University - Leonard N. Stern School of Business, Department of Economics, Universidad Nacional de La Plata (UNLP) and

detail.title: Falling Fertility: The Changing Value of Freedom, Fulfillment, and Family
detail.abstract:
Fertility has fallen in nearly all high-income countries. People also report wanting fewer children: between 2012 and 2022 the ideal number of children fell from 2.42 to 2.31 and the share of respondents intending a child within three years fell from 28 to 21 percent over a similar period. Why? Using two cross-national surveys that ask respondents about their attitudes and their fertility preferences, both fielded twice roughly a decade apart, we decompose each decline into the contribution of a broad and competing set of attitudes. Three stand out: children are increasingly seen as interfering with the freedom of parents; views on whether mothers of young children should work have become markedly more progressive and account for a substantially larger share of the decline among the tertiary-educated; and fewer people believe that women or men need children to lead a fulfilled life. This last attitude changed most over the decade and is the largest contributor to the fall in intended fertility, above all among less-educated women. The changing division of household work and increasing work-family conflict have minor contributions to changing fertility preferences.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用两项跨国调查（各进行了两轮，间隔约十年），分解了2012-2022年间高收入国家理想子女数量和短期生育意向下降的原因，发现三个关键的态度的转变：孩子被视为限制父母自由、对母亲工作的看法日趋进步（在高学历群体中影响显著）、以及越来越少人认为需要孩子才能过上完满人生（这一态度变化最大，是生育意向下降的最大贡献因素，尤其在低学历女性中）。家务分工变化和工作家庭冲突的贡献较小。
AI.research_question: 为什么近十年来高收入国家的理想子女数量下降、短期生育意向下降？哪些态度变化解释了这些生育偏好的下降？
AI.motivation: 几乎所有高收入国家的生育率都在下降，同时人们的生育偏好也在下降（理想子女数从2.42降至2.31，三年内打算生育的比例从28%降至21%），但此前研究对偏好下降的原因缺乏系统的跨国分解分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生育偏好变化的态度分解框架，关注价值观转变（如自由观、性别角色观、人生意义观）对生育决策的影响。
AI.method: 使用两项跨国调查数据（各调查两轮，间隔约十年），通过分解方法将生育偏好的下降归因于一系列相互竞争的态度变化。
AI.findings: 三个关键态度变化突出：（1）孩子越来越被视为限制父母自由；（2）对年幼孩子母亲是否应工作的看法日趋进步，且在高学历群体中占下降份额更大；（3）更少人认为女性或男性需要孩子才能过完满人生——这一态度在十年间变化最大，是生育意向下降的最大贡献因素，尤其在低学历女性中。家务分工变化和工作家庭冲突对偏好变化的贡献较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统量化了多种态度变迁对生育偏好下降的相对贡献，揭示了"孩子阻碍自由"和"孩子对人生完满不再必要"等价值观变化是生育偏好下降的核心驱动力，超越了传统的工作-家庭冲突解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解生育率下降的态度根源提供实证基础，提示政策干预可能需要关注价值观转变层面（如人生意义与生育的关联、性别角色观念），而非仅聚焦于家庭友好政策。

title: Stress Testing Cardiac Care Markets through Deregulation
affiliations: Brown University, Cornell University, Brown University and Brown University

detail.title: Stress Testing Cardiac Care Markets through Deregulation
detail.abstract:
The diffusion of technological innovation depends on incentives, regulations, and firms’ strategic behaviors. We study these intersections within cardiac procedure markets following Medicare’s expansion of non-hospital facility options for treatment, enabled by clinical advancements. State-level regulations restrain federal pro-competition policy. Where market entry occurs, business stealing is concentrated among the lowest cost treatment settings, rather than high-cost hospitals––increasing Medicare spending by approximately $2.5 million. Medicare policy also generates externalities for untargeted procedures and other payers, except when hospitals and physicians are vertically integrated. Federal rulemaking interacts with and is mitigated by complex market dynamics––including in potentially unanticipated ways.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Medicare扩大非医院设施选择后，心脏手术市场中的创新扩散如何受到激励、监管和企业战略行为的影响。研究发现，市场进入导致的业务抢占集中在低成本治疗场所而非高成本医院，增加了Medicare约250万美元的支出，且政策对未涉及的手术和其他支付方产生外部性，但纵向整合的医院-医生结构可以缓解这些效应。
AI.research_question: Medicare扩大非医院设施选择后，心脏手术市场中技术创新扩散如何在激励、法规和企业战略行为的交叉作用下展开？
AI.motivation: 技术创新的扩散不仅取决于临床进步，还受到政策激励、州级法规和企业战略行为的制约。理解这些因素的交互作用对评估联邦竞争政策的实际效果至关重要，尤其是在心脏手术这类高成本医疗市场中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新扩散理论、市场竞争与规制理论、企业纵向整合理论
AI.method: 基于Medicare扩大非医院设施选择的准自然实验，利用心脏手术市场的州级数据，分析市场进入、业务转移和支出变化的实证研究。
AI.findings: （1）州级法规限制了联邦促进竞争政策的落实；（2）市场进入后，业务抢占集中在最低成本治疗场所而非高成本医院；（3）这导致Medicare支出增加约250万美元；（4）政策对未涉及的手术和其他支付方产生外部性；（5）医院与医生的纵向整合可以缓解这些外部性；（6）联邦规则制定受到复杂市场动态的调节，可能产生未预期的后果。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了联邦促进竞争政策与州级法规之间的张力如何影响创新扩散，并识别了纵向整合在调节政策外部性中的关键作用，拓展了创新扩散与医疗市场规制交叉领域的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于Medicare支付政策扩张可能带来的意外后果的证据，提示在制定联邦竞争政策时需考虑州级法规差异和企业纵向整合结构对政策效果的影响。

title: To Tax or To Ax? Marginal Tax and Spending Multipliers in Consolidations
affiliations: Bocconi University - Department of Economics and University of Bocconi - Innocenzo Gasparini Institute for Economic Research (IGIER)

detail.title: To Tax or To Ax? Marginal Tax and Spending Multipliers in Consolidations
detail.abstract:
We introduce the notion of marginal cumulative multiplier — the effect of either government spending or taxation on output holding the other fiscal instrument constant — and apply it to a well known panel of consolidation episodes in 16 countries in the period 1978-2020. In our benchmark specification we estimate a marginal spending multiplier at two years of 1.5 and a marginal tax multiplier close to 0. We also estimate similar multipliers by applying the policy counterfactual method of McKay and Wolf (2023). In an extensive robustness analysis we never find spending multipliers below 1.3 or tax multipliers higher than -1. These findings are seemingly in contrast to those of much of the existing literature on fiscal multipliers, which typically finds higher tax than spending multipliers. We show that this contradiction disappears once the fiscal variables used in the literature are scaled by the proper factor.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文引入了"边际累积乘数"概念（在保持其他财政工具不变的情况下，政府支出或税收对产出的影响），并将其应用于16个国家1978-2020年间的财政整顿面板数据。基准估计显示两年期边际支出乘数约为1.5，边际税收乘数接近于0。稳健性分析中支出乘数从未低于1.3，税收乘数从未高于-1，这与现有文献中税收乘数通常高于支出乘数的结论相悖。作者证明这一矛盾源于文献中对财政变量的缩放因子使用不当。
AI.research_question: 在财政整顿情境下，政府支出乘数与税收乘数分别为多少？为何本文估计结果与现有文献（通常认为税收乘数更高）存在显著差异？
AI.motivation: 现有文献普遍发现税收乘数高于支出乘数，但本文通过引入"边际累积乘数"概念，在控制另一财政工具的条件下重新估计，发现支出乘数反而更高。作者试图解释这一矛盾并揭示其背后的方法论问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边际累积乘数（marginal cumulative multiplier）概念，即在一个财政工具变化而另一财政工具保持恒定条件下对产出的累积效应。
AI.method: 使用16个国家1978-2020年财政整顿事件的面板数据，采用基准回归规范估计边际支出乘数和边际税收乘数；同时应用McKay and Wolf (2023)的政策反事实方法进行交叉验证；并进行广泛的稳健性分析。
AI.findings: 基准规范下两年期边际支出乘数约为1.5，边际税收乘数接近于0；稳健性分析中支出乘数从未低于1.3，税收乘数从未高于-1。这一结果与文献中税收乘数更高的传统结论相反，但作者证明该矛盾源于文献中财政变量缩放因子使用不当。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"边际累积乘数"这一新概念框架，区分了在控制另一财政工具条件下支出与税收对产出的独立效应；揭示了现有文献中财政乘数估计差异可能源于变量缩放方法的方法论问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为财政政策制定者提供了更准确的支出与税收乘数估计，表明政府支出对产出具有更强的刺激效应（乘数约1.5），而税收变化对产出的影响接近于零，这对财政整顿政策的设计和评估具有重要政策含义。

title: The Meritocratic Consensus and Stratification in Higher Education
affiliations: Princeton University and University of California, Berkeley, The Richard & Rhoda Goldman School of Public Policy

detail.title: The Meritocratic Consensus and Stratification in Higher Education
detail.abstract:
American colleges and universities are highly stratified by pre-college academic achievement, family background, and institutional resources. We study the meritocratic consensus in American higher education: colleges that high-testing students (who are generally also from high-income families) attend spend dramatically more on instruction than do those that enroll lower-testing students. Stratification by test scores has been largely stable since the 1960s, but the stratification of instructional resources has risen sharply since 1970 at both private and public institutions. Non-academic admissions criteria like athletics, legacy, and affirmative action are second-order in determining the allocation of students to universities. Potential economic justifications for the positive association of instructional expenditures with student prior achievement—q-complementarity between achievement and resources, convex social returns to high human capital, and incentives to invest in learning prior to college—have little empirical support. Resource stratification across universities has not increased in the past decade, largely due to increased public funding of universities that enroll lower-testing students through financial aid programs like California's CalGrant, but stratification within institutions is now rising swiftly.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国高等教育的分层现象，发现高分学生（通常来自高收入家庭）就读的大学在教学支出上显著高于录取低分学生的大学。自1970年以来，教学资源的分层急剧加剧，而考试分数的分层自1960年代以来基本稳定。非学术录取标准（如体育、传承录取、平权行动）对学生的大学分配只起次要作用。关于教学支出与学生先前成绩正相关的经济理由缺乏实证支持。过去十年资源分层未加剧，主要归因于加州CalGrant等财政援助项目增加了对低分学生就读大学的公共资助，但机构内部的分层正在迅速上升。
AI.research_question: 美国高等教育中教学资源分配与学生学业成绩之间的分层关系如何？这种分层的经济学解释是否成立？
AI.motivation: 美国大学在入学前学业成就、家庭背景和机构资源方面高度分层，但缺乏对教学资源分层程度、趋势及其经济学解释的系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 质量互补性（q-complementarity）、高人力资本的凸社会回报、大学前学习投资激励等经济学理论。
AI.method: 利用NBER工作论文系列数据，对美国高校按考试成绩和教学支出的分层进行长时段（1960年代至今）的实证分析，并检验经济学理论的实证支持度。
AI.findings: （1）高分学生所在大学的教学支出显著更高；（2）考试分数分层自1960年代以来基本稳定，但教学资源分层自1970年以来急剧上升；（3）非学术录取标准是次要因素；（4）关于教学支出与先前成绩正相关的经济理由缺乏实证支持；（5）过去十年间总体资源分层未加剧，但机构内部的分层正在迅速上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统检验了质量互补性等经济学理论在高等教育资源配置中的适用性，发现这些理论缺乏实证支持，挑战了教学支出与学生先前成绩正相关关系的经济学合理性。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了公共财政援助项目（如加州CalGrant）对减缓大学间资源分层的积极作用，同时指出机构内部资源分层的上升趋势，为高等教育政策制定提供实证依据。

title: Crypto Capture of Foreign Aid
affiliations: National University of Singapore, National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Economics, Students, Cornell University - Dyson School of Applied Economics and Management and National University of Singapore (NUS)

detail.title: Crypto Capture of Foreign Aid
detail.abstract:
The 2016 Panama Papers leak tightened regulatory enforcement around money laundering and offshore banking. We investigate whether the diversion of foreign aid in developing countries led to a shift to cryptocurrency as an alternative laundering platform. We develop a disbursement-timed forensic measure of cryptocurrency activity, combining on-chain Bitcoin transactions and wallet creation, off-chain exchange records, and IP-linked web traffic, and apply it to World Bank aid disbursements covering $238 billion across the 93 recipient countries in our estimation sample during 2018-2024. Exploiting the administrative timing of aid tranche arrivals, we find sharp, short-lived surges of crypto activity at the disbursement month, driven mainly by anonymous and newly created wallets on both tax-haven and mainstream exchanges. Blockchain forensics reveal patterns consistent with the placement, layering, and integration sequence of conventional money laundering. We estimate an implied leakage of 2 to 6 cents per aid dollar, which amounts to roughly 1.7 to 4.4 billion dollars of aid diversion across the tranche arrivals we study. Capture carries no funding penalty: the four sectors where we detect it, Transport, Water and Sanitation, Social Protection, and Governance, still absorb half of subsequent World Bank funding. Cryptocurrency facilitates aid diversion, but its transparent ledgers also leave forensic traces that may help detect and recover diverted funds.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2016年巴拿马文件泄露后监管收紧的背景，研究外国援助资金是否被转移到加密货币作为洗钱替代渠道。通过结合链上比特币交易、钱包创建、交易所记录和IP网络流量构建基于拨款时间节点的取证指标，分析2018-2024年世界银行对93个受援国的2380亿美元援助拨款，发现拨款到账月份出现短暂而剧烈的加密货币活动激增，主要由匿名和新创建钱包驱动。区块链取证揭示了符合传统洗钱"放置-分层-整合"三阶段模式的痕迹，估计每援助美元有2-6美分的泄漏，总计约17-44亿美元的援助转移。
AI.research_question: 在2016年巴拿马文件泄露导致反洗钱监管加强后，发展中国家对外援助资金的转移是否转向加密货币作为替代洗钱平台？
AI.motivation: 巴拿马文件泄露后传统离岸银行洗钱渠道受到更严格监管，研究者希望探究洗钱行为是否转向加密货币这一新兴且相对不受监管的渠道，从而评估援助资金被转移的规模及其模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 洗钱理论（放置-分层-整合三阶段模型）；监管替代效应理论——监管加强可能导致不法行为向监管较弱的替代渠道转移。
AI.method: 构建基于拨款时间节点的取证指标，结合链上比特币交易数据、匿名/新创建钱包信息、链下交易所记录及IP关联网络流量数据，利用世界银行援助拨款的行政时间节点作为准自然实验，采用事件研究方法分析拨款到账前后加密货币活动的异常波动。
AI.findings: （1）援助拨款到账月份出现短暂而剧烈的加密货币活动激增，主要由匿名和新创建钱包驱动；（2）该活动同时出现在避税天堂交易所和主流交易所；（3）区块链取证揭示符合传统洗钱三阶段模式的证据；（4）估算每援助美元泄漏2-6美分，总计约17-44亿美元被转移；（5）涉及部门（交通、水和卫生、社会保障、治理）仍获得世界银行后续资金的一半，即"被捕获"不带来资金惩罚。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将洗钱的监管替代效应延伸到加密货币领域，证实了监管加强会促使非法资金渠道发生转移的理论预测；同时将传统的洗钱三阶段框架成功应用于链上加密货币交易取证分析，拓展了该理论框架的适用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际援助机构提供了一套基于区块链取证的新型援助腐败检测工具；揭示了加密货币公共账本在反腐败中的双重价值——既是被滥用的工具，也可能成为发现和追回被转移资金的证据来源；为推动针对加密货币洗钱的进一步监管政策和援助资金分配改革提供实证依据。

title: A Model of Global Firms and Capital Markets
affiliations: University of Minnesota - Minneapolis, Columbia University - Columbia Business School and University of Minnesota - Twin Cities - Carlson School of Management

detail.title: A Model of Global Firms and Capital Markets
detail.abstract:
We develop a general-equilibrium model of the global economy that integrates heterogeneous firms competing in product markets with countries that allocate capital around the world. Combining a hedonic demand system on the product side with a mean-variance portfolio system on the asset side, we obtain almost closed-form solutions for the equilibrium of the model. We use firm-level data on balance sheets, geographic breakdowns of revenue and employment, and business descriptions along with country-level data on bilateral equity holdings and trade costs to quantify the model to a cross section of roughly 23,000 listed firms in 48 countries. We use the model to evaluate the reallocation and welfare effects of globalization. Both financial and trade liberalization concentrate activity among the largest firms and raise welfare, with gains being larger in emerging and mid-sized open economies respectively. Product- and capital-market frictions amplify each other, meaning that liberalizing one market reduces the gains from liberalizing the other.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个整合异质性企业产品市场竞争与全球资本配置的全球一般均衡模型，利用约23,000家跨国上市公司数据量化模型，评估全球化（贸易与金融自由化）的再配置效应和福利效应。
AI.research_question: 全球化和金融/贸易自由化如何影响企业规模分布、资源再配置以及各国福利水平？产品市场与资本市场摩擦如何相互作用并影响自由化的收益？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常分别分析贸易或金融自由化对企业与福利的影响，缺乏一个将产品市场竞争与全球资本配置整合的统一一般均衡框架，无法捕捉两类市场化改革之间的交互效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡模型；异质性企业理论；享乐需求系统（产品侧）；均值-方差投资组合理论（资产侧）
AI.method: 构建整合享乐需求系统与均值-方差组合选择的全球一般均衡模型，利用企业层面的资产负债表、收入与就业地理分布数据以及国别层面的双边股权持有和贸易成本数据，对48个国家约23,000家上市公司进行量化校准。
AI.findings: （1）贸易和金融自由化都会促使经济活动向最大型企业集中并提升福利；（2）贸易自由化对新兴经济体的福利增益更大，而金融自由化对中等规模开放经济体的增益更大；（3）产品市场与资本市场摩擦相互放大，放开一个市场会降低放开另一个市场的边际收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将异质性企业产品市场竞争与全球资本配置纳入统一的一般均衡框架，揭示了产品市场与资本市场摩擦的互补放大效应，为理解全球化的福利来源提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于贸易与金融自由化的福利影响的量化评估，特别指出了不同经济体（新兴经济体vs中等规模开放经济体）在不同类型自由化中的相对获益差异，并提示同时推进两类改革的收益递减性。

title: Cultural Evolution
affiliations: Brown University - Department of Economics, University of Copenhagen - Department of Economics and University of Oxford

detail.title: Cultural Evolution
detail.abstract:
What gave rise to the mosaic of cultural expressions across the globe? Why are some societies more culturally diverse than others? This study develops a unified theory of cultural evolution, characterizing the forces that have governed this process over the course of human existence. The research advances the hypothesis that population movements and socioeconomic transformations generated a mismatch between inherited cultural traits and prevailing ecological and societal conditions, setting in motion an evolutionary process governed by adaptation-based vertical transmission, horizontal diffusion, and fitness-based evolutionary selection. The theory generates novel testable predictions concerning the origins of the global cultural mosaic and the cross-societal variation in cultural diversity. First, greater ecological distance between ancestral environments generated greater cultural distance across societies. Second, prehistoric differences in ancestral diversity contributed to divergent adaptive capacity and greater cultural distance. Third, societies descended from more diverse prehistoric populations exhibit greater cultural diversity despite convergence induced by adaptation to a common environment and societal norms. Drawing on measures of cultural distance and diversity derived from folkloric and musical traditions among ethnic groups, visual representations of common concepts, and the dispersion of norms, values, and attitudes, the empirical analysis lends credence to the predictions of the theory.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的文化演化理论，用以解释全球文化马赛克（文化多样性）的起源及各社会文化多样性程度的差异。该理论认为，人口迁徙和社会经济转型导致了遗传文化特质与生态环境及社会条件之间的错配，从而触发了由适应性垂直传播、水平扩散和基于适应度的演化选择共同驱动的文化演化过程。理论产生了关于文化距离与文化多样性的新预测，并通过民俗、音乐、视觉表征及规范价值观等多源数据进行了实证检验。
AI.research_question: 什么力量塑造了全球文化表达的多样性马赛克？为什么一些社会比另一些社会更具文化多样性？
AI.motivation: 现有的文化演化研究往往缺乏统一的解释框架，未能系统说明全球文化马赛克的起源以及跨社会文化多样性差异的根本原因，需要构建一个统一理论来整合多种文化演化力量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化演化理论，具体包括：适应性垂直传播、水平扩散和基于适应度的演化选择三种机制的统一框架。
AI.method: 理论建模与经验研究相结合。理论部分提出关于文化距离与文化多样性的新预测；实证部分利用族群民俗与音乐传统的文化距离和多样性度量、共同概念的视觉表征、以及规范、价值观和态度的离散程度等数据进行检验。
AI.findings: 第一，祖先环境之间的生态距离越大，社会间的文化距离越大。第二，史前祖先多样性的差异导致了不同的适应能力并增大了文化距离。第三，由更多样化的史前人群繁衍而来的社会，即使面临共同环境适应和社会规范所导致的趋同，仍表现出更大的文化多样性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了一个统一的文化演化理论，整合了生态演化、人口迁徙与传播机制，为解释全球文化马赛克的起源和跨社会文化多样性差异提供了系统的理论框架和可检验的预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解当代社会文化多样性的历史根源提供了理论依据，有助于政策制定者和社会研究者认识文化多样性的深层决定因素，从而在文化政策、社会治理等领域做出更明智的决策。

title: Algorithmic Governance and Audit Efficiency: The Role of AI Adoption and IT Governance in Jordanian Commercial Banks
affiliations: Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University, , , University of Tabuk, Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University and Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University

detail.title: Algorithmic Governance and Audit Efficiency: The Role of AI Adoption and IT Governance in Jordanian Commercial Banks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors agree that this research was conducted in the absence of any self-benefit or commercial or financial conflicts.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses data derived from the annual reports and financial statements of banks listed on the Amman Stock Exchange and involves no human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding is reported for this study.

detail.abstract: AI is rapidly developing in auditing practices worldwide, but there is little empirical evidence on the link between AI and audit efficiency among emerging market banks. In addition, the organizational variables through which AI improves audit efficiency-for example, IT governance maturity-are not theoretically and empirically theoretically sound and empirically untested. This study explores the effect of AI adoption on audit delay in Jordanian banks and the altering role of IT governance maturity. The data for 2015-2024 are summarized in a balanced panel of 15 commercial and Islamic banks listed on the ASE, indicating 150 bank years. The normalized score of AI adoption is obtained through bilingual content analysis of annual reports, and a CoBIT-aligned composite index for IT governance maturity is measured by a standardized score of the bilingual content analysis of the annual reports. Four model specifications employ pooled OLS regression with Driscoll-Kraay standard errors robust to heteroskedasticity, autocorrelation, and cross-sectional dependence. This suggests that AI adoption significantly reduces audit delay (= 26.07, p = 0.01); an increased AI score = 4.06 fewer audit days, which translates into a 6.5% efficiency improvement; and an increase in one standard deviation in the AI score yields 4.06 fewer audit days, or a 6.5% improvement in accuracy. I conclude that the interaction between AI adoption and IT governance maturity is negative and significant: 3 = 6.22, p = 0.011, and banks with larger IT governance maturity significantly increase the efficiency of audit performance. The results are reliable when the year fixed effects are replaced with a COVID-19 control variable. The present study contributes the first archival evidence from emerging-market banks in the MENA region on the AI-audit efficiency nexus, incorporates Agency Theory, TOE and Institutional Theory, and emphasizes IT governance as a critical barrier to achieving an efficient use of AI in auditing.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2015-2024年约旦15家银行（含商业银行和伊斯兰银行）的平衡面板数据（150个银行-年观测值），通过年度报告双语内容分析构建AI采用和IT治理成熟度指标，实证检验了AI采用对审计延迟的影响及IT治理成熟度的调节作用。研究发现AI采用显著降低审计延迟（AI得分增加一个标准差可减少4.06个审计日，相当于6.5%的效率提升），且IT治理成熟度正向调节这一关系。
AI.research_question: AI采用如何影响新兴市场银行的审计效率（以审计延迟衡量）？IT治理成熟度是否以及如何调节这一关系？
AI.motivation: 尽管AI在全球审计实务中快速发展，但关于AI与新兴市场银行审计效率之间关系的实证证据极为缺乏；此外，IT治理成熟度等组织层面变量如何影响AI对审计效率的作用，在理论和实证上均未被充分检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理理论（Agency Theory）、技术-组织-环境框架（TOE）、制度理论（Institutional Theory）
AI.method: 采用2015-2024年约旦安曼证券交易所上市银行的面板数据（150个银行-年观测），通过年度报告双语内容分析构建AI采用标准化得分和CoBIT对齐的IT治理成熟度综合指数；使用四种模型规格的混合OLS回归，采用Driscoll-Kraay标准误以稳健处理异方差、自相关和横截面依赖问题，并以COVID-19控制变量替换年份固定效应进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: AI采用显著降低审计延迟（系数=26.07，p=0.01），AI得分每增加一个标准差可减少4.06个审计日（相当于6.5%的效率提升）；AI采用与IT治理成熟度的交互项为负且显著（系数=6.22，p=0.011），表明IT治理成熟度较高的银行能显著提升AI对审计效率的促进作用；在替换为COVID-19控制变量的稳健性检验中结果保持可靠。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为MENA地区新兴市场银行提供AI-审计效率关系的档案证据；整合代理理论、TOE框架和制度理论，构建了多理论视角的分析框架；强调了IT治理成熟度作为充分发挥AI审计效率的关键组织边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场银行的管理层和审计委员会提供了关于AI投资决策的实证依据；强调了建立健全IT治理机制对最大化AI审计效率价值的重要性；为监管机构和政策制定者提供了关于银行业AI采纳和IT治理协同发展的政策参考。

title: Critical Minerals, Geopolitics, and the Green Transition
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, Johns Hopkins University and Stanford University

detail.title: Critical Minerals, Geopolitics, and the Green Transition
detail.abstract:
The green energy transition will be powered by the mining and processing of lithium, nickel, and cobalt, which are critical for the production of advanced batteries. These minerals are concentrated geographically but traded globally, allowing key mining countries to exercise market power through policy intervention. Advanced batteries use multiple minerals in combination, and this joint use creates interdependence across mineral markets. We study the geopolitical implications of these forces and their consequences for green technology adoption worldwide. We quantify supply chain vulnerability, international policy spillovers, and the potential for mineral cartels.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究绿色能源转型所需的锂、镍、钴等关键矿产的地缘政治影响，探讨这些矿产的地理集中性、市场支配力以及联合使用产生的跨市场相互依赖，量化供应链脆弱性、国际政策溢出效应和矿产卡特尔的可能性。
AI.research_question: 关键矿产的地缘政治力量如何影响绿色技术的全球采用？具体包括：供应链脆弱性如何量化、国际政策溢出效应有多大、矿产卡特尔形成的可能性如何？
AI.motivation: 绿色能源转型依赖锂、镍、钴等关键矿产，这些矿产地理集中但全球交易，使主要矿业国家能够通过政策干预行使市场支配力。同时，先进电池需要多种矿产组合使用，造成跨矿产市场的相互依赖。这些力量的地缘政治影响及其对全球绿色技术采用的影响尚需系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 涉及国际贸易理论中的市场支配力（market power）、供应链经济学、地缘政治经济学以及多市场相互依赖（cross-market interdependence）理论。
AI.method: 该研究采用量化分析方法，对供应链脆弱性进行测量，评估国际政策溢出效应，并分析矿产卡特尔形成的潜力。
AI.findings: 研究量化了关键矿产供应链的脆弱性、政策干预的国际溢出效应，以及矿产出口国形成卡特尔的可能性，揭示这些因素对全球绿色技术采用速度与模式的深远影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将地缘政治力量、市场支配力和跨矿产市场的相互作用纳入绿色能源转型的分析框架，丰富了资源经济学与国际贸易理论在清洁能源背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者识别关键矿产供应链风险提供量化依据，帮助各国评估绿色技术依赖关键矿产进口的地缘政治风险，并为预防矿产卡特尔和设计供应链韧性策略提供参考。

title: The Temporal Paradox of Mandatory Sustainability Disclosure: Evidence from Saudi Arabia's 2021 Tadawul ESG Guidelines on Reporting Quality
affiliations: Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University, , , Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University, Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University and Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University

detail.title: The Temporal Paradox of Mandatory Sustainability Disclosure: Evidence from Saudi Arabia's 2021 Tadawul ESG Guidelines on Reporting Quality

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Institutional Review Board Statement: Not applicable. Informed Consent Statement: Not applicable. The study uses publicly available firm financial statements and disclosures and involves no human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University Researchers Supporting Project number (PNURSP2026R861), Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

detail.abstract: Does mandatory sustainability disclosure improve the quality of corporate financial reporting immediately, gradually, or with delay? We address this question using Saudi Arabia's January 2021 Tadawul ESG Disclosure Guidelines-the first comprehensive sustainability disclosure framework in the Gulf Cooperation Council and a uniform, accurately dated regulatory shock affecting all listed firms. Using a balanced panel of 135 non-financial firms over 2017-2024 (1080 firm-year observations), we estimate absolute discretionary accruals from the Modified Jones Model and employ event-time fixed-effects regressions with Driscoll-Kraay standard errors robust to heteroskedasticity, autocorrelation, and cross-sectional dependence. We document a temporal paradox: reporting quality did not change in the announcement year (2021), deteriorated significantly in 2022 (+28%) and 2023 (+38%) relative to the pre-reform baseline, and then improved significantly in 2024 (-17%). The pattern survives performance-matched discretionary accruals, exclusion of the 2020 COVID-19 year, a placebo test, sectoral disaggregation across nine Tadawul-aligned industry groups, and a battery of pre-reform firm characteristics. Heterogeneity analysis identifies the underlying mechanism: voluntary pre-2021 ESG disclosers and firms with stronger pre-reform governance exhibit amplified short-run deterioration, while larger firms with pre-existing reporting infrastructure show a substantially attenuated paradox. These patterns are jointly consistent with the adjustment-cost mechanism we develop: the reform redirected scarce reporting governance toward the new disclosure margin during a three-year compliance buildout, after which the constraining effect on accrual-based earnings management emerged. The findings carry direct implications for the design and evaluation of mandatory sustainability disclosure reforms currently advancing across emerging and developed markets.

AI.tldr: 本文利用沙特阿拉伯2021年1月Tadawul ESG披露指引这一准自然实验，研究强制性可持续披露对财务报告质量的动态影响。研究发现存在"时间悖论"：披露要求宣布当年财务报告质量无变化，2022-2023年显著恶化（绝对可自由裁量应计分别增加28%和38%），2024年显著改善（下降17%），符合"调整成本"机制——改革初期将稀缺的报告治理资源转向新披露维度，三年合规建设期后才释放对应计盈余管理的约束效应。
AI.research_question: 强制性可持续披露是否立即、渐进还是延迟改善公司财务报告质量？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对强制性可持续披露与财务报告质量关系的研究主要停留在静态效应分析，忽略了政策冲击的动态时间路径。沙特Tadawul ESG披露指引提供了首个海湾合作委员会（GCC）全面可持续披露框架，且是统一、精确日期的监管冲击，为研究财务报告质量的时序演化提供了独特机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 调整成本理论（adjustment-cost mechanism）：改革将稀缺的报告治理资源从应计盈余管理防线重新配置到新的可持续披露维度，导致短期报告质量恶化，待合规建设期完成后约束效应才显现。
AI.method: 基于2017-2024年135家非金融企业的平衡面板（1080个公司-年观测），采用Modified Jones Model估计绝对可自由裁量应计，使用事件时间固定效应回归，采用Driscoll-Kraay标准误以稳健处理异方差、自相关和横截面依赖。稳健性检验包括绩效匹配可自由裁量应计、排除2020年疫情年份、安慰剂检验、九个行业分组分析及改革前公司特征检验。
AI.findings: （1）2021年宣布年财务报告质量无显著变化；（2）2022年和2023年报告质量显著恶化（分别+28%和+38%）；（3）2024年报告质量显著改善（-17%）；（4）异质性分析表明：改革前自愿披露ESG的公司和治理更强的公司短期恶化更明显；规模更大、具备既有报告基础设施的公司悖论效应显著减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了"调整成本机制"理论，揭示强制性可持续披露对财务报告质量影响的非线性和动态时间路径，为理解监管改革与报告质量关系提供了新的理论解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场和发达市场正在推进的强制性可持续披露改革的设计与效果评估提供直接的政策启示，提醒政策制定者需预期和容忍改革初期的短期质量退化，并基于更长的时间窗口评估改革效果。

title: The Effects of SNAP Sugary Drink Restrictions on Consumption and Welfare
affiliations: Stanford University, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics, Stanford University and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: The Effects of SNAP Sugary Drink Restrictions on Consumption and Welfare
detail.abstract:
As of July 2026, 23 states had approved policies that disallow spending of SNAP benefits on sugary drinks. The effects of such restrictions on consumption are unclear, however, since most households can simply switch to buying sugary drinks with non-SNAP funds. Using a difference-in- differences design with nationwide grocery purchase panel data, we estimate that restrictions in the first 10 states reduced the average SNAP household’s retail purchases of excluded drinks by 12.4 percent (standard error = 1.0) over the first half of 2026. In states that excluded only some sugary drinks, SNAP households partially substituted to non-excluded drinks. Surveys we carried out before and after implementation show that the restrictions increased SNAP recipients’ perceptions of stigma. We combine our estimated consumption reductions with external parameters to model welfare effects given an over-consumption internality and a fiscal externality via public health care spending. In our model, excluding all sugary drinks from SNAP nationwide would provide benefits of about $1.1 billion per year, of which about 70 percent is from reduced health care costs.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用双重差分设计和全国杂货购买面板数据，估计了SNAP（补充营养援助计划）限制含糖饮料购买的政策效果。研究发现，前10个州的限制使SNAP家庭的被排除饮料零售购买量下降了12.4%，同时增加了受益人的污名感知。结合外部参数建模，若全国范围内将含糖饮料从SNAP中排除，每年可带来约11亿美元的福利收益，其中约70%来自医疗保健成本降低。
AI.research_question: SNAP政策限制含糖饮料购买是否有效减少消费？其福利效应如何？
AI.motivation: 截至2026年7月，已有23个州批准限制SNAP福利用于含糖饮料，但此类限制的实际效果尚不明确，因为家庭可以转而使用非SNAP资金购买含糖饮料。
AI.theoretical_framework: 过度消费内在性（over-consumption internality）和财政外部性（fiscal externality）理论，通过公共医疗支出渠道分析福利效应。
AI.method: 双重差分设计（difference-in-differences），使用全国杂货购买面板数据；辅以实施前后的调查数据；结合外部参数进行福利建模。
AI.findings: 1) 前10个州的限制使SNAP家庭被排除饮料的零售购买量减少12.4%；2) 仅排除部分含糖饮料的州中，家庭部分替代为非排除饮料；3) 限制增加了SNAP受益人的污名感知；4) 全国范围内排除所有含糖饮料每年可带来约11亿美元福利收益，其中约70%来自医疗成本降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文整合了过度消费内在性和财政外部性理论，为SNAP限制政策提供了福利经济学分析框架，将消费行为改变与健康经济学理论相联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了SNAP含糖饮料限制政策的量化效果评估，包括消费减少幅度、替代效应、污名影响以及全国推广的福利收益估算，为相关政策决策提供实证依据。

title: The Data Revolution, and Its Uses, in International Trade
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics and University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Data Revolution, and Its Uses, in International Trade
detail.abstract:
In recent decades, economists studying international trade have gained access to an unprecedented volume and variety of data. These data have provided new insights and a more granular understanding of the mechanics of trade. Analyzing a large corpus of papers, we document that the nature of research has also shifted. Previously, the typical trade paper was either purely theoretical or an empirical paper testing theoretical predictions. More recently, scholarship has shifted toward a more integrated approach, particularly quantitative modeling. This development is surprising. We might have expected the data revolution (and contemporaneous credibility revolution) to increase the share of primarily empirical papers—although the markers of these revolutions are clearly evident in the rise of causal inference within empirical work. This article reviews these developments, assessing the strengths and limitations of different modes of inquiry, and plotting a path forward to harness the growing richness of data within the field.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了国际贸易经济学领域研究范式在过去几十年的转变，发现该领域从纯粹理论或实证检验理论预测的论文，逐渐转向更整合的定量建模方法。尽管数据革命和可信度革命推动了因果推断方法在实证研究中的兴起，但论文结构整体上并未以纯粹实证为主流，这一发现令人意外。文章评估了不同研究模式的优缺点，并为利用日益丰富的数据资源指明了前进方向。
AI.research_question: 国际贸易经济学领域的研究性质如何随时间演变？数据革命是否如预期那样推动了实证研究的兴起？不同研究模式的优缺点是什么？
AI.motivation: 国际贸易领域近几十年出现了前所未有的数据革命，但研究者观察到该领域的学术论文性质发生了意想不到的转变——从纯理论和实证检验转向定量建模的整合方法。这一现象与直觉预期（数据革命应推动纯粹实证研究）相悖，值得系统审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文为综述性文献回顾，不依赖单一理论框架，而是基于对大量论文语料的计量分析，梳理研究范式（纯理论、实证检验、定量建模）的演变轨迹，结合数据革命与可信度革命的概念来理解这些变化。
AI.method: 对大量已发表论文的语料库进行系统性分析，量化分类不同研究模式（纯理论、实证检验、定量建模）的比重及其随时间的变化趋势，并结合因果推断方法的兴起进行交叉分析。
AI.findings: 1）国际贸易研究已从纯粹的理論或实证检验论文转向更整合的定量建模方法；2）尽管数据革命和可信度革命的痕迹明显体现在实证工作中因果推断方法的兴起，但并未如预期那样提高纯实证论文的占比；3）不同研究模式各有优缺点，定量建模在利用数据丰富性方面展现出独特优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地刻画了国际贸易领域研究范式的演变轨迹，解释了为何数据革命并未如预期推动纯实证研究的增长，为理解经济学各子领域研究生产方式的动态变化提供了分析框架和理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了国际贸易领域不同研究模式（纯理论、实证检验、定量建模）的优缺点评估，有助于研究者根据研究问题和数据条件选择合适的方法论路径，并为该领域未来如何更好地利用日益丰富的数据资源指明了方向。

title: Measuring the Welfare Gains from Cardinal-Preference Mechanisms in School Choice
affiliations: Rice University, University of Michigan at Ann Arbor and Rice University

detail.title: Measuring the Welfare Gains from Cardinal-Preference Mechanisms in School Choice
detail.abstract:
Ordinal mechanisms use rankings but not preference intensities. Cardinal mechanisms also elicit school utilities, allowing them to use students’ preferences over assignment lotteries. We compare probabilistic serial with four cardinal mechanisms that maximize the same welfare objective under successively stronger restrictions: capacity-only, ε-envy-free, envy-free, and a welfare-maximizing cardinal-preference pseudomarket. Because the feasible sets are nested, maximum welfare weakly falls as the restrictions tighten from capacity alone to approximate no-envy, exact no-envy, and equal budgets with common prices. We establish positive and negative results on large-market truthtelling. All 44 theorem parts in the paper are machine-checked in the Lean 4 proof assistant. We develop methods for computing cardinal-preference pseudomarket equilibria for Seattle’s 898 students and 11 schools. Using set-identified cardinal preferences from Seattle high-school choice data, we estimate that, under exact capacity, capacity-only raises mean welfare over probabilistic serial by 0.053, equivalent to shifting 5.3 percentage points of assignment probability from the average student’s worst school to the top school. Exact envy-freeness retains 79% of this gain; best-found pseudomarket equilibria yield a mean gain of 0.002. The estimates show both the value of cardinal information and the welfare cost of pseudomarket fairness restrictions.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了序数机制（概率串行）与四种基数机制在学区分配中的福利表现。通过嵌套的约束条件（容量约束、ε-无嫉妒、无嫉妒、伪市场公平），研究发现随着约束收紧，最大福利下降。利用西雅图898名学生和11所学校的真实数据，估计容量约束下的基数机制较概率串行可提升平均福利0.053，但伪市场公平约束几乎完全抵消了这一增益。所有44个定理均在Lean 4证明助手中机器验证。
AI.research_question: 在学校选择分配中，基数机制相较于序数机制能带来多大的福利提升？在不同公平性约束下（容量约束、近似无嫉妒、精确无嫉妒、伪市场公平），这些福利增益如何变化？
AI.motivation: 序数机制仅利用排名，无法利用偏好强度信息；基数机制虽能利用学校效用信息，但不同约束条件下的福利表现缺乏系统比较。理解公平性约束对福利的代价对于设计更好的学校分配机制至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制设计理论、福利经济学、伪市场均衡理论（pseudomarket）、无嫉妒（envy-free）理论
AI.method: 理论分析（嵌套可行集下的福利比较）+ Lean 4 定理机器验证 + 实证估计（使用西雅图高中选择数据的集识别基数偏好，计算伪市场均衡）
AI.findings: 容量约束下基数机制较概率串行平均福利提升0.053（相当于5.3个百分点的分配概率从最差学校转移到最优学校）；精确无嫉妒保留了该增益的79%；最佳伪市场均衡仅产生0.002的平均增益，表明伪市场公平约束的福利代价很大。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了序数与基数机制福利比较的统一理论框架；证明了嵌套约束下最大福利单调下降的性质；用Lean 4对全部44个定理进行了形式化验证，提升了理论结果的可靠性；提出了计算基数偏好伪市场均衡的方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学校分配政策制定提供实证量化依据：基数信息具有显著价值，但伪市场公平约束的经济成本极高；大市场中存在真实报告的积极/消极结果，为实际机制设计提供指导。

title: Algorithmic Patriarchy: Artificial Intelligence, the Feminisation of Poverty, and the Limits of Governance

detail.title: Algorithmic Patriarchy: Artificial Intelligence, the Feminisation of Poverty, and the Limits of Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I do not have any personal or financial relationship with other people or organisations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Nobody has funded this research.

detail.abstract: Nearly fifty years after Diana Pearce named the feminisation of poverty, the systems now deciding who gets hired, credited, or cared for were trained on the same discourse that has kept it in place. Patriarchal capitalist structures have long depended on women's unpaid labour while excluding women from the rewards of the economy they sustain. Neoliberal governance extended that arrangement, swapping a structural vocabulary of poverty for one of resilience, self-improvement, and personal responsibility. The neoliberal discourse brought the shrinking of the welfare state, and with it, a new vocabulary that spread from policy papers to self-help writing, human resources content, and coaching material. It has been produced at internet scale for four decades through the same text now training large language models (LLMs). Currently, this new vocabulary is embedded in the systems that screen résumés, and intertwined with the caseworkers who draft eligibility determinations. To understand algorithmic patriarchy and its relationship with the feminisation of poverty, this paper connects two bodies of scholarship: work on how neoliberal governance produces individualising discourse, and work on how AI systems inherit bias from training data. My contribution is to name and trace the mechanism by which patriarchy, neoliberalism, and unconscious bias combine to produce a vocabulary, reproduced by artificial intelligence systems, that may sustain the feminisation of poverty. Current governance frameworks audit outcomes but not the discourse producing them. This paper argues that language matters, and that identifying the unconscious bias it carries is a precondition for its measurement and correction-the basis on which governance bodies can design policies bypassing their own invisible limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了算法父权制（algorithmic patriarchy）如何通过大型语言模型（LLMs）中嵌入的新自由主义话语，延续女性贫困化（feminisation of poverty）这一现象。文章认为，新自由主义治理用"韧性""自我提升""个人责任"等个人化话语取代了结构性的贫困叙事，这些话语在过去四十年间以互联网规模生产，如今已被LLMs吸收并嵌入简历筛选、福利资格认定等自动化系统中，从而在算法层面再生产了父权制的性别不平等。
AI.research_question: 算法父权制如何通过与新自由主义话语和潜意识偏见结合，在人工智能系统中再生产并延续女性贫困化？
AI.motivation: 自Diana Pearce提出"女性贫困化"概念近五十年后，决定谁被雇佣、获得信贷或被照护的系统，仍然基于维系该现象的同一套话语进行训练。当前治理框架只审计结果而不审计产生结果的话语，亟需揭示这一被忽视的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连接两条学术脉络：（1）新自由主义治理如何生产个体化话语（resilience、self-improvement、personal responsibility）；（2）AI系统如何从训练数据中继承偏见。两者结合形成父权制、新自由主义与潜意识偏见共同产生话语的机制框架。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念论文：命名并追踪父权制、新自由主义与潜意识偏见三者结合产生"算法话语"（algorithmic vocabulary）的机制，论证语言的重要性及其作为测量与纠正前提的分析路径。
AI.findings: 新自由主义话语已从政策文件扩散至自助写作、人力资源内容和教练材料，四十年间以互联网规模生产，并被当前训练LLMs的文本所吸收；这一话语现已嵌入简历筛选系统及社会工作者起草资格认定的流程中。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并命名"算法父权制"（algorithmic patriarchy）概念，连接新自由主义话语研究与AI偏见研究两大学术领域，阐明三者结合的机制是女性贫困化在算法时代得以延续的根源。
AI.practical_contributions: 论证识别话语中潜意识偏见是测量和纠正的前提，为治理机构设计绕过自身"隐形局限"的政策提供理论基础。

title: Empirical Asset Pricing via Machine Learning: Evidence from Indian Equity Markets

detail.title: Empirical Asset Pricing via Machine Learning: Evidence from Indian Equity Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no conflict of interest
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding

detail.abstract: This paper applies the machine learning asset-pricing framework of Gu, Kelly & Xiu (2020) to Indian equity markets. Using a panel of 375 stocks listed on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) over 2000-2024 and ten price-based firm characteristics, we evaluate 14 machine learning models spanning linear regression, penalized regression, dimension reduction, generalized linear models, tree ensembles, and neural networks within a rolling expanding-window outof-sample framework. A three-layer neural network (NN3) delivers the strongest pooled out-of-sample R 2 (0.55% per month), while tree-based ensembles (Random Forest, GBRT, XGBoost) deliver the weakest statistical predictability among the fourteen models, with Random Forest producing a negative out-of-sample R 2. A COVID-19 subperiod analysis shows that predictability rises markedly during and after the pandemic, with NN3 the only model to remain positive across all three subperiods examined. Portfolio sorts reveal a disconnect between statistical and economic performance: XGBoost ranks eleventh of fourteen models by out-of-sample R 2 but delivers the highest long-short Sharpe ratio (2.03) and the lowest maximum drawdown (-12.03%). SHAP-based variable importance analysis identifies firm size and twelve-month momentum as the dominant and most stable predictors across all model classes, while short-term reversal contributes negligibly. A supplementary benchmarking exercise situates these estimates against the international evidence reported in the literature. Taken together, the results document substantial heterogeneity across model classes in the mechanisms underlying return predictability in an emerging equity market and offer new baseline evidence for machine learning-based return prediction in India.

AI.tldr: 本文借鉴Gu, Kelly & Xiu (2020)的机器学习资产定价框架，应用于印度股票市场。使用2000-2024年NSE上市的375只股票和十个基于价格的财务特征，评估了14种机器学习模型。三层神经网络(NN3)在样本外R²上表现最佳（月度0.55%），而树集成模型表现最弱。COVID-19子期间分析显示可预测性显著上升。统计与经济绩效存在脱节：XGBoost在样本外R²排名第十一，但拥有最高的多空夏普比率(2.03)。SHAP分析发现公司规模和十二个月动量是最主要的预测因子。
AI.research_question: 机器学习资产定价框架在印度新兴股票市场中的收益可预测性表现如何？不同模型类别在统计预测能力和经济价值方面存在怎样的异质性？
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习资产定价研究主要集中于发达市场（如美国），对新兴市场尤其是印度的系统性证据匮乏。印度作为重要的新兴市场，其市场结构、投资者构成和效率特征与美国市场存在显著差异，需要独立的基准证据来推动机器学习在印度市场中的应用和研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习资产定价框架（Gu, Kelly & Xiu 2020）；跨模型类别比较框架，涵盖线性回归、惩罚回归、降维方法、广义线性模型、树集成和神经网络。
AI.method: 使用2000-2024年NSE上市的375只股票的面板数据，结合十个价格类公司特征，在滚动扩展窗口的样本外框架下评估14种机器学习模型。采用池化样本外R²衡量统计预测能力，使用组合排序（多空夏普比率、最大回撤）衡量经济表现，并使用SHAP进行变量重要性分析。
AI.findings: （1）三层神经网络(NN3)在14个模型中取得最高的池化样本外R²（月度0.55%）；（2）树集成模型（随机森林、GBRT、XGBoost）统计可预测性最弱，随机森林样本外R²为负；（3）COVID-19期间及之后可预测性显著上升，NN3在所有三个子期间均保持正R²；（4）统计与经济表现脱节：XGBoost夏普比率最高(2.03)、最大回撤最低(-12.03%)，但R²排名仅第十一；（5）SHAP分析显示公司规模和十二个月动量是最主要且最稳定的预测因子，短期反转贡献可忽略。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将GKX机器学习资产定价框架系统应用于印度市场，提供了新兴市场机器学习收益预测的基础性证据；揭示了不同模型类别在收益可预测性机制上的显著异质性，表明统计预测能力与经济价值之间不存在简单对应关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度市场的投资实践提供了可操作的模型选择基准：统计预测能力最佳的NN3和投资绩效最佳的XGBoost各有优势；识别了公司规模和动量作为印度市场最稳健的预测因子，为实践者构建投资策略提供指导；COVID-19子期间分析为不同市场环境下的模型稳定性提供了参考。

title: Grid Investment and Solar Integration in Malaysia: Evidence from TNB's RP4, Battery Storage and Cross-Border Interconnection

detail.title: Grid Investment and Solar Integration in Malaysia: Evidence from TNB's RP4, Battery Storage and Cross-Border Interconnection
detail.abstract: An earlier paper (Cheng, 2026) found Malaysia's solar capacity sitting comfortably below Peninsular Malaysia's published grid-penetration thresholds once those thresholds are converted from generation-output into capacity-equivalent terms: a nding about headroom relative to the inherited engineering benchmarks available to that study, not a measurement of the grid's current limit. This paper asks the infrastructure-response question that leaves open, and nds active engagement on most fronts but no single verdict. Tenaga Nasional Berhad's fourth regulatory period (20252027) raises base allowed capital expenditure by 29.2% and authorizes a further RM16.3 billion in contingent capital expenditure, linked to several triggers including energy transition, without a disclosed split. On storage, 100 MW is operating on the Peninsular grid and 400 MW formally shortlisted; if commissioned as targeted in 2027, that 500 MW pipeline would equal the cumulative position scheduled for 2034 in Suruhanjaya Tenaga's Generation Development Plan 2020, seven years earlier than that published schedule. Although secondary reporting commonly attributes 500 MW to a 2030 National Energy Transition Roadmap target, the published Roadmap contains no numerical battery-storage target. Cross-border interconnection is mixed rather than uniformly lagging: an ageing 300 MW Thailand link with completed upgrade feasibility but no disclosed construction timeline, alongside a 1,000 MW Singapore link already upgraded in 2022 and a second, larger link under full feasibility study targeting 2030. An updated 2025 capacity estimate stays below the inherited thresholds under three of four scenarios, and that result holds independently of the uncertain regional-share assumption, though it exceeds the earlier study's deliberately extreme stress-test case. The evidence is genuinely mixed, and the benchmark itself may be moving.

AI.tldr: 本文考察马来西亚半岛电网对可再生能源渗透率阈值的响应性基础设施投入，发现电网投资、储能部署和跨境互联呈现"积极但混合"的局面，没有单一结论。
AI.research_question: 马来西亚半岛电网在已知的（继承自工程基准的）渗透率阈值约束下，其基础设施（输配电投资、储能、跨境互联）的响应性部署进展如何？
AI.motivation: 此前Cheng (2026)的研究发现马来西亚太阳能装机容量在换算为容量当量后低于已发布的电网渗透率阈值，但该发现仅反映相对旧工程基准的富余空间，而非电网当前实际极限。本文旨在回答该研究所遗留的基础设施响应问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 电网渗透率阈值与容量当量换算框架；监管周期资本支出与能源转型触发机制；储能管线和跨境互联作为电网灵活性基础设施的评估框架。
AI.method: 基于公开政策文件与行业报告的文档分析，包括Tenaga Nasional Berhad第四个监管期（2025-2027）的资本支出计划、Suruhanjaya Tenaga的发电发展计划、国家能源转型路线图，以及泰国和新加坡跨境互联的技术与进度文件。采用多情景容量估算对比。
AI.findings: （1）国能第四监管期基础资本支出上调29.2%，并授权163亿林吉特或有资本支出（含能源转型触发，但未披露分配）；（2）储能方面100MW已运营、400MW入选，若2027年投产则500MW管线的累计容量将比GDP 2020规划的2034年目标提前7年；（3）但国家能源转型路线图（2030）并未包含数值电池储能目标，二手报道存在误归因；（4）跨境互联呈混合态势：泰国300MW老化线路升级可行性已完成但无建设时间表，新加坡1000MW线路已于2022年升级且第二条更大线路正开展全可行性研究（目标2030）；（5）2025年容量估算在四情景中三情景低于继承阈值，且结果独立于不确定的区域份额假设，但超过先前研究刻意设定的极端压力测试案例。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文对"电网渗透率阈值"文献的贡献在于：将先前静态的阈值评估扩展为动态的基础设施响应分析，并揭示储能管线的"提前交付"与公开路线图目标缺乏数字基准之间的张力，以及跨境互联"混合而非普遍滞后"的差异化格局。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管机构提供多维度证据：资本支出触发机制需更透明（未披露能源转型份额）、储能目标需在路线图中明确数值基准以避免误归因、跨境互联需根据具体线路差异化管理（泰国线路的老化升级时间表应明确），并为电网容量决策提供四情景的稳健性检验框架。

title: Institutional Models of Veteran Healthcare: A Comparative Analysis of the United States and China and a Framework for Integrated Public-Private Care

detail.title: Institutional Models of Veteran Healthcare: A Comparative Analysis of the United States and China and a Framework for Integrated Public-Private Care

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a comparative institutional and policy analysis based on publicly available literature and theoretical modeling, involving no human participants, clinical intervention, or private patient data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or funding from any agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Healthcare provision for military veterans represents a critical intersection of national defense commitments, public finance, and health system design. This paper compares the institutional architectures of veteran healthcare in the United States and China. The author analyze how the US Veterans Health Administration (VHA)-a direct public provider increasingly augmented by publicly funded private care via the VA MISSION Act-contrasts with China's multi-tiered system overseen by the Ministry of Veterans Affairs (MVA), which combines Basic Medical Insurance (BMI), targeted veteran medical relief, and priority access within public tertiary hospitals. The author identifies systemic vulnerabilities in both systems, including administrative choice friction, care fragmentation, and regional supply disparities. Building on these comparative insights, we propose the Integrated Veteran Healthcare Model (IVHM)-a hybrid framework for the US that unifies VHA specialized care with private hospital networks through dynamic risk-adjusted triage, centralized Electronic Health Record (EHR) interoperability, and automated cost-sharing elimination to guarantee accessible, high-quality treatment regardless of facility ownership.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了美国和中国的退伍军人医疗保健制度架构，发现两国系统均存在行政选择摩擦、护理碎片化和区域供给不均等问题，并基于比较洞见提出美国"综合退伍军人医疗模式"（IVHM）混合框架，通过动态风险调整分诊、EHR互操作和自动化费用分担消除来保障医疗可及性与质量。
AI.research_question: 美国和中国的退伍军人医疗保健制度在机构架构上有何差异？两国系统各自存在哪些系统性脆弱性？如何设计一个改进的混合医疗框架？
AI.motivation: 退伍军人医疗保健是国防承诺、公共财政与卫生体系设计的关键交汇点，但美国VHA系统与中国多层级系统各有缺陷，缺乏系统的跨国比较研究来指导制度改进。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度比较分析框架，涉及公共提供者与混合提供模式的比较、多层级医疗保障体系设计、卫生系统整合理论。
AI.method: 比较案例研究：对美国的VHA系统（直接公共提供者+通过VA MISSION法案扩充的公共资助私人护理）与中国退伍军人事务部（MVA）监督下的多层级系统（基本医疗保险、退伍军人专项医疗救助、公立三甲医院优先通道）进行制度比较。
AI.findings: 两国系统均存在三类系统性脆弱性：行政选择摩擦、护理碎片化、区域供给不均。在此基础上提出IVHM综合模型，该模型统一VHA专科护理与私立医院网络，通过动态风险调整分诊、集中化EHR互操作、自动化费用分担消除来保证跨机构的高质量医疗服务。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统比较美中两国退伍军人医疗制度，提出了VHA混合护理模式的制度理论框架，为"公共提供与私人网络融合"的混合卫生治理模式提供了理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国退伍军人医疗改革提供可操作的IVHM实践框架，包括动态风险调整分诊、EHR互操作和费用分担自动消除三大实施要点。

title: Data Dominance and Digital Gatekeepers: Reconciling Competition Enforcement with Privacy Imperatives under India's Digital Competition Bill
affiliations: PES University

detail.title: Data Dominance and Digital Gatekeepers: Reconciling Competition Enforcement with Privacy Imperatives under India's Digital Competition Bill
detail.abstract: Data dominance and data privacy are not only vital but also necessary components of the ongoing public discourse surrounding the digital economy, which is continually evolving. India's Digital Competition Bill (DCB) seeks to enable timely, effective intervention in matters of digital competition by the Digital Competition Regulator through a range of investigatory and enforcement tools. Competition enforcement, particularly data-related mandates, in the DCB raise considerable tensions, posing challenges for operationalisation. The interplay between competition enforcement and privacy protection warrants critical scrutiny as DCB proceeds through Parliament; incumbent digital platforms currently enjoy multiple data-based advantages over new entrants and smaller rivals, while incumbent uncertainties surrounding data access risk chilling privacy-preserving innovations. Potential disruptions to privacy-improvement initiatives demand careful governance, alongside preventive measures to avert ongoing harm to innovation and consumer welfare from established digital gatekeepers. Potential candidate options are proposed to safeguard privacy while also promoting access to the rapidly growing data economy.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度《数字竞争法案》（DCB）在竞争执法，特别是数据相关授权方面与隐私保护之间的张力。指出在位数字平台基于数据优势挤压新进入者，同时数据访问的不确定性可能抑制隐私创新，并提出在保障隐私的同时促进数据经济发展的候选方案。
AI.research_question: 印度《数字竞争法案》（DCB）中的数据相关竞争执法授权如何与隐私保护产生冲突？应如何设计治理方案以平衡二者？
AI.motivation: 数字经济和数据隐私是公共讨论的持续重要议题。印度DCB寻求赋予数字竞争监管机构及时有效的介入工具，但其数据相关竞争执法措施与隐私保护之间存在显著张力，且在位平台享有基于数据的多重优势，同时数据访问不确定性可能抑制隐私创新，亟需审视与治理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争执法与隐私保护的交叉理论；数据驱动型市场支配力理论；创新激励与消费者福利理论
AI.method: 规范性法律与政策分析，基于DCB立法进程的批判性审查，提出候选治理方案
AI.findings: DCB中的数据相关竞争执法授权在操作化方面面临挑战；在位数字平台享有多种基于数据的优势；数据访问不确定性可能抑制隐私改善型创新；需要谨慎治理以防止在位数字关口对创新和消费者福利造成持续损害。
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了竞争执法与隐私保护之间的内在张力及其对创新的影响机制，拓展了数字市场竞争法与数据隐私治理交叉领域的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度DCB立法提供政策建议，提出在保障隐私的同时促进数据经济发展的候选治理方案，助力监管机构平衡竞争执法的及时有效介入与隐私保护。

title: The Unintended Costs of Targeted Performance Pay: Measuring Clinical Crowding-Out in Primary Care

detail.title: The Unintended Costs of Targeted Performance Pay: Measuring Clinical Crowding-Out in Primary Care

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study consists of theoretical microeconomic modeling and econometric methodology design, involving no direct human subjects, clinical interventions, or primary data collection by the author.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or funding from any agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Pay-for-Performance (P4P) schemes in primary care frequently tie financial bonuses to specific maternal and child health (MCH) targets. While these targeted incentives significantly expand rewarded services, principal-agent theory predicts that clinicians face trade-offs when allocating finite time and cognitive effort across multiple medical services. Building on multitasking agency theory and behavioral health economics, this paper develops a microeconomic model of clinician effort allocation that incorporates intrinsic provider altruism and separate sub-models for maternal and child healthcare delivery. We derive comparative statics demonstrating that financial bonuses on targeted MCH metrics induce clinical task distortion, crowding out effort on unrewarded services such as pediatric acute illness and maternal chronic condition management during pregnancy. We outline a difference-indifferences empirical strategy, present structural diagrams of effort substitution, and propose policy mechanisms to mitigate task distortion in low-and middle-income health systems.

AI.tldr: 本文基于多任务代理理论和行为健康经济学，构建了一个纳入医生内在利他主义的微观经济模型，分析初级医疗中按绩效付费（P4P）计划对母婴健康指标的激励如何导致临床任务扭曲，挤出未获奖励服务的努力投入，并提出缓解策略。
AI.research_question: P4P计划中对特定母婴健康指标的财务激励，如何影响临床医生在不同医疗任务之间的努力分配？是否会导致任务扭曲并挤出未获奖励的服务？
AI.motivation: 初级医疗中的P4P计划通常将财务奖励与特定母婴健康指标挂钩，虽然扩大了受奖励的服务范围，但主代理理论预测临床医生在有限时间和认知资源下需要在多项医疗服务之间进行权衡取舍，可能产生任务扭曲效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多任务代理理论（multitasking agency theory）、行为健康经济学、主代理理论、医生内在利他主义模型
AI.method: 构建临床医生努力分配的微观经济模型，分别包含母婴健康服务交付的子模型，推导比较静态分析，并勾勒双重差分（difference-in-differences）实证策略、努力替代的结构模型图。
AI.findings: 对母婴健康指标的财务奖励会诱导临床任务扭曲，挤出对未获奖励服务的努力投入，包括儿科急性疾病管理和孕期母亲慢性病管理。
AI.theory_contributions: 将多任务代理理论与行为健康经济学结合，引入医生内在利他主义，为P4P中的任务扭曲提供了微观经济理论框架，并区分了母婴两类服务的异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中低收入卫生系统提出缓解任务扭曲的政策机制，并为P4P方案设计提供理论指导。

title: Large-scale Assessment of Socioeconomic, Demographic and Health System Structures With Us County Excess Mortality, 2020–2024
affiliations: Stanford University - Department of Structural Biology, Mortality Watch,  and Stanford University - Meta-Research Innovation Center at Stanford (METRICS)

detail.title: Large-scale Assessment of Socioeconomic, Demographic and Health System Structures With Us County Excess Mortality, 2020–2024

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was funded by the US National Institutes of Health (R35 GM122543 to ML), the National Institute of Environmental Health Sciences (R01ES032470 to JPAI), and the Office of Naval Research (N000142412687 to JPAI).

detail.abstract:
Background Socioeconomic, demographic, and health system structures may have shaped COVID-19 pandemic impact across populations, but past analyses typically examined few factors. We systematically examined correlates of COVID-era excess mortality across US counties.

Methods We considered 2,745 county-level variables of demography, race/ethnicity, income, insurance, education, employment, housing, and health system from the Area Health Resources File. Pearson correlation coefficients (CCs) were obtained for the most recent available pre-pandemic value against age-standardized county excess death for each year during 2020–2024, with counties population-weighted. Variables were grouped by meaning into 11 semantic super-clusters.

Findings Overall, 17·3% of variables reached at least moderate correlation (|CC|>0·30) and 2·8% strong correlations (|CC|>0·45). Strongest correlations were seen for college attainment (CC −0·54), uninsurance among adults 40–64 (+0·53), and high income (−0·53). At least moderate correlations were seen for 9·1% of variables in 2020 and 8·5% in 2021, but only 1·8%, 0%, and 1·3% in 2022, 2023, and 2024, respectively, with similar patterns in elderly and non-elderly populations. Of 472 variables with |CC|>0·30, 285 of 395 moderate-band and all 77 strong-band variables belonged to demography and socioeconomic super-clusters; only 7% of health system variables reached |CC|>0·30, versus 31% of socioeconomic and demographic variables. Using variable values until 2023 or 2015, different population weighting, or Spearman correlations yielded similar results.

Interpretation These ecological analyses suggest strong relationships of socioeconomic structure and demographics rather than health-care resources and supply with excess mortality across US counties, especially during 2020–2021.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统分析了美国各县2,745个社会经济、人口和卫生系统变量与2020-2024年COVID-19时期超额死亡率的相关性，发现社会经济地位和人口结构与超额死亡率关联最强（尤其是大学学历、无保险率和收入），而卫生系统资源关联较弱，且这种关联主要集中在2020-2021年。
AI.research_question: 哪些社会经济、人口和卫生系统结构因素与美国各县COVID-19时期超额死亡率相关联？
AI.motivation: 以往研究仅考察少量因素与COVID-19死亡率的关系，缺乏全面系统的多因素分析，因此需要大规模系统性地检验各类结构性因素与超额死亡率的相关性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会决定因素健康理论（Social Determinants of Health），强调社会经济地位、人口结构和卫生系统资源对人群健康结果的综合影响。
AI.method: 利用Area Health Resources File中2,745个县级变量，计算各变量大流行前值与2020-2024年年龄标准化超额死亡率的Pearson相关系数，以县人口加权，将变量按含义分为11个语义超集群，并进行敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 17.3%的变量达到中度及以上相关（|CC|>0.30），2.8%达到强相关（|CC|>0.45）。最强相关为大学学历（-0.54）、40-64岁成人无保险率（+0.53）和高收入（-0.53）。相关性在2020-2021年较强，2022年后显著减弱。大部分强相关变量属于人口和社会经济超集群，仅7%的卫生系统变量达到中度相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了大规模生态学证据，系统性地证明社会经济结构和人口特征（而非卫生系统资源）是COVID-19超额死亡率的主要结构性驱动因素，丰富了社会决定因素健康理论在流行病学中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示公共卫生政策应优先解决社会经济不平等问题以增强社区韧性，而非仅关注医疗资源供给；对未来的大流行应对和资源分配具有重要政策参考价值。

title: Macroeconomic Signals for the Equity Investor: Leading Indicators, Official Statistics, and the Response of Interest Rates, Central Banks, and Currencies

detail.title: Macroeconomic Signals for the Equity Investor: Leading Indicators, Official Statistics, and the Response of Interest Rates, Central Banks, and Currencies
detail.abstract: This paper examines what information equity investors can extract from macroeconomic releases — from survey-based leading indicators (ISM and global purchasing managers' indices, ifo, ZEW, consumer sentiment, Tankan) as well as from official statistics (employment reports, job openings, price and monetary aggregates such as M3, activity indicators). It analyses the dual transmission of the data: directly, via earnings expectations and the discount rate, to equity prices (supportive or adverse), and indirectly, via the central banks' reaction functions (hawkish or dovish), to interest rates and currencies. A systematic comparison of the United States, Europe, and Japan covers institutions, indicator landscapes, and exchange rate channels. The event-study literature supplies precise magnitudes: more than 60 percent of the equity risk premium accrues on a small number of announcement days (Savor and Wilson, 2013); an unexpected 25-basis-point cut in the policy rate lifts US equity prices by about 1 percent on average (Bernanke and Kuttner, 2005); and the same labour market news works in opposite directions depending on the business cycle regime — rising unemployment is good for stocks in expansions and bad in recessions (Boyd, Hu, and Jagannathan, 2005). The inverted yield curve remains the most reliable single recession indicator (Estrella and Mishkin, 1996, 1998), and a large share of the equity market's return has historically accrued in the 24 hours before Fed decisions (Lucca and Moench, 2015). From these findings the paper derives a three-step framework for investment practice — surprise, regime, expected policy response — while marking its limits: data revisions, forecast accuracy, and market efficiency place tight bounds on macro-based timing. The paper is intended as a didactic synthesis of the literature, not as investment advice.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了宏观经济数据发布对股票市场的影响机制，提出"意外-经济周期阶段-预期政策反应"的三步投资分析框架，并基于事件研究文献量化了各传导渠道的效应。
AI.research_question: 股权投资者能从宏观经济数据发布中提取哪些有效信息？宏观经济数据通过哪些渠道、以什么幅度传导至股票价格？
AI.motivation: 宏观经济数据发布对股票市场影响显著（超过60%的股权风险溢价集中在少数公告日），但现有文献分散，缺乏系统的教学性整合框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双重传导理论：直接影响渠道（盈利预期和贴现率）与间接传导渠道（央行反应函数）；事件研究法；收益率曲线倒挂作为衰退指标的理论。
AI.method: 文献综述与事件研究整合：系统比较美国、欧洲、日本三地的制度、指标环境和汇率渠道，整合Savor & Wilson、Bernanke & Kuttner、Boyd等经典事件研究的量化结果。
AI.findings: 1) 超过60%的股权风险溢价集中在少数公告日；2) 意外降息25个基点平均推升美股约1%；3) 劳动力市场消息对股市的影响取决于经济周期阶段；4) 收益率曲线倒挂是最可靠的单一衰退指标；5) 股市回报在美联储决策前24小时集中获取。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"意外-经济周期阶段-预期政策反应"三步框架，整合了宏观数据双重传导机制，系统比较了美欧日三地制度差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资实践提供了基于宏观数据的可操作分析框架，同时明确标注了数据修订、预测精度和市场有效性对宏观择时的限制。

title: Multi-Sensor Convergence as a Regime Detection Signal: The Sensor Convergence Theorem

detail.title: Multi-Sensor Convergence as a Regime Detection Signal: The Sensor Convergence Theorem
detail.abstract:
When several independent instruments observing one system begin to move together, that agreement carries information about the system's near future. We formalize this as the Sensor Convergence Theorem: under a latent factor model with three scope conditions - sensor independence, persistent regime structure, and positive loading - the average pairwise correlation of sensor divergences is a monotonically increasing function of latent regime magnitude (numeric stress test: true; symbolic verification of the companion closed forms: true). We test the theorem across four natural domains where it should hold - financial markets, river hydrology, solar physics, and economics - and a fifth, public-health surveillance, registered to fail, with a pre-registered design, fingerprinted input data, and a machine-verified claims ledger. The thesis concerns independent sensors; the evidence that bears on it most directly comes from the multi-instrument tests, and we are careful throughout to separate that evidence from single-instrument constructions, which we find are largely a repackaging of trailing volatility. Solar physics offers the cleanest case: three physically distinct instruments yield Spearman rho = 0.0972 against forward solar variability (conservative block-shuffle z = 2.171), while a matched set of four transforms of a single instrument - an engineered independence violation - yields rho = -0.2319, uninformative as the theorem predicts. Three weekly economic indicators, placed on an equal footing, yield only rho = 0.09 (block-shuffle z = 0.969, not significant); an earlier construction in which one large-scale indicator dominated the target overstated this, so economics sits at the theorem's boundary, where the internal-facet and cross-indicator tests both fail; two previously claimed single-indicator exceptions did not survive reconstruction and are withdrawn. A market-wide count of simultaneously converging instruments anticipates risk-asset volatility but not currencies or rates. By contrast, single-instrument convergence - eight futures markets (mean rho = 0.0677, 7 of 8 positive; S&P 500 e-mini rho = 0.2571) and two rivers (Connecticut rho = 0.1885, block z = 3.957; Ohio rho = 0.1089, block z = 2.88) - correlates with forward variability, but controlling for trailing volatility collapses it (S&P partial rho = 0.0307): at the single-instrument level the signal is largely redundant with recent turbulence, and we do not claim incremental skill there. Even the apparent rise in equity-sensor convergence during crises is largely mechanical: a Forbes-Rigobon heteroskedasticity correction turns the genuine equity component sharply negative (adjusted dispersion measure -1.4277), while the same correction leaves a robust genuine component in crude oil (1.5905). The signal's non-redundant content is structural - the cross-system count, the scope contrasts above, and the Detection Frontier, whose closed-form difficulty ranking is negatively rank-correlated with empirical detection strength across 96 configurations (partial Spearman = -0.4743; the ranking survives removal of window-width, controlled Spearman = -0.5066). Derivative transformations of the signal carry almost nothing (mean rho = 0.0162 and 0.0261): the information lives in the level. A weather battery registered to fall short instead weakly clears the honest block-shuffle null (rho = 0.0997, z = 1.826), so the predicted scope-failure is not cleanly confirmed; the boundary of the regime-structure condition appears soft at seasonal timescales. A fifth domain, influenza surveillance, is registered to fail and does: its four near-redundant sensors all track influenza prevalence and so violate the independence condition, and convergence is anti-predictive of forward influenza activity (rho = -0.248; principled failure confirmed true). A falsifiable forward prediction for 2026-2031 is registered; at the level of non-overlapping elevated-convergence episodes (33 historical episodes, each separated by at least one forward-window length), the in-sample hit rate is 0.6364 against a base rate of 0.5 - suggestive but not significant once the windows are required not to overlap (one-sided binomial p = 0.0814). The Connecticut result survives deseasonalization (rho = 0.1846). This work is not the first to link rising co-movement to impending regime change - it shares that core with the critical-slowing-down and systemic-risk literatures (Section 5.1); our contribution is the explicit, separately tested independence condition, the closed-form detection frontier, and a fully reproducible verification contract. Every number in this paper regenerates from committed scripts on hash-pinned data; the verification gate (verify.py) is green.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"传感器收敛定理"：在潜在因子模型下，独立仪器观测同一系统时，其发散度的平均两两相关性与潜在制度幅度单调递增相关。作者在金融市场、河流水文、太阳物理、经济学四个自然领域测试该定理，并以公共卫生监测作为预注册的失败对照。研究发现多仪器收敛信号具有结构性、非冗余的预测信息，而单仪器收敛信号在很大程度上只是滞后波动率的重新包装。
AI.research_question: 多个独立传感器（仪器）观测同一系统时，其运动同步性（收敛）是否包含关于系统近期未来的预测信息？该信号在哪些条件下成立、哪些条件下失效，以及其信息含量是否超越了传统波动率指标？
AI.motivation: 现有文献（如临界减速理论和系统性风险文献）已关注共同运动与制度变化的关系，但缺乏对"独立性"条件的明确检验，也缺乏闭合形式的检测边界和完全可复现的验证契约。作者旨在将这种直觉形式化，并在多个自然领域进行严格的、预注册的实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 潜在因子模型（latent factor model），传感器收敛定理（Sensor Convergence Theorem），包含三个范围条件：传感器独立性、持续制度结构、正载荷。此外借鉴临界减速理论（critical slowing down）和系统性风险文献。
AI.method: 形式化定理推导（数值压力测试+符号验证），跨领域实证检验（金融、水文学、太阳物理、经济学、公共卫生、气象），预注册设计，指纹输入数据，机器验证账本（verify.py），块洗牌（block-shuffle）零假设检验，Forbes-Rigobon异方差校正，检测边界（Detection Frontier）闭合形式推导与经验检测强度相关分析。
AI.findings: （1）太阳物理呈现最干净案例：三个物理独立仪器Spearman rho=0.0972（z=2.171显著），而单仪器四重变换（工程化独立性违规）rho=-0.2319不具有信息量；（2）三个经济指标仅rho=0.09（不显著），经济学处于定理边界；（3）市场范围内的同时收敛计数能预测风险资产波动率，但不预测货币或利率；（4）单仪器收敛信号在控制滞后波动率后崩塌（S&P偏相关rho=0.0307）；（5）危机期间股权传感器收敛上升大部分是机械性的，Forbes-Rigobon校正后股权成分变负（-1.4277），原油保留稳健正成分（1.5905）；（6）流感监测四个近冗余传感器违反独立性条件，收敛对流感活动具有反预测性（rho=-0.248）；（7）检测边界难度排名与96种配置的经验检测强度负秩相关（偏Spearman=-0.4743）；（8）导数变换几乎不携带信息（mean rho=0.0162和0.0261），信息存在于水平值。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）明确提出并分别测试了传感器独立性条件；（2）提供了闭合形式的检测边界（Detection Frontier）；（3）形式化传感器收敛定理并给出三种范围条件的边界；（4）与临界减速和系统性风险文献建立联系，同时明确区分多仪器信号与单仪器信号的本质差异。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供了一个完全可复现的验证契约（哈希固定数据、提交脚本、verify.py验证门）；（2）为风险管理提供了市场级收敛计数作为风险资产波动率的先行指标；（3）为公共健康监测提供了"独立性失败"的反面案例，警示传感器设计中的冗余问题；（4）注册了2026-2031年的可证伪前瞻预测，推动科学可复现性实践。

title: The Instruments of Professional Risk Management: From Value at Risk and Expected Shortfall to Monte Carlo Simulation and Performance Attribution

detail.title: The Instruments of Professional Risk Management: From Value at Risk and Expected Shortfall to Monte Carlo Simulation and Performance Attribution
detail.abstract: This paper systematises the quantitative instruments for measuring and managing financial risk that are available to the professionals in charge of wealth management — whether the wealth of private investors is pooled in a dedicated special fund, transferred to a foundation, or steered by a family office. Starting from the distributional foundations — moments, skewness, kurtosis, quantiles — it develops the central risk measures on a formula basis: Value at Risk (VaR) as a loss quantile in parametric form with the Cornish-Fisher correction, the Expected Shortfall (Conditional Value at Risk) as a coherent expectation measure of the exceedance losses (Artzner, Delbaen, Eber, and Heath, 1999; Rockafellar and Uryasev, 2000), the cash flow-oriented quantities Cash-Flow at Risk and Earnings at Risk, the risk score as the product of probability of occurrence and severity, and the Lower Partial Moments as target-return-related downside measures (Bawa, 1975; Fishburn, 1977; Harlow, 1991). Three methods of risk quantification are demonstrated on a running example portfolio of 10 million euros: the parametric calculation, historical simulation with bootstrap confidence intervals (Efron, 1979), and stochastic Monte Carlo simulation (Boyle, 1977). A dedicated chapter quantifies the default risk of an interest rate swap via simulated exposure profiles and the credit valuation adjustment (CVA); another decomposes active returns following Brinson, Hood, and Beebower (1986) and in the factor-based Barra framework (Rosenberg, 1974; Grinold and Kahn, 2000). A further chapter compares the three carrier structures — special fund, foundation, and family office mandate — by benefit, cost, and governance; the total-wealth perspective connects the instruments via target returns, withdrawal plans, and the supervisory reference measures of Basel (Expected Shortfall 97.5 percent) and Solvency II (VaR 99.5 percent) as quality benchmarks for private mandates.

AI.tldr: 本文系统化了财富管理中用于测量和管理金融风险的定量工具，涵盖从分布基础（矩、偏度、峰度、分位数）出发的各类核心风险度量（VaR、CVaR/ES、CFaR、EaR、风险评分、Lower Partial Moments），并通过三种风险量化方法（参数法、历史模拟、蒙特卡洛模拟）在1000万欧元组合中演示，同时涉及利率互换违约风险（CVA）、业绩归因（Brinson及Barra框架），以及三种财富载体结构（专项基金、基金会、家族办公室）的比较，最终以Basel和Solvency II的监管基准作为私人委托的质量参照。
AI.research_question: 如何系统化为财富管理专业人员（私人投资者集合的专项基金、基金会或家族办公室）测量和管理金融风险的定量工具？
AI.motivation: 财富管理领域的风险度量工具分散且缺乏系统性梳理，专业人员在实践中需要一套从分布基础到具体风险指标再到量化方法的完整工具体系，同时需要监管基准作为私人委托的质量参照。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于分布理论基础（矩、偏度、峰度、分位数），核心风险度量包括：VaR（含Cornish-Fisher修正的参数化损失分位数）、Expected Shortfall/CVaR（Artzner et al., 1999; Rockafellar & Uryasev, 2000）、CFaR与EaR（现金流导向）、风险评分（概率×严重性）、Lower Partial Moments（Bawa, 1975; Fishburn, 1977; Harlow, 1991）。业绩归因基于Brinson, Hood & Beebower (1986)和Barra因子框架（Rosenberg, 1974; Grinold & Kahn, 2000）。
AI.method: 三种风险量化方法：参数法计算（含Cornish-Fisher修正）、带bootstrap置信区间的历史模拟（Efron, 1979）、随机蒙特卡洛模拟（Boyle, 1977），在1000万欧元组合上演示。另通过模拟敞口剖面和信用估值调整（CVA）量化利率互换违约风险。
AI.findings: 系统展示了各风险度量在财富管理情境下的公式化实现与实证演示；以Basel（Expected Shortfall 97.5%）和Solvency II（VaR 99.5%）的监管基准作为私人委托质量标杆；比较了专项基金、基金会、家族办公室三种载体在收益、成本与治理方面的差异。
