AI.theory_contributions: 为MSM波动率模型中的贝叶斯滤波提供了基于置换对称性的新理论框架，从理论上证明了利用该对称性可以大幅降低计算复杂度，丰富了贝叶斯滤波在复杂状态空间模型中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一种计算效率显著更高的滤波器实现方案，使MSM模型在高维频率分量设置下变得切实可行，同时在恢复真实波动率状态方面表现更优，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: The Political-Economic Devastation of Sudan's Civil War (2023-2026)
affiliations: Al-Neelain University - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Political-Economic Devastation of Sudan's Civil War (2023-2026)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I am Sudanese and I am a victim and a scholar
declarations.ethicsApproval: There is no conflict of interest
declarations.funderStatement: No Funding

detail.abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of the economic effects of the war in Sudan that erupted on April 15, 2023, examining the historical antecedents, macroeconomic collapse, war economy dynamics, agricultural sector devastation, fiscal instability, humanitarian consequences, and prospects for reconstruction. Drawing on World Bank, UNDP, African Development Bank, and UK government data, the analysis documents how the conflict has precipitated one of the most severe economic contractions in recent history. Real GDP plummeted by nearly 40 percent between 2022 and 2024, wiping out more than three decades of development progress. Average incomes have dropped to levels last seen in 1992, while extreme poverty has surged from 48 percent to 59 percent of the population between 2023 and 2025. The paper examines the collapse of productive sectors-particularly agriculture, which has seen cereal production fall 46 percent in the first year alone-alongside the disintegration of fiscal capacity, inflation peaking at 218 percent in August 2024 , and the erosion of public institutions. Particular attention is paid to the war economy, including the role of illicit gold smuggling estimated at billions of dollars annually, which has become the primary engine financing both belligerent parties. The analysis considers the humanitarian catastrophe affecting 11.7 million displaced persons and over 21 million facing acute food insecurity. The paper concludes by evaluating reconstruction challenges, estimating costs between $500 billion and $1 trillion, and identifying conditions necessary for sustainable recovery, including good governance, institutional reform, and integration of productive sectors.

AI.tldr: 本文全面分析了2023年4月15日爆发的苏丹战争的经济影响，涵盖历史背景、宏观经济崩溃、战争经济动态、农业部门破坏、财政不稳定、人道主义后果及重建前景。研究表明，冲突导致真实GDP在2022至2024年间暴跌近40%，抹去了三十多年的发展成果，极端贫困率从48%上升到59%，重建成本估计在5000亿至1万亿美元之间。
AI.research_question: 2023年苏丹战争对经济造成了怎样的全面影响？包括宏观经济、农业生产、财政能力、战争经济机制以及重建前景等维度。
AI.motivation: 苏丹战争引发了近代历史上最严重的经济收缩之一，但其经济影响的系统性分析仍然缺乏。作者旨在利用世界银行、联合国开发计划署、非洲开发银行和英国政府等多方数据，全面揭示这场冲突的经济破坏程度及重建挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战争经济学框架，涉及宏观经济崩溃理论、战争经济动力学（包括非正规经济与资源掠夺机制）、冲突与贫困关系理论、国家能力瓦解与制度侵蚀分析。
AI.method: 基于多边机构（世界银行、UNDP、非洲开发银行）和英国政府等多来源宏观经济数据的综合文献分析，对GDP、通货膨胀、农业生产、贫困率、人口流离失所等关键指标进行纵向对比和定量描述。
AI.findings: （1）真实GDP在2022-2024年间下跌近40%，平均收入降至1992年水平；（2）极端贫困率从48%升至59%（2023-2025）；（3）农业部门首年谷物产量下降46%；（4）通货膨胀在2024年8月达到218%峰值；（5）非法黄金走私每年数十亿美元，成为交战双方主要资金来源；（6）1170万流离失所者，超过2100万人面临严重粮食不安全；（7）重建成本估计在5000亿至1万亿美元之间。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了战争经济学理论，特别是关于现代内战如何通过非正规经济（如黄金走私）自我融资的机制分析；揭示了冲突在较短时间内造成发展的全面倒退（三十多年成果被抹去）这一独特现象，为理解冲突的经济毁灭性提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际社会、政策制定者和重建规划者提供了关于苏丹重建成本（5000亿至1万亿美元）的量化估计，并指出了可持续复苏的必要条件，包括善治、制度改革和生产部门整合，为战后重建政策设计提供了实证基础。

title: When Economic Agents Learn: AI-Driven Heterogeneous Agents, Market Dynamics, and Equilibrium Stability

detail.title: When Economic Agents Learn: AI-Driven Heterogeneous Agents, Market Dynamics, and Equilibrium Stability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.

detail.abstract: Dynamic economics-encompassing evolutionary game theory, real business cycle theory, agent-based computational economics, and adaptive learning-has long studied economies as systems evolving over time. What has limited the scope of this tradition is the computational and modeling cost of populating such systems with cognitively sophisticated, heterogeneous, adaptive agents. We argue that large language models (LLMs) reduce this cost substantially, enabling a new class of experiments in which AI agents with distinct learning mechanisms interact in explicitly modeled markets. We construct an artificial asset market populated by three agent types-rational (model-consistent), Q-learning (reinforcement-based), and LLM (natural-language reasoning)-and study how the composition of learning mechanisms shapes market dynamics, equilibrium stability, and the emergence of bubbles. We embed the market in a nonlinear dynamical systems framework, deriving conditions for local stability of the fundamental-price equilibrium and showing that variations in the learning-rate parameter can induce a period-doubling route to chaos. Simulations reveal that LLM-agent markets exhibit larger price deviations, higher volatility, and more frequent bubble-crash episodes than both rational and Q-learning markets, while mixed populations display non-monotonic effects: a small share of LLM agents can destabilize an otherwise stable market. A path-dependence experiment shows that identical fundamentals can produce divergent long-run outcomes-convergence to fundamentals, sustained oscillations, or systemic collapse-depending on the initial perturbation and agent learning composition. We conclude that AI does not "introduce dynamics" to economics, but rather extends the frontier of what kinds of dynamic economic systems are tractable to study.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大语言模型（LLM）显著降低了在动态经济学系统中引入认知复杂、异质性自适应智能体的计算成本，构建了一个包含理性、Q-learning和LLM三类智能体的人工资产市场，研究学习机制构成对市场动态、均衡稳定性及泡沫涌现的影响，发现LLM智能体市场表现出更大的价格偏差和更高的波动性，且混合群体具有非单调效应。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型智能体是否能降低在动态经济系统中建模认知复杂、异质性自适应智能体的成本，以及不同学习机制（理性、Q-learning、LLM）的构成如何影响市场动态、均衡稳定性和泡沫的涌现？
AI.motivation: 动态经济学传统（包括演化博弈论、真实商业周期理论、基于主体的计算经济学和适应性学习）长期研究系统随时间演化的经济，但其研究范围受限于在系统中填充认知复杂、异质性自适应智能体的计算和建模成本。大语言模型有望大幅降低这一成本，从而开辟新的实验类别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 演化博弈论、真实商业周期理论、基于主体的计算经济学、适应性学习理论、非线性动态系统理论（局部稳定性分析、倍周期分岔通向混沌）。
AI.method: 构建人工资产市场，包含三类智能体（理性/模型一致型、Q-learning/强化学习型、LLM/自然语言推理型），将市场嵌入非线性动态系统框架，推导基本价格均衡的局部稳定性条件，并通过仿真实验分析不同学习机制构成下的市场表现，同时进行路径依赖实验。
AI.findings: （1）LLM智能体市场比理性和Q-learning市场表现出更大的价格偏差、更高的波动性和更频繁的泡沫-崩盘事件；（2）混合人群存在非单调效应：少量LLM智能体足以使原本稳定的市场不稳定；（3）路径依赖实验表明，相同的基本面可因初始扰动和智能体学习构成不同而产生不同的长期结果——收敛于基本面、持续振荡或系统性崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 将大语言模型引入动态经济系统研究，扩展了动态经济学的可研究前沿，证明AI并未"引入"动态性到经济学中，而是拓展了何种动态经济系统是可处理的；深化了对学习机制异质性如何影响市场稳定性与混沌行为的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为利用AI智能体构建可计算、可实验的经济系统提供了新范式，对市场稳定监管、泡沫预警以及政策设计具有潜在应用价值，同时证明了少量LLM智能体即可对市场稳定性产生显著影响这一重要的实践启示。

title: The Price Impact of Hedging Expiring Index Options
affiliations: Instituto Tecnológico Autónomo de México (ITAM), Instituto Tecnológico Autónomo de México (ITAM) - Department of Business Administration, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign - Department of Finance and Wilfrid Laurier University

detail.title: The Price Impact of Hedging Expiring Index Options
detail.abstract: A previously unrecognized channel through which index options trading impacts the underlying market is that delta hedges of expiring cash-settled index options are unwound at expiration. This contrasts with physically-settled options, where the delta hedge positions in the underlier are used to settle the options position. We use proprietary data to determine market maker positions in expiring S&P 500 index options, and show that hedge unwinding trades have important impacts on index futures returns and volatility during the 30 minutes before options expiration. We also study the impact of options market maker hedge rebalancing trades on market volatility.

AI.tldr: 本文发现了一个此前未被识别的渠道：现金结算的到期指数期权中，做市商的delta对冲头寸在到期时被平仓（与实物结算期权不同），这种对冲平仓交易在期权到期前30分钟对指数期货收益和波动率产生显著影响。
AI.research_question: 到期现金结算指数期权的delta对冲平仓交易如何影响标的市场的期货收益和波动率？
AI.motivation: 已有研究主要关注指数期权交易对标的市场的整体影响，但未能识别到期日对冲平仓这一特定渠道。与实物结算期权不同，现金结算期权的对冲头寸需要在到期时平仓，这可能对市场产生独特影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期权做市商delta对冲理论；现金结算与实物结算期权的结算机制差异分析
AI.method: 使用专有数据确定做市商在到期S&P 500指数期权中的持仓头寸，分析对冲平仓交易对指数期货收益和波动率的影响，并研究期权做市商对冲再平衡交易对市场波动率的影响。
AI.findings: 对冲平仓交易在期权到期前30分钟对指数期货收益和波动率产生重要影响；期权做市商的对冲再平衡交易也会影响市场波动率。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别了现金结算期权到期时对冲平仓这一此前被忽视的传导渠道，补充了期权交易影响标的市场的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者理解期权到期前后市场波动提供参考；为监管机构了解期权做市商对冲行为对市场稳定性的影响提供依据。

publicationDetails.detailsText: Rishabh Mehta, Automated Decision Making Through AI—An End to the Quintessential Discretion?, in Architectures of Autonomy: Balancing Federalism, Pluralism, and Rights in the Digital State 209, 209–26 (Anil R. Nair ed., National University of Advanced Legal Studies 2026).

detail.abstract: This paper explores how Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping administrative decision-making, raising concerns about the erosion of discretion—a cornerstone of administrative law in common law systems. Discretion has historically ensured fairness, flexibility, and accountability where rigid rules fall short. As governments adopt AI to enhance efficiency and consistency, the paper critiques the risks of diminishing human judgment, including opacity in algorithmic logic, reduced procedural fairness, and weakened accountability. Drawing on Indian developments such as the Faceless Assessment Scheme under the Income Tax Act and voter roll deduplication by the Election Commission, these issues are examined against constitutional jurisprudence affirming reasoned and transparent decisions (e.g., S.N. Mukherjee v. Union of India; Madhyamam Broadcasting Ltd. v. Union of India). Comparative insights from Australia highlight tensions between automated systems and traditional doctrines. The paper advocates a balanced approach—AI should assist, not replace, human discretion—through explainable systems, subject-specific responsiveness, and embedded oversight. Ultimately, while AI promises transformative gains, its integration must preserve discretion to uphold the rule of law and protect individual rights.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人工智能如何重塑行政决策，批评了AI侵蚀行政裁量权的风险（算法不透明、程序公正削弱、问责弱化），结合印度税收无面评估计划、选举委员会选民名单去重等案例及宪法判例，并借鉴澳大利亚比较视角，主张AI应辅助而非替代人类裁量权，通过可解释系统、领域定制响应和嵌入监督来实现平衡，以维护法治和个体权利。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何重塑行政决策，以及如何在AI应用中保留行政裁量权以维护法治原则？
AI.motivation: 各国政府日益采用AI以提升效率和一致性，但可能侵蚀行政法中裁量权这一基石，引发对透明度、程序公正和问责制的担忧，亟需批判性审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政法中的裁量权理论（公平、灵活性和问责性）；宪法判例法学（S.N. Mukherjee案与Madhyamam Broadcasting案确立的合理决策与透明决策原则）。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析与案例研究，结合印度行政实践（无面评估计划、选民名单去重）与澳大利亚的比较法分析。
AI.findings: AI在行政决策中的无节制整合会侵蚀裁量权，导致算法不透明、程序公正削弱和问责弱化；通过可解释系统、领域特定响应和嵌入式监督，AI可以辅助而非替代人类裁量权。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI治理问题置于行政法裁量权理论框架内，阐明AI整合与宪法正当程序原则之间的张力，丰富了数字行政法理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和行政机构提供AI整合的平衡路径建议，包括可解释AI系统设计、监督机制嵌入及保留人类判断的实操框架。

title: Tax Relief Made Visible: The STAR Conversion and Anticipatory Fiscal Restraint in New York School Districts

detail.title: Tax Relief Made Visible: The STAR Conversion and Anticipatory Fiscal Restraint in New York School Districts

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declared no potential conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no financial support for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: Does it matter how a property tax benefit is delivered, apart from its dollar value? This paper exploits New York State's 2016 conversion of the School Tax Relief (STAR) program from an assessed-value exemption to a refundable credit, a change that required new recipients to pay the gross school tax bill and receive relief separately, while leaving the intended net benefit broadly unchanged, to ask whether local governments respond when constituents become more aware of the tax they pay. A continuous difference-indifferences design applied to a balanced panel of 662 school districts from 2013 through 2019 shows that more-exposed districts reduced proposed per-pupil spending by roughly one-half to one percent and proposed per-pupil levies by approximately seven-tenths of one percent per standard deviation of baseline STAR exposure. Budget vote outcomes were undisturbed. The pattern is interpreted as anticipatory restraint by school boards acting as agenda setters under a binding property tax cap.

AI.tldr: 本文利用纽约州2016年将STAR房产税福利从评估价值豁免转为可退还税收抵免的政策转换（该变化使新受益者需先缴纳全额学校税再单独获得退税，但净收益基本不变），研究当纳税人更清楚自己缴纳的税款时，地方政府是否会做出回应。通过连续双重差分设计分析2013-2019年662个学区的平衡面板数据，发现暴露程度更高的学区每增加一个标准差的基础STAR暴露，拟议生均支出下降约0.5%-1%，拟议生均税负下降约0.7%。预算投票结果未受影响，该模式被解释为学校董事会在具有约束力的房产税上限约束下作为议程制定者采取的预期性克制行为。
AI.research_question: 房产税福利的交付方式（除美元价值外）是否重要？当纳税人对其所缴税款更加知情时，地方政府（学区）是否会做出财政行为上的回应？
AI.motivation: 探究税收福利的"显性化"（从隐形豁免转为显性退税）如何影响纳税人对税收的感知，进而影响地方政府财政决策，为财政幻觉理论提供实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政幻觉理论（纳税人低估隐性税收成本）、税收显著性与行为公共财政、议程设定者理论（学校董事会作为议程制定者）、房产税上限约束下的财政约束理论。
AI.method: 利用纽约州2016年STAR项目政策转换作为准自然实验，采用连续双重差分（continuous difference-in-differences）设计，使用2013-2019年662个学区的平衡面板数据进行因果推断。
AI.findings: （1）STAR暴露程度每增加一个标准差，学区拟议生均支出下降约0.5%-1%；（2）拟议生均税负下降约0.7%；（3）预算投票结果未受政策转换的显著影响；（4）该行为模式被解释为学校董事会在房产税上限约束下的预期性财政克制。
AI.theory_contributions: 为财政幻觉和税收显著性理论提供了因果证据，表明税收福利的交付形式（隐性豁免vs显性抵免）会影响纳税人的税收感知，进而影响地方政府的财政决策行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于税收福利设计的重要启示：即使净福利金额不变，福利的交付方式也会通过影响纳税人的税收认知来改变地方政府行为，这对税收政策设计和财政透明度的政策实践具有参考价值。

title: KX-Net: A Kernel-Aware Cross-Attention Network for Multi-Scale Medical Image Segmentation
affiliations: University of Shanghai for Science and Technology, University of Shanghai for Science and Technology, University of Shanghai for Science and Technology, University of Shanghai for Science and Technology, University of Shanghai for Science and Technology and University of Shanghai for Science and Technology

detail.title: KX-Net: A Kernel-Aware Cross-Attention Network for Multi-Scale Medical Image Segmentation
detail.abstract: ​AbstractBackground and Objective: Accurate medical image segmentation is a prerequisite for intelligent computer-aided diagnostic systems, yet it remains challenging due to low contrast, ambiguous boundaries, and large variations in anatomical scale. Convolutional neural networks extract local features effectively but struggle to model long-range contextual dependencies, whereas vision transformers capture global context but tend to lose fine-grained spatial details. To overcome these complementary limitations, we propose KX-Net, a kernel-aware cross-attention network designed for multi-scale medical image segmentation.Methods: KX-Net integrates three complementary components: (1) a Halo block that couples halo-shaped directional convolution with lightweight cross-channel attention, preserving boundary-sensitive local details and modeling global correlations; (2) a Cross-Scale Mix module that enhances inter-scale interaction through spatial perturbation and gated hybridization; and (3) a tri-fusion decoder that refines structural boundaries via residual-difference cues. Experiments and ablation studies were carried out on four public benchmarks to evaluate model performance.Results: KX-Net achieved Dice scores of 0.9138, 0.8969, 0.9324, and 0.8425 on skin lesion (ISIC2018), optic disc/cup (REFUGE), cell nuclei (2018DSB), and breast ultrasound (BUSI) segmentation, respectively. The corresponding sensitivity and specificity values were 0.9168/0.9539, 0.9153/0.9994, 0.9347/0.9878, and 0.8485/0.9875. KX-Net used only 2.833 million parameters and 12.168 billion floating-point operations, demonstrating a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Ablation studies showed complementary gains from the three proposed components.Conclusions: These results indicate that KX-Net provides an effective and computationally efficient segmentation framework across diverse medical imaging modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KX-Net，一种核感知交叉注意力网络，通过融合Halo块（定向卷积+轻量级通道注意力）、跨尺度混合模块和三分支融合解码器，在四个公开医学图像分割基准上取得优异性能（Dice分数0.8425-0.9324），仅需283万参数和121.68亿浮点运算，实现了准确性与效率的良好平衡。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种既能有效建模长距离上下文依赖又能保留精细空间细节的医学图像分割网络，以应对低对比度、模糊边界和器官尺度差异大的挑战？
AI.motivation: 卷积神经网络擅长提取局部特征但难以建模长距离上下文依赖，而视觉Transformer虽能捕获全局上下文却容易丢失细粒度空间细节。现有方法难以同时兼顾两者优势，需要一种新的网络架构来克服互补性局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于卷积神经网络与视觉Transformer的互补优势整合理论，结合核感知（kernel-aware）注意力机制、跨尺度特征交互和残差差异融合的理论框架。
AI.method: 提出KX-Net网络架构，包含三个互补组件：(1) Halo块——耦合Halo形定向卷积与轻量级跨通道注意力，保留边界敏感局部细节并建模全局相关性；(2) 跨尺度混合模块——通过空间扰动和门控混合增强跨尺度交互；(3) 三分支融合解码器——利用残差差异线索细化结构边界。在四个公开基准数据集上进行实验和消融研究。
AI.findings: KX-Net在皮肤病变（ISIC2018）、视盘/视杯（REFUGE）、细胞核（2018DSB）和乳腺超声（BUSI）分割上分别取得0.9138、0.8969、0.9324和0.8425的Dice分数，灵敏度/特异度分别为0.9168/0.9539、0.9153/0.9994、0.9347/0.9878和0.8485/0.9875。模型仅需283万参数和121.68亿浮点运算，消融实验证实三个组件具有互补增益。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了将局部卷积细节保留与全局注意力建模有机融合的可行性，提出了核感知交叉注意力机制这一新的架构设计范式，并验证了跨尺度空间扰动与门控混合在增强多尺度交互中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多种医学影像模态（皮肤镜、眼底、显微、超声）提供了统一的高效分割框架；其低参数和低计算量特性使其适用于计算资源受限的临床部署场景，有望推动智能计算机辅助诊断系统的实用化。

title: Impact of Missing MRI Sequences on Deep-Learning Glioma Survival Prediction: A Systematic Modality Sensitivity Analysis with External Validation
affiliations: Fuyang Normal University, Fuyang Normal University, Dalian Minzu University, Anhui University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Impact of Missing MRI Sequences on Deep-Learning Glioma Survival Prediction: A Systematic Modality Sensitivity Analysis with External Validation

keywords: external validationIf CMPB enforces a 5-keyword limit

detail.abstract: Accurate preoperative survival prediction for glioma supports treatment planning and risk stratification, and multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is its imaging foundation. Real-world acquisitions are frequently incomplete, yet most MRI-based survival models assume that all sequences are available at inference, and the prognostic consequence of an individual sequence being absent has rarely been quantified.We trained a 3D convolutional neural network with a Cox survival head on the BraTS-TCGA cohort (163 patients) using five-fold cross-validation and training-time modality dropout. A systematic modality sensitivity analysis was performed at inference across seven missing-sequence scenarios, with patient-level bootstrap testing. External validation used the independent UCSF-PDGM cohort (494 patients) via ensemble prediction.The model reached an internal five-fold cross-validation C-index of 0.72. The sensitivity analysis identified contrast-enhanced T1-weighted imaging (T1CE) as the most critical sequence: its removal lowered the C-index from 0.72 to 0.62, and retaining only FLAIR gave the lowest performance, differences confirmed by bootstrap testing. Training-time modality dropout did not yield a statistically significant robustness gain. On the external UCSF-PDGM cohort, the ensemble C-index was 0.61. A clinical baseline using age and tumor grade outperformed the imaging model on both cohorts (internal C-index approximately 0.78 vs. 0.72; external approximately 0.72 vs. 0.61), and adding imaging features provided no improvement.This study quantifies how individual MRI sequence absence affects survival prediction and finds that T1CE is the most influential sequence on internal evaluation, an effect that awaits external confirmation.

AI.tldr: 本研究训练了一个带Cox生存头的3D卷积神经网络，在BraTS-TCGA队列上通过训练时模态丢弃和五折交叉验证进行胶质瘤术前生存预测，并在UCSF-PDGM外部队列上验证。研究发现T1CE序列是最关键序列，其缺失将C指数从0.72降至0.62；但临床基线（年龄和肿瘤分级）在两个队列上均优于影像模型，且加入影像特征无额外提升。
AI.research_question: 多参数MRI中单个序列缺失如何影响胶质瘤术前生存预测的预后准确性？
AI.motivation: 真实世界的MRI采集常常不完整，但大多数基于MRI的生存预测模型假设推理时可获得所有序列，单个序列缺失的预后后果很少被量化。
AI.theoretical_framework: Cox生存分析、3D卷积神经网络、模态丢弃（modality dropout）训练策略、集成预测。
AI.method: 在BraTS-TCGA队列（163例患者）上使用五折交叉验证和训练时模态丢弃训练3D CNN加Cox生存头；在推理时系统分析七种缺失序列场景，采用患者级bootstrap检验；在UCSF-PDGM外部队列（494例）通过集成预测进行验证。
AI.findings: 模型内部五折交叉验证C指数为0.72；T1CE是最关键序列，移除后C指数从0.72降至0.62，仅保留FLAIR性能最低；训练时模态丢弃未带来显著鲁棒性增益；外部队列集成C指数为0.61；临床基线（年龄和肿瘤分级）在两个队列上均优于影像模型（内部约0.78 vs 0.72；外部约0.72 vs 0.61），加入影像特征无改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化了单个MRI序列缺失对胶质瘤生存预测的影响，识别出T1CE是最具影响力的序列，并检验了训练时模态丢弃策略的鲁棒性增益效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床实践中MRI序列缺失情况下的生存预测模型应用提供了重要参考，提示T1CE序列的缺失会显著降低预测性能，并指出了影像模型相对于简单临床基线的局限性。

title: Joint Modelling of Survival Data and Longitudinal Features Using Autoencoder Neural Networks
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Joint Modelling of Survival Data and Longitudinal Features Using Autoencoder Neural Networks
detail.abstract: Background and Objective: In recent years, the application of deep learning methods in survival analysis has led to significant advances. In this study, we propose a novel modelling framework for incorporating multiple longitudinal markers into the model building process to enhance predictive performance and to cope with some barriers such as computational cost in classical approaches.Methods: To extract essential features from multiple longitudinal outputs, we use a long short-term memory (LSTM)-based autoencoder neural network. To handle missing values and irregular repeated measurements, a masked loss function is employed during optimization. The derived time-invariant predictors are subsequently used in a Cox proportional hazards model. Predictive performance is assessed using the concordance index and the likelihood ratio test.Results: The proposed method yields a concordance index of 0.93, demonstrating strong discriminative capacity for identifying high-risk patients. Furthermore, the likelihood ratio test produces a statistic of 472.69 with 16 degrees of freedom, confirming statistical significance.Conclusions: The findings confirm that deep learning tools can effectively enhance predictive performance in longitudinal and survival studies while addressing the challenges faced by classical models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于LSTM自编码器的新型建模框架，将多个纵向标记整合到Cox比例风险模型中用于生存分析预测。该方法通过掩码损失函数处理缺失值和不规则重复测量，所得模型的C指数达0.93，似然比检验统计量为472.69（自由度16），显著提升了预测性能。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个新型建模框架，将多个纵向标记有效整合到生存分析模型中，以提升预测性能并解决经典方法面临的计算成本和数据处理障碍？
AI.motivation: 传统生存分析方法在处理多个纵向标记时面临计算成本高、难以处理缺失值和不规则重复测量等障碍。深度学习方法的快速发展为此提供了新机遇，需要探索如何将深度学习工具与生存分析有效结合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习；长短期记忆（LSTM）网络；自编码器；Cox比例风险模型；生存分析
AI.method: 该研究采用LSTM-based自编码器神经网络从多个纵向输出中提取关键特征（时间不变预测因子），在优化过程中使用掩码损失函数处理缺失值和不规则重复测量，随后将提取的预测因子用于Cox比例风险模型。性能评估采用一致性指数（concordance index）和似然比检验。
AI.findings: 所提出方法的C指数达到0.93，展示出对高风险患者识别的强判别能力；似然比检验统计量为472.69（自由度16），结果具有统计显著性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将LSTM自编码器与Cox模型相结合的创新框架，有效解决了经典模型在整合多个纵向标记时的计算成本和数据处理难题，扩展了深度学习在生存分析领域的理论应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可行且高效的纵向-生存数据建模方案，能够处理临床实际中常见的缺失值和不规则测量问题，有助于识别高风险患者，支持临床决策和预后管理。

title: Triple Embedding Enhanced Graph Convolutional Network for Colorectal Polyp Classification
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Triple Embedding Enhanced Graph Convolutional Network for Colorectal Polyp Classification
detail.abstract: Accurate medical image classification is important for early disease diagnosis and for supporting clinical decision-making. However, conventional deep learning methods may struggle to capture multi-scale contextual information and model complex non-Euclidean relationships.,In this study, we propose a hybrid HOG–AE–TE–GCN framework for colonoscopy image classification. The proposed framework employs Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) for local feature extraction, a ReLU-based Autoencoder (AE) for hierarchical feature learning, a Triple Embedding (TE) module for contextual feature representation, and a Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) for modeling structural relationships in non-Euclidean feature spaces.,By combining handcrafted features, deep representations, embedding-based feature learning, and graph-based modeling, the proposed framework aims to improve feature representation and classification performance. Experiments were conducted on the Kvasir-SEG and PolypsSet datasets. In addition, an ablation study was performed by comparing the proposed framework with and without the TE module to investigate its contribution to classification performance.,The results indicate that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance across multiple evaluation metrics, including Precision, Recall, F1-score, Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC), and AUC. Overall, the HOG–AE–TE–GCN framework provides a potential approach for colonoscopy image classification and may support further research in medical image analysis and clinical decision-support applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合HOG-AE-TE-GCN框架用于结肠镜图像分类，通过结合手工特征（HOG）、深度特征（自编码器）、嵌入特征（三重嵌入模块）和图卷积网络（GCN）来捕捉多尺度上下文信息和非欧几里得空间中的结构关系，在Kvasir-SEG和PolypsSet数据集上取得了有竞争力的分类性能。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种混合框架，将手工特征、深度学习特征和图结构建模相结合，以提高结肠镜图像分类的准确性？
AI.motivation: 传统深度学习方法难以捕获多尺度上下文信息，并且无法有效建模复杂的非欧几里得关系，这限制了医学图像分类的性能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 包括手工特征提取（HOG）、自编码器（AE）的层次特征学习、三重嵌入（TE）模块的上下文特征表示以及图卷积网络（GCN）的非欧几里得结构建模。
AI.method: 构建HOG-AE-TE-GCN四模块混合框架：HOG提取局部特征，ReLU自编码器进行层次特征学习，三重嵌入模块进行上下文特征表示，GCN建模特征间的结构关系。在Kvasir-SEG和PolypsSet数据集上进行实验，并通过消融研究（有无TE模块）验证各组件的贡献。
AI.findings: 该框架在Precision、Recall、F1-score、MCC和AUC等多个评价指标上均取得了有竞争力的分类性能，消融研究验证了TE模块对分类性能的贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将手工特征、深度特征、嵌入学习和图结构建模四种范式整合于一体的混合框架，为医学图像分类中的特征表示提供了新的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为结肠镜图像分类提供了有效的解决方案，有望支持医学图像分析和临床决策辅助应用，帮助早期疾病诊断。

title: Sufficiency without a Likelihood in Population Genetics
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Sufficiency without a Likelihood in Population Genetics
detail.abstract: Approximate Bayesian Computation was invented in population genetics because coalescent likelihoods are intractable, and it has carried two acknowledged defects ever since: the analyst must choose summary statistics, so that the object computed is π(θ | S(y)) rather than π(θ | y), and the analyst must choose a tolerance, which trades bias against acceptance rate. We propose replacing the whole apparatus with a learned transport map. By the noise outsourcing lemma the posterior is a deterministic function of the data and an independent uniform, and that function is the population minimiser of an expected check loss, so it can be fitted by regression on simulated parameter and data pairs. There is no summary statistic and no tolerance. Our main theoretical contribution is Theorem 4, which shows that if a permutation invariant architecture with a d-dimensional bottleneck attains the Bayes risk of the check loss at almost every quantile level, then the bottleneck is a sufficient statistic. This turns sufficiency into something that can be tested by fitting, and it makes the infinite alleles model, where Ewens (1972) proved that K n is sufficient, the natural validation problem. Empirically the method rediscovers that theorem: a one-dimensional bottleneck matches an eight-dimensional one to within Monte Carlo error and its learned scalar has Spearman correlation 0.998 with K n , while a plausible but non-sufficient summary is 62% worse. We then apply the same procedure to the infinite sites model and prove that Watterson's S is not sufficient there. The learned posterior using the whole site frequency spectrum is 21% narrower than the exact posterior given S. On efficiency, rejection ABC at zero tolerance accepts 1.04% of proposals, so 2 × 10 5 simulations buy 2073 draws for one dataset, whereas the generative fit is trained once on 3 × 10 4 simulations and costs nothing per additional dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用学习传输映射（learned transport map）替代近似贝叶斯计算（ABC）中的概要统计量和容差，从而避免ABC的两大缺陷。通过噪声外包引理将后验表示为数据和独立均匀变量的确定性函数，并用回归拟合。理论上证明了若具有d维瓶颈的置换不变架构在几乎每个分位数水平达到check loss的贝叶斯风险，则该瓶颈是充分统计量。
AI.research_question: 如何消除ABC方法中需要选择概要统计量和容差这两个固有缺陷？
AI.motivation: ABC自群体遗传学发明以来，始终存在两个缺陷：必须选择概要统计量（导致计算的是π(θ|S(y))而非π(θ|y)），以及必须选择容差（在偏差和接受率之间权衡）。这些人为选择可能影响推断结果的准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 噪声外包引理（noise outsourcing lemma）、check loss回归、置换不变架构、充分统计量理论（Ewens 1972无限等位基因模型）
AI.method: 通过噪声外包引理，将后验表示为数据和独立均匀变量的确定性函数，该函数是预期check loss的总体最小化者，因此可以通过对模拟的参数和数据对进行回归来拟合。无需概要统计量和容差。
AI.findings: 1) 在无限等位基因模型中，一维瓶颈与八维瓶颈在蒙特卡罗误差范围内匹配，学习到的标量与K_n的Spearman相关系数为0.998；2) 非充分概要统计量效果差62%；3) 在无限位点模型中证明Watterson's S不充分，使用全位点频率谱学习的后验比给定S的精确后验窄21%；4) 效率上，零容差拒绝ABC接受率为1.04%，而生成式拟合训练一次后每个额外数据集零成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) Theorem 4首次将充分性转化为可通过拟合检验的性质；2) 为无限等位基因模型和无限位点模型的充分性理论提供了新验证和反驳；3) 将传输映射与贝叶斯充分性理论建立联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了无需选择概要统计量和容差的贝叶斯推断新方法，在计算效率上大幅优于传统ABC（训练一次后每个额外数据集零成本），适用于群体遗传学等似然难以处理的领域。

title: The Touch Carries No Direction: A Pre-Registered Null on Order-Flow Imbalance and Queue Depletion in Index Futures Josy

detail.title: The Touch Carries No Direction: A Pre-Registered Null on Order-Flow Imbalance and Queue Depletion in Index Futures Josy
detail.abstract: Two order-book features widely believed to carry short-horizon directional informationaggressor imbalance at the touch (OFI) and trade-driven queue depletion (DEPL)-are tested against a symmetric ±3-tick first-passage barrier on 45,700 races drawn from 20 regular-hours sessions of NQ index futures. Both hypotheses, the barrier geometry, the cost line, and the falsification criterion were declared before the test was run. Neither feature departs measurably from the unconditional base rate: OFI resolves up-first in 49.91% of races and DEPL in 50.20%, against an unconditional 49.71% and a breakeven requirement of 63.00% at the measured passive cost line. Two robustness questions an earlier draft only conceded are answered here by computation. The threshold rests on a simulated passive fill, so the cost line is swept to zero: at free execution the required rate is 50.00 percent and the better arm's interval of [49.74, 50.66] contains it, so the null does not depend on the fill model anywhere in its range. Races overlap heavily, initiated every 10 seconds and abandoned after 300, giving an analytic design effect as high as 20; that raises the standard error from 0.234 to 1.046 percentage points and reduces the gap from 56 standard errors to 12.5, and to 10.2 at a deliberately pessimistic 30. The conclusion is therefore a range bounded below by ten standard errors rather than a single figure assuming independent races. This is not an inconclusive test. A symmetric-barrier first-passage statistic returns 0.50 by construction in the absence of conditional drift, so 0.50 is the value the null predicts, and it is the value observed to within half a percentage point. A separate execution measurement drawn from the same corpus does survive and is reported here, because it changes which question the test was able to ask: a prior internal estimate of passive mark-out was wrong by a factor of twenty, and had rendered the breakeven requirement arithmetically unreachable.

AI.tldr: 本文基于20个NQ股指期货常规交易时段的45,700次"竞速"实验，对订单簿中两个被广泛认为承载短期方向性信息的特征——触价处激进度失衡（OFI）和交易驱动的队列消耗（DEPL）——进行了事前注册的对称±3跳首达障碍检验。结果显示两个特征的命中率（49.91%和50.20%）均未显著偏离无条件基准率（49.71%），远低于盈亏平衡所需的63.00%。作者通过计算回答了此前草稿中遗留的两个稳健性问题：将成本线扫至零时，免费执行所需命中率为50.00%，且较优策略的置信区间[49.74, 50.66]包含该值；考虑种族重叠的设计效应后，标准误从0.234个百分点升至1.046个百分点，差距从56个标准误降至12.5（悲观情形下为10.2）。结论是一个下限至少为10个标准误的区间，而非假设独立竞速的单一数字。此外，作者报告了一个在同一语料中幸存的独立执行度量：此前被动标记出错的内部估计偏差达20倍，使盈亏平衡要求算术上不可达。
AI.research_question: 订单簿特征OFI（触价处激进度失衡）和DEPL（交易驱动的队列消耗）是否真的携带短期方向性信息，能否在扣除被动执行成本后产生统计显著的预测能力？
AI.motivation: OFI和DEPL被学术界和业界广泛认为能预测短期价格方向，但缺乏事前注册、在真实执行成本框架下的大规模严格检验。作者旨在用预先声明的检验协议来验证这两个假说是否成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对称首达障碍统计量（symmetric-barrier first-passage statistic）：在无条件漂移下，该统计量构造性地返回0.50，因此0.50是零假设的预测值；被动执行成本线框架用于确定盈亏平衡所需命中率。
AI.method: 在20个NQ股指期货常规时段中提取45,700次±3跳对称首达障碍"竞速"，采用事前注册的检验协议（含障碍几何、成本线和证伪标准）。对成本线进行从测量值到零的敏感性扫描；利用设计效应（design effect）校正竞速间的重叠性（每10秒启动一次，300秒后放弃），计算非独立情形下的稳健标准误。
AI.findings: （1）OFI与DEPL的命中率分别为49.91%和50.20%，与无条件基准49.71%无实质差异，远低于测量被动成本线下63.00%的盈亏平衡要求；（2）成本线扫至零时，免费执行下所需命中率为50.00%，较优策略的区间[49.74, 50.66]包含该值，即零假设不依赖填充模型；（3）考虑重叠后的设计效应最高达20，标准误从0.234升至1.046个百分点，检验差距从56个标准误降至12.5（悲观情形10.2）——结论仍远高于传统显著性门槛；（4）同一语料中一个独立的执行度量幸存：此前被动标记的内部估计偏差达20倍。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）通过事前注册的对称障碍首达检验框架，为订单簿微观结构文献提供了严格的假说检验范式；（2）明确展示了在考虑竞速重叠（设计效应）后，显著性结论的稳健性边界，说明了检验结论应在区间维度而非单点维度上报告；（3）将被动执行成本显式纳入盈亏平衡推导，修正了此前内部估计中20倍的标记错误，表明成本模型的选择可以彻底改变假说检验的可行性结论。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）对量化交易者而言，OFI和DEPL在扣除被动执行成本后不具备可利用的短期方向预测能力，不应作为独立alpha信号；（2）被动执行成本模型的准确性对信号可行性评估至关重要，此前偏差达20倍的估计会错误地使盈亏平衡要求"算术上不可达"；（3）提供了考虑竞速重叠时的标准误计算方法，对未来同类实证检验的实验设计有直接指导意义。

title: E-MAS: An Efficient Multi-Scale Attention System for Dermoscopic Image-Based Skin Cancer Classification
affiliations: Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou University, China-US (Henan) Hormel Cancer Institute, Zhengzhou University and Zhengzhou University - Department of Molecular Pathology

detail.title: E-MAS: An Efficient Multi-Scale Attention System for Dermoscopic Image-Based Skin Cancer Classification
detail.abstract: Skin cancer remains a major clinical challenge due to the need for precise differentiation among visually similar lesion types, particularly when datasets are imbalanced, and lesion morphology varies significantly. Existing studies highlight persistent limitations in capturing multi-scale information and ensuring reliable generalization across diverse imaging conditions. This research addresses these issues by introducing E-MAS, an Efficient Multi-Scale Attention System that integrates MobileNetV2 and EfficientNet-B0 within a lightweight ensemble, supported by ASPP and SE attention mechanisms to enhance the model’s focus on clinically relevant features. To improve robustness against class imbalance, multiple stratified training strategies and cross-dataset evaluations are employed, enabling consistent learning across heterogeneous lesion categories. Furthermore, the proposed E-MAS framework is designed to be more transparent by leveraging attention mechanisms that highlight salient image regions, thereby improving interpretability and diagnostic confidence. Extensive experiments conducted on the HAM10000, PH2, and combined dermoscopic datasets demonstrate substantial improvements over existing baseline models. On HAM10000, E-MAS achieved 98.73% accuracy and 98.21% AUC, outperforming MobileNetV2 and EfficientNet-B0. Similarly, the model achieved 97.78% accuracy and 99.01% AUC on the PH2 dataset, and 98.20% accuracy with a 99.00% AUC on the combined dataset, reflecting strong generalization capabilities. These findings underscore the effectiveness of E-MAS in enhancing skin lesion classification and addressing critical gaps in current diagnostic systems, offering a reliable and computationally efficient solution for clinical and tele-dermatology applications

AI.tldr: 本文提出了E-MAS（高效多尺度注意力系统），一种结合MobileNetV2和EfficientNet-B0的轻量级集成模型，配备ASPP和SE注意力机制，用于皮肤病变分类。在HAM10000、PH2及组合数据集上分别达到98.73%/98.21%、97.78%/99.01%和98.20%/99.00%的准确率/AUC，显著优于基线模型，同时具备良好的可解释性和泛化能力。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种轻量级且高精度的皮肤病变分类模型，以解决视觉相似的皮肤病变类型难以区分、数据集类别不平衡以及跨数据集泛化能力不足的问题？
AI.motivation: 皮肤癌诊断面临病变类型视觉相似、数据集不平衡和形态差异大的临床挑战；现有研究在多尺度信息捕获和跨成像条件泛化方面存在持续局限，亟需一个兼顾准确性、可解释性和计算效率的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度集成学习理论、多尺度特征提取理论（ASPP空洞空间金字塔池化）、注意力机制理论（SE通道注意力）以及迁移学习框架，结合类别不平衡处理策略（分层训练）。
AI.method: 构建E-MAS轻量级集成系统：集成MobileNetV2和EfficientNet-B0两个骨干网络，引入ASPP模块增强多尺度特征捕获，集成SE注意力机制强化对临床相关特征的关注；采用多种分层训练策略处理类别不平衡，并通过跨数据集评估验证泛化能力；利用注意力可视化提升模型可解释性。
AI.findings: E-MAS在HAM10000上达到98.73%准确率和98.21% AUC；在PH2上达到97.78%准确率和99.01% AUC；在组合数据集上达到98.20%准确率和99.00% AUC，均显著优于MobileNetV2和EfficientNet-B0等基线模型，表现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 为皮肤病变分类提供了轻量级集成与多尺度注意力机制相结合的新框架；验证了ASPP和SE注意力机制在皮肤影像学中的协同增效作用；通过注意力可视化增强了深度学习模型在医疗诊断中的可解释性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床和远程皮肤病学提供了一种可靠且计算高效的诊断工具；通过跨数据集验证证明了模型的实际部署可行性；注意力可视化机制有助于提升医生的诊断信心和临床采纳度。

title: MDAD-Net: Multi-dimensional deep convolution and adaptive dimension-changing attention mechanism network for lesion segmentation in breast ultrasound images
affiliations: Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Chongqing University, Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications and Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications - Department of Biomedical Engineering

detail.title: MDAD-Net: Multi-dimensional deep convolution and adaptive dimension-changing attention mechanism network for lesion segmentation in breast ultrasound images
detail.abstract: Background and Objective: Early detection of breast cancer and accurate segmentation of lesion regions in breast ultrasound images are crucial for improving diagnostic efficiency and treatment outcomes. However, existing segmentation methods fail to adequately identify lesions due to their complex features and blurred boundaries.Methods: In order to solve this problem, a breast ultrasound image segmentation method (named MDAD-Net) is proposed based on the multi-dimensional deep convolution (MDconv) module and the adaptive dimension-changing attention mechanism (ADatt) module. Firstly, the MDconv module is designed to extract the feature information of the image from different scales and depths to enhance the ability to capture the fine lesion region. Then, the ADatt module is utilized to dynamically adjust the weight allocation of feature channels and spatial dimensions, focusing on the key features of the lesion region and suppressing the interference of background noise.Results: Extensive comparative experiments are carried out on two public and one private datasets to verify the superior performance of the proposed MDAD-Net method. The results demonstrate that the MDAD-Net outperforms the current mainstream breast ultrasound segmentation models in various evaluation metrics. Moreover, ablation experimental results show that the introduction of either the MDconv or ADatt modules can improve the segmentation performance, and the integration of them achieves greater improvement. Finally, external validation experiments verify that the MDAD-Net has better generalization performance than the state-of-the-art methods.Conclusions: The proposed method can more accurately segment the lesion region in breast ultrasound images, potentially providing strong technical support for the auxiliary diagnosis of breast tumor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为MDAD-Net的乳腺超声图像分割方法，通过多维度深度卷积模块（MDconv）和自适应变维注意力机制（ADatt）来增强对病灶区域的精细特征捕捉能力，在两个公开数据集和一个私有数据集上的实验表明其性能优于当前主流方法。
AI.research_question: 如何解决乳腺超声图像中病灶区域特征复杂、边界模糊导致的分割不准确问题？
AI.motivation: 乳腺超声图像的早期检测和病灶区域精确分割对提高诊断效率和治疗效果至关重要，但现有分割方法因病灶特征复杂和边界模糊而无法充分识别病灶区域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多维度深度卷积（MDconv）模块和自适应变维注意力（ADatt）机制的多维特征提取与注意力分配框架。
AI.method: 提出MDAD-Net方法：（1）设计MDconv模块从不同尺度和深度提取图像特征信息，增强对精细病灶区域的捕获能力；（2）利用ADatt模块动态调整特征通道和空间维度的权重分配，聚焦病灶区域关键特征并抑制背景噪声干扰；在两个公开数据集和一个私有数据集上进行对比实验和消融实验验证。
AI.findings: （1）MDAD-Net在各种评估指标上优于当前主流的乳腺超声分割模型；（2）消融实验表明MDconv和ADatt模块的单独引入都能提升分割性能，两者整合可实现更大提升；（3）外部验证实验表明MDAD-Net比现有最优方法具有更好的泛化性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了MDconv模块和ADatt模块的设计，为乳腺超声图像分割提供了新的多尺度特征提取与自适应注意力机制相结合的技术框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 所提出的MDAD-Net方法能够更准确地分割乳腺超声图像中的病灶区域，可为乳腺肿瘤的辅助诊断提供强有力的技术支持。

title: Climate Displacement and the Limits of U.S. Immigration Law:  A Rights-Based Framework for Protecting Vulnerable Migrants

detail.title: Climate Displacement and the Limits of U.S. Immigration Law:  A Rights-Based Framework for Protecting Vulnerable Migrants
detail.abstract: Climate change rarely acts alone. Drought, flooding, sea-level rise and extreme heat destroy livelihoods, intensify competition for land and water, weaken public institutions and expose already marginalized communities to violence. Yet U.S. immigration law generally protects people only when these conditions can be connected to a recognized legal category. The statutory refugee definition requires persecution on account of race, religion, nationality, membership in a particular social group or political opinion. Temporary Protected Status can respond to an environmental disaster, but only after an executive designation and only for eligible nationals already present in the United States. Humanitarian parole is discretionary, temporary and individualized. These mechanisms therefore leave a significant group of cross-border climate-displaced people without a stable protection route. This article argues against simply adding "climate" as a sixth refugee ground. That approach would blur the distinction between environmental harm and persecution while failing to address mixed causes of movement. Instead, the article proposes a Climate Mobility Protection Framework built on five elements: contextual risk assessment, differentiated legal pathways, temporary protection with review, meaningful procedural access, and regional responsibility-sharing. The framework preserves the integrity of asylum law while providing a principled response to foreseeable displacement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"气候流动保护框架"，主张不应简单将"气候"增加为第六类难民理由，而应通过风险评估、差异化法律途径、临时保护审查、程序准入和区域责任分担五个要素，为跨境气候流离失所者提供有原则的保护路径。
AI.research_question: 美国现行移民法律机制（难民定义、临时保护身份、人道主义假释）是否足以应对气候变化导致的跨境流离失所？应如何构建一个既能保护气候流离失所者又不损害庇护法律完整性的法律框架？
AI.motivation: 气候变化导致的跨境流动日益增多，而美国现行移民法律机制仅能覆盖少数与既有法律类别相关的情形，留下大量气候流离失所者缺乏稳定保护路径的法律空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 难民法律理论、国际保护法框架、气候移民治理理论、责任分担理论
AI.method: 法律规范分析，对美国现行移民法律（难民定义、TPS、人道主义假释）进行批判性审视，并提出替代性法律框架设计。
AI.findings: 现有机制（难民、TPS、人道主义假释）无法充分保护气候流离失所者；将"气候"简单列为第六类难民理由存在缺陷（混淆环境损害与迫害的界限、未能处理混合动因）；需建立包含五个要素的气候流动保护框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了将气候难民纳入现有难民体系的简单化路径，提出保留庇护法律完整性的同时回应气候流动的新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供气候流动保护的具体设计要素，包括风险评估机制、差异化法律途径、临时保护审查、程序准入和区域责任分担。

title: Many-parameter Models in Population Genetics
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Many-parameter Models in Population Genetics
detail.abstract: Population genetics has become a many-parameter subject. Whole-genome average effects, polygenic effect sizes and allelic frequency spectra all involve parameter counts that are large relative to any sample, and in Fisher's whole-genome formulation the count is astronomically large. We make three points. First, Fisher's definition of the average effect, as restated by Ewens (2025a), is a weighted least-squares projection, and the plug-in additive genetic variance obtained by fitting that projection is inflated by σ 2 tr(H ⊤ H)/N, which for the unregularised fit is exactly pσ 2 /N. Second, the natural prior for such problems is a species sampling prior in the sense of Kingman (1975), of which the Ewens Sampling Formula is the canonical member. Third, the global-local shrinkage priors of sparse Bayesian statistics and the two-parameter Poisson-Dirichlet family are the same object: if κ ∼ Be(a, b) is the shrinkage weight of a prior in the three-parameter beta normal class, then κ is the first stick-breaking weight of GEM(1a, a + b-1), and the frequency spectrum intensity is ν(x) = x-1 f κ (x) exactly. Sparsity level is Pitman's α. We then prove the resulting rate directly for the shrinkage prior as used: at the canonical global scale τ n = n-1/2 the expected effective model size is ≍ n 1-a , matching the Poisson-Dirichlet discovery rate in exponent exactly and in constant to within Γ(2a) ∈ [0.886, 1]. The horseshoe therefore sits at n 1/2 and Laplace-type priors at log n, and the conventional choice of global scale is the unique power of n at which the two sides agree for every a. We give proofs, worked one-locus and two-locus examples, a conjugate augmentation for the mutation parameter, and simulations. In an epistatic whole-genome simulation with L = 400 loci the unregularised projection inflates σ 2 A by a factor of 3.07 at N = 200; a species sampling prior at the global scale the theory identifies, with no oracle input, never inflates it and reaches 0.98 of the truth by N = 3200.

AI.tldr: 本文指出Fisher平均效应的plug-in加性遗传方差估计存在由参数过多导致的膨胀问题（未正则化时恰好为pσ²/N），并提出将物种抽样先验（尤其是Ewens抽样公式及其推广的Poisson-Dirichlet族）作为自然先验，证明全局-局部收缩先验与两参数Poisson-Dirichlet族本质上等价，并给出了匹配的收缩率理论，通过单/两位点实例和上位性全基因组模拟验证了理论。
AI.research_question: 在全基因组参数化日益增多的背景下，如何解决Fisher平均效应定义中plug-in加性遗传方差的膨胀问题，并找到匹配高维稀疏结构的自然先验与统计率？
AI.motivation: 群体遗传学已成为多参数学科，全基因组平均效应、多基因效应大小和等位基因频率谱的参数数量相对于任何样本都极大（Fisher公式中甚至天文数字般大），导致传统plug-in估计方差膨胀，亟需理论框架和正则化方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 加权最小二乘投影（Fisher平均效应）、物种抽样先验（Kingman 1975）、Ewens抽样公式、两参数Poisson-Dirichlet族、三参数beta正态类全局-局部收缩先验、GEM粘断表示、Pitman's α稀疏度。
AI.method: 理论推导与证明（含膨胀因子的解析表达式、收缩先验与Poisson-Dirichlet等价的粘断构造证明）、单/两位点实例分析、共轭增广方法处理突变参数、蒙特卡洛模拟以及L=400位点的上位性全基因组模拟。
AI.findings: （1）未正则化拟合的plug-in加性遗传方差膨胀恰好为pσ²/N；（2）全局-局部收缩先验与两参数Poisson-Dirichlet族是同一对象，κ~Be(a,b)的收缩权重对应GEM(1a,a+b-1)的第一个粘断权重，频率谱强度恰为ν(x)=x⁻¹f_κ(x)；（3）在规范全局尺度τ_n=n^{-1/2}下，期望有效模型大小≍n^{1-a}，与Poisson-Dirichlet发现率在指数上精确匹配、常数上相差Γ(2a)；马蹄先验对应n^{1/2}，Laplace型先验对应log n；（4）全基因组模拟表明未正则化投影在N=200时使σ²_A膨胀3.07倍，而物种抽样先验从不膨胀，且N=3200时达到真实值的0.98。
AI.theory_contributions: 在理论上将稀疏贝叶斯统计的全局-局部收缩先验与群体遗传学的Poisson-Dirichlet谱先验领域建立严格等价关系，证明了Fisher平均效应定义下的方差膨胀公式，确立了规范全局尺度的唯一性和最优性，为群体遗传学提供了统计前沿的理论桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种无需oracle信息即可避免遗传方差膨胀、并快速收敛到真实值的先验选择方案，可用于全基因组关联分析和多基因性状的遗传方差估计，为实际数据分析提供了可操作的正则化策略。

title: Betting on Disaster: Price Discovery in Catastrophe Prediction Markets
affiliations: and

detail.title: Betting on Disaster: Price Discovery in Catastrophe Prediction Markets
detail.abstract: Prediction markets offer a market-based approach to measuring the probability of future events in real time. We study price discovery in Kalshi contracts on U.S. hurricanes, tornadoes, and earthquakes, three perils that trade on the same federally regulated exchange but whose information environments differ sharply in how much public forecasting is available. We examine how prices, trading volume, and bid-ask spreads respond to realized events, forecast revisions, and catastrophe-model updates, comparing information sources that differ in accessibility. Kalshi prices incorporate public forecast revisions, and the strength of that response tracks the amount of public forecasting available for each peril. Catastrophe-model updates, which revise the loss expectations that sophisticated market participants price against, leave no detectable trace in these prices. Public forecasting also disciplines the cost of trading, as spreads are comparable across perils on most days but widen severalfold during episodes when no forecast anchors the market. Price discovery in these markets appears bounded by the accessibility of information rather than by its supply.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Kalshi平台上美国飓风、龙卷风和地震三类气象灾难合约的价格发现过程，发现市场价格能吸收公共预报修正信息，且响应强度与各灾害可获得的公共预报数量成正比；但巨灾模型更新对价格无显著影响。价格发现受信息可及性而非信息供给的限制。
AI.research_question: 预测市场中价格发现如何受到信息可及性（而非信息供给）的制约？具体而言，Kalshi上的飓风、龙卷风和地震合约对不同类型的公共信息（预报修正、巨灾模型更新）反应有何差异？
AI.motivation: 预测市场为实时衡量未来事件概率提供了市场化方法，但不同灾害的信息环境差异巨大。理解价格发现如何受信息可及性影响，有助于评估预测市场的有效性和信息效率边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价格发现理论、市场微观结构理论、信息可及性假设
AI.method: 实证分析：使用Kalshi交易所上飓风、龙卷风和地震合约的交易数据，分析价格、交易量和买卖价差对已实现事件、预报修正及巨灾模型更新的响应，并对三个灾害市场进行对比。
AI.findings: (1) Kalshi价格能吸收公共预报修正信息，响应强度与每类灾害可获得的公共预报数量成正比；(2) 巨灾模型更新（影响成熟交易者定价预期的信息）在价格中无迹可寻；(3) 买卖价差在大多数天数内各灾害间可比，但在缺乏预报锚定的事件期间会扩大数倍；(4) 价格发现受信息可及性而非信息供给的限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了预测市场价格发现的边界条件，提出信息可及性（而非信息供给）是制约价格发现效率的关键因素，丰富了市场效率与信息传播理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和交易所运营者提供参考：改善公共信息的可及性（如提供免费预报服务）比单纯增加信息供给更能提升预测市场的价格发现效率；也为交易者理解市场价格对信息的反应模式提供指导。

title: The Horseshoe and the Fundamental Theorem of Natural Selection
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: The Horseshoe and the Fundamental Theorem of Natural Selection
detail.abstract: Ewens's reading of Fisher's Fundamental Theorem identifies the partial change in mean fitness with the additive genetic variance in fitness divided by mean fitness. Once the average effects are recognized as the coefficients of a weighted least-squares regression of genotypic fitness on allelic dosage, the theorem is a one-line algebraic identity and the whole of its empirical content is transferred to the estimation of a regression. That regression is over-parameterized: there are more loci than individuals, the ordinary estimator of the additive variance is inflated by Lσ 2 ε /n, and the implied rate of adaptation is correspondingly overstated. I propose estimating the average effects under a horseshoe prior and reading the Fundamental Theorem through the resulting shrinkage weights, which yields a rate of adaptation discounted by a signal-to-noise factor that is estimated rather than assumed. Three results are given: any shrinkage rule delivers a conservative estimate of the rate; oracle shrinkage tuned for the average effects necessarily understates the additive variance; and the coherent estimator is the posterior mean of the quadratic functional, not the quadratic of the posterior mean. In simulation with L = 400 loci and n = 300 individuals the naive estimator overstates the additive variance by a factor of 3.1, ridge understates it by half, and the horseshoe posterior recovers it to within 6%. Four further questions are then taken up. Posterior intervals for the quadratic functional cover at 83% against a nominal 90%, failing one-sidedly in the direction the medium-signal theory of the horseshoe predicts, and the regularized horseshoe recovers most of the shortfall. Robertson's secondary theorem requires a bilinear functional whose plug-in carries a bias Lρσ w σ z /n in the residual correlation; a bivariate horseshoe with shared local scales reduces a 2.5-fold overstatement to a 12% understatement. Under linkage disequilibrium the estimand is α ⊤ V α rather than a diagonal form, and correcting the estimator without correcting the functional leaves an error of the same order. Ascertainment is not a shrinkage problem at all: measuring fitness on survivors understates the additive variance threefold, and no prior repairs it. The choice between a horseshoe and a Gaussian prior encodes the sweep-versus-infinitesimal question about genetic architecture, and the Fundamental Theorem inherits the answer.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视Wright-Fisher基本定理（费雪基本定理）的经验估计问题，指出平均效应本质上是一个加权最小二乘回归的系数，而该回归是过参数化的（位点数超过个体数）。作者提出使用马靴先验（horseshoe prior）来估计平均效应，从而将适应速率估计转化为一个由信噪比因子折减的问题。通过模拟证明朴素估计会高估加性遗传方差3.1倍，岭回归低估一半，而马靴后验能将误差控制在6%以内。文中还处理了后验区间覆盖、Robertson次级定理、连锁不平衡和选择偏差（ascertainment）等问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在高维过参数化回归框架下（位点数L=400大于个体数n=300）可靠地估计费雪基本定理中的加性遗传方差及适应速率？
AI.motivation: 费雪基本定理是进化遗传学的基石，但其经验实施受制于"多位点-少个体"的过参数化问题：普通最小二乘估计加性遗传方差时存在偏差（Lσε²/n的膨胀项），导致适应速率被系统性地高估。需要一种能够处理高维回归同时保持估计可靠性的统计方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 费雪基本定理（Fisher's Fundamental Theorem）、Robertson次级定理、加权最小二乘回归框架下平均效应的定义、贝叶斯层次模型（马靴先验/正则化马靴）、Oracle收缩理论、二次泛函的后验推断。
AI.method: 将平均效应识别为基因型适应度对等位基因剂量的加权最小二乘回归系数；采用马靴先验（horseshoe prior）估计高维回归系数；利用后验均值估计二次泛函（加性遗传方差）；通过模拟实验（L=400位点、n=300个体）比较朴素估计、岭回归与马靴后验的表现；并针对双变量泛函（Robertson定理）、连锁不平衡（α⊤Vα形式）和选择偏差（ascertainment）进行扩展分析。
AI.findings: （1）任何收缩规则都给出适应速率的保守估计；（2）针对平均效应的oracle收缩必然低估加性遗传方差；（3）一致的估计量是二次泛函的后验均值，而非后验均值的平方；（4）模拟中朴素估计高估加性方差3.1倍，岭回归低估一半，马靴后验恢复至误差6%以内；（5）二次泛函的后验区间名义90%实际覆盖83%，正则化马靴可弥补大部分不足；（6）双变量马靴（共享局部尺度）将Robertson定理中的2.5倍高估减至12%低估；（7）连锁不平衡下若只修正估计量而不修正泛函（应为α⊤Vα而非对角形式），误差同阶；（8）选择偏差无法通过收缩修复——测量幸存者适应度高估加性方差三倍，任何先验都无法补救；（9）马靴与高斯先验的选择对应sweep与infinitesimal遗传结构之争。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）证明了费雪基本定理可简化为一行代数恒等式，其全部经验内容被转移至回归估计；（2）将马靴收缩与基本定理联系起来，阐明收缩规则与遗传结构假设（sweep vs. infinitesimal）之间的理论对应；（3）确立二次泛函后验均值（而非后验均值的二次方）作为一致估计量的原则；（4）揭示选择偏差并非收缩问题，从理论上划定贝叶斯方法的适用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为实证研究者提供了估计适应速率的实用方法——马靴先验下的后验推断；（2）明确量化了朴素方法的高估程度（3.1倍）并给出了改进方案；（3）提供了Robertson次级定理的双变量估计框架（共享局部尺度的双变量马靴）；（4）警示选择偏差（ascertainment）的不可修复性，指导研究者在实验设计阶段避免幸存者偏差。

title: Over-parameterization in Statistical Genomics
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Over-parameterization in Statistical Genomics
detail.abstract: Genomic data are severely over-parameterized: the number of measured variants exceeds the number of individuals by one to four orders of magnitude. Every method in current use restores identifiability by imposing an assumption that the data at hand cannot check. This paper takes that observation seriously and asks what follows from it. I show that the likelihood is flat on a subspace of dimension at least p-n, that a prior which factorizes across the row-space/null-space decomposition leaves the null-space component exactly at its prior, and that the standard heritability estimand is a bilinear functional of the assumed and true effect-size weightings whose bias factor equals unity only when the two coincide. A partialidentification bound gives the constructive counterpart: under a norm budget the identified set for a single coefficient is an explicit interval, whose width is close to the full budget precisely when p ≫ n. I then survey the main method families-marginal testing, variance-component models, penalized likelihood, global-local shrinkage, model-X knockoffs, fine-mapping, polygenic scores, and sequence-to-function deep learning-classifying each by the assumption it imposes rather than by the algorithm it runs. A simulation illustrates the three failure modes. I propose a threelevel taxonomy of assumptions-those affecting efficiency, those defining the estimand, and those that are unfalsifiable from data of the same kind-and a reporting protocol built around the distinction between prediction, which is identified, and attribution, which is not. Within-family designs are the one intervention that shrinks the problem rather than reparameterizing it, and the empirical deflation they produce is the best available measure of how much the assumptions were carrying. The historical section argues that Mendel, Fisher and Wright would each reject the modern analysis, for three different reasons that correspond exactly to the three levels of the taxonomy.

AI.tldr: 本文系统论证了基因组数据中变异数远超个体数（p≫n）导致的根本性识别问题：似然函数在至少p-n维子空间上是平坦的，任何现行方法都必须施加数据本身无法检验的假设。作者提出了假设的三层级分类体系，区分效率性假设、定义估计量的假设和不可证伪的假设，并论证了预测（可识别）与归因（不可识别）之间的根本区别。
AI.research_question: 当基因组数据中变异数远超个体数（p≫n）时，参数识别失败的后果是什么？不同方法族各自施加了哪些不可检验的假设？这些假设如何影响估计和推断的可靠性？
AI.motivation: 基因组数据存在严重的过度参数化问题（变异数比个体数多1-4个数量级），所有现有方法都依赖数据本身无法验证的假设来恢复可识别性。作者认为这是一个被系统忽视的根本性问题，需要严肃对待其理论和实践后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 部分识别理论（partial identification）；似然函数的平坦子空间分析；行空间/零空间分解；双线性泛函的偏差分析；Mendel、Fisher和Wright的理论传统作为历史分析框架
AI.method: 理论推导（似然平坦性证明、先验分解不变性证明、可识别性边界推导）、方法族分类综述、模拟研究（展示三种失败模式）、历史文本分析
AI.findings: （1）似然函数在至少p-n维子空间上平坦；（2）因子化的先验使零空间分量保持先验不变；（3）标准遗传力估计量是有偏的，偏差因子仅在假设权重与真实权重一致时等于1；（4）在范数预算下，单一系数的识别集是显式区间，p≫n时接近全预算宽度；（5）家庭内设计（within-family designs）是唯一能缩小问题而非重新参数化的干预措施，其经验性收缩是衡量假设负担的最佳指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出三层级假设分类法（效率性假设、定义估计量的假设、不可证伪的假设），区分预测（可识别）与归因（不可识别）的本质区别；建立了基因组分析中部分识别边界的形式化理论；通过Mendel、Fisher和Wright各自会拒绝现代分析的论点，从历史视角印证了三层级假设分类的合理性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出基于三层级假设分类的报告协议；建议以家庭内设计作为检验假设负担的经验工具；提醒研究者在预测与归因之间做出明确区分；为基因组方法的比较和评估提供了新的分类标准（按假设而非算法）。

title: Female Directors' Board Positions and IPO Underpricing: Evidence from Japan
affiliations: and

detail.title: Female Directors' Board Positions and IPO Underpricing: Evidence from Japan

declarations.funderStatement: This study is part of the research output supported by a Japan Society for the Promotion of Science Grant-in-Aid for Scientific Research (Project No. 21K01646).

detail.abstract: This study empirically examines whether the positions held by female board members affect the extent of underpricing in Japanese initial public offerings (IPOs). Prior studies generally treat female directors as a homogeneous group, which may help explain their mixed findings. Using 754 IPOs from 2016 to 2023, and 727 nonfinancial IPOs in the regression analysis, we distinguish among female representative directors, titled executive directors, ordinary directors without executive titles, statutory auditors, outside directors, outside statutory auditors, and full-time statutory auditors. We first document that the proportion of IPO firms with at least one female board member rose from 38.91% in 2016-2020 to 58.01% in 2021-2023, with particularly large increases in outside directors and outside statutory auditors following the 2021 revision of Japan's Corporate Governance Code. The regression results show that the overall female board-member ratio and, more specifically, the ratio of female ordinary directors are negatively associated with IPO underpricing. These associations are concentrated among small and medium-sized firms. The findings suggest that female participation in internal board decision-making may provide a particularly valuable signal when information asymmetry is relatively high.

AI.tldr: 本文实证考察了日本IPO中女性董事会成员所担任的具体职位是否影响抑价程度。基于2016-2023年754家IPO企业（回归分析中使用727家非金融企业）的数据，区分了女性代表董事、有头衔的执行董事、无执行头衔的普通董事、法定审计师、外部董事、外部法定审计师及专职法定审计师等不同职位。研究发现，女性董事会成员总体比例以及女性普通董事比例与IPO抑价呈负相关，且这一关系集中在小中型企业中，表明在信息不对称较高时，女性参与内部董事会决策可能提供特别有价值的信号。
AI.research_question: 女性董事会成员所担任的不同职位是否以及如何影响日本IPO的抑价程度？
AI.motivation: 以往研究将女性董事视为同质群体，这可能导致其研究结果不一致。通过区分女性董事的具体职位，可以更细致地理解女性参与董事会对IPO抑价的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以信息不对称理论和信号理论为基础，认为女性参与内部董事会决策可以作为一种信号传递机制，在信息不对称较高时（如中小企业IPO）其信号价值更为突出。
AI.method: 使用2016-2023年日本754家IPO企业样本（回归分析727家非金融企业），通过多元回归分析检验不同职位的女性董事会成员比例与IPO抑价之间的关系，并区分企业规模进行分组分析。
AI.findings: （1）拥有至少一名女性董事会成员的IPO企业比例从2016-2020年的38.91%上升至2021-2023年的58.01%，尤其在2021年日本公司治理守则修订后，外部董事和外部法定审计师的增幅显著；（2）女性董事会成员总体比例及女性普通董事比例与IPO抑价呈负相关；（3）上述负相关关系集中在小中型企业中。
AI.theory_contributions: 突破了以往将女性董事视为同质群体的研究框架，首次在日本IPO情境下区分不同职位的女性董事角色，揭示了女性参与内部董事会决策（特别是普通董事职位）的信号价值，丰富了女性董事异质性与IPO抑价关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业提供实证依据，表明提升女性在内部董事会决策中的参与（尤其是普通董事职位）可以作为降低信息不对称、减少IPO抑价的治理机制；同时为中小企业在信息不对称较高情境下的治理结构优化提供参考。

title: Planning for Sustainable Urban Growth in Fiji

detail.title: Planning for Sustainable Urban Growth in Fiji

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author certify that there are no affiliations with or involvement in any organization or entity with any financial interest, or non-financial interest in the subject matter or materials discussed in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not require formal ethical approval or informed consent as it did not involve human participants, subjects, or the collection of sensitive personal data, in accordance with institutional and national guidelines.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declare that no external funding, financial support, or grants were received for the research, authorship, or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: This paper examines sustainable urban growth planning in Fiji through the linked lenses of urban governance, land tenure, climate resilience, infrastructure finance, and local accountability. Fiji is among the most urbanised countries in Melanesia, with growth concentrated in the Greater Suva Urban Area and marked by informal settlement expansion, uneven service delivery, and increasing exposure to climate and disaster risk. Drawing on international urban frameworks, government policy documents, multilateral development reports, and Fiji-focused academic literature, the paper argues that Fiji's urban challenge cannot be reduced to either infrastructure shortage or land scarcity. It is better understood as an integrated governance problem in which metropolitan planning, customary land relations, municipal capacity, climate finance, and settlement upgrading must be addressed together. The paper finds that Fiji has made important advances through its National Housing Policy, climate finance strategy, participation in the Pacific Urban Forum, Suva's Voluntary Local Review, and major investments in water and wastewater resilience. However, implementation remains constrained by fragmented institutions, limited professional planning capacity, weak peri-urban governance, and persistent data gaps in informal settlements. The paper concludes that sustainable development in Fiji requires a stronger policy architecture for metropolitan coordination, culturally grounded land governance, risk-informed planning, and SDG-aligned monitoring systems. It also identifies future research priorities, including longitudinal settlement studies, spatial modelling, gendered analysis of urban vulnerability, comparative Pacific research, and evaluation of settlement upgrading outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文通过城市治理、土地权属、气候韧性、基础设施融资和地方问责制的综合视角，分析斐济的可持续城市增长规划。研究发现斐济的城市挑战本质上是一个综合性治理问题——大都市规划、习惯土地关系、市政能力、气候融资和住区升级需统筹解决。尽管斐济已取得一定进展，但碎片化机构、有限的规划能力、薄弱的城郊治理和数据缺口仍是主要制约因素。
AI.research_question: 斐济可持续城市增长规划面临的核心挑战是什么？如何通过城市治理、土地权属、气候韧性、基础设施融资和地方问责制的联动视角来理解和应对这些挑战？
AI.motivation: 斐济是美拉尼西亚地区城市化程度最高的国家之一，大苏瓦都市区集中了快速增长的人口，面临非正规住区扩张、服务供给不均、气候与灾害风险加剧等问题。既有讨论往往将城市问题简单归因于基础设施短缺或土地稀缺，缺乏对治理维度整合性的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市治理理论、土地权属理论、气候韧性框架、基础设施融资理论、地方问责制框架，以及联合国可持续发展目标（SDG）等国际城市发展框架。
AI.method: 文献分析方法，综合运用国际城市框架、政府政策文件、多边发展报告及斐济相关学术文献进行交叉分析。
AI.findings: （1）斐济在国家住房政策、气候融资策略、太平洋城市论坛参与、苏瓦自愿地方审查以及水资源和废水韧性投资方面取得重要进展；（2）实施仍受限于机构碎片化、专业规划能力不足、城郊治理薄弱以及非正规住区数据缺失；（3）斐济的城市挑战应被理解为综合性治理问题，而非单纯的基础设施或土地问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出斐济城市挑战应被重新框定为"综合性治理问题"而非"基础设施短缺或土地稀缺"的二元论述，将大都市规划、习惯土地关系、市政能力、气候融资与住区升级纳入统一的治理分析框架，丰富了太平洋小岛屿发展中国家（SIDS）城市化研究的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为斐济及类似太平洋岛国的政策制定者提供建议：建立更强的大都市协调政策架构、文化根基的土地治理体系、风险知情规划以及SDG对齐的监测系统；同时提出未来研究优先方向，包括纵向住区研究、空间建模、城市脆弱性的性别分析、太平洋比较研究及住区升级成效评估。

title: Regional Differences in the Purchasing Power of the Minimum Wage in Türkiye

detail.title: Regional Differences in the Purchasing Power of the Minimum Wage in Türkiye
detail.abstract: This study examines regional differences in the purchasing power of Türkiye's uniform national minimum wage arising from variations in living costs across regions. Using Regional Purchasing Power Parity (RPPP) and Consumer Price Index (CPI) data at NUTS 2 level, regional purchasing power indices are constructed for Türkiye's seven geographical regions and used to compare the real purchasing power of the minimum wage over time. The results reveal substantial regional disparities. The purchasing power of the minimum wage is relatively lower in the Aegean, Marmara, and Central Anatolia regions, while it is higher in regions with comparatively lower living costs. Differences are also observed across major expenditure categories, including food, housing, education, health, and transport. These findings suggest that a uniform national minimum wage may translate into significantly different real living standards across regions. Rather than relying exclusively on differentiated regional minimum wages, complementary measures such as housing, education, and transport support in high-cost areas could provide a more manageable policy alternative. Where regional differentiation is considered, targeting high-cost provinces rather than broad geographical regions may better account for socioeconomic differences within regions.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用区域购买力平价（RPPP）和消费者价格指数（CPI）数据，在NUTS 2层面构建土耳其七大地理区域的购买力指数，比较统一最低工资的真实购买力差异。研究发现区域间存在显著差异，爱琴海、马尔马拉和中安纳托利亚地区最低工资购买力相对较低，而生活成本较低的地区购买力较高。建议采用住房、教育、交通等补助作为补充政策，而非仅依赖差异化区域最低工资；若需区域差异化，应针对高成本省份而非广泛地理区域。
AI.research_question: 土耳其统一的全国最低工资在不同区域之间的实际购买力存在多大差异？这种差异背后的政策含义是什么？
AI.motivation: 土耳其实施统一的全国最低工资政策，但各区域生活成本差异显著，可能导致统一最低工资在不同地区对应截然不同的实际生活水平，需要量化评估这种区域差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 购买力平价理论（Purchasing Power Parity）；区域购买力平价（RPPP）与消费者价格指数（CPI）的比较分析框架；最低工资与生活成本的区域差异分析。
AI.method: 使用NUTS 2层面的区域购买力平价（RPPP）和消费者价格指数（CPI）数据，构建土耳其七大地理区域的区域购买力指数，并对最低工资的实际购买力进行跨时间和跨区域的比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）土耳其最低工资的实际购买力存在显著的区域差异；（2）爱琴海、马尔马拉和中安纳托利亚地区的最低工资购买力相对较低；（3）生活成本较低地区的购买力相对较高；（4）食品、住房、教育、健康和交通等主要支出类别之间也存在差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 将区域购买力平价（RPPP）应用于最低工资政策分析，为统一最低工资在不同生活成本区域的实际价值差异提供了量化证据，丰富了最低工资与生活成本区域差异关系的理论探讨。
AI.practical_contributions: 为土耳其最低工资政策制定提供了实证依据，建议在高成本地区采用住房、教育和交通补助等补充措施作为差异化最低工资的替代方案；若实施区域差异化，建议针对高成本省份而非广泛地理区域，以更精准地反映区域内社会经济差异。

title: Unreachable Heights: Desuetude, Selective Enforcement, and an Arlington Heights Record of Purposeful Discrimination, 1886 to 2026

detail.title: Unreachable Heights: Desuetude, Selective Enforcement, and an Arlington Heights Record of Purposeful Discrimination, 1886 to 2026

keywords: Personnel Administrator of Massachusetts V. Feeney

detail.abstract: American law has recognized since 1886 that a statute fair on its face may be administered with an evil eye and an unequal hand, and that unequal administration is itself a constitutional violation. That recognition has never been withdrawn. In 1967 a federal district court connected selective enforcement to the Yick Wo doctrine and to the desuetude literature, then dismissed the claim because the defendant had adduced not a scintilla of evidence that the government singled him out. The recognition and the proof problem were both on the record before anything that followed was built. What followed is this Article's subject. Washington v. Davis, Feeney, McCleskey, Armstrong, Sandoval, Iqbal, and Dukes each rest on separate ground. Together they make intent an element, place awareness of consequences outside it, disqualify aggregate proof, condition discovery on evidence only discovery can produce, close the route requiring no intent at all, and bar aggregation. Inclusive Communities preserved the surviving private route in 2015 and fitted it with the same instruments. Desuetude, which would have kept dormant rules from remaining available for selective revival, was declined. The Article does not present that sequence as an indictment. It assembles it as an Arlington Heights record, drawn from the Court's own published rationales, and runs the framework against it. The record fails, because Feeney places awareness of consequences outside the definition of purpose. The architecture is self-immunizing, and the showing is by construction rather than by assertion. Two claims follow. A standard provable only from the decisionmaker's own record measures documentation, not purpose. And because reaching internal records requires counsel, time, and the capacity to absorb delay, the remedy is rationed along the same axis as the injury. Five literatures document that pattern independently.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了从1886年Yick Wo案确立的"选择性执法构成违宪"原则，到后续一系列最高法院判例（Washington v. Davis, Feeney, McCleskey, Armstrong, Sandoval, Iqbal, Dukes）如何逐步构建起一套"自我免疫"的法律架构——使故意（intent）成为要件、将后果认知排除在目的之外、否定聚合证据、要求只有通过证据开示才能获得的证据、关闭无需故意即可主张的路径、并禁止集体诉讼。作者运用Arlington Heights框架对该判例序列进行检验，发现该架构在定义层面即存在系统性缺陷：其可证明的标准实质衡量的是文书记录而非真实目的，而获取内部记录所需的资源（律师、时间、承受拖延的能力）恰恰沿与伤害相同的轴（种族/阶层）分配，导致救济被不平等地配给。
AI.research_question: 美国法律中关于选择性执法的宪法原则（源自1886年Yick Wo案）为何在司法实践中变得实质上无法证明？最高法院的判例序列如何构建了一套"自我免疫"的法律架构，使得歧视性执法的受害者难以获得救济？
AI.motivation: 尽管法律自1886年起就承认选择性执法构成违宪，但后续司法判例逐步收紧了证明标准，使得这一原则在实践中几乎无法操作。1967年的判例已经指出"证明问题"，而后续判例序列（Washington v. Davis到Dukes）将这一证明问题系统性地制度化，形成一个自我强化的封闭体系。作者意在以Arlington Heights框架检验这一判例架构，揭示其内在缺陷，并借助五个独立文献领域证明该体系沿阶层/种族轴线不平等地配给救济。
AI.theoretical_framework: Arlington Heights框架（意图审查标准）；Yick Wo选择性执行原则；Desuetude理论（法律废弃理论）；故意（intent）与目的（purpose）的区分理论（Feeney案确立的awareness of consequences与purpose的界分）
AI.method: 本文采用法学文献分析方法，系统梳理从1886年Yick Wo案到2015年Inclusive Communities案的判例演进序列，以Arlington Heights框架为分析工具逐案检验最高法院公布的理由（rationales），并从五个独立文献领域（五类文献）交叉验证"救济配给沿种族/阶层轴线分布"这一实证模式。
AI.findings: (1) 判例序列共同构成了一个"自我免疫"的架构：故意成为要件、后果认知被排除在目的定义之外、聚合证据不被采纳、证据开示以需要证据本身为条件、无需故意的路径被关闭、集体诉讼被禁止；(2) 用Arlington Heights框架检验该序列，发现其无法通过——因为Feeney案将"后果认知"排除在"目的"定义之外，使架构在定义层面即具有免疫力；(3) 可从决策者自身记录证明的标准实际上衡量的是"文书记录"而非"真实目的"；(4) 获取内部记录需要律师、时间和承受拖延的能力，因此救济的配给沿与伤害相同的轴线（种族/阶层）分布，五个文献领域独立证实了这一模式。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次以Arlington Heights框架系统检验最高法院自身的选择性执法判例序列，揭示其结构性缺陷；(2) 提出"自我免疫"（self-immunizing）概念，指认法律架构通过定义层面的构造而非事实层面的断言实现自我防御；(3) 论证了desuetude理论（废弃法律不应被选择性复活）的被拒是这一体系中一个关键但被忽视的环节；(4) 将救济可及性与资源分配的不平等联系起来，为法律与不平等研究提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为选择性执法诉讼中的原告提供了一份系统的判例障碍图谱，有助于诉讼策略的制定；(2) 揭示现行证明标准的实质是"文书质量测试"而非"目的测试"，为法律改革提供了靶点；(3) 通过五个文献领域的交叉验证，为实证研究和公共政策讨论提供了关于司法救济不平等分配的可靠证据基础。

title: Severity or Attention? What Prices an ESG Controversy — Evidence from 49,693 Korean Incident Records, 2015–2026
affiliations: and Hongik University

detail.title: Severity or Attention? What Prices an ESG Controversy — Evidence from 49,693 Korean Incident Records, 2015–2026

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The first author, Dukchan Yoon, is the chief executive of Who's Good, the firm that produces the data used in this study, and is its largest shareholder with a 30.22% equity stake. He holds related patents in three countries: Korea, Japan, and the United States. The co-author, Kihoon Hong (Hongik University), has no financial interest in that firm. The severity and event-date assignment rules are proprietary to that firm and are not included in the replication package; this limits independent verification of the explanatory variables, and is stated in the paper's disclosure statement.
declarations.funderStatement: No external research funding was received.

detail.abstract:
Using 49,693 negative ESG incident records observed for 1,314 Korean listed firms from January 2015 to January 2026, this paper examines what the short-horizon stock price reaction following a negative ESG incident is associated with. The dependent variable is the abnormal return cumulated from the event date (cumulative abnormal return, CAR). There are four explanatory variables: the severity score assigned at the incident level, the same-day article count, firm size, and the incident sequence number within the same firm.

The average reaction is negative and significant at short windows. CAR(0,0) is −0.192% and CAR(0,+5) is −0.353%, and from CAR(0,+60) onward the average is indistinguishable from zero. The confidence intervals at long horizons are, however, wide enough that they cannot exclude the −0.353% of CAR(0,+5); this therefore does not mean that there is no long-horizon effect, but that there is no power to determine whether decay occurs. A significant cumulative decline of −0.434% is also observed over the five trading days preceding the event date. In the full sample this exceeds the post-event window in absolute value; in the subsample in which no other incident at the same firm falls inside either window, the ordering reverses and the pre-event share is 38–46% (§7.3).

Five things are observed in the cross-section. First, severity reaches +0.088 (p = 0.081) in the specification in which it is entered alone, falling short of conventional significance levels, and becomes significant with the sign opposite to the prediction once other variables are controlled (issue and year fixed effects +0.134, p = 0.016; adding size and sequence +0.108, p = 0.049; adding the article count as well +0.204, p < 0.001; firm fixed effects +0.147). This positive sign is confined to the post-event interval. Taking the pre-event interval as the dependent variable, the coefficient is −0.095 pp (p = 0.064), and over the combined pre- and post-event interval CAR(−5,+5) it is +0.103 pp (p = 0.203), which is not significant. Second, the only variable that retains the predicted negative sign irrespective of the stage of controls is the same-day article count (−0.402 pp to −0.445 pp), and the effective range of that association is about one week after the event (−0.110 pp in CAR(+1,+20), p = 0.4369).

Third, the relationship between the incident sequence number and the size of the reaction is confirmed only in the range of the 21st incident and beyond, and a substantial part of it comes from overlapping event windows. The CAR(0,+5) of incidents in the 21st-and-later range is +2.249 pp higher than that of first incidents in the firm fixed effects specification, but 74.8% of this range is followed by the next incident within five trading days (versus 22.8% for first incidents), so the reactions to several incidents overlap within a single window. Restricting to observations whose next incident lies outside five trading days gives +1.035 pp (p = 0.049). Changing the overlap criterion moves the p-value between 0.022 and 0.051, so the association sits at the conventional threshold and is not treated as established (§7.3). Fourth, size is insignificant in the regressions (+0.075, p = 0.281), and only the univariate gap across size quartiles is significant (Q4 − Q1 = +2.511 pp, t = 2.85). Fifth, the coefficients on severity and on the article count move in exactly opposite directions as the window is lengthened. Severity (mean definition) rises from +0.037 at (0,0) to +0.239 at (0,+5), +0.395 at (0,+20) and on to +0.706 at (0,+120), whereas log(article count) is largest in absolute value at −0.214 (0,0) and −0.380 (0,+5) and is insignificant from (0,+20) onward.

The main coefficients are not sensitive to the standard-error structure. Two-way firm-and-date clustered standard errors are nearly identical to firm-clustered ones, and in a wild cluster bootstrap (B = 999) the p-values for both severity and the article count are 0.0010. They are, however, sensitive to tail observations and to the composition of the estimation window. After 1% winsorization the severity coefficient falls from +0.204 to +0.124 and the article count coefficient from −0.442 to −0.357, and in the subsample whose estimation window contains no own-firm incident (N = 4,647) severity is not significant.

This study is exploratory and has no pre-registered hypotheses. Because multiple specifications and windows are examined before reporting, individual p-values should not be read as the outcome of confirmatory tests, and the coefficients presented are conditional correlations observed in this sample. No causal relationship is claimed anywhere.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2015年1月至2026年1月韩国1314家上市公司的49,693条负面ESG事件记录，考察了负面ESG事件后短期股价反应（累计异常收益CAR）与严重程度、同日文章数、公司规模及事件序列号之间的关联。发现市场平均反应为负且短期显著，但严重程度与CAR呈正相关（与预期相反），仅同日文章数始终呈现预期的负向关联。研究为探索性分析，不主张因果关系。
AI.research_question: 负面ESG事件发生后的短期股价反应（累计异常收益CAR）与哪些因素相关联？具体考察四个解释变量：事件级别严重程度评分、同日媒体报道文章数、公司规模、以及同一公司内事件发生的序列号。
AI.motivation: ESG负面事件日益受到市场关注，但已有文献对负面ESG事件股价反应的决定因素缺乏系统性的实证考察。本研究旨在利用韩国大型面板数据，探索短期市场反应与事件特征、媒体报道、公司特征及事件频率之间的关联模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于有效市场假说与事件研究法框架，结合媒体报道的信息传播理论（注意力效应）以及投资者对负面信息的反应不对称性等相关理论视角。
AI.method: 事件研究法（计算CAR），采用多元回归分析，包含严重程度评分、文章数、公司规模、事件序列号四个解释变量；使用不同固定效应设定（年份、行业、公司固定效应），多种窗口长度（CAR(0,0)至CAR(0,+120)），以及稳健性检验（双向聚类标准误、wild cluster bootstrap、1%缩尾处理、剔除重叠事件窗口的子样本分析）。
AI.findings: （1）平均CAR在短期窗口显著为负：CAR(0,0)=-0.192%，CAR(0,+5)=-0.353%，60天后归零；（2）事件前5天也存在显著累计下跌-0.434%；（3）严重程度与CAR呈正相关（与预期相反，+0.204, p<0.001），且仅限于事后窗口；（4）同日文章数是唯一始终呈预期负号的变量（-0.402至-0.445pp），有效关联范围约为一周；（5）事件序列号的效应仅在21次及以上事件中确认，且大部分来自重叠事件窗口；（6）公司规模不显著；（7）严重程度系数随窗口延长单调上升，文章数系数则在短期最大后衰减。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）挑战了"严重负面ESG事件应导致更大市场负面反应"的直觉假设，发现严重程度与CAR呈正相关，提示可能存在提前预期或信息提前泄露机制；（2）揭示了媒体报道数量作为负面信息市场反应的稳健解释变量，强化了注意力效应在ESG事件中的理论意义；（3）系统性地检验了事件频率（序列号）对市场反应的影响，发现重复事件存在边际递减或信息含量递减效应，但强调重叠窗口的偏误问题。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为投资者提供了负面ESG事件短期市场反应幅度和持续时间的量化参考；（2）提醒投资者关注媒体报道量而非仅评分严重程度作为反应指标；（3）为上市公司在面临负面ESG事件时的沟通策略提供参考；（4）提示监管机构关于ESG信息披露和媒体报道环境对市场效率的影响。

title: Automated ICCS Coding of German Police Reports: Distilling a Student against a Teacher, and the Structure of the Residual Error
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Automated ICCS Coding of German Police Reports: Distilling a Student against a Teacher, and the Structure of the Residual Error
detail.abstract: National statistical offices code free-text crime reports into the UN International Classification of Crime for Statistical Purposes (ICCS). In our production system a large language model of 120 billion parameters reads the 33,000-token ICCS manual with each report, codes it five times, and keeps the codes most runs agree on. This is far too expensive at scale, so we asked whether a smaller model could do it. We used it to code about 13,500 German police reports, then trained models of 0.07 to 20B on its codes, from two families, encoders and decoders. Encoders classify a report by picking codes from a fixed list. Decoders write the codes out as text. Neither is given the manual. On 2,016 held-out reports, the four encoders, spanning 67M to 335M parameters, all landed between 55.2% and 59.4% of reports coded exactly, while decoders reached 66.6% at 1.5B and 73.5% at 9B. The smallest decoder runs on ordinary hardware and stayed closer to the reference than any encoder. The remaining errors are mostly near misses in the right branch, where the report never states the fact a code depends on, such as whether a burgled dwelling was permanent. Coding it requires an assumption.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了用较小语言模型替代120B参数大模型进行犯罪报告ICCS编码的可能性。通过对比编码器（encoder）和解码器（decoder）两个模型家族、从0.07B到20B不同规模的模型，发现解码器在1.5B参数时达到66.6%的精确编码率，9B参数时达到73.5%，均优于编码器（55.2%-59.4%），且最小规模的解码器可在普通硬件上运行。
AI.research_question: 能否用更小规模的语言模型替代120B参数的巨型模型进行犯罪报告的ICCS编码，在保持编码准确率的同时大幅降低计算成本？
AI.motivation: 现有的生产系统使用1200亿参数的大语言模型对犯罪报告进行ICCS编码，每次编码需要读取33,000个token的ICCS手册并重复编码五次，成本过高，无法大规模应用。因此需要探索更小、更具成本效益的替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于编码器-解码器架构的语言模型分类/生成范式对比。编码器模型从固定代码列表中分类选择，解码器模型以文本形式生成代码输出。
AI.method: 使用120B模型对约13,500份德国警察报告进行编码生成训练数据，然后训练0.07B到20B参数规模的编码器和解码器两类模型。在2,016份保留报告上进行评估，比较精确编码率（exact coding rate）。
AI.findings: （1）四个编码器（67M-335M参数）精确编码率为55.2%-59.4%；（2）解码器在1.5B达到66.6%、9B达到73.5%；（3）最小解码器可在普通硬件运行且优于所有编码器；（4）剩余错误多为"近失"（near miss），即报告文本未明确说明编码所需的事实细节（如被盗住宅是否为永久居住），编码需要假设推断。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在结构化文本分类任务中，解码器架构相比编码器架构具有显著优势，即使模型更小也能超越大参数编码器。同时指出了文本生成式任务与分类式任务在利用上下文知识方面的本质差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一条低成本、可扩展的犯罪报告自动编码路径：小规模解码器模型即可在普通硬件上运行并达到较高编码准确率，支持国家统计机构大规模部署刑事案件统计编码系统。

title: Climate Policy at the Fiscal Limit: Sovereign Risk and the Carbon Laffer Curve

detail.title: Climate Policy at the Fiscal Limit: Sovereign Risk and the Carbon Laffer Curve

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. Part of this research was conducted during the author's internship at Deutsche Bundesbank. The views expressed are those of the author and do not reflect those of Deutsche Bundesbank or BI Norwegian Business School.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involves no human participants or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author is supported by a PhD position at BI Norwegian Business School. Early work on this project was carried out during the author's internship at Deutsche Bundesbank.

detail.abstract: Climate policy is typically studied under financing assumptions that abstract from fiscal limits. I show that whether carbon taxes and green subsidies differ in their macroeconomic effects depends on how they are financed rather than on the instruments themselves. Under a balanced budget, the offsetting adjustment of distortionary taxation makes both instruments equivalent in aggregate. Once the government can borrow and default is possible, carbon tax revenue relaxes the repayment constraint and lowers default risk, whereas the subsidy obligation raises it, with default risk and the debt-to-GDP ratio moving in opposite directions. Because carbon tax revenue follows a Laffer curve, default risk is non-monotonic in climate ambition under national financing. Under optimal borrowing, the default-minimizing carbon tax has a closed form that depends only on the abatement technology, nearly coincides with the revenue-maximizing rate, and is the rate at which the fiscal transmission of policy uncertainty vanishes to first order. Supranational financing restores equivalence by decoupling climate policy from national repayment obligations. All mechanisms survive in a general equilibrium model with long-term debt calibrated to the euro area.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在财政约束（特别是政府违约风险）下，碳税与绿色补贴的宏观经济效应差异。研究发现，两者的效应差异取决于融资方式而非政策工具本身：在平衡预算下两者等价；在允许借贷和违约的情况下，碳税收入降低违约风险而补贴义务提高违约风险；超国家融资可恢复两者等价性。
AI.research_question: 在财政约束和违约风险存在的情况下，碳税与绿色补贴的宏观经济效应是否不同？这种差异取决于什么因素？
AI.motivation: 现有气候政策研究通常假设融资不受财政限制，忽略了政府面临的实际财政约束与违约风险。本文旨在填补这一空白，探究财政融资方式如何影响气候政策的宏观经济效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政理论、公共债务与主权违约理论、拉弗曲线理论
AI.method: 理论建模与校准的一般均衡模型。构建包含政府借贷与违约可能性的模型框架，分析碳税与绿色补贴在不同融资安排下的效应，并用欧元区长期债务数据进行校准。
AI.findings: （1）平衡预算下，碳税与绿色补贴在宏观上等价；（2）政府可借贷且存在违约风险时，碳税收入降低违约风险，补贴义务提高违约风险；（3）碳税收入遵循拉弗曲线，国家融资下违约风险随气候雄心非单调变化；（4）最优借贷下，违约最小化碳税率有闭式解，仅取决于减排技术，接近收入最大化税率；（5）超国家融资恢复两者等价性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将财政约束与主权违约风险纳入气候政策分析，揭示政策工具与融资方式的交互作用，拓展了气候财政政策理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者选择碳税与绿色补贴的组合及融资安排提供理论指导，尤其是针对欧元区等有主权债务风险的地区。

title: Large Zombies, Small Victims: Evidence on Congestion Effects from Population-Level Data
affiliations: The Bank of Korea

detail.title: Large Zombies, Small Victims: Evidence on Congestion Effects from Population-Level Data
