title: Audit-Closed AI Scientist Protocol
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Audit-Closed AI Scientist Protocol

publicationDetails.detailsText: Takahashi, K. (2026). Audit-Closed AI Scientist Protocol. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18728589

detail.abstract: AI scientist systems and self-driving laboratories require governance protocols that are statistically valid under continuous monitoring, auditable without privileged operators, and robust to physical-world failure modes. We present an audit-closed protocol in which every decision is a deterministic function of a public transparency log, with all semantic claims grounded in explicitly declared observable contexts. The formal core integrates typed stochastic observation interfaces, tolerance-aware predictive semantics, and non-vacuous coherence auditing on finite acyclic proof graphs. To resolve the deterministic-pipeline tension, we combine explicit deterministic-depth controls with a Lipschitz observation-translation theorem that converts latent Wasserstein closeness into observable totalvariation guarantees. For sequential inference we use always-valid e-processes with gate-wise alpha accounting, robust score sanitization plus integrity monitoring, and anti-griefing novelty dynamics with signal-qualified eligible-cost updates. For adaptive experimentation we provide two regimes: a conservative fixed-ratio IPS test and a variance-adaptive predictable betting process that preserves optionalstopping validity while avoiding high-ratio evidence paralysis. For physical deployment we introduce hierarchical primary/secondary sentinels, spoofing-aware coherence gates, and auditable calibration transitions that separate sensor aging from sentinel degradation. For long-horizon autonomy we use drift-mode state transitions, exogenous-only root-memory decay, and subgraph-local fault localization with familywise error control. We prove system-level guarantees covering adaptive optional stopping, variance-adaptive evidence growth, Byzantineresilient aggregation, legal-spam stability, drift-localization safety, and mixture re-anchoring coherence. A fully reproducible synthetic benchmark confirms improved availability under outliers, high-ratio contextual exploration, root-debt erosion attacks, and sentinel aging while maintaining conservative false-acceptance behavior; the released manifest includes cryptographic digests and an automatic manuscript-value consistency check.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"审计闭合"（audit-closed）的AI科学家系统与自动驾驶实验室治理协议，所有决策均为公共透明度日志的确定性函数，结合类型化随机观测接口、容忍感知预测语义和有限无环证明图上的非空洞一致性审计，为连续监控下的统计有效性与可审计性提供系统级保证。
AI.research_question: 如何在连续监控、无特权操作者审计、物理世界失败模式下，设计统计有效且可审计的AI科学家系统与自动驾驶实验室治理协议？
AI.motivation: 现有AI科学家系统和自动驾驶实验室缺乏在连续监控下统计有效、无需特权操作者即可审计、且对物理世界失败具有鲁棒性的治理协议。需要解决确定性流程与统计推断之间的张力，以及适应性实验、物理部署和长时程自主中的多重挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: e-process（始终有效过程）、Lipschitz观测翻译定理、Wasserstein距离与total variation之间的转换、IPS测试、可预测投注过程、可选停止有效性、拜占庭鲁棒聚合、族系错误控制（FWER）
AI.method: 形式化的审计闭合协议，包括：确定性深度控制与Lipschitz观测翻译定理；用于序列推断的始终有效e-process与门控α分配、鲁棒评分消毒和完整性监控；自适应实验的保守固定比率IPS检验与方差自适应可预测投注过程；物理部署的分层主/次哨兵、防欺骗一致性门和可审计校准转换；长时程自主的漂移模式状态转换、外生根记忆衰减和子图局部故障定位。最终通过完全可复现的合成基准进行验证。
AI.findings: 合成基准证实了协议在异常值、高比率上下文探索、根债侵蚀攻击和哨兵老化场景下具有改进的可用性，同时维持保守的误接受行为；发布的清单包含密码学摘要和自动手稿值一致性检查。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将审计闭合概念形式化为公共透明度日志上确定性决策的协议框架；提出Lipschitz观测翻译定理将潜在Wasserstein接近性转化为可观测的total variation保证；系统级保证覆盖自适应可选停止、方差自适应证据增长、拜占庭鲁棒聚合、法律垃圾信息稳定性、漂移定位安全性及混合重新锚定一致性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接部署的治理协议框架，包含分层哨兵机制、可审计校准转换、子图局部故障定位等实用工具；发布的合成基准和包含密码学摘要的清单使社区能够复现和验证结果；解决了实际部署中传感器老化与哨兵退化的区分问题。

title: Energy Consumption Across the Generative Artificial Intelligence Lifecycle
affiliations: Ahsanullah University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Energy Consumption Across the Generative Artificial Intelligence Lifecycle
detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence depends on a large technical lifecycle that begins before public release and continues after deployment. The environmental impact of AI is therefore not limited to one stage, such as model training. It is shaped by the full process of data collection, data preprocessing, model training, fine-tuning, deployment, and real-world inference.

AI.tldr: 本文指出生成式人工智能的环境影响贯穿其完整技术生命周期，从数据收集、预处理、模型训练、微调、部署到实际推理，而不仅仅是模型训练这一单一阶段。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能的环境影响如何在完整的技术生命周期中体现？
AI.motivation: 现有研究往往只关注AI模型训练阶段的环境影响，忽视了AI环境影响的全局性和全过程性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术生命周期理论（涵盖数据收集、数据预处理、模型训练、微调、部署和推理等阶段）
AI.method: 概念性/综述性分析，从全生命周期视角审视AI的环境影响
AI.findings: AI的环境影响由数据收集、数据预处理、模型训练、微调、部署和实际推理的全过程共同塑造，不应仅局限于模型训练阶段。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI环境影响的分析框架从单一阶段拓展至全技术生命周期，强调了被忽视的前期（数据准备）和后期（部署与推理）阶段的环境成本。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI开发者和政策制定者提供了更全面的环境影响评估视角，有助于在全生命周期各环节采取针对性的减排和可持续措施。

title: Artificial Intelligence-driven Business Intelligence: Applications, Frameworks, and the Enhancement of Organizational Decision-making

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence-driven Business Intelligence: Applications, Frameworks, and the Enhancement of Organizational Decision-making

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interes.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable - this study is a literature review and did not involve human participants or primary data collection.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
The convergence of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Business Intelligence (BI) is reshaping how organizations collect, process, and act upon data. Traditional BI systems — built around static dashboards, scheduled batch processing, and historical reporting — are increasingly unable to meet the speed and complexity demands of modern, data-intensive markets. This paper presents a structured literature review of how AI technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, predictive analytics, and generative AI, are being integrated into BI platforms to strengthen organizational decision-making. 

Drawing on a purposively assembled set of peer-reviewed journal articles, foundational texts, and authoritative industry reports published primarily between 2015 and 2024, the review synthesizes the literature thematically across eight domains: the evolution of business intelligence, the limitations of traditional BI systems, the core AI technologies entering BI environments, commercial platform integration, predictive forecasting, decision automation, retail and e-commerce applications, and ethical considerations. A comparative framework contrasting Traditional BI and AI-Driven BI across ten dimensions is developed from this synthesis, supported by three illustrative organizational examples (Amazon, Netflix, and Walmart) drawn from public corporate disclosures and prior published case research. 

The review identifies nine priority research gaps — most notably the underrepresentation of small and medium enterprises (SMEs), the immaturity of generative AI research in BI contexts, the absence of a unified theoretical framework, and a pronounced research deficit in developing-economy and South Asian settings — and proposes a conceptual model specifying the technological inputs, the mediating role of the BI platform layer, the organizational outcomes most associated with AI-BI adoption, and the moderating conditions (data quality, human expertise, organizational culture) that the literature suggests but has not yet rigorously tested. The paper concludes with theoretical, managerial, and policy implications and a future research agenda, including the rationale for a proposed Master's-level study examining AI-BI adoption in Indian and BRICS enterprise contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结构化文献综述，系统梳理了AI技术与商业智能（BI）的融合如何提升组织决策能力，跨越八个主题领域进行综合，开发了传统BI与AI驱动BI的十维度比较框架，识别了九大研究空白，并提出了包含技术输入、BI平台中介作用、组织产出及调节条件的概念模型。
AI.research_question: AI技术（包括机器学习、自然语言处理、预测分析和生成式AI）如何被整合到BI平台中以强化组织决策，以及这一整合过程存在哪些研究空白和理论缺口？
AI.motivation: 传统BI系统基于静态仪表盘、定期批处理和 历史报告，已无法满足现代数据密集型市场对速度和复杂性的要求，需要系统梳理AI-BI融合的文献现状与研究缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献综述采用主题综合方法，跨越八大领域（BI演进、传统BI局限、进入BI环境的核心AI技术、商业平台整合、预测性预报、决策自动化、零售电商应用、伦理考量），并构建传统BI与AI驱动BI的十维度比较框架及概念模型（涉及技术输入、BI平台中介、组织产出与调节条件）。
AI.method: 目的性抽样选取同行评审期刊文章、基础文本和权威行业报告（主要为2015-2024年间发表），进行结构化文献综述；通过主题综合法分析文献；构建比较框架和概念模型；辅以三个组织案例（Amazon、Netflix、Walmart）进行说明。
AI.findings: 识别了九大优先研究空白，最显著包括：中小企业代表性不足、BI情境下生成式AI研究不成熟、缺乏统一理论框架、发展中经济体和南亚地区研究赤字明显；提出了概念模型，指出数据质量、人类专业知识、组织文化是文献建议但尚未严格验证的调节条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出AI驱动BI与传统BI的十维度比较框架；构建了包含技术输入-平台中介-组织产出-调节条件的整合概念模型；系统化识别了九大研究空白，为后续理论构建提供了方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供AI-BI采纳的技术路径和组织条件参考；通过Amazon、Netflix、Walmart案例提供实践启示；为政策制定者提供决策参考；并提出硕士层面研究印度和BRICS企业AI-BI采纳的合理性和未来研究议程。

title: The Evolution of Student Assessment Using Technology and AI

detail.title: The Evolution of Student Assessment Using Technology and AI

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: The evolving use of Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping contemporary education by enabling more personalised, efficient, and data-driven learning environments. AI systems analyse, identify patterns, and support tailored instructional approaches. Used properly. these capabilities enhance student outcomes, streamline assessment, and reduce administrative workload through tools such as intelligent tutoring systems and automated feedback. However, the integration of AI into any curriculum also raises challenges, particularly with assessment. Few institutions have come to grips on how to effectively rise to the challenge of just how AI should be used, or not used, when determining the ability of students. This paper examines some of the pitfalls and outlines some of the ideas to address an issue that is of the utmost importance in upholding educational standards.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能在教育领域的应用及其在评估环节带来的挑战。AI虽然能提升个性化学习、效率和评估流程，但大多数机构尚未有效应对如何在学生能力评估中合理使用或不使用AI的问题。论文分析了相关陷阱并提出了一些应对思路，以维护教育标准。
AI.research_question: 如何有效应对AI在课程整合中对学生能力评估带来的挑战？机构应如何使用或限制AI来确保教育标准的维护？
AI.motivation: AI正深刻重塑当代教育，带来个性化、高效和数据驱动的学习环境，但其在评估环节的整合也引发了重大挑战。目前很少有机构能够有效应对这一问题，而评估是维护教育标准的核心环节，亟需研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该摘要未明确提及特定理论框架，主要基于AI教育应用与技术整合的实践视角展开讨论。
AI.method: 本文为概念性/观点性论文，通过分析AI整合到教育评估中的陷阱（pitfalls），并概述应对思路和解决方案。
AI.findings: 论文指出了AI在教育评估中的若干陷阱，并提出了解决这些问题的一些思路，旨在帮助机构在维护教育标准的同时合理利用AI技术。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI教育评估领域的实践提供了分析框架，明确了评估环节中AI使用的关键争议点，丰富了AI与教育标准关系的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构和政策制定者提供了在评估中合理运用或限制AI的实践建议，有助于在保持教育质量标准的前提下应对AI带来的挑战。

title: AI Before 16 - Protecting Children's Thinking, Learning and Human Development in the AI Era

detail.title: AI Before 16 - Protecting Children's Thinking, Learning and Human Development in the AI Era
detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence is entering children's educational and everyday environments faster than long-term evidence and governance arrangements are developing. Generative AI can explain, translate, write, calculate and solve problems within seconds. These capabilities create substantial educational opportunities, but they also raise a developmental question: What happens when technology performs cognitive work that children are still learning to perform themselves?

This conceptual review examines recent international evidence concerning children's digital exposure, artificial intelligence, sleep, attention, executive function, problematic gaming, ADHD and learning. It also considers the emerging policy movement towards age-appropriate restrictions on AI and digital technologies. The paper does not argue that AI or screen exposure causes ADHD, nor does it equate digital technology with substance use. Instead, it examines whether excessive or poorly governed digital engagement can interact with existing attentional vulnerabilities, disrupt sleep, encourage problematic behavioural patterns and reduce opportunities for independent cognitive practice.

The paper introduces Digital Childhood Governance (DCG) as the proposed Layer 5 of Bakr Governance Theory. DCG moves beyond simple screen-time limits by asking how children's digital environments are structured, when technology is used, what purpose it serves, what behaviour it encourages, and which human activities it may displace. The paper argues for balanced governance rather than blanket prohibition, seeking to preserve the educational benefits of technology while protecting sleep, independent thinking, learning, relationships, cultural identity and human agency. In doing so, the paper extends the earlier BGT layers of failure, design, execution and infrastructure into human cognitive governance.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇概念性综述，探讨人工智能和数字技术对儿童睡眠、注意力、执行功能、问题性游戏、ADHD及学习的影响。论文提出"数字童年治理"(DCG)作为Bakr治理理论的第五层，主张平衡治理而非全面禁止，在保留技术教育益处的同时保护儿童的睡眠、独立思考、学习、人际关系、文化认同和人类自主性。
AI.research_question: 当技术执行儿童尚在学习中的认知工作时，会发生什么？过度或治理不善的数字参与是否会与现有注意力脆弱性相互作用、扰乱睡眠、鼓励问题行为模式并减少独立认知练习的机会？
AI.motivation: 人工智能进入儿童教育和日常环境的速度快于长期证据和治理安排的发展。生成式AI能在几秒内解释、翻译、写作、计算和解决问题，创造了巨大的教育机会，但也引发了关于技术执行儿童认知工作的发展性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: Bakr治理理论（BGT），包括治理失败层、设计层、执行层和基础设施层。本文提出将其扩展至第五层——"数字童年治理"(Digital Childhood Governance, DCG)，涵盖人类认知治理。
AI.method: 概念性综述（Conceptual Review），检视关于儿童数字暴露、人工智能、睡眠、注意力、执行功能、问题性游戏、ADHD和学习的最新国际证据，并考虑针对AI和数字技术的适龄限制政策动向。
AI.findings: 论文不主张AI或屏幕暴露导致ADHD，也不将数字技术与物质使用等同。但认为过度或治理不善的数字参与可能与现有注意力脆弱性相互作用、扰乱睡眠、鼓励问题行为模式并减少独立认知练习的机会。主张通过DCG框架实现平衡治理而非全面禁止。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Bakr治理理论从失败、设计、执行和基础设施四个层面扩展至第五层——人类认知治理（Digital Childhood Governance），超越了简单的屏幕时间限制，通过考察数字环境的构建方式、使用时间、目的、鼓励的行为和可能取代的人类活动来推进理论发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为儿童数字环境的治理提供了DCG实践框架，帮助政策制定者和教育者在保留技术教育益处的同时，保护儿童的睡眠、独立思维、学习、人际关系、文化认同和人类自主性，并支持适龄限制AI和数字技术的政策运动。

title: A Quantitative Study Informing Digital Health Pre-Acceptance in Respiratory Medicine: An Irish Perspective"
affiliations: Technological University of the Shannon, Technological University of the Shannon, Technological University of the Shannon and Technological University of the Shannon

detail.title: A Quantitative Study Informing Digital Health Pre-Acceptance in Respiratory Medicine: An Irish Perspective"

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that the research was conducted in the absence of any commercial or financial relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was first sought from the Technological University of the Shannon Research Ethics Committee, and upon gaining approval then ethical permission was sought from clinical sites. Participants provided written informed consent
declarations.funderStatement: Not applicable

detail.abstract:
Introduction; Digital health technology (DHT) is increasingly being integrated into healthcare delivery; however, limited research exists exploring the pre-acceptability of DHT among ageing respiratory patients. This study aimed to identify the factors influencing the pre-acceptability of digital health technology in individuals with chronic respiratory disease in Ireland.

Methods: A quantitative study was conducted among respiratory service users attending two respiratory centres in the Midlands and West of Ireland. A convenience-based questionnaire was developed and distributed, which was informed by prior Phase 1 qualitative findings that adopted the Technology Acceptance Model and the Health Belief Model.Data were analysed using non-parametric statistical methods, including the Mann–Whitney U test, to explore differences between gender and geographical location (urban/rural). 

Results: Fifty-eight participants completed the study. Overall, participants demonstrated positive perceptions toward the use of DHT, particularly regarding support for self-management, hospital admission avoidance, increased symptom awareness, and enhanced engagement with healthcare professionals. Perceived usefulness emerged as a significant factor influencing acceptability. Concerns regarding privacy, data security, and digital literacy were less significant than anticipated. Statistical differences were identified between urban and rural participants in relation to perceived usefulness, technology design preferences, feedback functionality, and preference for reduction in face-to-face appointments. No significant differences were identified between male and female participants. 

Conclusions: This study demonstrates that ageing respiratory patients in Ireland are receptive to the integration of digital health technology provided that technologies are perceived as useful, userfriendly, and supportive rather than replacements for healthcare professionals. The findings highlight the importance of involving service users during the design phase of DHT and recognising geographical differences in perspectives toward technology adoption. These findings may inform future policy, service development, and digital health implementation strategies nationally and internationally.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了爱尔兰慢性呼吸系统疾病老年患者对数字健康技术的预接受度，发现患者总体持积极态度，感知有用性是影响接受度的关键因素，城乡差异显著而性别差异不显著。
AI.research_question: 影响爱尔兰慢性呼吸系统疾病老年患者对数字健康技术预接受度的因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 数字健康技术日益融入医疗服务，但关于老年呼吸系统疾病患者对数字健康技术预接受度的研究十分有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受模型（Technology Acceptance Model）与健康信念模型（Health Belief Model）
AI.method: 定量研究，采用便利抽样问卷调查（基于第一阶段质性研究结果开发），数据使用非参数统计方法（Mann-Whitney U检验）分析性别和地理位置（城市/农村）之间的差异。
AI.findings: 58名参与者总体对数字健康技术持积极态度，尤其在自我管理支持、避免住院、症状意识和与医疗专业人员互动方面。感知有用性是显著的影响因素。隐私、数据安全和数字素养的担忧低于预期。城市和农村参与者在感知有用性、技术设计偏好、反馈功能和减少面对面就诊偏好上存在显著差异，性别间无显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了技术接受模型和健康信念模型在老年慢性呼吸系统疾病患者数字健康技术预接受度领域的应用，揭示了感知有用性作为核心驱动因素，并识别了地理因素（城乡差异）作为影响技术接受的重要调节变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字健康技术的设计、政策制定和实施方案提供实证依据，强调在设计阶段纳入服务使用者参与，并认识到城乡差异对技术采纳的影响，可指导国内外的数字健康实施策略。

title: NMU: One Character, One Identity A Static Character-Identity Substrate and Character-level Characterisation of an Indonesian Corpus
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: NMU: One Character, One Identity A Static Character-Identity Substrate and Character-level Characterisation of an Indonesian Corpus
detail.abstract: We describe NMU (NINMENI Meaning Unit), a representation substrate in which every Unicode code point in a declared, normalised character stream is assigned exactly one fixed identity, with no unknown-identity fallback and no frequency threshold for inclusion. Here character means a Unicode code point after newline canonicalisation and NFC normalisation, not a user-perceived grapheme cluster. The substrate is bound to a registry of 10,240 identity slots by SHA-256. We then report a sampled characterisation of an Indonesian training split computed entirely by counting; no information-theoretic quantity is used anywhere in this work. Two measurements are reported. First, the distribution of document lengths, read character-weighted as well as per record: the per-record median is 238 characters, but the character-weighted median is 4,285, and 79.64% of sampled content characters reside in documents longer than 2,048 characters. Second, among admitted within-shard repeated occurrences of identical character strings, the median re-use distance is 263 characters for k = 32, 1,822 for k = 16, and 16,758 for k = 8. Because occurrence history is reset at shard boundaries, these are shard-local statistics rather than estimates of the corresponding corpus-wide fractions. We make no capability claim and no matched comparative claim. The contribution is an explicit fixed character-identity contract and a registry-scoped corpus characterisation; a global novelty claim is withheld pending a reproducible literature-review protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NMU（NINMENI意义单元），一种表示基片（representation substrate），为标准化字符流中的每个Unicode码点分配固定身份，通过SHA-256绑定到10,240个身份槽的注册表。基于此基片，作者对印度尼西亚语训练集进行了纯计数的字符级统计表征，报告了文档长度分布和重复字符串重用距离两个测量结果。作者明确不作任何能力声明或对比性声明。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个固定的字符身份契约（通过哈希绑定的注册表），并在此基础上对大规模语料进行纯计数式的字符级统计表征？
AI.motivation: 现有的文本表示和语料表征方法常依赖频率阈值、信息论度量或未知身份回退机制，缺乏固定的、不可变的字符身份契约。本文旨在提供一个无回退、无频率阈值的确定性字符身份基片，为后续可复现的语料分析奠定基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文不依赖信息论框架。核心概念包括：NFC标准化的Unicode码点定义、SHA-256哈希绑定身份槽机制、以及基于计数（counting）的统计表征方法。
AI.method: （1）定义NMU基片：每个标准化Unicode码点通过SHA-256绑定到10,240个身份槽之一，无未知身份回退、无频率阈值。（2）对印度尼西亚语训练集进行纯计数统计：测量文档长度分布（按记录和按字符加权两种方式）以及分片内重复字符串的重用距离（k=8,16,32）。
AI.findings: （1）文档长度分布：按记录中位数为238字符，按字符加权中位数为4,285字符，79.64%的内容字符处于超过2,048字符的文档中。（2）重复字符串重用距离：k=32时中位数为263字符，k=16时为1,822字符，k=8时为16,758字符。这些是分片局部统计量而非全局估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种明确的固定字符身份契约（NMU），建立了哈希绑定身份槽的表示基片框架，为语料统计提供无信息论依赖的确定性基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了印度尼西亚语训练集的字符级统计表征数据，包括文档长度分布的记录加权与字符加权对比，以及重复字符串重用距离的多尺度测量，为语料库构建和数据去重策略提供参考。

title: Bridging the Gap: A Conceptual Analysis of Cross-Unit Patient Flow Coordination in Hospital Operations
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Bridging the Gap: A Conceptual Analysis of Cross-Unit Patient Flow Coordination in Hospital Operations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the sole developer of the RUISA framework described in this paper and has filed a U.S. copyright deposit and pursued trademark registration related to RUISA. The author is also engaged in independent commercial and consulting activities associated with RUISA, including a personal website and related products. This interest is disclosed in the interest of transparency; the author declares no other financial or personal relationships that could have inappropriately influenced the development of this conceptual paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a conceptual framework analysis and does not include patient-level data, participant data, institutional data, or identifiable clinical case material. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Cross-unit patient flow is one of the most persistent sources of operational instability in hospital systems. Admissions, discharges, transfers, and bed readiness depend on coordination across emergency, inpatient, intensive care, and support-service units that frequently operate with separate information sources, separate priorities, and no shared command structure. This conceptual paper applies RUISA™-an operational coherence framework organized around five connected elements: Roles, Users, Information, Situation, and Actions-to the specific problem of cross-unit patient flow coordination. RUISA™ is proposed as a conceptual coordination layer that helps hospital systems read flow pressure, detect separation between units, prioritize risk, coordinate cross-unit users, and convert fragmented signals into coordinated action. The paper identifies common cross-unit failure points, outlines a practical coordination cycle, and discusses implications for hospital operations, digital dashboard design, and future research. This analysis does not present patient-level data or institutional outcomes; it offers a conceptual structure intended to inform further evaluation and context-specific adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将RUISA™运营一致性框架应用于医院跨单元患者流动协调问题，旨在解决医院系统中最持久的运营不稳定来源之一。该概念性论文将五个相互关联的要素（角色、用户、信息、情境、行动）作为概念协调层，帮助医院系统读取流动压力、检测单元间隔离、优先级排序风险、协调跨单元用户，并将碎片化信号转化为协调行动。
AI.research_question: 如何将RUISA™运营一致性框架应用于解决医院跨单元患者流动协调问题，以改善医院系统的运营稳定性？
AI.motivation: 医院跨单元患者流动（入院、出院、转科、床位准备）涉及急诊、住院、重症监护和支持服务等多个单元的协调，但这些单元往往使用独立的信息源、独立的优先级，且缺乏共享指挥结构，导致运营不稳定。这一问题亟需一个概念性协调框架来指导改进。
AI.theoretical_framework: RUISA™运营一致性框架，围绕五个相互连接的要素构建：角色（Roles）、用户（Users）、信息（Information）、情境（Situation）和行动（Actions）。
AI.method: 概念性论文方法：运用RUISA™框架对跨单元患者流动协调问题进行理论分析和概念构建，识别常见的跨单元失败点，概述实用的协调周期。
AI.findings: 论文识别了常见的跨单元失败点，概述了一个实用的协调周期，并讨论了RUISA™框架对医院运营、数字仪表板设计以及未来研究的影响。该框架能帮助医院系统读取流动压力、检测单元间分离、进行风险优先级排序、协调跨单元用户，并将碎片化信号转化为协调行动。
AI.theory_contributions: 为医院运营管理提供了一个新的概念性协调框架（RUISA™），将运营一致性理念系统性地应用于跨单元患者流动这一此前缺乏整合理论框架的具体问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医院管理者提供了识别跨单元协调失败点的结构性工具、可操作的协调周期指导，以及对数字仪表板设计的启示，有助于改善跨单元患者流动的运营效率和稳定性。

title: Healthcare System Challenges in Government Medical Hospitals in Bangladesh
affiliations: Ahsanullah University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Healthcare System Challenges in Government Medical Hospitals in Bangladesh
detail.abstract:
This study examines the major challenges affecting government medical hospitals in Bangladesh and explores how human resource management can help address them. The study focuses on employee health and hygiene, waste management, infrastructure, staffing, leadership, training, staff engagement, and ethical responsibility. It first reviewed newspaper-based reports covering 37 medical hospitals and extracted 104 participant statements. These statements were used to identify key challenges and their root causes. A questionnaire was then developed, and responses from 12 healthcare professionals were used to validate the findings.

The findings show that employee health, well-being, and hygiene was the most common challenge, followed by waste management and environmental health and workplace environment and infrastructure. The survey also revealed serious concerns about overcrowding, staff shortages, high workloads, inconsistent infection-control practices, limited hygiene awareness, and shortages of medicines and supplies. The study applies the Harvard Model of HRM to connect these problems with stakeholder interests, situational factors, HR policy choices, HR outcomes, and long-term consequences. Based on this framework, the study recommends stronger staff training, improved infrastructure and hygiene, safer waste management, better workforce planning, accountable leadership, and stronger ethical practices. These changes can improve employee performance, patient care, service quality, and public trust in government healthcare facilities.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察了孟加拉国政府医疗医院面临的主要挑战，并探讨人力资源管理如何应对这些挑战。通过审查覆盖37家医院的报纸报道提取104条参与者陈述，识别关键挑战及其根源，并通过12名医疗专业人员的问卷验证。研究发现员工健康、福祉和卫生是最常见挑战，其次为废物管理、环境健康及工作场所环境和基础设施。研究运用哈佛人力资源管理模型将问题与利益相关者、情境因素、HR政策选择、HR结果和长期后果联系起来，并提出培训、基础设施、废物管理、人力规划、领导力和伦理实践方面的改进建议。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国政府医疗医院面临的主要挑战是什么？人力资源管理如何帮助解决这些挑战？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国政府医疗医院面临多重重大挑战，影响员工绩效、患者护理和公众信任，亟需系统性地识别这些挑战并通过人力资源管理框架提出解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 哈佛人力资源管理模型（Harvard Model of HRM），该模型将问题与利益相关者利益、情境因素、HR政策选择、HR结果和长期后果联系起来。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：首先审查覆盖37家医疗医院的报纸报道，提取104条参与者陈述以识别关键挑战及根源；随后开发问卷，收集12名医疗专业人员的反馈以验证研究发现。
AI.findings: 员工健康、福祉和卫生是最常见挑战，其次是废物管理和环境健康、工作场所环境和基础设施。调查还揭示了对过度拥挤、人员短缺、高工作量、感染控制实践不一致、卫生意识有限以及药品和物资短缺的严重关切。
AI.theory_contributions: 将哈佛人力资源管理模型应用于政府医疗医院情境，系统地将医院面临的运营挑战与HR政策选择及长期后果联系起来，扩展了HRM理论在公共医疗部门的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国政府医疗医院提出具体改进建议，包括加强员工培训、改善基础设施和卫生条件、更安全的废物管理、更好的劳动力规划、负责任的领导力和更强的伦理实践，以提升员工绩效、患者护理、服务质量和公众信任。

title: Manufactured Stupidity as the Third Level of Brain Rot
affiliations: Phenikaa University and Widya Mandala Surabaya Catholic University

detail.title: Manufactured Stupidity as the Third Level of Brain Rot
detail.abstract: Nearly every AI model now warns its user, in some form, that it can be wrong. This note treats that warning as a symptom of a third, most consequential level of intellectual delegation, in which a person hands over not just thinking but checking to a machine while remaining confident in their own intelligence. A short argument first establishes why modest usefulness costs strictly more than grand uselessness, in both entropy and effort. A coverage bound then shows the checked fraction of AI-assisted output collapsing toward zero as volume grows, independent of diligence (Vuong, 2026a, Prop. 3). A cubic captureand-hysteresis model, completing a hypothesis a companion note left explicitly tentative, shows lapsed vigilance is harder to recover than it was to lose. A proficiency/effectiveness decoupling result then shows visible polish and genuine understanding drifting apart without anyone deciding this should happen. A closing corollary identifies the resulting absorbing state exactly with the grand uselessness established at the outset, and Kingfisher-style "relearning to be stupid" with the activation cost of modest usefulness. None of the results is new; the contribution, if any, is the mapping.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI辅助认知的一个深层问题：当人们将思考与检查都委托给AI时，会产生一种"第三种智力委托"现象。论文通过信息论论证、覆盖界、三次方捕获-滞后模型等数学工具，表明AI辅助输出中被人工检查的比例会随产出量增长而趋近于零，且警觉性的丧失比恢复更容易。最终将这种"有效愚蠢"状态锁定为一种吸收态，而"重新学会愚蠢"则是恢复适度有用性的激活成本。
AI.research_question: 当人类将检查（checking）也委托给AI时，这种"第三种智力委托"会产生什么样的后果？适度有用性（modest usefulness）为何比宏大无用性（grand uselessness）代价更高？
AI.motivation: 几乎所有AI模型都以某种形式警告用户它可能出错，但这种警告本身被忽视，标志着人类智力委托进入了一个更深的阶段——不仅委托思考，还委托验证。作者试图揭示这一现象背后的结构性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息论（熵与努力成本）、覆盖界（coverage bound）、三次方捕获-滞后模型（cubic capture-and-hysteresis model）、熟练度-有效性解耦（proficiency/effectiveness decoupling）
AI.method: 理论推演与数学建模相结合：首先论证适度有用性的代价高于宏大无用性；其次通过覆盖界证明被检查比例随产出量增大趋零；再次用三次方捕获-滞后模型刻画警觉性丧失的不可逆性；最后用解耦结果说明表面打磨与真正理解的分离。
AI.findings: （1）适度有用性在熵和努力上严格高于宏大无用性；（2）AI辅助输出中被检查的比例随产出量增长指数式塌缩至零，不受勤勉程度影响；（3）警觉性的丧失具有滞后性，恢复比失去更难；（4）外在的流畅度与内在的理解力会无可避免地漂移分离；（5）最终系统会落入"宏大无用性"这一吸收态。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的核心贡献不在于提出新结论（作者自认所有结果并非新发现），而在于将分散的数学结果系统性地映射到"智力委托"这一认知风险框架上，完成了对前作中明确标注为试探性假设的捕获-滞后模型的补全论证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI时代的人类认知管理提供了警示性框架：即使个体勤奋，在AI辅助产出规模增长的条件下，人工检查覆盖率必然趋零；恢复警觉需要付出比失去警觉高的多的"激活成本"，提示组织与个人需要主动设计防退化机制（如Kingfisher式的"重新学会愚蠢"策略）。

title: How Long Should AI Retain Your Data? Task Clocks and the Design of Data Lifetimes
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Visakhapatnam and Indian Institute of Management Raipur

detail.title: How Long Should AI Retain Your Data? Task Clocks and the Design of Data Lifetimes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No Financial relationships with any one
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is a theory and secondary data paper
declarations.funderStatement: No Funding

detail.abstract: How long should an AI system retain user data? We treat retention duration as a decision variable in the design of AI information systems. A general task-clock theorem separates two forces that are often conflated: an institutional wedge determines whether private incentives favor retaining too long or deleting too early, while a temporal clock converts that distortion into calendar days. In a transparent special case, the clock is the sum of a value-saturation rate and an exposure-growth rate. We extend the model to information lineages, showing why deleting a source record need not produce functional forgetting when embeddings, indexes, or learned influence persist, and to strategic competition in which platforms jointly choose price and retention. Competition can correct over-retention or overshoot into excessive deletion. Evidence from 85 finite retention states across 27 AI vendors, nine matched control contrasts, externally timed institutional episodes, independent data-ageing studies, and randomized choice evidence supports the observable mechanisms while preserving explicit identification boundaries. The resulting decision framework maps purpose, temporal value and risk, incentive alignment, and system architecture into state-specific time-to-live and deletion-propagation choices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI系统应保留用户数据多长时间的问题，将保留期限视为AI信息系统设计中的决策变量。作者提出一个"任务时钟定理"，区分了制度楔子（决定私人激励偏向过度保留还是过早删除）和时间时钟（将该扭曲转化为日历天数）两种力量。在透明的特例中，时钟等于价值饱和速率与暴露增长速率之和。模型还扩展到信息谱系（解释为何删除源记录不一定产生功能性遗忘）和战略竞争（平台联合选择价格与保留期）。基于27家AI供应商、85个有限保留状态、9个匹配对照、外部定时的制度事件、独立数据老化研究及随机选择证据支持了可观察机制。最终提出一个将目的、时间价值与风险、激励对齐和系统架构映射到具体状态的时间到活（TTL）和删除传播选择的决策框架。
AI.research_question: AI系统应保留用户数据多长时间？保留期限应如何作为AI信息系统设计中的一个决策变量被系统化地确定？
AI.motivation: AI系统面临的数据保留决策长期被忽视或随意处理，缺乏系统的理论框架来指导保留期限的设定。既要防止过度保留带来的隐私风险，也要避免过早删除造成的数据价值损失，需要一个统一的理论来厘清影响保留期限的各种力量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 任务时钟定理（Task-Clock Theorem）：区分制度楔子（institutional wedge）与时间时钟（temporal clock）两种力量；价值饱和速率与暴露增长速率之和构成时间时钟；信息谱系理论（information lineage）；战略竞争理论（平台联合定价与保留期选择）。
AI.method: 理论建模（任务时钟定理及多种扩展模型）+ 多种实证证据：27家AI供应商的85个有限保留状态分析、9个匹配对照实验、外部定时的制度事件研究、独立数据老化研究、随机选择证据。
AI.findings: 制度楔子决定了私人激励偏向过度保留还是过早删除；时间时钟将制度扭曲转化为具体的日历天数；在透明特例中时钟等于价值饱和速率与暴露增长速率之和；删除源记录不一定产生功能性遗忘（因嵌入、索引或学习影响持续存在）；竞争可以纠正过度保留，也可能矫枉过正导致过度删除；多种实证证据支持这些可观察机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出任务时钟定理，将数据保留期限从行政性决定提升为系统性的理论设计变量；分离了制度激励扭曲与时间转换两种常被混淆的力量；将信息谱系概念引入数据保留研究，解释了"删除≠遗忘"的机制；将竞争因素纳入保留期与定价的联合决策分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个将目的、时间价值与风险、激励对齐和系统架构映射到具体状态的时间到活（TTL）和删除传播选择的决策框架；为AI平台设计数据保留策略提供实证基础；为监管者理解数据保留激励扭曲提供理论工具；帮助企业在隐私保护与数据价值之间找到最优平衡点。

title: Experiential Costs, Facilitators, and Barriers in Virtual Hospital Care: A Qualitative Analysis of Patient and Carer Reported Experience Measures
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Macquarie University, Macquarie University Centre for the Health Economy and Macquarie University

detail.title: Experiential Costs, Facilitators, and Barriers in Virtual Hospital Care: A Qualitative Analysis of Patient and Carer Reported Experience Measures
detail.abstract: BackgroundVirtual hospitals (VHs) deliver hospital-level care in patients' homes and expanded rapidly during the COVID-19 pandemic. As these services transition into routine care, their sustainability may depend on how patients and carers experience the effort and value associated with participation.ObjectivesTo identify experiential cost domains, facilitators, and barriers in virtual hospital care and examine their implications for patient and carer engagement.Material and MethodsA theory-informed qualitative analysis, grounded in Burden of Treatment Theory and perceived value literature, examined Patient and Carer Reported Experience Measures from Australia’s first virtual hospital between 1 March 2020 and 26 August 2024. Of 4,411 free-text responses screened, 2,485 were eligible and yielded 2,698 experiential segments. Segments were classified by polarity and organised across eight experiential cost domains. Facilitator and barrier coverage was summarised at the response level, and findings were interpreted through Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology 2 (UTAUT2) and Non-adoption, Abandonment, Scale-up, Spread and Sustainability (NASSS).ResultsEight experiential cost domains were identified. Perceived value Balance was the most represented domain, followed by organisational reliability, time and coordination, technology interaction, structural and system support, cognitive and emotional load, workflow and routine fit, and direct financial cost. Time and coordination were the predominant source of burden, while perceived value balance and organisational reliability were the principal facilitators. Costs and benefits were unevenly distributed: patients often reported convenience, reassurance and perceived value, whereas carers more frequently described coordination, monitoring, and cognitive and emotional demands. Direct financial cost was infrequently reported in this publicly funded setting.ConclusionEngagement appears to depend on the balance between effort and perceived value rather than technology alone. Sustainable virtual hospital services require reliable, responsive care, reduced coordination demands, and attention to how benefits and responsibilities are distributed across stakeholders. Experiential Cost provides a useful organising concept for service design.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于治疗负担理论和感知价值文献，对澳大利亚首家虚拟医院4,411份患者和照护者的体验反馈进行定性分析，识别出八个体验成本维度，发现患者和照护者参与虚拟医院服务的可持续性取决于努力与感知价值之间的平衡，而非技术本身。
AI.research_question: 虚拟医院护理中的体验成本维度、促进因素和障碍是什么？这些因素如何影响患者和照护者的参与？
AI.motivation: 虚拟医院在COVID-19疫情期间快速扩张，正从应急服务向常规护理过渡，其可持续性可能取决于患者和照护者对参与所涉及努力与价值的体验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治疗负担理论（Burden of Treatment Theory）、感知价值文献、UTAUT2（技术接受与使用统一理论2）、NASSS（非采纳、放弃、扩展、推广与可持续性框架）
AI.method: 理论指导的定性分析，对2020年3月1日至2024年8月26日期间澳大利亚首家虚拟医院的患者和照护者报告体验测量数据进行筛查，从4,411份自由文本回应中筛选出2,485份合格回应，产生2,698个体验片段，按极性分类并组织为八个体验成本维度。
AI.findings: 识别出八个体验成本维度：感知价值平衡（最常被提及）、组织可靠性、时间与协调、技术交互、结构性与系统性支持、认知与情感负荷、工作流程与日常契合度、直接财务成本。时间与协调是负担的主要来源；感知价值平衡和组织可靠性是主要促进因素。患者和照护者之间成本与收益分布不均：患者常报告便利性、安心感和感知价值，而照护者更常描述协调、监测及认知情感需求。直接财务成本在公共资助环境中很少被报告。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"体验成本"（Experiential Cost）作为服务设计的有用组织概念，将治疗负担理论与感知价值文献整合应用于虚拟医院场景，拓展了UTAUT2和NASSS框架在医疗技术采纳与可持续性分析中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为虚拟医院服务的可持续设计提供指导：需要可靠、响应迅速的护理，减少协调需求，并关注收益和责任在不同利益相关者之间的分配。

title: Security Investment and Threshold Disclosure as a Dynamic Signaling Game: Evidence from the HHS OCR Breach Portal
affiliations: and

detail.title: Security Investment and Threshold Disclosure as a Dynamic Signaling Game: Evidence from the HHS OCR Breach Portal
detail.abstract: Healthcare has been the costliest industry for data breaches for fourteen consecutive years, yet whether HITECH's mandatory 500-record disclosure rule disciplines security investment or merely reshapes reporting remains largely untested. We develop a dynamic signaling/moralhazard model in which a healthcare organization privately knows its security-investment type, chooses investment, and reports under genuine uncertainty about a breach's true scope by a statutory deadline; a regulator observes only the reported figure and sets investigation duration in response. A single forensic capacity governs whether a breach is detected in time to be filed at all and how precisely its scope can be characterized, so the disclosure regime taxes the very monitoring investment it presupposes. The model yields five propositions, tested against the full HHS OCR breach panel matched to CMS ownership data and to hospitals' Meaningful Use attestation histories, a direct behavioral measure of accumulated IT capacity. Investment rises with type. Floor-value reporting declines with accumulated EHR capacity, most strongly among government-affiliated hospitals, while current capacity predicts more, not fewer, filings, the joint signature of a detection margin operating alongside a precision channel. Floor-value reports are far more likely to remain under investigation, a rational consequence of Bayesian updating, not manipulation. Apparent threshold-gaming partly reflects genuine information constraints, not only deliberate suppression, and disclosure design that ignores the detection margin discourages monitoring precisely where capacity is lowest.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了HITECH法案下500条记录强制披露规则对医疗机构安全投资的影响。作者构建了一个动态信号/道德风险模型，区分了"检测边际"（决定违规是否被发现并报告）和"精确度渠道"（决定报告范围的准确性），并使用HHS OCR违规数据、CMS所有权数据和Meaningful Use认证数据验证了五个命题。
AI.research_question: HITECH法案的500条记录强制披露规则究竟是约束了医疗机构的安全投资，还是仅仅重塑了其报告行为？
AI.motivation: 医疗行业连续14年成为数据泄露成本最高的行业，但HITECH强制披露规则的实际效果——是改善安全投资还是仅仅改变报告策略——在很大程度上未经实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态信号/道德风险模型，结合贝叶斯更新理论与法医检测能力概念。
AI.method: 构建动态信号/道德风险理论模型，推导五个命题，并使用HHS OCR完整违规面板数据、CMS所有权数据以及医院Meaningful Use认证历史（作为累计IT能力的直接行为测量）进行实证检验。
AI.findings: (1) 投资随机构类型递增； (2) 最低值报告（floor-value reporting）随累计EHR能力增加而减少，在政府关联医院中最为显著； (3) 当前能力预测更多而非更少的申报，体现出检测边际与精确度渠道的联合效应； (4) 最低值报告更可能处于调查中，这是贝叶斯更新的理性结果而非操纵； (5) 表面上的门槛操控部分反映了真实的信息约束，而非仅是有意的隐瞒；忽视检测边际的披露设计恰恰在最不具能力的领域抑制了监控。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次区分了披露规则中的"检测边际"与"精确度渠道"两大机制；表明表观上的门槛博弈部分源于真实信息约束而非有意操纵；揭示了忽略检测边际的披露设计会在能力最低的领域阻碍监控投资。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者重新设计医疗数据泄露披露规则提供依据，表明当前的500条记录阈值规则可能适得其反，尤其是在IT能力最弱的机构中；为理解强制性披露制度的效率与局限提供实证参考。

title: Does Social Capital Matter More Than Policy Compliance in Reducing Cybersecurity Incidents?
affiliations: Florida International University (FIU), University of Oklahoma - Michael F. Price College of Business and University of Virginia - McIntire School of Commerce

detail.title: Does Social Capital Matter More Than Policy Compliance in Reducing Cybersecurity Incidents?
detail.abstract: Cybersecurity incidents endanger the strategic and operational integrity of organizations. To reduce this risk, research has focused on employee compliance with cybersecurity policies. However, evidence that higher levels of compliance result in fewer or less severe incidents is lacking. Moreover, the emphasis on compliance has neglected other factors that are more difficult to study but may play important roles. We contend that coordinating cybersecurity activities is among the most critical tasks of a cybersecurity unit, and that this task requires significant social capital. Therefore, this study estimated the effect of compliance on cybersecurity incidents and contrasted it with the effect of social capital. Following a registered report model, we conducted a paired-sample survey of cybersecurity managers and business unit managers from public U.S. companies (N = 150 dyads) that captured social capital, compliance, and the quantity and severity of cybersecurity incidents across a three-year window (2022-2024). The analysis did not provide evidence for a significant general effect of employee compliance on cybersecurity incidents. Only among smaller companies was a significant effect on severity found. In contrast, social capital demonstrated significant general effects on quantity and severity and was especially influential in organizations with above-median levels of framework adoption, cybersecurity spending, revenue, proportion of cybersecurity personnel, and top management support. These results suggest compliance impacts cybersecurity outcomes more narrowly than previously assumed. Furthermore, "soft factors" such as social capital may play a more critical role than previously thought and require additional scholarly attention.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过配对样本调查（150个企业网络安全经理与业务部门经理的对子），对比了员工合规行为与网络安全部门社会资本对网络安全事件数量及严重性的影响。结果显示，员工合规对网络安全事件总体上没有显著影响（仅在小公司中对严重性有显著影响），而社会资本在数量与严重性两方面均具有显著的一般性效应，且在框架采纳、网络安全投入、收入、网络安全人员比例及高层支持水平较高的组织中影响尤为突出。
AI.research_question: 员工对网络安全政策的合规程度与网络安全部门的社会资本，分别对网络安全事件的数量和严重性有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究聚焦于员工对网络安全政策的合规性，但缺乏证据表明更高的合规水平能带来更少或更轻的网络安全事件。同时，对合规的强调忽视了其他更难研究但可能发挥重要作用的关键因素（如社会资本）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会资本理论；网络安全合规研究
AI.method: 采用注册报告（registered report）模式，对美国上市公司进行配对样本（dyadic）调查，收集150组网络安全经理与业务部门经理的配对数据；构建社会资本、合规水平及2022-2024年三年间网络安全事件数量与严重性的变量，进行回归分析。
AI.findings: （1）员工合规对网络安全事件总体上没有显著的普遍效应，仅在小公司中对事件严重性存在显著影响；（2）社会资本对事件数量与严重性均具有显著的一般性效应；（3）社会资本在框架采纳、网络安全支出、收入、网络安全人员比例及高层支持高于中位数的组织中影响更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了现有研究对员工合规作为网络安全结果关键驱动因素的普遍假设，将社会资本这一"软因素"引入网络安全治理研究框架，扩展了对网络安全事件前因变量的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织管理者提供启示：应超越单纯的合规培训与监管，重视投资于网络安全部门的社会资本建设（如跨部门协调、信任关系与网络关系），特别是在规模较大或资源较充足的组织中，社会资本可能比合规管理更能有效降低网络安全风险。

title: Do Local Synthetic Opioid Overdose Deaths Affect Provider Prescribing of Buprenorphine?
affiliations: Indiana University - School of Public and Environmental Affairs, Indiana University, Indianapolis, Indiana University Purdue University Indianapolis (IUPUI) - Indiana University School of Medicine, Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey, Rutgers University, Rutgers University, , Indiana University and University of Southern California - Schaeffer Center for Health Policy  and Economics

detail.title: Do Local Synthetic Opioid Overdose Deaths Affect Provider Prescribing of Buprenorphine?
detail.abstract: Buprenorphine prescribing for opioid use disorder remains far below the scale of the overdose crisis. We estimate the causal effect of county-level synthetic opioid overdose mortality shocks on the volume of buprenorphine treatment delivered, exploiting the staggered geographic diffusion of synthetic opioids from 2013 to 2023. Linking IQVIA Longitudinal Prescription Claims to National Vital Statistics System mortality records, we implement a difference-in-differences estimator with propensity score matching under three complementary exposure measures. Treatment volume increases significantly under all three definitions, with no evidence of differential pre-trends; point estimates for buprenorphine prescribing rates range from 5 to 17 percent of pre-treatment means, emerge within one to two quarters, and grow monotonically thereafter. Our design does not separately identify changes in patient demand and provider behavior, but the increase in unique prescribers is consistent with a provider-side response. The response is concentrated among advanced practice providers, Medicaid patients, and counties with pre-existing buprenorphine infrastructure; counties with little baseline prescribing show no response. Local mortality information acts as a determinant of treatment volume, with effects comparable in magnitude to major legislative interventions aimed at expanding treatment, but appear only where prescribing capacity already exists.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2013至2023年合成阿片类药物地理扩散的准自然实验，估计县级合成阿片类药物过量死亡冲击对丁丙诺啡治疗处方量的因果效应。通过倾向得分匹配的双重差分模型，发现死亡率冲击显著增加了治疗量（相当于处理前均值的5-17%），效应在1-2个季度内出现并持续增长，且集中于具有既有处方基础设施的县。
AI.research_question: 县级合成阿片类药物过量死亡冲击对丁丙诺啡治疗处方量有何因果效应？
AI.motivation: 阿片类药物使用障碍的丁丙诺啡处方量远低于过量危机的规模，需要理解本地死亡率信息是否以及如何推动治疗供给的扩张，以指导政策干预。
AI.theoretical_framework: 准自然实验理论；差分之差（DID）识别策略；供给端响应理论（提供者行为）
AI.method: 使用IQVIA纵向处方理赔数据与国家生命统计系统死亡率数据，采用倾向得分匹配的差分之差估计量，基于三种互补的暴露测量指标（合成阿片类药物地理扩散的时间差异）进行分析。
AI.findings: 三种暴露定义下治疗量均显著增加，点估计为处理前均值的5%-17%；效应在1-2个季度内出现并单调增长；无差异化前趋势证据。效应集中于高级执业提供者、医疗补助患者和具有既有丁丙诺啡基础设施的县；基线处方量低的县无响应。独特处方医师数量的增加表明存在供给端响应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次以因果识别框架估计本地死亡率信息对治疗供给的影响，揭示了"死亡率冲击-供给响应"机制中处方能力的调节作用，表明当地死亡率信息是治疗量的重要决定因素且与传统大型立法干预的效果相当。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于治疗能力建设的启示：单纯暴露于死亡率冲击不足以引发供给响应，需要预先建设处方基础设施（如高级执业提供者网络）才能有效利用危机信号扩大治疗规模。
